name: Běh na Kraví horu
location: Kraví hora, Teplice nad Metují, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Kraví hora is a public mass-start hill race held in the picturesque setting of Kraví hora in Teplice nad Metují. The race is part of the hill-running series and challenges athletes with a demanding climb and beautiful views. It has a long-standing tradition and is popular with runners who want to test their strength on mountain terrain. The event is organised by Redpoint Teplice nad Metují, which ensures high-quality organisation and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: A demanding mass-start hill race
Picturesque setting of Kraví hora in Teplice nad Metují
Part of the hill-running series and hill-running league
additional: The race takes place on urban and hilly terrain. Registration and results are managed using professional chip timing. Parking and travel information are available on the website.

name: Zátopkova pětka
location: Stadion Emila Zátopka, Kopřivnice, Czech Republic
description: Zátopka’s Five is a traditional running race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club in Kopřivnice. The race takes place on the cinder track at Emil Zátopek Stadium and is part of the Lašská Running League. It is open to the general public and offers the opportunity to run on a quality athletics track in a pleasant sporting atmosphere. The race has a long tradition and is popular with runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Race on the cinder track at Emil Zátopek Stadium
Part of the Lašská Running League
Pleasant atmosphere and quality athletics facilities
additional: The race is part of the Lašská Running League and is open to adults and young people. It is organized by Atletický klub Emila Zátopka Kopřivnice, z.s. Registration takes place online via the official entry form. The club also has active sections for children and young people, with their own contacts and coaches. The previous edition documented in the sources took place in October 2025 and started in three waves. Details about registration or the entry fee for the 2026 edition have not been confirmed in the cited sources.

name: Běh Heulosem - memoriál Jiřího Šmrhy
location: Lesopark Heulos, Jihlava, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: The Heulos Run – Jiří Šmrha Memorial is a traditional running race held in Heulos Forest Park in Jihlava. The race offers various categories and distances for men, women, veterans, juniors, youth and children, with colour-coded circuits along the park’s paths and trails. The event has a long history dating back to 1977 and is part of the Vysočina Runners series. It starts in the afternoon at the Na Stoupách athletics stadium, and its courses are suitable for a wide range of runners, from the youngest participants to veterans.
course_highlights: Colour-coded circuits along the paths and trails of Heulos Forest Park
Various distances, from 300 m for the youngest participants to 9 km for men and veterans
Start and finish at the Na Stoupách athletics stadium in Jihlava
additional: Categories include men, women, veterans, juniors, youth and children, with different race distances. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, and young participants receive medals and prizes. This is the 49th edition, supported by the statutory city of Jihlava and the Czech Sports Office. The race is open to the general public, offers trail courses in nature, and is part of the Vysočina running cup. The date is 16 October 2026.

name: Gladiator Race Praha
location: Přírodní park Čihadla, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Gladiator Race Prague is a challenging obstacle race set in Čihadla Nature Park on the outskirts of Prague. The race combines relatively flat running sections with water, mud, and challenging obstacles, including a net above a water sluice. This ninth edition brings a unique atmosphere, new challenges, and the camaraderie that participants have come to love. Various race categories are available for adults, children, and dogs, making the event appealing to a wide range of participants.
course_highlights: Čihadla Nature Park, with a combination of relatively flat running sections
Challenging obstacles, including a net above a water sluice
Plenty of water and mud on a varied running course
additional: Mass start in waves of up to 50 participants. The race is timed using wristband chips, with online results. Facilities and services include changing rooms, baggage storage, parking, medical service, toilets, showers, catering, race photos and video, sportswear and footwear sales, and a Gladiator Race photo wall. Race capacity is 2,000 places. Categories: ORIGINAL: 6+ km and 30+ obstacles; NIGHT: 3+ km and 15+ obstacles; RUN: 4+ km and 20+ obstacles; KIDS: 1–2 km and 10–12 obstacles; DOG: 3+ km and 15+ obstacles. Starts are in waves of up to 50 participants; capacity across all categories is 2,000 places.

name: Půlmaraton Český les
location: Nemanice, Český les, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 500 Kč předem / 600 Kč na místě (21 km), 300 Kč předem / 400 Kč na místě (7 km)
description: The Český les Half Marathon is a traditional trail race held amid the picturesque nature of the Český les in the village of Nemanice. The event offers two routes: 21 km with 520 m of elevation gain and 7 km with 80 m of elevation gain. Both run through beautiful countryside, and GPX routes are available to download. The longer route awards overall winners and age-group winners, while the shorter route recognizes the three fastest men and women. The start and finish are in Nemanice, with parking available at the start.
course_highlights: 21 km route with 520 m of elevation gain through the Český les
7 km route with 80 m of elevation gain, suitable for fast runners
Start and finish in Nemanice, with parking at the event venue
additional: Parking is available at the start and finish. On the 21 km route, overall winners and 10 age categories for men and women are recognized. On the 7 km route, the three fastest men and three fastest women are awarded. GPX routes for the race are available to download. A trail race with downloadable GPX routes, registration, and categories for men and women; the race is part of the Trail Running Cup series.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (11) – říjnový
location: Praha 4-Braník, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY is a regular running race in Prague’s Braník district, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava. The race is part of the 16th edition of the running league, where runners can compare themselves with others and with their own previous performances. The course is certified, and the 10 km distance gives runners the opportunity to achieve the qualifying time for the Czech Championships. After the race, enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, refreshments and an awards ceremony for the top runners.
course_highlights: A pleasant, fast course along the Vltava in Prague’s Braník district
Course measured by a certified course measurer
Opportunity to achieve the qualifying time for the Czech Championships in the 10 km race
additional: Registration from 18:00; 10 km starts at 19:00 and 5 km at 19:05. Refreshments and an awards ceremony for the top runners after the race. Luggage storage is available in the organisers’ tent. Recommended parking: P+R Nádraží Braník; public transport: trams and buses. Free sports drink after the race. The race is part of a league offering rewards for top-performing and loyal runners, including medals and prizes from partners. Registration is through the website. Winners and regular runners can win prizes; the race is part of a series of races in Prague.

name: Běh kolem Ameriky
location: Lesní park Amerika, Písek, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Běh kolem Ameriky (Run Around Amerika) is the oldest forest running race in the Czech Republic and the third-oldest running race overall. It has been held since 1925 in the Amerika Forest Park in Písek. This off-road race has a history spanning more than 100 editions and offers a challenging 10.4 km course that has evolved over the years. It is popular with runners and local residents and is known for its history and atmosphere in a natural setting. It is organized by Atletika Písek, z.s., and is internationally recognized thanks to partnerships with towns in England and Germany.
course_highlights: Forest terrain in Amerika nature park
A 10.4 km course with historical significance
A traditional race with more than 100 years of history
additional: The race takes place in Amerika Forest Park in Písek and is the oldest off-road running race in the Czech Republic. It is organized by Atletika Písek, z.s. The race has a rich history, with several categories, and is internationally recognized. The 100th anniversary edition will take place in 2026. In the past, the race was interrupted several times (1942, 2020). The oldest forest running race in the Czech Republic, an off-road course, the 100th anniversary edition in 2026.

name: ČEZ RunTour Pardubice
location: Velké pardubické závodiště, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: ČEZ RunTour Pardubice is a family-friendly running event offering seven different races for all ages and ability levels. With distances ranging from 500 metres for the youngest runners to a half marathon, everyone can find their own challenge. The race takes place at the Velká pardubická racecourse and, alongside the sporting experience, offers a varied programme for the whole family. Participants receive a race pack and contribute to charity. The atmosphere is friendly and welcoming to both recreational and elite runners.
course_highlights: Distances include 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km, plus children’s races of 500 and 1,000 m
Start and finish at the Velká pardubická racecourse, with its unique atmosphere
Refreshment stations along the course; at least two on the half-marathon route
additional: The race offers a special emergency medical service phone line during the event. Every runner receives a gymsack with gifts from partners. Children receive a Lidl race pack, and there is a supervised kids’ corner. Pacers are on the course to help runners achieve their target times. Refreshments are available at the finish for children’s races, with refreshment stations on the longer routes. The event includes multiple distances, participant medals, refreshment stations, changing rooms, showers, medical support and post-race photography.

name: Běh podél Halštrova
location: Pramen Halštrova, Aš, Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic
description: The Run Along the Halštrov is a traditional race organised by the Jasan Aš Ski Club. It takes place in October near the source of the Halštrov. The race offers a running experience in the beautiful natural surroundings of Aš and the surrounding area, suitable for active athletes and runners looking for a challenge. Jasan Aš is known for its long-standing tradition and support for running activities in the region.
course_highlights: The course follows the source of the Halštrov through a natural setting
Beautiful views and forest terrain around Aš
The race is part of Jasan Aš’s autumn running calendar
additional: The event marks the end of the running season, offers refreshments at the finish, and is open to the general public, including children.

name: Od radnice k radnici
location: Náchod, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
organizer: Okresní sdružení České unie sportu Náchod
description: From Town Hall to Town Hall is a traditional children’s running race organized by the Náchod District Association of the Czech Union of Sport. In 2026, the event will take place for the 7th time, offering several age categories for children, with distances ranging from 150 to 1,200 meters. The race is intended primarily for young runners and encourages children’s participation in sport in the Náchod region. Starts begin at 9:00 a.m. and proceed by age category. The event is part of the wider ČUS sports program in the region.
course_highlights: Categories range from the youngest children (born in 2021 or later) to older pupils (born in 2011–2012)
Distances from 150 m to 1,200 m, adapted to age
Starts are organized by category, according to a schedule running from 9:00 to 10:25
additional: The race is divided into categories by year of birth, with a precise start schedule. Results from previous editions are available online. The event is part of the wider Czech Union of Sport program in the Náchod region. It takes place as part of the regional sports calendar; registration is via sportchallenge.cz, and it is suitable for all age groups.

name: Silniční běh Hronov-Náchod
location: Radnice, Hronov, Náchod, Czech Republic
description: The Hronov–Náchod Road Run is a traditional race with a long history, connecting the towns of Hronov and Náchod. It starts at Hronov Town Hall and finishes at Náchod Town Hall. The race gives runners of all levels the chance to enjoy a beautiful course through picturesque surroundings. It is popular with locals and visitors alike and creates a friendly sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Road course connecting the towns of Hronov and Náchod
Start and finish at the town halls of both towns
Picturesque surroundings in Eastern Bohemia
additional: Start at 11:00. The course includes asphalt and cobbled roads. The race is open to the general public.

name: Malá křivoklátská
location: Křivoklát, Rakovník, Czech Republic
description: Malá křivoklátská is a traditional forest run with a long history dating back to 1973. It takes place in the picturesque valley of the Rakovnický Stream below Křivoklát Castle. The main race is 6,000 metres long and consists of two laps over gently undulating terrain, combining forest trails, paved roads and a ford across the stream. Children can take part in a 600-metre schoolchildren’s race on a flat course at the Kolečko sports ground. Race facilities are at the Kolečko sports ground, which belongs to Sokol Křivoklát, the event organiser.
course_highlights: Forest run in the Rakovnický Stream valley below Křivoklát Castle
The 6,000 m main course consists of two laps, with elevation changes and a ford across the stream
Flat 600 m schoolchildren’s course at the Kolečko sports ground
additional: Race facilities and the start/finish are at the Kolečko sports ground. The main race has a mass start, and the course crosses footbridges and a ford over the Rakovnický Stream. The schoolchildren’s race is a 600 m loop at Kolečko, run over 1–3 laps depending on age. The course is measurable and comparable with previous editions dating back to 1975. The course is set in a natural environment; registration and further information are probably available on the website. The course includes forest and urban sections, and the main race consists of two 3,000 m laps.

name: Běh okolo Lemberka
location: Jablonné v Podještědí, Liberec, Czech Republic
organizer: Sportovní klub ZŠ Jablonné v Podještědí
description: Běh okolo Lemberka is a traditional autumn running race held near the chapel by Markvartický Pond, between Jablonné v Podještědí and Lvová. The race offers various distances, from children’s categories to adult 5 km and 10 km races, including relays. The course starts on the green hiking trail, and the race is part of the Českolipská District Running League. Participants have access to limited changing facilities, and category winners receive diplomas and prizes.
course_highlights: Courses follow the green hiking trail between Jablonné v Podještědí and Lvová
Distances range from 50 m for children to 10,000 m for adults and veterans
The race is part of the Českolipská District Running League – For the Českolipský deník Cup
additional: Registration from 8:30 a.m. at the start and finish area. Limited men’s and women’s changing facilities are available in a tent near the start. The first three finishers in each category receive a diploma and a prize. Veteran categories are offered only over 10,000 m. The race is part of the Českolipská District Running League – For the Českolipský deník Cup. Course distances range from 300 m to 10,000 m; veteran categories, relays and a public run are available. Registration from 8:30 a.m.; start at 9:30 a.m. Limited changing facilities are available in a tent.

name: Malá Kunratická
location: Kunratický les, Praha 4-Kunratice, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Malá Kunratická is a traditional running race in Kunratice Forest in Prague, now in its 23rd edition. The race offers a 3-kilometre course starting in the southern part of the forest near Kunratický Mill. It is open to the general public and is part of a sports and entertainment afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, where participants and visitors can try various activities such as slacklining and disc golf. The race is scheduled to start in the morning, making for an enjoyable sporting get-together in nature.
course_highlights: A 3-kilometre course in Kunratice Forest
Start in the southern part of the forest near Kunratický Mill
A run in a natural setting, with the option to enjoy additional sports activities in Nové Roztyly Park
additional: The race is part of a sports and entertainment afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, with activities including slacklining, sack races, a spider climbing frame and disc golf. The race includes various categories and is part of the SABZO series, with a cross-country course in the natural setting of Krč Forest.

name: Heimstaden Havířovská desítka
location: Náměstí Republiky, Havířov, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 290 Kč - 700 Kč (on the day), 4000 Kč - 5000 Kč (team categories)
description: The Heimstaden Havířovská Desítka is a traditional running race held in the centre of Havířov, offering several categories and distances for the general public, including children’s races and relays. The course follows two laps through the city centre, with the start and finish at Republic Square, where fans and spectators add to the atmosphere. The race has a charitable purpose and supports athletes with disabilities from the HSC Moravia club. The 10th-anniversary edition attracted a record number of participants and prominent sporting figures, including Pavel Maslák. Registration is also available on race day, and the event supports corporate well-being and teamwork.
course_highlights: 10 km run through the centre of Havířov (2 laps)
The course runs through the city centre, with the finish at Republic Square
Professional electronic chip timing
additional: Registration is available until 11:00 on race day at the Lučina Cultural Centre. The race is designated as the Czech Republic Veterans’ Road Running Championship. Race packs can be collected at the company’s headquarters. The race supports athletes with disabilities from the HSC Moravia club, with part of the entry fee going towards their activities. Corporate teams are offered a 12-week training plan and online consultations with a coach. Refreshments are provided on the course and after the race. A financial prize is awarded for breaking the course record. Race over 2 laps, prize money, discounts for locals and tenants, relay race, corporate categories, online training support

name: Plesenská 7 Plesná – Skalná
location: Sportovní hala, Skalná, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné: 100 Kč = pomoc tam, kde je potřeba

description: Plesenská sedmička is a charity running race held as part of a series of seven races in different towns. The fifth race will take place in Skalná over a course of approximately 5.2 km, following forest trails and paved roads. The start and finish are at the sports hall in Skalná. The race takes place in the evening in low visibility, so a headlamp or another light source is mandatory. Proceeds from the entry fees go to charity, and the atmosphere is friendly and encourages runners to push their limits.
course_highlights: Course length: approx. 5.2 km
Surface: forest trails and paved roads
Start and finish at the sports hall in Skalná
additional: Registration opens at 19:00 on race day. The race takes place in all weather conditions and may be cancelled only if a risk of danger in the forest is officially declared. The results are expected to be announced at approximately 21:00 after the race. Refreshments, including homemade cakes and drinks, will be available. Each race has a sponsor who prepares a prize package for one runner; the winner is drawn from among the participants. Registration opens at 19:00. Parking is available by the sports hall in Skalná; refreshments, including homemade cakes and drinks, will be available at the venue. The race takes place in all weather conditions, and participation is at your own risk.

name: NN NIGHT RUN České Budějovice
location: Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., České Budějovice, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: BELLIS RUN proti rakovině prsu - 5 Km

description: NN NIGHT RUN České Budějovice is one of the largest running events in České Budějovice, held in Přemysl Otakar II Square. This night run offers the atmosphere of the city illuminated by headlamps and is open to runners of all ages and abilities. More than 2,000 runners take part each year, from beginners to experienced racers. The programme also includes children’s races and charity runs, alongside the main 10 km race.
course_highlights: A night run through České Budějovice, with the city illuminated by headlamps
The main race course is 10 km long, with a 90-minute time limit
Children’s races and a charity run against breast cancer over shorter distances
additional: The programme includes children’s races, a charity run against breast cancer, a 2 × 5 km relay and the main 10 km night run. Race packs are available from 13:00, and the bag drop and changing rooms are open from 14:00. The event also features a programme of performances, warm-ups, sports product testing, a photo booth, tattoos and a raffle. The time limit is 90 minutes for the main race and 75 minutes for the charity run. According to the organisers, online registration is open until 13 October 2026 at 18:00, or on site subject to capacity. The main race has a 90-minute time limit; BELLIS RUN has a 75-minute limit and can also be completed as a brisk walk.

name: Ultramaraton Zapomenuté hory
location: Areál Račího údolí, Uhelná, Czech Republic
description: The Forgotten Mountains Ultramarathon is an autumn trail race that takes you along superb mountain trails to the most remote parts of the Rychlebské Mountains. The routes pass through deep valleys, remote ridges and beautiful viewpoints, including the highest peak of the neighbouring Góry Bialskie in Poland. The race offers three route options of varying distances and difficulty, suitable for experienced runners seeking wild nature and unforgettable experiences. The event also includes an evening programme of talks and entertainment. We look forward to welcoming everyone who wants to discover these forgotten mountains as few have before.
course_highlights: The routes follow superb mountain trails along the main border ridge and side ridges of the Rychlebské Mountains
Beautiful views from deserted rocky outcrops, old quarries and mountain meadows around former Sudeten settlements
Very little running on asphalt; the routes are mostly forest trails and footpaths
additional: Registration is closed. The remaining option is to purchase an entry from another participant. Runners are divided into two age categories (up to 39 and 40+). The fee includes a forest fee, map, race number, chip timing, a GPS tracker for the long route, a finisher’s diploma, generous refreshments along the course and hot soup at the finish (vegan and non-vegan options). This year, the gym has changed; alternative accommodation is available in Javorník for 150 Kč per night. The start and finish are at the Račí údolí grounds. Registration for the race is closed; participation is only possible by buying an entry from another runner.

name: Krumlovský běh
location: Orlovna, Rakšice, Moravský Krumlov, Czech Republic
description: The Krumlov Run is a road race held in Moravský Krumlov, in Rakšice at the Orlovna complex. It offers courses of 10.9 km for men and 4.5 km for women, on asphalt and nearby roads. The race is suitable for recreational runners and families with children, as it also includes children’s races and a run for health. It is organized by AC Moravský Krumlov under the direction of Mgr. Zuzana Marková. Registration is available on a separate page, and the race is part of the Český běh running series.
course_highlights: The courses run on asphalt and nearby roads
Course distances: 10.9 km (men) and 4.5 km (women)
Includes a run for health, a recreational run, and children’s races
additional: Registration is available on the external page http://registrace.atletika-mk.cz. The race is part of the Český běh running series and is suitable for the general public, including children. It is organized by AC Moravský Krumlov; the contact person is Mgr. Zuzana Marková. The race takes place in Rakšice near the Orlovna complex. Registration: http://registrace.atletika-mk.cz.

name: Kros Českým rájem
location: Skokov, Český ráj, Czech Republic
description: Kros Českým rájem is a trail race in a picturesque, little-known corner of the Bohemian Paradise. It offers a varied, undulating course among sandstone rocks, woodland paths and white-sand tracks. The race is 100% trail and is suitable for nature lovers and fans of technical running. The start and finish are in the village of Skokovy, less than an hour from Prague. Race day also features children’s races and a side programme, including a children’s corner.
course_highlights: 99% of the course follows woodland trails and passes among sandstone rocks
The route runs over white sand, grass and pine needles, with up to 440 m of elevation gain
Picturesque spring forests and technical descents on sandy paths
additional: A children’s corner for ages 3 to 10, with art supplies and a teacher supervising. It opens 30 minutes before the start and closes 5 minutes after the last competitor finishes. There are plenty of toilets, refreshments and restaurants at the start and finish. Family registration is available, with a discount on children’s entry fees. The course is marked, and maps will be available on site. The time limit for completing the shorter course is 2 days and for the longer course 3 days (for orientation). Trail races in nature, children’s races, easy access from Prague, technical courses, varied scenery, registration including gift vouchers.

name: Podzimní Kiosk
location: Tyršovy sady, Šternberk, Czech Republic
description: Podzimní Kiosk is a cross-country race held in Tyršovy sady in Šternberk, offering a 7 km course for men and a 3.5 km course for women. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners Grand Prix and gives runners the chance to test themselves in pleasant autumn surroundings. The course crosses mixed terrain, making for an engaging and dynamic run for all participants.
course_highlights: A cross-country race in the natural surroundings of Tyršovy sady
A 7 km course for men and a 3.5 km course for women
Part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners Grand Prix
additional: The race takes place at the Kiosk gazebo in Tyršovy sady in Šternberk. It is part of a series of races with various distances and offers the option of taking part on either a trail or road course.

name: Běh Zlínem "Přes valašské kotáry"
location: Stadion Mládeže, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The “Across the Wallachian Hills” run in Zlín is a traditional running race that gives participants the chance to experience the beauty of the Wallachian countryside and enjoy a sporting atmosphere. The race starts at the Youth Stadium, and the route passes through picturesque hills and natural scenery. The organizers focus on high-quality organization and a friendly atmosphere for all participants. The race is part of the year-round Běhy Zlín series, which includes various running events in the region.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Wallachian hills, with picturesque views
Start and finish at the Youth athletics stadium in Zlín
Natural and forest terrain with varied surfaces
additional: The race is part of the year-round Běhy Zlín series, which offers various running events in the region. The organizers provide a friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization. The website also lists other races and a running school for anyone interested in running. The race takes place in the center of Zlín; registration is at the Zlín City Hall. Various age categories are offered, with prizes for the top runners and record holders.

name: PREFA Brněnská 25
location: Olympia park, Modřice, Brno, Czech Republic
organizer: BehejBrno.com, MARATON BRNO z.s., Aleš Čtvrtníček
description: PREFA Brněnská 25 is a traditional road race held in Brno and the surrounding area, running continuously since 1967. It offers several race distances—25 km, 16 km and 8 km—as well as relays, and is open to a wide range of participants, from competitive runners to beginners. The race takes place at Olympia Park near the rope centre in Modřice and is part of the Czech Running Club. The first category starts at 11:00, making it convenient for families and recreational runners to take part.
course_highlights: Road race distances of 25 km, 16 km and 8 km
Start and finish at Olympia Park near the rope centre in Modřice
A traditional race dating back to 1967, held every year except 1968
additional: The race is part of the Czech Running Club project and is open to the general public, including newcomers. Brno runner Karel Fuksa has completed every edition to date. The race is part of the traditional running calendar and is supported by the Czech Athletics Federation. It offers several race distances and relay options, with the start and finish at Olympia Park, on-site registration and bib collection, and the option to watch the race live.

name: Horokros
location: Šumperk, Jeseníky, Czech Republic
description: Horokros is part of the Chlapácký běh series, which offers a challenging cross-country race in the picturesque Jeseníky Mountains near Šumperk. The race is for runners seeking an off-road challenge with varied terrain and natural obstacles. The course is known for its difficulty and beautiful views, attracting both experienced competitors and mountain-running enthusiasts. The Chlapácký běh series recognizes regular participants who complete at least six races in a season. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and push your limits in the unique setting of the Jeseníky Mountains.
course_highlights: Challenging cross-country terrain in the Jeseníky Mountains
Natural obstacles and varied terrain
Beautiful views and a mountain setting
additional: The race is part of the Chlapácký běh series, where competitors who have completed at least 6 races in a season are officially recognized. The race is part of the Chlapácké běhy series and takes place in the Jeseníky Mountains; the exact terrain conditions are not specified.

name: Běh na Žaltman
location: Malé Svatoňovice, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Žaltman is a public uphill race with a mass start, part of the Krakonoš Czech Mountain Running Cup and the East Bohemia Grand Prix series. The race takes place in Malé Svatoňovice in the Hradec Králové Region and offers a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings. The course crosses challenging terrain with significant elevation gain, attracting runners of all levels. The event is a traditional part of the running season and welcomes all athletes and fans of uphill running.
course_highlights: A challenging uphill race with significant elevation gain
The course passes through the scenic countryside around Malé Svatoňovice
Part of the Krakonoš Czech Mountain Running Cup and the East Bohemia Grand Prix series
additional: The race is part of the Krakonoš Czech Mountain Running Cup and East Bohemia Grand Prix series, and is suitable for runners looking for mountain and trail challenges.

name: Běh okolo Rané
location: Rané u Loun, Louny, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh okolo Rané is a race around Raná near Louny in the Ústí nad Labem Region. It offers an 8.5 km course for men and a 4.25 km course for women. The race is part of the Louny Running Cup and gives runners the chance to enjoy a run in natural surroundings with scenic views. The event is suitable for a wide range of runners looking for a quality race with a regional tradition.
course_highlights: 8.5 km course for men and 4.25 km course for women
Natural scenery around Raná near Louny
Part of the Louny Running Cup
additional: The race is part of a running cup; exact registration and entry fee information has not yet been published.

name: Klánovický 1/2maraton
location: Klánovický les, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Klánovice Half Marathon is an off-road half marathon through the beautiful Klánovice Forest in Prague. The race offers a certified 21.0975 km course along forest paths, an educational trail and trails with very little asphalt, with no significant climbs. The event also includes 10 km races, a relay and children’s races, all with convenient facilities and refreshments on the course. It is suitable for nature lovers and trail runners who want to discover the forest’s beautiful corners and enjoy a friendly atmosphere with an accompanying program.
course_highlights: Off-road course along forest and gravel paths with very little asphalt
Certified 21.0975 km half-marathon course with approximately 120 m of elevation gain
The route passes the remains of medieval villages and follows the educational trail through Klánovice Forest
additional: Race numbers can be collected on Saturday, 17 October, from 16:00 to 19:00, and on Sunday, 18 October, up to one hour before the race start, at the sports hall by the Klánovice primary school. There are 6 refreshment stations on the course, and cakes from a local bakery (including gluten-free options) are available at the finish. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available in the covered hall. Childcare for runners’ children is provided at a kindergarten approximately 200 m from the event facilities. Parking is arranged within walking distance; parking is not available at the start. Travel by train or bus is recommended. The race offers refreshments on the course, childcare, massages and other services. Registration is open from 17 October 2026. The event is part of a wider running day with various categories and activities for all age groups.

name: Loučení s oválem
location: Na Příkopě 1159, Frýdek-Místek, Czech Republic
description: Loučení s oválem (Farewell to the Track) is a traditional race organized by Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, held annually since 2000 as the final track event of the season. Originally intended only for young athletes, it added adult categories in 2014, with distances of 1500 m for men and 800 m for women. After a break from 2017 to 2019, the race returned in 2020 with 800 m events for youth and 3000 m for adults. The race takes place at Na Příkopě 1159 in Frýdek-Místek and is a popular event among the region’s athletics community.
course_highlights: Track race on an athletics oval
Categories for youth and adults
Traditional final race of the season since 2000
additional: Venue: Na Příkopě 1159, 738 01 Frýdek-Místek.

name: Mizuno Neon Run Olomouc
location: Výstaviště Flora, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Mizuno Neon Run in Olomouc is a nighttime running event full of colors, lights and fun. It is not a race, but an experience for all participants. This neon run offers a wild and crazy glowing experience that celebrates the joy of movement and having fun together. Get ready to shine and enjoy an unforgettable atmosphere at the Výstaviště Flora grounds in Olomouc.
course_highlights: A nighttime run full of colors and neon lights
A fun, informal atmosphere with no timekeeping
An event suitable for all ages and levels of running ability
additional: The event is not a race and no times are recorded. It takes place at night with neon lighting and fun features. The route runs through the Výstaviště Flora grounds in Olomouc. Organized by Eventmedia s.r.o. The event includes neon gear, a live performance, the FénixRun charity run and various categories, including children and family teams. The run is not timed, and registration is available online and on site.

name: Tálínská desítka
location: Tálín, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Tálínská desítka is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Tálín, now being held for the 23rd year. The race is open to the general public and offers an opportunity for athletes of all ages, including recreational runners. The event supports community life and sporting activities in the municipality and its surroundings. The race is scheduled to start on October 24, 2026, at 12:00 in Tálín.
course_highlights: A traditional running race with a long history
Held in the municipality of Tálín in the South Bohemian Region
Suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels
additional: The race is part of the municipality of Tálín’s sporting events, which support sporting activities and community life. The event is also suitable for athletes with disabilities. It is organized by the municipality of Tálín in cooperation with the Triatlon Team Tálín and Galaxy Cyklošvec Písek sports clubs. The race is 9.5 km long; results and participants from 2026. It is traditionally held in autumn.

name: Třebíčský maraton
location: Třebíč, Vysočina Region, Czech Republic
description: Třebíč Marathon 2026 invites you to run through the picturesque lanes of Třebíč’s historic centre, where you can enjoy the atmosphere of its UNESCO sites, including the iconic Basilica of St. Procopius. Choose from the marathon, half marathon, 10K, or children’s races—offering a great sporting experience for everyone. Look forward to refreshment stations along the course and at the finish, followed by a chance to relax and enjoy the AfterRun party, the perfect way to end the day. Come and enjoy an unforgettable day full of movement and a great atmosphere in the heart of Třebíč.
course_highlights: Picturesque lanes in Třebíč’s historic centre
The atmosphere of UNESCO sites, including the Basilica of St. Procopius
Refreshment stations along the course and a great atmosphere
additional: The entry fee must be paid within 14 days of registration; otherwise, the registration will be cancelled. The organiser notes that race packs are available in limited quantities and may not be available for on-site registration. Online registration and payment are available only until 20 October 2026 at 24:00; after that, registration is available only on site. Races include the marathon, half marathon, 10 km, and children’s races; registration is open until 20 October 2026; entry fees range from CZK 100 to CZK 1,400, depending on the category and registration date.

name: Slapy Trail Maniacs
location: Cholín u Slapské přehrady, Slapy, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 550 Kč / 33 km, 600 Kč / 47 km, 700 Kč / 61 km (při včasné registraci), vyšší ceny po 30.09.2025

tiers.description: 950 Kč zaplacených po 30. 9. 2025 a na místě.

description: Slapy Trail Maniacs is a challenging trail race in the picturesque surroundings of the Slapy Reservoir in the Central Bohemian Region. It offers three courses of 61 km, 47 km, and 33 km, crossing rugged terrain with significant elevation gain. The race is suited to experienced runners looking to test their abilities in nature and earn points toward their UTMB Index. The race hub is in the village of Cholín; start times vary by course and take place on Saturday. The organizers also provide accommodation and refreshments during the race.
course_highlights: 61 km course with 2,300 m of ascent and 2,400 m of descent
47 km course with 1,850 m of ascent and descent
Scenic routes around the Slapy Reservoir with technical sections
additional: The 61 km race starts at 7:00 in Nečín, the 47 km race starts at 9:00 in Cholín, and the 33 km race starts at 12:00 by the Živohošť Bridge. The race cutoff is 23:00 in Cholín. Accommodation is available for 250 Kč per night in a bed, or on a sleeping mat in the common room. Registration changes are free until 12 October 2025; after that, a 100 Kč fee applies. The terrain includes trails, off-trail sections, rocky areas, and climbs. The race offers accommodation, set start times and cutoffs, and contributes to the UTMB Index.

name: Olomoucký kros
location: Stadion AK Olomouc, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Olomouc Cross is a traditional cross-country race organized by AK Olomouc and held at the AK Olomouc stadium. The race features a challenging 9 km off-road course that tests runners’ endurance and strength. The main category starts at 10:15, and the race is part of the official Czech Running calendar under the Czech Athletics Federation. The organizers invite runners of all levels to take part in this popular event in Olomouc.
course_highlights: 9 km cross-country course on off-road terrain
Start and finish at the AK Olomouc stadium
Challenging terrain suited to endurance runners
additional: The race is held at the AK Olomouc stadium; registration and further details are not specified.

name: Skalička run
location: Skalička, South Moravia, Czech Republic
description: Skalička Run is an off-road running event set in the picturesque valley of the Lubě stream in South Moravia. It offers three interconnected routes of 7, 13 and 22 kilometres, running mostly through forests and meadows along hiking trails and cycle paths. The route is gently undulating, with a few hills, and is suitable for recreational runners and those who prefer a relaxed pace and want to enjoy the beautiful countryside and colourful autumn scenery. The course is well marked, and the stream crossings are shallow and easy to get across. During the race, it is possible to switch to a shorter distance.
course_highlights: Off-road route running mostly through forests and meadows, away from paved roads
The longest route is 22 km, with three interconnected loops and a moderate elevation gain of 436 m
Autumn run over fallen leaves, with a well-marked course and shallow stream crossings
additional: During the race, it is possible to switch to a shorter distance. The course is thoroughly marked with arrows and trail ribbons. The stream crossings are shallow and can be crossed with dry feet using a footbridge. The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours. Trail running; registration details are not specified; an autumn race with a beautiful natural atmosphere.

name: Leskros Hradečák
location: Hradec Králové, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Leskros Hradečák is part of the Leskros series, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and running in nature. The race offers various running categories, including a half marathon, a 10K, and shorter distances for children and young people. It also includes canicross categories for different age groups and experience levels. The race takes place in the beautiful forest surroundings of Hradec Králové and is suitable for the whole family, including beginner runners.
course_highlights: GELOREN and MIZUNO forest routes of 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km)
Canicross distances from 1 km for children up to 4 km for experienced competitors
Aid stations along the course and at the finish, chip timing, and a unique finisher’s medal
additional: The entry fee includes a unique finisher’s medal, a Speedcup cup, chip timing, drinks, refreshments, a race photo, gifts from partners, and parking arrangements. Canicross equipment can be borrowed by prior arrangement. Categories for children and adults, including junior and non-competitive categories for beginners. Aid stations along the course and at the finish, prize money for elite canicross competitors. Trail running and canicross, categories for children and adults, registration opens in December, the event includes charity activities and the option to borrow equipment.

name: KEEN Prague Park Race – Prokopské údolí
location: Prokopské údolí, Praha, Czech Republic
description: KEEN Prague Park Race in Prokopské údolí is a running race in beautiful natural surroundings within sight of Prague. The race offers a unique atmosphere and a course through a picturesque valley on both natural and paved paths. Prokopské údolí is an ideal place for nature-loving runners who want to take on a sporting challenge in peaceful, scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: The course follows paved and unpaved paths in Prokopské údolí
Natural terrain with picturesque views and scenic sections
A race near the city of Prague, with the atmosphere of a nature park
additional: The course is accessible as part of the race; no wave divisions or capacity limits are specified. After registering, participants will receive payment instructions by email. The race is part of the Prague Park Race series, which also includes races in Průhonice Park, Divoká Šárka and Konopiště. Trail running, multiple races in various parks in Prague, online registration, pre-race runs and events featuring KEEN shoe testing

name: Běhej Valachy
location: Velké Karlovice, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: Běhej Valachy is a traditional running race held in the picturesque setting of Velké Karlovice and the surrounding area in the Beskydy Mountains. The race gives athletes of all ages and fitness levels the chance to test themselves in beautiful countryside, with views of the hills of Wallachia. Since 2013, it has been part of the Valachy Tour series, which offers attractive prizes and prize money. Come and enjoy a run in the heart of Wallachia and experience the unique atmosphere of this sporting celebration.
course_highlights: Picturesque valley of Velké Karlovice and the surrounding area
Running in the Beskydy countryside among the hills of Wallachia
Traditional race with a long history, part of the series since 2013
additional: The race is part of the Valachy Tour series, which offers events in various disciplines for all ages and fitness levels. The organizers are MORAVIA EVENTS s.r.o. and BESKYDY OUTDOOR s.r.o. The race director can be reached at +420 602 275 790. The race routes follow paved roads and forest trails, with the option to relax in thermal pools. Registration opens at 8:00, and races start at 9:30. Course maps are available on mapy.cz.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka Ostrava
location: Ostrava, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Golden Emil Zátopek Marathon Ostrava is a prestigious running event held on a fast, certified course in Ostrava. The event offers a marathon, half marathon, 10 km race and mixed team race, and welcomes every runner, whether a beginner or an experienced athlete. The atmosphere is professional, with world-class elite runners and extensive facilities including refreshments, music and sports shopping. The course is one loop, with the start and finish at the famous Vítkovice Stadium, where Emil Zátopek set his records.
course_highlights: Fast, certified course in Ostrava
Start and finish at Vítkovice Stadium
The chance to run alongside the world’s elite runners
additional: Race entry can also be purchased on-site in cash or by QR code during registration. The race pack includes an original Macron technical T-shirt, a finisher’s medal, refreshments during and after the race, a large expo, and free taping and physiotherapy care. The race takes place on a one-loop course, with partial traffic restrictions in effect during the event from 8:50 to 15:00. The event includes various categories, including relay races, and supports charitable activities. It is held with the support of the City of Ostrava and the Moravian-Silesian Region.

name: Moravská Sázava
location: Zábřeh na Moravě, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic

tiers.description: Startovné DVOJIC je stanoveno na 2.000,- Kč

description: Moravská Sázava Ultra 50 is a challenging 50 km ultramarathon that follows the valley of the Moravská Sázava River from Zábřeh through Lázek to the river’s source on Buková hora. The route offers beautiful natural scenery, including Březná Nature Park and the Suchý vrch–Buková hora Nature Reserve, where the race also finishes. The total elevation change is 698 metres of descent and 1,369 metres of ascent. The race base is at Horský Resort Buková Hora, where runners can rest and refresh themselves after finishing. The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge beyond a standard marathon but who do not want to take on an extreme 100 km mountain course.
course_highlights: The route follows the course of the Moravská Sázava River
Březná Nature Park and the Suchý vrch–Buková hora Nature Reserve
Finish at the summit of Buková hora, with 1,369 m of ascent
additional: Participants can hand in their own refreshment bags to be transported to the aid stations. Support is available only at aid stations. Check-in is from 10:00 at the start in the Zábřeh skatepark. Aid stations also serve as relay handover points. Soup with pasta is provided at the finish. Results are recorded both electronically and manually; the relay baton is a GPS tracker with online tracking. Participants can hand in labelled bags for the aid stations at the start. Personal support is allowed only at aid stations.

name: NN Night Run Olomouc
location: Výstaviště Flora, Olomouc, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: BELLIS RUN proti rakovině prsu - 5 Km

description: NN Night Run Olomouc is the largest running event in Olomouc, held at the Flora Exhibition Centre. The event offers a 10 km night run, a 2 × 5 km relay, a 5 km charity run, and a 3 km family run, including children’s races. It brings an unforgettable atmosphere, a varied programme of activities, and support for charitable projects. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and can enjoy running through the city at night by the light of headlamps.
course_highlights: Night run through Olomouc, with an atmosphere illuminated by headlamps
Distances ranging from 300 m for children to a 10 km night run
Bellis Run charity race supporting the fight against breast cancer
additional: Registration and race-pack collection take place from 13:00 to 17:30, depending on the race. A baggage drop and changing rooms are available. After the race, participants can enjoy activities including a photo booth, face painting, a bouncy castle, and testing and sales of running equipment and nutritional supplements. Entry can be transferred to another participant online or on site for a fee. All participants receive a commemorative medal at the finish. The race facilities are at the Flora Exhibition Centre. Online registration closes on 19 October 2026 at 18:00; on-site registration is subject to available capacity. The time limit for the main race is 90 minutes.

name: Běh kolem Asuánu
location: Jižní konec retenční nádrže Asuán, Jinonice, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Aswan is a traditional cross-country and trail race held on the embankment of the Aswan retention reservoir in Prague 5-Jinonice. It offers courses of varying lengths for all age groups, from the youngest children to adults, over gently rolling terrain with a natural surface, finishing on an asphalt straight. The race is organized by Atletika Stodůlky z.s. and is accessible only on foot from nearby stops. The entry fee is voluntary, enabling broad participation by runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Gently rolling course with a natural surface
Asphalt finishing straight
Loops around the Aswan retention reservoir in Prague 5-Jinonice
additional: The start and race office are at the southern end of the Aswan retention reservoir, accessible only on foot from the Ovčí hájek and Galerie Butovice bus stops and the Volcano complex. Categories are divided by age, with course distances ranging from 250 m for the youngest participants to 3600 m for men. The entry fee is voluntary. The start and race office are at the southern end of the reservoir; they can only be reached on foot. Information about the 2026 edition has not been confirmed in the available sources.

name: Kobeřický půlmaraton
location: Kobeřice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Kobeřice Half Marathon is a traditional athletics race organized by TJ Sokol Kobeřice, with a long history dating back to 1996. The race is part of the Moravia and Silesia Championships and attracts runners from across the Czech Republic and abroad. The course offers an opportunity for both experienced and recreational runners and is part of a series of public races organized by the athletics club in Kobeřice. The organizers emphasize supporting young people and developing running traditions in the region.
course_highlights: A traditional half-marathon course in Kobeřice, with a history dating back to 1996
Part of the Moravia and Silesia Half Marathon Championships
Natural and urban sections suitable for runners of different levels
additional: The race is part of a series of three public runs organized by TJ Sokol Kobeřice, including the Winter Run through Kobeřice and the Kobeřice Twenty. The athletics club focuses on young people and has a long-standing tradition in the region. In 1998, the half marathon was included in the Moravia and Silesia Championships; in 2005 and 2009, the half-marathon and veterans' championships were held here. The race is part of the Moravian-Silesian Running Cup and the Prajzsko-Opava Running League, and has a history and tradition in the region.

name: Běh metropole MČ Praha 6
location: Park Ladronka, Praha 6, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Běh Metropole is a series of public running races held in various districts of Prague, aiming to promote a healthy lifestyle and residents’ sense of belonging to their district. The race in Prague 6 takes place in Ladronka Park and is part of the series, where each participant represents their district and contributes to the competition for Prague’s most athletic district. The event is suitable for all ages, including children, seniors, and people with disabilities. The organizers prepare original medals and a welcoming atmosphere for all runners.
course_highlights: Race in Ladronka Park in Prague 6
Running series across Prague’s districts
Promoting a healthy lifestyle and community spirit
additional: Each participant represents their district based on their permanent place of residence and contributes to the districts’ scores in the series. The organizers prepare special medals for each category as a keepsake from the race. Race series with multiple events; terrain details not specified; registration information on the website.

name: Jilemnický kros
location: Všesportovní Hraběnka, Jilemnice, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: The Jilemnice Cross-Country Race is a traditional autumn running race in Jilemnice, held at the Hraběnka All-Sports Complex. The race offers 5- and 10-kilometre courses, mainly along forest roads and paths that are clearly marked and suitable for trail running. The Olda Hrubý Memorial commemorates the race’s founder and attracts runners in all categories. The mass start takes place at 10:00, allowing everyone to share the experience of running in the beautiful autumn surroundings of the Krkonoše Mountains.
course_highlights: The routes follow forest roads and paths in the Hraběnka complex
Two main courses: 5 km for women and 10 km for men
Clearly marked and maintained running routes on natural surfaces
additional: All categories start together in a mass start. The routes are available and marked year-round. The Hraběnka complex offers four running routes of 3, 5, 7 and 10 km, marked with coloured symbols on trees. The race is a memorial to Olda Hrubý and is intended for juniors, adults and veterans. The race is part of local sporting activities, with results available via Strava and other online platforms. The event is open to all age groups and promotes an active lifestyle.

name: Smaltovaný bažant
location: Bažantnice v Heřmanově Městci, Heřmanův Městec, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Enamelled Pheasant is a traditional race organized by the Heřmanův Městec Running Club, held in the beautiful surroundings of the pheasantry in Heřmanův Městec. It is the final round of the Mrdice League and gives runners the chance to test themselves over 1,500 metres in a pleasant atmosphere. The event is suitable for all runners looking for a sporting challenge within a friendly club and league.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the pheasantry on natural terrain
A 1,500-metre race serving as the final event of the Mrdice League
The friendly atmosphere of a running club in Heřmanův Městec
additional: The race is part of the Ruler of Mrdice sports league, which includes a series of races and timed training runs throughout the year. The club also holds regular timed runs every Tuesday and other sporting events in the region. The race is part of the Mrdice League; entry is by voluntary contribution. It takes place in the natural surroundings of the pheasantry, and registration and the start list are available online.

name: Podzimní půlmaraton VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
location: Praha 4-Braník, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The VAŠE LIGA Autumn Half Marathon 2026 is a 21.1 km road race taking place on October 28, 2026, in Prague 4-Braník. The course follows the cycle path along the Vltava from Braník to Vrané and back. It is flat and fast, often allowing runners to achieve personal bests. The race offers a relaxed running atmosphere and is suitable for anyone looking to enjoy a pleasant half-marathon in beautiful surroundings. The first category starts at 11:00 on the cycle path by Kempink 2.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course on the cycle path along the Vltava
The course runs from Braník to Vrané and back
Beautiful surroundings and the chance to achieve a personal best
additional: The race starts on the cycle path by Kempink 2 in Prague 4-Braník. The race is organized by VAŠE LIGA; the contact person is Petr Lundák. The course is flat and fast, making it suitable for personal bests. A relaxed running atmosphere is guaranteed. The course is measured by a certified course measurer, and the race uses chip timing. It includes refreshments, a medal, a certificate, a shower, toilets, changing facilities, and the option to withdraw up to 24 hours before the start.

name: Náměšťský tvarůžek
location: Náměšť na Hané, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Náměšťský tvarůžek is a four-year running race in Náměšť na Hané, which is part of the Haná Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Distance Runners. The main race is 9.22 km long and consists of three 2.9 km loops, plus an approach and a run-out. The course runs on asphalt and farm tracks, offering a combination of firm surfaces and natural surroundings. The race is open to different age categories, as well as a recreational run with no age limit, with an emphasis on fair play and participant safety.
course_highlights: Main race: 9.22 km, consisting of three 2.9 km loops
Surface: asphalt and farm tracks
Approach and run-out outside the loop: 518 m in total
additional: Race-day check-in takes place at the venue. Runners must have a chip card with a balance of at least CZK 150, which will be deducted at check-in. The results ceremony will take place at the KVS grounds; results will be published on hanackybeh.cz and liga100.cz. Categories are divided by age and gender, including a recreational run with no age limit. The race offers cash prizes for the top runners, registration is available with a chip card, and the course passes through the scenic surroundings of Náměšť na Hané.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Nepomuk
location: Nepomuk, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Nepomuk is a fun run with no racing, held on October 28. Routes are available for adults and children. Adults run 3.2 km through the town, mostly on asphalt, while children take a shorter route with off-road obstacles. All participants receive a race pack and a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish. The event base is at the local Sokol grounds, with refreshments and a place to leave belongings. The event celebrates the founding of Czechoslovakia and takes place in a friendly atmosphere, with no times or rankings recorded.
course_highlights: Adults run 3.2 km on paved paths and asphalt through the town
Children’s 350 m course features several off-road obstacles near the Sokol hall
Adults run their loop twice; the route passes the polyclinic and housing estate
additional: The race pack includes a race number and gifts from the organizers and partners. All participants receive a medal shaped like the republic at the finish. Sports activity stations are set up for children at the event grounds. Parking is available on nearby streets and in the Sokol hall car park. The event base is at the local Sokol grounds, with refreshments and a place to leave belongings. The event is held every year on October 28 and is open to participants from different continents, with online registration available and a race pack that includes a medal. The route passes through town streets, by the polyclinic and the Sokol hall, with parking available nearby.

name: Provodovský běh
location: Provodov, Provodov-Šonov, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 300 Kč (online registrace), 500 Kč (při registraci na místě)
