description: The Provodov Run is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Provodov in the Zlín Region. The race offers three distances—5, 11 and 21 km—which run mainly along field and forest paths. Shorter age-based courses with free entry are available for children. The event is suitable for the general public and takes place whatever the weather, with an emphasis on safety and fair play.
course_highlights: Trail running mainly along field and forest paths
Three distances of varying difficulty: 5 km, 11 km and 21 km
Children’s courses by age group with free entry
additional: Race registration from 9:00 at Areál mládí and the FC Rak Provodov football pitch. Race starts: 21 km at 11:00, 11 km at 11:05, 5 km at 11:10. Children’s races from 14:00, with age-based categories. Medical supervision provided by members of the Czech Red Cross (ČČK). Entry is free for preschool children and pupils taking part in the children’s races. Each participant runs at their own risk. The organiser reserves the right to make changes or cancel the race in extreme conditions without compensation. Outdoor course; registration online or on site; compliance with road traffic rules and wearing a race number are mandatory. Refreshments and facilities are available at Areál mládí and the FC Rak football pitch.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Březník
location: Údolí Oslavy a Chvojnice, Březník, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: startovné pro dospělé a děti (cena explicitně uvedena na stránce)
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Březník is a fun run with no racing, held on 28 October in the picturesque Oslava and Chvojnice valley. The routes follow paved and forest paths with gentle descents and climbs, ideal for anyone who wants to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia by getting active. Capacity is limited to 20 adults and 30 children, so early online registration is required. At the finish, everyone receives a beautiful medal shaped like the republic and a race pack with gifts from the organizers and partners.
course_highlights: The routes follow paved forest paths with gentle descents and climbs
The run takes place in the Oslava and Chvojnice Valley Nature Reserve
Two main adult routes: 5 km and 6.2 km, with a challenge from ambassador Katarína Pejpková
additional: Finish times are not recorded, and no ranked results list is produced. Capacity is limited to 20 adult and 30 child participants. Toilets are available, course marshals staff the route, a race pack is provided at the event facilities, and a medal shaped like the republic is awarded at the finish. Non-competitive run, routes from 0.6 km to 6.2 km, capacity of 20 for the main race and 30 child participants, accompanying programme, free refreshments, online registration, facilities on private grounds, on the border of the Divoká Oslava reserve

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Děčín
location: Děčín, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: startovné, ceny u vstupného pro dospělé a děti
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Děčín is a traditional race held on October 28, offering routes for adults and children. The main race is 5 km long and runs through the picturesque city, through the castle gardens and Mariánská louka, across the new bridge with views of the Elbe, and along the Elbe Embankment. Children’s races are offered in two distances: 5 km for older children and 1 km for the youngest, who run along the river and Mariánská louka. The course is flat, with varied sections, and professionally timed. At the finish, participants receive a medal shaped like the republic. The event celebrates the republic and offers a sporting atmosphere for all age groups.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km route through the castle gardens and Mariánská louka
Cross the new bridge with views of the Elbe
Run along the Elbe Embankment and across Tyrš Bridge
additional: The race is professionally timed. At the finish, each participant receives a race pack with a race number and gifts from partners. A beautiful medal shaped like the republic awaits at the finish. The route is suitable for all age groups, including children, who have their own shorter courses. The race includes professional timing, medals, and race packs; routes pass through city landmarks and natural scenery; the event caters to various age groups with different race lengths.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Dolní Újezd
location: Dolní Újezd, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: startovné pro děti je uvedeno, přesná cena není specifikována
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Dolní Újezd is a traditional race held on October 28 to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The main course is 8.9 km long and runs partly alongside the Desná stream, across fields and along the edge of the village, combining paved roads with surfaced forest and field paths. Children can choose a 1.4 km course on paved roads and through the housing estate. Facilities at the Sokol hall include a race pack, refreshments, changing rooms and parking. Everyone receives a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish.
course_highlights: An 8.9 km course with gentle elevation and a mix of paved roads, forest paths and field paths
The route follows the Desná stream for part of the way and crosses the surrounding fields
The 1.4 km children’s courses run on paved roads and through the housing estate
additional: The race pack includes a race bib and gifts from the organizers and partners. All participants receive a medal shaped like the republic at the finish. Facilities at the Sokol hall include changing rooms, refreshments and parking. Timing may be manual or chip-timed, but is not compulsory. Suitable for children and adults. The event takes place in Dolní Újezd, Pardubice Region, on October 28, with online registration available and facilities offering refreshments and parking.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Kutná Hora
location: Sokolák, Oleška, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: Cena u vstupného znamená cenu startovného pro dospělé, snížené pro děti
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Kutná Hora is the first edition of this traditional event, which celebrates the founding of Czechoslovakia on October 28 each year. The race offers a sporting atmosphere and a family-friendly experience in the beautiful surroundings of a city with a rich sporting tradition. The main course is just under six kilometres long, with the start and finish at the Sokol hall, which provides facilities including changing rooms, toilets and refreshments. Safe courses for children are set up on the Sokol hall grounds. Capacity is limited to approximately 155 runners to ensure high-quality organisation and timekeeping.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Sokol hall, with full facilities
Main course of just under 6 km through the city
Safe children’s courses on the Sokol hall grounds, with no need to cross roads
additional: Facilities at the Sokol hall include changing rooms, toilets and refreshments. Capacity is set at approximately 155 runners. The event is organised by a team of 4–5 people, with support from volunteers. The children’s courses are safely located on the Sokol hall grounds. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers various courses, including children’s courses, with online registration and an accompanying programme in Oleška, Central Bohemian Region.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Louňovice pod Blaníkem
location: Louňovice pod Blaníkem, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: T. J. Sokol Louňovice pod Blaníkem
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Louňovice pod Blaníkem is a traditional race held on October 28 to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The main course is 5.6 km long and passes the natural and historic sights of Malý Blaník, including its highest point, where the Chapel of St. Mary Magdalene stands. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka running series and offers a race pack, a medal shaped like the republic, and a raffle for participants in the main race. The start and finish are in the square in front of the château in Louňovice pod Blaníkem. In addition to the main race, children’s courses of 0.4, 0.8, and 1.3 km are available.
course_highlights: The course passes the natural and historic sights of Malý Blaník
Run past the Chapel of St. Mary Magdalene at the highest point of Malý Blaník
A mix of paved, field, and forest paths
additional: All races are electronically timed. After the race, participants in the main race can enter a raffle. Everyone will receive a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish. Each participant can collect their race pack at the race facilities. The main race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka running series. An accompanying program and refreshments are provided. The races are electronically timed, free parking is available in the square, and proceeds support charitable projects.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Lužice
location: Lužice, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Lužice is a traditional race held on October 28 to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The race is run without mandatory timekeeping; participants receive a starter pack and a beautiful republic-shaped medal at the finish. The main race course is 7.3 km long and runs along roads, paved farm tracks and through a vineyard, past the railway line and Lužák Pond. Shorter children’s courses of 0.2, 0.5 and 1 km are laid on paved surfaces. The race facilities are at the Sokol Hall complex, with changing rooms, showers, toilets and refreshments available.
course_highlights: The course runs along roads, paved farm tracks and through a vineyard
The route passes the railway line and Lužák Pond
Children’s courses run on paved surfaces
additional: The starter pack includes a race number and gifts from the organizers and partners. All participants receive a republic-shaped medal at the finish. Facilities at the Sokol Hall complex include changing rooms, toilets, showers and refreshments. Parking is available at the car park by the Sports Hall, approximately 500 m from the complex. Children can enjoy sports activities and games at the venue. Time may be recorded manually or with a timing system, but timekeeping is not mandatory. The course runs along roads, paved farm tracks and through a vineyard. Children can run on paved surfaces. Facilities at the Sokol Hall complex include changing rooms, toilets, showers and refreshments. Parking is approximately 500 m from the complex.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Mníšek pod Brdy
location: Státní zámek Mníšek pod Brdy, Mníšek pod Brdy, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Mníšek pod Brdy is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on 28 October. The race offers a 5 km adult course passing the Sokol Hall, ponds and Hostinec u Káji Maříka, with the start and finish by the state château. Shorter children’s loops are set on a grassy area and are easy, making them suitable for different age groups. Facilities at the start include registration, changing tents, toilets and refreshments, and parking is free. Every participant receives a race pack and a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish.
course_highlights: A 5 km asphalt course passing the Sokol Hall, ponds and Hostinec u Káji Maříka
Children’s loops on a grassy area, with distances of 150 m, 500 m and 1 km
Start and finish by Mníšek pod Brdy State Château
additional: The event is run in RACE format, without the need for timing equipment, but finishing times and a winners’ presentation are provided. At the start, there is a registration tent, changing tents, toilets, refreshments and benches. Free parking is available right by the start. The course is asphalt for up to 1 km; the children’s courses are on grass. The start is by the state château, with registration and refreshments on site. Parking is free. The event has no official timekeeper, but all participants receive a medal.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Nový Bydžov
location: Revoluční tř. 774, Nový Bydžov, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
price_range: startovné pro dospělé a děti, přesná cena není uvedena
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Nový Bydžov is a traditional race held on 28 October to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The race offers a 4.8 km course for adults, running from the town along country roads through the village of Humburky and crossing the Cidlina River via two bridges. Shorter 250 m and 420 m races for children take place at the Sportring complex. The race is held in open traffic, with marshals at intersections, and offers a race pack and a republic-shaped medal for all participants.
course_highlights: 4.8 km course with 30% asphalt and 70% country roads
Crossing the Cidlina River via two different bridges
The most challenging section is the climb in the village of Humburky
additional: The race is held in open traffic, with marshals and volunteers at intersections. A cyclist will lead the front runner. The race pack contains a race number and gifts from the organizers and partners. Participants receive a republic-shaped medal at the finish. In bad weather, race-pack collection is in the Sokol hall lobby; in normal conditions, it is outside by the clay court. The awards ceremony for the children’s races will take place shortly after they finish. The 4.8 km route is mostly on country roads. Online registration, refreshments at the finish, parking by the Sokol hall or Penny Market, start at Revoluční třída 774.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Uherský Brod
location: Sokolský stadion, Uherský Brod, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Uherský Brod is a traditional race held on 28 October to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The 5 km main race starts at the Sokol stadium and runs through the city centre, through residential areas and on to a garden colony, past a pond and back to the stadium. Shorter courses of 0.17 km, 0.34 km and 0.8 km are available for children and run around the stadium and nearby park. All participants receive a race pack and a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish. On-site registration is available. Participants under 18 may take part only with the consent of a legal guardian.
course_highlights: The 5 km main course runs through the city centre and residential areas
Past a garden colony and a pond
Children’s courses run around the Sokol stadium and nearby park
additional: The event is run in RACE format, with no need for chip timing, but results and an awards ceremony are provided. Toilets, showers and changing rooms are available at the Sokol stadium, and refreshments are available at the start. Free parking is available in the adjacent car park and around the Sokol hall. No accompanying programme is provided. Courses include 5 km for adults and 170 m, 340 m and 800 m for children; online registration is open until 24 October 2025; the event takes place in Uherský Brod; toilets, showers, changing rooms, refreshments and free parking are available.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Ústí nad Labem
location: Ústí nad Labem, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on October 28. This run has become a modern tradition that is growing in many places across the Czech Republic and abroad. Participants can choose from various routes for adults and children, which run on both paved roads and forest trails. The event is open to all runners who want to celebrate the founding of the republic through exercise and the joy of running.
course_highlights: The route in Alšovice has a varied profile, with uphill and downhill sections
The course runs on both paved roads and unpaved forest trails
The finish is always at the Sokol hall, where a beautiful medal shaped like the republic awaits
additional: The race pack includes a race bib and gifts from the organizers and partners. Refreshments are available at the finish, provided for the fourth consecutive year by partner PENNY, including bars, fruit, and water. In Prague, a PENNY food tent with a hot buffet and the option to pay by PENNY card is also available. Parking at the start is limited. The race may not be timed, but finish times and a winners’ ceremony are provided. Adult route: 4.5 km; children’s routes: 0.25 km, 0.5 km, and 0.75 km; registration until October 24, 2025; the event takes place in Ústí nad Labem and other locations in the Czech Republic and abroad.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Milovice
location: Hakenovo stadion, Milovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: startovné u vstupného (cena pro dospělé a děti, přesná částka není uvedena)
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Milovice is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on 28 October. The race offers an easy 5.8 km nature route, suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike, with a partly paved and road surface. The children’s routes are simple gravel-surfaced loops around Haken Stadium, ideal for young runners. At the finish, all participants receive a beautiful medal in the shape of the republic, and the band Basslake will perform live from 6 p.m. Race facilities are at Haken Stadium in the centre of Milovice, with refreshments and restroom facilities.
course_highlights: An easy 5.8 km nature route with a partly paved and road surface
Oval children’s routes around Haken Stadium with a gravel surface
A finish-line medal in the shape of the republic and an accompanying programme featuring a live band
additional: The event is held in RACE format without chip timing, but finishing times are recorded and winners are announced. Registration and race packs are collected at the stadium facilities. A public changing tent, Toi Toi toilets and the RKDM restaurant, approximately 100 m from the venue, are available. Catering is provided, including draft beer and soft drinks. Trail and road routes, children’s routes, cultural programme, refreshments, parking nearby, start at Haken Stadium

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Písek
location: Palackého sady, Písek, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Písek is a traditional race held on October 28 in honour of the founding of Czechoslovakia. The race offers a 5.35 km course for adults through the picturesque Palacký Gardens, across the Stone Bridge and along the river. Shorter courses from 100 m to 1.5 km are available for children, running on paved and asphalt paths. At the finish, all participants receive a beautiful republic-shaped medal and a gift-filled race pack. The main race is limited to 150 runners. On-site registration is available if capacity has not been reached.
course_highlights: The route crosses the historic Stone Bridge and follows the Otava River
The route combines paving, asphalt, gravel and forest paths
The start and finish are in the Palacký Gardens by the music pavilion
additional: Race times are measured using professional timing equipment. The race pack contains a race number and gifts from the organisers and partners. New registrations and race-pack collection close 30 minutes before the race starts. The main race is limited to 150 runners; on-site registration is available if capacity has not been reached. Courses range from 100 m to 5.35 km. On-site registration is available. The race starts in the Palacký Gardens. Refreshments, changing rooms, toilets, showers and parking are available at Fügner Square and by the post office.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Prostějov
location: Náměstí T.G. Masaryka, Prostějov, Olomoucký kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: Cena u vstupného znamená cenu startovného pro dospělé, snížené pro děti
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Prostějov is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on October 28. The race offers adult courses of 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km, running through the city centre on paved roads. Children can choose from shorter loops of 700 m, 350 m, and 100 m around T. G. Masaryk Square. The start and finish are on the central square, with facilities including changing rooms, baggage storage, and refreshments. Runners can look forward to professional timing and a beautiful republic-shaped medal at the finish.
course_highlights: A flat course through the historic centre of Prostějov
A 2.5 km loop on paved roads, run once, twice, or four times depending on the race distance
Start and finish on T. G. Masaryk Square, with easy access and facilities
additional: The race pack includes a bib number and gifts from the organisers and partners. On-site payment is available via Apple Pay or Google Wallet. A republic-shaped medal awaits runners at the finish. Changing rooms, storage for valuables and bags, ample toilet facilities, music, and athlete demonstrations are available. Adult distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km; children’s distances: 0.1 km, 0.35 km, and 0.7 km; online registration; over 200 registered runners.

name: Podzimní běh Dražovkou
location: Dražovka, Hořovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 150,- Kč dospělí, 50,- Kč děti a žactvo
description: The Podzimní běh Dražovkou is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Dražovka near Hořovice. The main course is approximately 7.2 km long and runs mostly along forest trails over varied terrain, offering runners a pleasant challenge and beautiful natural scenery. The race is suitable for various age groups, including children and youth, who have their own shorter courses. The start and registration take place at the same location by the water tower on Podlužská Street in the forest, providing easy access and a forest-run atmosphere.
course_highlights: Mostly forest trails over varied terrain
Main course: 7.2 km; women run 3.6 km
Youth runners, women, and veterans over 70 run one lap; everyone else runs two laps
additional: The start and registration are at the same location by the water tower on Podlužská Street in the forest. The race offers children's events. Youth runners, women, and veterans over 70 run one lap; all other runners run two laps. The race includes children's and school-age categories; the start and registration are by the water tower in Dražovka, and the course follows forest trails.

name: Vinařský maraton
location: Velké Bílovice, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic

description: The Wine Marathon is a traditional running race organized by the Báječné ženy v běhu association and held in Velké Bílovice in the South Moravian Region. The event offers a marathon and a half-marathon route through the scenic vineyards and the villages of Čejkovice and Vrbice. The event also includes the charitable Vinařská míle run, which is open to children and adults. The race has a friendly atmosphere and supports the running community and local charity projects.
course_highlights: The route passes through vineyards and the scenic villages of Čejkovice and Vrbice
Marathon and half-marathon courses with beautiful views of the South Moravian countryside
The charitable Vinařská míle run is open to children and adults
additional: The race has a capacity of 800 participants. The entry fee also applies to relay participants, who must register under the same relay team name. Changing facilities are in the school, and bag storage is in a tent at the multi-purpose sports field. The organizer is not responsible for items left outside the official bag storage area. If capacity remains, it is possible to pay the entry fee on race day in cash or by QR code. The race takes place in October and has a capacity of approximately 800 runners. Registration is available online or on site. Race routes include various wine-growing locations, including Vrbice, Hradištěk and Čejkovice, with participation available in different categories, including relay races and special categories for blind runners.

name: Běh Labským údolím
location: Dolní Žleb, Děčín, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: LABÁCI (Děčínský horolezecký oddíl a Klub orientačního běhu Děčín)
description: The Run through the Elbe Valley is a traditional autumn running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Žleb, near Děčín. The race offers routes of various lengths, running mainly along forest roads and trails over varied terrain. It is organised by the Labáci group, which continues the long-standing tradition of local organisers. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including veterans and youth.
course_highlights: 16 km main course and 8 km shorter course over varied terrain
Mostly forest roads and trails
Picturesque autumn setting in the Elbe Valley
additional: Race-day check-in takes place from 10:45 at the “U Kosti” pub in Dolní Žleb. Travelling to the race by train is recommended. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup. Registration will open during spring 2026. Registration runs until 30 October 2025; the start is scheduled for 1 November at 12:00, with check-in until 10:45. Train transport from Děčín is available.

name: Lhotecká Kaštanka
location: Lhotě, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Lhotecká Kaštanka is a 15 km race on asphalt and firm forest trails in the Lhota area of the Central Bohemian Region. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup and offers runners a pleasant route through natural surroundings. It is suitable for runners looking for a quality run on asphalt and forest trails in picturesque countryside. Come enjoy the sporting atmosphere and test yourself against other runners at this traditional event.
course_highlights: 15 km course
Runs on asphalt and firm forest trails
Part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup
additional: The race takes place on October 31, 2026, in Lhota and is for runners who want to enjoy a sporting day outdoors.

description: The Krospůlmaraton in Sosnová near Česká Lípa is a traditional running race held as part of the Českolipsko District Running League. The race takes place on October 31, 2026, and gives runners the chance to test themselves in the pleasant autumn surroundings of the Liberec Region. The event is part of a series of regional races that promote physical activity and bring together runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Natural terrain suitable for cross-country running
Part of a regional running league
Held in the picturesque surroundings of Sosnová near Česká Lípa
additional: The race is part of a regional running series. The exact course profile is not provided, but the terrain is expected to be suitable for running in nature.

name: Lesní kros mezi přeštickými prasaty
location: Střelnice, Přeštice, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč při online registraci, 250 Kč na místě
description: Lesní kros mezi přeštickými prasaty is a traditional 8-kilometre race in Přeštice. Runners follow forest trails over dirt, leaves and roots, with the possibility of mud. The start and finish are at Střelnice in Přeštice, which provides convenient facilities including changing rooms, refreshments and home-style food. The race is part of the Běžecký pohár Plzeňska 2026 and is open to runners over 15. Registration opens at 9:00, and the race starts at 10:30. The results are announced after the last runner finishes, usually around noon.
course_highlights: Eight kilometres of forest trails over dirt, leaves and roots
Start and finish at Střelnice in Přeštice, with full facilities
Part of the Běžecký pohár Plzeňska 2026
additional: Registration opens at 9:00. Results are usually announced around noon, after the last runner finishes. The race takes place in all weather. Runners keep their race numbers. The organiser provides changing rooms, refreshments and home-style food. The race is open to runners over 15; minors must have the responsibility of their legal guardians. The race takes place on 31 October 2026. Registration opens at 9:00 and the start is at 10:30. Changing rooms and refreshments are available at Střelnice; the race is part of the Běžecký pohár Plzeňska 2026.

name: Motolské jamky

The race gives runners the chance to enjoy challenging trail terrain in Prague 5, with beautiful views and a natural atmosphere. The event is part of the Trail Running Cup series and is suitable for everyone who loves running in nature. The race traditionally starts at 9:00.
course_highlights: Trail run at the Golf Club Praha grounds in Motol
Natural, varied terrain with views
Location in Prague 5 with good accessibility
additional: Registration, race details and results are available at the external link https://tech.orgsu.org/Site/SG/3. The race is part of the Trail Running Cup series, which features other races throughout the year. The trail courses include the golf course; registration closes 30 minutes before the start, and parking is available directly at the venue.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - listopad
location: Smetanovy sady, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Olomouc 2 Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and competing primarily against themselves. It also includes a cup competition, with results adjusted using an age-grading coefficient and runners collecting points throughout the year. On-site registration is from 9:30 to 10:00, and the race starts in the morning. The race is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which has supported the running community for more than 35 years.
course_highlights: 2-mile (3.2 km) course in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc
Suitable for all ages and running abilities
Picturesque setting by the park fountain
additional: On-site registration is from 9:30 to 10:00. The start is by the fountain in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc. The top three finishers in each category receive awards. The race is part of a year-long cup competition, with points calculated using an age-grading coefficient. It is part of the Olomouc 2-mile race series, takes place on a paved course, registration is from 9:30 to 10:00, and it is suitable for all age groups and running abilities.

description: The HRUŠTICE Road Race – Zdeněk Drobník Memorial is a traditional race with a history dating back to 1974. Since 2024, it has been run on a new 10 km course through the Jizera Valley. This popular autumn event attracts runners from across the surrounding area each year and offers beautiful views and an atmosphere shaped by local history and traditions. The start and race facilities are in Turnov, with chip timing and professional organization. After the race, prizes are raffled, traditionally including regional semi-precious stones.
course_highlights: New 10 km course through the Jizera Valley
Beautiful views from the plateau above Turnov
Traditional prizes featuring regional semi-precious stones
additional: All categories start together. Registration and race-number pickup take place from 08:30 to 10:00. On-site registration is available until 10:00 for a higher entry fee. After the race, race numbers are entered into a prize draw. Race facilities are located in the AC Turnov athletics clubroom at Ludvík Daněk Stadium. The race is part of a long-running series and offers various age categories. Registration and results are managed by STOPNI TO s.r.o. The race takes place on a road course and is open to runners of all levels.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Beroun
location: Hospoda na Černém vršku, Praha, Czech Republic
price_range: 240 Kč (voucher za celou sérii), 316 Kč (voucher za 6 závodů)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 240 Kč (v rámci voucheru na celou sérii 12 závodů)

description: The Berounka Running Series is a series of 12 races in the beautiful natural surroundings along the Berounka, motivating runners of all levels to exercise regularly. The race in Beroun, held on November 2, 2026, is a night stage through the Křivoklát forests, with views of the surrounding area and a final descent from the Děd lookout tower to the finish. The route is well marked and offers beautiful natural scenery, refreshments, and baggage storage. The series is suitable for experienced runners as well as beginners who want to improve their fitness and enjoy running in nature.
course_highlights: Night stage requiring a headlamp
The route runs through the Křivoklát forests, with views by the walnut-tree avenue
A challenging climb to the Děd lookout tower, followed by a descent back to the finish with views of Beroun
additional: Every participant receives a race number. Refreshments and baggage storage are available on site. Bringing a headlamp for the night run is recommended. The top three finishers in each category receive diplomas. Night stage, trail run, marked routes, views of the surrounding area, on-site registration, start no later than 17:45, refreshments and baggage storage, winners’ awards by category, headlamp required.

name: Běžecká série Berounka - Beroun
location: Beroun, Středočeský, Czech Republic
price_range: 240 Kč (voucher na 12 závodů), 316 Kč (voucher na 6 závodů)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voucher na celou sérii 12 běhů = 2 900 Kč (240 Kč/závod)

description: The Berounka Running Series is a series of 12 trail races in the beautiful surroundings of the Berounka River, from Radotín to Nižbor, running from January to December 2026. The routes follow the best running trails in the area, with varying elevation and beautiful views of nature and the surrounding landscape. The series is suitable for experienced runners as well as beginners looking for motivation to run regularly. Most start locations are accessible by train, and local pubs provide facilities. At the end of the series, winners are celebrated in several categories.
course_highlights: Routes follow educational trails and nature reserves, with views of the Bohemian Karst
Challenging climbs and descents, with elevation gain exceeding 330 m on some courses
Start and finish near train stations, with refreshments and facilities available
additional: Every participant receives a race number. Refreshments, bag storage, changing rooms and showers are available on site. A headlamp is recommended because some races take place at night. The series counts each runner’s 10 best races, and winners are announced at the end in 12 categories. Races take place at various locations around Beroun; most starts are accessible by train. The winners are announced in December, and the races are divided into 12 categories.

name: TRAIL LÁZNĚ VELICHOVKY
location: Lázně Velichovky, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Trail Lázně Velichovky is the third edition of an autumn trail race in the historic spa town of Velichovky. It offers varied and beautiful running terrain, with the start and finish on the spa colonnade, where covered facilities with changing rooms and a restaurant are available. The race is complemented by spa amenities, including a café, and offers original medals, gifts and a race pack. The atmosphere is friendly, and the race is suitable for all lovers of trail running and spa surroundings.
course_highlights: The most colourful autumn running terrain
Start and finish on the spa colonnade
Covered facilities with changing rooms and a restaurant
additional: The race includes an original medal, race pack, electronic timing chip, refreshments during the race and at the finish, changing rooms, baggage storage, toilets, medical services and an accompanying programme. Gladiator Race clothing is also available for purchase, and parking is available near the event centre. Online registration via reg-sportvisio.cz, medals, chip timing, course photos, certificates, refreshments and spa services.

name: Jizerun
location: stadion Čelákovice, Čelákovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: přátelé a sportovní nadšenci z Hitgymu

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: RUN AND FUN - pouze do 31. 8. 2026 nebo do vyprodání kapacity.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: NO FUN, JUST RUN - pouze do 24. 10. 2026 nebo do vyprodání kapacity.

description: Jizerun is a relay race connecting Prague and the Jizera Mountains. Teams of 4–5 runners cover a total of 164 km along cycle paths and Jizera Mountain trails in a single day. The race offers a unique team experience, with a choice of two entry packages featuring different benefits such as a sports T-shirt, headband, evening buffet and finisher medals. The event is open to men’s, women’s, mixed and corporate relay teams and is supported by general partner Metrostav a.s.
course_highlights: 164 km route from Prague to the Jizera Mountains
A combination of cycle paths and Jizera Mountain trails
Relays for teams of 4–5, with each runner completing at least 3 legs
additional: Entry packages are for teams of 5. The RUN&FUN package includes T-shirts, headbands, a buffet dinner, finisher medals, refreshments, race bibs, GPS tracking and a finisher party with live music. The NO FUN, JUST RUN package includes finisher medals, refreshments, race bibs, GPS tracking and a finisher party. Facilities and services include mobile toilets, showers at the finish, medical services, an announcer and full event support. When registering, the captain’s details must be provided; team members and T-shirt sizes can be added later. Each team member must run at least 3 legs, and only one car per team is allowed. The race supports a fundraiser for hospice and hospice care in the Czech Republic. Registration opens in April 2026.

name: Běh kolem Práchně
location: Horažďovice, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Běh kolem Práchně is a traditional running race in Horažďovice, offering a 9.5 km course. Since 2024, the updated route has followed the Horažďovice Green Walking Circuit. The start and finish are located in front of Envicentrum PROUD, which provides runners with facilities including changing rooms, toilets and refreshments. The results are announced at approximately 12:00 after the race. The event is organized by DDM Horažďovice and KČT Horažďovice, who ensure a pleasant atmosphere and a smooth event.
course_highlights: The 9.5 km course follows the Horažďovice Green Walking Circuit
Start and finish in front of Envicentrum PROUD, with full facilities
A mixed-type race in the picturesque surroundings of Horažďovice
additional: The results are announced at approximately 12:00 at Envicentrum PROUD, where refreshments, changing rooms and toilets are available. The course follows the Horažďovice Green Walking Circuit, with the start and finish in front of Envicentrum PROUD and refreshments and facilities available after the race.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - listopad
location: Příluk, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2 Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is welcomed at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake as a reward for their effort.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt circuit, just under two laps long (3.2 km)
The children's course is 800 m long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and over, and children up to 12 years old (boys and girls). Every runner is timed, and the top three finishers in both adult and children's categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get to the start include by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates, or by trolleybus no. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). Races take place on the first Saturday of every month, start at 9:00, and registration is from 8:15 to 8:55; you can arrive by bike, on foot, by car, or by trolleybus. The course is a precisely measured asphalt circuit; the main course is 3.2 km long and the children's course is 800 m long.

name: Memoriál MUDr. Josefa Podmolíka - Běžecký festival Otrokovice 2026
location: Otrokovice, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Otrokovice Running Festival is a traditional sporting event offering a wide range of races, including a marathon, half marathon, half-marathon relay, decamarathon and youth races. The MUDr. Josef Podmolík Memorial is the flagship half-marathon race, held in the beautiful surroundings of Otrokovice. Runners can enjoy a well-maintained course with electronic timing and the atmosphere of a running festival with a varied program for all age groups. Race check-in and the awards ceremony take place at the Otrokovice Municipal Sports Hall.
course_highlights: Half-marathon and marathon courses in Otrokovice with chip timing
A 4.2195 km decamarathon loop
Youth races over various distances from 200 m to 1,700 m
additional: Race check-in takes place at the Otrokovice Municipal Sports Hall. Runners must collect their race number and chip for electronic timing. Winners are presented with their awards after each race in turn, and winners are required to attend the ceremony. Registration is by email. The event includes various age groups and races on city streets and at the sports hall.

name: Svatojánská 20
location: TJ Lokomotiva Beroun, Beroun, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Svatojánská 20 is a traditional running race held in Beroun, offering two main routes of 11 and 18 kilometres. The start and finish are at the TJ Lokomotiva Beroun athletics stadium. The routes run mainly on paved roads and cycle paths along the Berounka River and the Loděnice Stream, with turnarounds at the settlement of V Kozle (11 km) and in Svatý Jan pod Skálou (18 km). The race is open to a wide range of age groups and offers refreshments at the finish, as well as cash and non-cash prizes for the top runners.
course_highlights: The routes run mainly on paved roads and cycle paths along the Berounka River and the Loděnice Stream
The 11 km route turns around at the settlement of V Kozle; the 18 km route turns around in Svatý Jan pod Skálou
The start and finish are at the TJ Lokomotiva Beroun athletics stadium
additional: On-site check-in and registration on race day from 11:00 to 12:40. Runners who register in advance and pay by 5 November will receive a race number bearing their name. Finish-line refreshments include tea and biscuits. The race takes place in open traffic; participants must obey traffic regulations and take part at their own risk. Parking is available around the stadium; nearby car parks are recommended because of the blue parking zones. Online and on-site registration are available. Medals and certificates are awarded, and cash prizes are paid.

name: Kovářská pětka
location: Baťovský areál, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Kovárna VIVA a spolkem Běhy Zlín
description: Kovářská pětka is a traditional 5-kilometre city road race held in the Baťa complex in Zlín. The race is open to both adults and children and is organised by Kovárna VIVA in cooperation with the Běhy Zlín association. The event offers a high-quality sporting experience in the centre of the regional capital, with international participation. It attracts a wide running community every year and is known for its friendly atmosphere and well-organised proceedings.
course_highlights: The course runs through the former Baťa complex in Zlín
A 5-kilometre road race in an urban setting
The race is suitable for adults and children
additional: The race is part of a year-round competition for runners from the Zlín region. The organisers provide online results and event photos. Children’s categories are also included. The event provides professional timing and support for the regional running community. It is part of a series of races in Zlín, offers various age categories and is suitable for the general public.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - listopad
location: Park Stromovka, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running levels, including children up to 12 years old, who run 1.6 km. The race is suitable for slow and fast runners, experienced runners and beginners who want to improve their personal best, train, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful park setting. After the finish, everyone receives a warm cinnamon pancake. Times are recorded for every participant and results are published online; they count toward the year-round Lívancový Cup.
course_highlights: The course runs along Stromovka’s paved paths
Adults run 2 laps (2 miles, 3.2 km); children run 1 lap (1.6 km)
The race takes place in the beautiful setting of Královská obora–Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Bruselská Gate area (beneath the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45. Online pre-registration is available for faster check-in. Arriving by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop) is recommended. Parking is available by the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou Street. Tents are available for changing and leaving belongings (unattended), along with a mobile valuables storage service. Toilet cabins are available on site. Start at 9:07; registration from 8:15 to 8:45; online registration available. The race takes place in Královská obora–Stromovka Park. Parking is by the bridge to Císařský Island; changing facilities and toilets are available.

name: Labský půlmaraton
location: Lysá nad Labem, Lysá nad Labem, Středočeský, Czech Republic
description: The Labský Half Marathon is a running race held in Lysá nad Labem, offering two courses of approximately 12.5 km and 21.3 km. The routes pass through the flat Polabí forest, on a mix of paved and unpaved roads, trails, and short sections of asphalt or concrete. The start and finish are at the racecourse, where refreshments, baggage storage, and other facilities are available. The race is suitable for the general public and is limited to 700 participants. The program also includes children’s races with distances varying by age.
course_highlights: The courses are flat and run through the beautiful Polabí forest
Start after approximately 1 km on the racecourse
Refreshment stations at km 8 and 17 on the 21 km course, and one station at km 8 on the 12 km course
additional: The race is limited to 700 participants. Baggage storage, changing tents, toilets, refreshments, and a raffle are available for runners. Parking in the venue costs 50 CZK per car. Children’s races range from 200 to 1,000 metres depending on age. The route is marked with ribbons, signs, and flour arrows, and each kilometre is marked approximately. The race includes children’s races, registration is available online, and the route may be modified due to reconstruction work in the area.

name: Závod dvojic
location: Hostivař, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Hostivařské dvojice is a relay running race for pairs, offering a unique team-running experience in the beautiful surroundings of Hostivař. The race is for pairs who want to enjoy a sporting challenge as well as the friendly atmosphere. The route passes through scenic terrain and is suitable for runners of all levels. Come for a run and enjoy a great sporting event in a welcoming community.
course_highlights: Relay race in pairs
Scenic surroundings of Hostivař
Friendly race atmosphere
additional: The race takes place on November 7, 2026, in Kladno. It is a team relay event, and registration is available online.

name: Hornická desítka
location: Národní dům, Frýdek-Místek, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Hornická desítka is a traditional running race held in Frýdek-Místek. It has been held since 1980, with interruptions, and the tradition was revived in 1996. The event offers various running disciplines, including youth races, a Run for Health and the main 10 km race. It celebrates exercise and sporting spirit, attracting hundreds to thousands of participants of all ages. It is known for its excellent organization and friendly atmosphere. The race starts at the National House in Frýdek-Místek and is suitable for the general public, including families with children.
course_highlights: The course runs in the Frýdek-Místek area; the event dates back to 1980
A main 10 km race, accompanied by youth races and a Run for Health
Start and finish at the National House in Frýdek-Místek
additional: The event includes a non-competitive parents-and-children run, youth races, a Run for Health and the main 10 km race. It is known for its excellent organization and relaxed atmosphere. The organizer is Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, z.s. The race takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at the National House in Frýdek-Místek. The event involves road closures and traffic measures.

name: Malá Pardubická cross country
location: Labe and vicinity, near TJ Dynamo canoe club, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Malá Pardubická - cross country is a traditional cross-country race organized by the AC Pardubice athletics club. The race takes place near the Elbe River and close to the TJ Dynamo Pardubice canoe club. The organizers warmly invite all runners and running fans to this popular event, which offers a sporting experience in a natural setting. The race regulations and further information are available on the club’s website.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on natural terrain near the Elbe River
Start and finish close to the TJ Dynamo Pardubice canoe club
A traditional running event organized by AC Pardubice
additional: The race takes place on November 7, 2026, is open to the general public, including children and young people, and is part of the local sports calendar.

name: Jizerun
location: Jizerka, Jizerské hory, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Obsahuje : 5x funkční účastnické triko, 5x čelenka, 5x večeře formou rautu v Parkhotelu Smržovka, 5x finisher medaile, předstartovní káva a drobné občerstvení na startu a v cíli, startovní čísla, výsledkový servis a online GPS tracker, finisher párty s živou hudbou.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Obsahuje : 5x finisher medaile, předstartovní káva a drobné občerstvení na startu a v cíli, startovní čísla, výsledkový servis a online GPS tracker, finisher párty s živou hudbou.

description: Jizerun is a relay running race from Prague to the Jizera Mountains, following the Jizera River. Teams of 4–5 runners cover a total of 165 km along cycle paths and trails in the Jizera Mountains in a single day. The race offers a unique sporting experience and the chance to work as a team in men’s, women’s, mixed, and corporate categories. The route is divided into several stages of varying difficulty, allowing each runner to choose a suitable segment.
course_highlights: A 165 km route from Prague to the Jizera Mountains along cycle paths and trails
A relay race for teams of 4–5 in several categories
Stages with difficulty ratings from 1 to 8 on a 10-point scale, across varied terrain
additional: The entry fee includes timing, GPX tracking and the JIZERUN app, portable toilets, finish-area facilities including showers, a speaker and sound system, medical services throughout the race, gifts from partners, photos and video, and full event staffing and all relevant permits. The route is divided into 14 stages of varying lengths and difficulty; for example, the Bradlec–Klášter stage is 14.7 km and rated 7/10. The 2026 edition is sold out; the organizer mentions a waiting list. Teams consist of four or five runners.

name: Během proti závislostem
location: Lesopark Homolka, Plzeň, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: MUŽI, ŽENY, HOŠI, DÍVKY – 150,- Kč. Online

description: The Run Against Addiction is a running race in Homolka Forest Park in Plzeň, with courses for different age groups, from children to adults. The route follows paved paths and includes both flat children’s courses and the varied terrain of the 6 km main race. There is also a relay race for teams of three, with each runner completing one lap. The event is suitable for runners of all abilities who want to support the fight against addiction and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in nature.
course_highlights: The route follows paved paths in Homolka Forest Park
The 6 km main race features varied terrain and three laps
The children’s courses are flat and adapted to different age groups
additional: Race numbers are distributed from 9:00 to 10:30. Children’s races begin at 10:00, with staggered starts by age group. The men’s and women’s main races and the relay start at 11:30. The relay has three runners, each completing one lap of approximately 2,000 m. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 12:15. A recommended route is available on Garmin Connect as a single lap, which will be run three times during the race. The organizer lists children’s races and a 6 km race; Kudy z nudy also lists a 3 × 2 km relay for 2026. The race regulations available on the organizer’s website are for the 2024 and 2025 editions, so prices from those editions have not been assigned to the 2026 race.

name: Žandovská desítka
location: Žandov, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Žandovská desítka is a traditional 10-kilometer race held in Žandov in the Liberec Region. The event is part of the Českolipsko District Running League and welcomes runners of all ages. The course runs on both roads and trails, offering varied surroundings for competitors. The race is popular with the regional running community and provides an opportunity to challenge yourself and meet fellow running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The course runs on both roads and trails
Part of the regional Českolipsko running league
Suitable for all age groups
additional: The race takes place in November 2026. Registration and further details are not specified. The event is part of a broader series of regional races.

name: Dobřichovický běh
location: Škvárový stadion TJ Sokol Dobřichovice, Dobřichovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Dobřichovice Run is part of the Brdy Running Cup and offers runners a course approximately 6 km long. The race starts at the cinder track at TJ Sokol Dobřichovice and follows farm roads, providing pleasant running terrain. The event is suitable for both adults and children, who have their own races. The main race starts at 13:00 and is organized by ASK Dipoli.
course_highlights: Course approximately 6 km long
Starts at the cinder track at TJ Sokol Dobřichovice
The course follows farm roads
additional: Start location: TJ Sokol Dobřichovice, Pražská 375. The course was measured by GPS at 5.72 km, though the race information lists it as 6 km. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup, which also includes children's races. The course combines a cinder track and farm roads. The course includes a cinder track and farm roads; online registration is available; races are suitable for all age groups.

name: Velká kunratická
location: Kunratický les, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Velká kunratická is one of the oldest running races in the Czech lands. It is held every year on the second Sunday in November in Kunratice Forest in Prague. The race has been run continuously since 1934 and is known for its challenging course and changeable weather, which contribute to its unique atmosphere. A wide range of runners take part, from young children to veterans, competing on six courses ranging from 370 to 3,100 metres. The event is organised by the Spartak Praha 4 athletics club.
course_highlights: Challenging courses through Kunratice Forest
Six courses ranging from 370 m to 3,100 m
Wave starts in pairs, with a 10-second interval
additional: All categories start in pairs at 10-second intervals. Official BUSHMAN-brand T-shirts are available exclusively during registration. Ordered T-shirts can be collected at the tent on the dam. The total number of participants is limited to 3,600, with a limit of 2,700 runners on the route over Hrádek. Registration changes can be made by email until 14 October 2026; after that, they can only be made at check-in. The race takes place in November, with the number of participants limited to 3,400. Online registration opens on 5 October 2026, and on-site registration is available. There are various age and performance categories.

name: Krumlovská 11
location: Hornobránský rybník, Český Krumlov, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné 500 Kč (věk 60+: 250 Kč) pro ženy i muže, starší i mladší, zdatné i méně zdatné běžce

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné 350 Kč/osoba (věk 60+: 200 Kč) ženská, mužská, smíšená

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné 2 640 Kč/dvojice = celé dar ve prospěch Osobní asistence

description: Krumlovská 11 is a St. Martin’s charity run held on 8 November 2026 at Hornobránský Pond in Český Krumlov. It offers a main run of approximately 11 km for runners aged 15 and over, a family run for children aged 2 to 15, and relay races. The route passes through beautiful countryside via Křížová hora and Přídolí. The event supports the Personal Assistance social service, which helps children with disabilities and seniors in the region. There is also a varied program of accompanying activities and running T-shirts available to purchase.
course_highlights: Main route: approx. 11 km via Křížová hora and Přídolí
Family run: 1–2 km depending on age category
Relay race: 2 × 5.5 km, with the baton exchange at Hornobránský Pond
additional: The main run and relay races start at 12:11; the family run begins from 10:01, with staggered start times for the different categories. The main run has a capacity of 200 runners, and the family run a capacity of 200 children. Race packs with bib numbers can be collected at the venue from 8:45 to 11:30. Running T-shirts and St. Martin’s goose are available to purchase for an additional fee. Relays may be women’s, men’s, mixed or corporate. The event is a charity event, with proceeds supporting the Personal Assistance social service in Český Krumlov. The start and finish are at Hornobránský Pond; the main run starts from 12:11. Online registration is open until 30 October 2026 and is mandatory. The race has a capacity of 200 participants.

name: Běh na Dobrošov
location: Náchod-Běloves, Náchod, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Dobrošov is a public uphill race with a mass start, held in Náchod-Běloves in the Hradec Králové Region. The race is part of the Běžecké vršky series and gives athletes the chance to test themselves on a challenging uphill course. It is organized by the Redpoint Teplice nad Metují club and is popular with runners who enjoy challenges in a natural setting. Runners of all ages and ability levels traditionally take part.
course_highlights: Uphill race with a mass start
Challenging course through the natural surroundings of Náchod-Běloves
Part of the Běžecké vršky series
additional: This is a public mountain race with various categories, including historical information about the race and related events.

name: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec
location: Krkavec, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec is a traditional autumn trail race in the Plzeň area, offering scenic routes through nature with minimal asphalt. The race is intended both for fans of healthy outdoor exercise and for competitive athletes and elite trail runners. Choose from routes of 42 km with 700 m of elevation gain, 22.5 km, 7 km, and shorter children’s and youth routes, including a multigenerational relay. The race hub, start and finish are in the suburban district of Plzeň - Bílá hora. The organizers follow the motto “I don’t run on asphalt” and prepare a race focused on running in nature and enjoying beautiful views.
course_highlights: Scenic trails along both banks of the Berounka River valley
Forests around the Bolevec ponds
A climb to Krkavec with 700 m of elevation gain on the marathon route
additional: Three main routes are available (42 km, 22.5 km, 7 km), along with shorter children’s and youth routes, including a multigenerational relay. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup. The race hub is in the suburban district of Plzeň - Bílá hora. Terrain: trail, cross-country; the race takes place in November 2026; exact registration details are not provided.

name: BoBoBěh
location: Bedřichov, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: BoBoběh is the final mountain race in the BoBoloppet trilogy, taking runners through the beautiful Jizera Mountains. The race offers a challenging 30 km course with climbs up Olivetská hora, a section across the Černá Nisa dam, and a tough ascent up Bílý Štolpich. A shorter 10 km course is available for less experienced runners, as well as a 1 km children’s MINI run. The race is open to all running and nature lovers, whether they are registered for the full trilogy or wish to take part in this race only.
course_highlights: 30 km mountain race over Vysoký hřeben and Kanál
Two climbs up Olivetská hora and a section across the Černá Nisa dam
The toughest climb in the Jizera Mountains — Bílý Štolpich
additional: The race does not have a mass start. The start area is open for two hours, during which runners choose their start time. The course is not marked, so the race involves some orienteering. name: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec
location: Bílá Hora, Plzeň, Czech Republic

The race offers three main distances of 42 km, 22.5 km and 7 km, as well as shorter categories for school-age children and younger kids. The course follows paths along the Berounka River and through the woods near the Bolevec ponds, and includes a challenging climb up Krkavec with 700 metres of elevation gain. The race is open to everyone regardless of gender or age, with finishing times adjusted by age and gender coefficients. A welcoming atmosphere and friendly setting
The opportunity to take part in various categories and at different performance levels
additional: The race is part of the Monaka series, which has a long tradition in the region. Exact information about registration and course distance has not yet been published.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (12) – listopadový
location: Praha 4-Braník, Praha, Czech Republic
description: 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (12) – November is a regular running race in Prague’s Braník district, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava. The race is part of the 16th edition of the Vaší Liga running series, where runners can compare their performances with others and track their progress throughout the year. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the opportunity to achieve the qualifying standard for the Czech Championships. After the race, enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, refreshments, and the chance to share your experiences at the restaurant in the Hamr Braník complex.
course_highlights: A pleasant, fast course along the Vltava in Prague’s Braník district
Course measured by a certified measurer; suitable for achieving the Czech Championships qualifying standard over 10 km
Relaxed running atmosphere with refreshments after the race
additional: The 10 km race starts at 14:00 and the 5 km race at 14:05. Check-in is open from 13:00 in the blue tent by the cycle path near U Kempinku 2, Prague. After the race, an isotonic drink is available, as well as refreshments at the Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage is available in the organizers’ tent. The race is timed using chip timing, and each runner also receives a chip time. The race takes place in November 2026; registration is probably through the official website. The series includes multiple races throughout the year.

name: Mikulášský běh Zlín
location: Zlín, Louky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The St. Nicholas Run in Zlín-Louky is a traditional running race held in the beautiful setting along the Dřevnice River. The event offers 5 km and 10 km routes on flat loops with crossings over small bridges and cycle paths. It also includes a 1.5 km family run in costume, a children’s programme, and St. Nicholas and devil-themed festivities. Runners receive a race pack with gifts and a commemorative medal at the finish. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant Advent atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route follows a wide grassy path along the Dřevnice River
Crossings over a concrete bridge and an iron footbridge
Flat loops around the football pitch in Zlín-Louky
additional: A 1.5 km family run in costume, with gingerbread as a finish-line reward. A children’s programme and St. Nicholas and devil-themed festivities in costume. The race pack contains gifts from partners and a commemorative medal. A charity raffle for Krtek, with prizes sold and awarded during the event. 5 km and 10 km races, family and children’s runs, a charity event, start and finish by the football pitch in Zlín-Louky, a varied accompanying programme, and a race pack.

name: Výběh na Lovoš
location: Lovoš, Lovosice, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run up Lovoš is a traditional uphill race held in Lovosice, in the Ústí nad Labem Region. The race offers a challenging trail run climbing to the summit of Lovoš, a popular destination for runners seeking a challenge and beautiful views. The start is on Lovošská Street, and the race is suitable for runners who want to try uphill running in a natural setting. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with registration available in advance or on site.
course_highlights: Off-road uphill run
Start on Lovošská Street in Lovosice
Challenging climb to the summit of Lovoš
additional: Luggage transport is available from 12:30 to 13:30. The vehicle carrying the bags departs at 13:30, so be sure to watch the departure time. The race is part of the Král středohoří sports event series. Registration is available in advance or on site. The start is at 14:00, and luggage departs at 13:30.

name: Stupenská sedmička
location: TJ Sokol Stupno, Stupno, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 200 Kč do neděle 25. 10. 2026 (platba předem na účet)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 250 Kč do neděle 22. 11. 2026 (platba předem na účet)

description: Stupenská sedmička is the sixth edition of a trail running race, taking place on Saturday, November 28, 2026, at the TJ Sokol Stupno grounds. The race features a 7.2 km loop running mostly along forest paths with very little asphalt, suitable for experienced runners and beginners of all ages. The atmosphere is friendly and relaxed, with extensive facilities and refreshments after the finish. The entry fee includes a finisher’s medal, timing, race photos, prizes, and a raffle. The race is open to all athletes, taking their health and abilities into account.
course_highlights: A 7.2 km loop running mostly along forest paths with very little asphalt
A forest trail with tree roots and several wooded hills
A road crossing supervised by a volunteer and a section along an MTB route
additional: The entry fee includes refreshments after the finish, including tea, water, mulled wine, beer, lemonade, homemade cakes, savory pastries, Christmas breads, bananas, and energy bars. Winners are announced and raffle prizes are drawn after the race. The race bib has a timing chip that must be returned after finishing (a 500 Kč fee applies if it is lost). Race facilities include toilets, changing rooms, and parking at the TJ Sokol Stupno grounds. Runners are advised to write any allergies and an emergency contact on the back of their race bib in case of medical complications. A medical professional will be present at the start and finish area. Registration, including gift vouchers; proceeds support charity; a detailed route description is available.
