description: Stupenská sedmička is a trail running race held on Saturday, November 28, 2026, at the TJ Sokol Stupno grounds. The race features a 7.2 km loop, mostly on forest paths with very little asphalt, suitable for both experienced runners and beginners of all ages. The atmosphere is relaxed and friendly, with plenty of amenities, including refreshments, medals, timing, and a raffle. The course runs along forest trails, fields, and cycle paths, with several hills and road crossings monitored by volunteers.
course_highlights: A 7.2 km loop, mostly on forest paths with very little asphalt
Forest trail with tree roots and several hills
Road crossings monitored by volunteers, with part of the route on a cycle path
additional: The entry fee includes post-race refreshments (tea, water, mulled wine, beer, lemonade, homemade cakes, savoury pastries, Christmas bread, bananas, and bars), a finisher’s medal, course marking, timing, race photos, prizes for the winners, and a raffle. Runners attend a briefing and course description before the start; the awards ceremony and raffle draw take place after the race. The race is also suitable for complete beginners and children. The sixth edition takes place on November 28, 2026. The first category starts at 10:00.

name: Maraton Praha – Dobříš
location: A Park, Braník, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Prague–Dobříš Marathon is a traditional trail race held on 5 December 2026. The event offers three distances: 42 km with an individual start, and 21 km and 10 km with mass starts. The route runs from Prague 4, Braník, through Dobříš to Kytín, with elevation ranging from 125 to 593 metres. Runners can use baggage transport from the start to the finish. Overall winners and age- and gender-based category winners are announced. The event is suited to trail-running enthusiasts looking for a challenge in a natural setting, with a choice of distances.
course_highlights: 42 km course with 593 m of elevation gain
Start in Prague 4, Braník; finish in Kytín
Baggage transport for runners from the start to the finish
additional: The 42 km race has an individual start; the 21 km and 10 km races have mass starts. The 42 km course has aid stations at kilometres 10, 16, 27 and 33, and at the finish. Parking is available near the start and finish area. Runners take part at their own risk and must take extra care when crossing roads. The course is suitable for runners of all levels. Online registration is available, along with course maps and information about race categories.

name: Mikulášský běh Čimelice
location: Čimelice, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Mikulášský běh Čimelice is a traditional annual race held in Čimelice, a popular event with a long history that usually takes place in early December. It attracts local runners and visitors, who can look forward to a sporting experience in a friendly atmosphere. Exact details about the course and race distance are not currently available, but the race is part of the local sporting calendar and has a long tradition.
course_highlights: A traditional race with a long history in Čimelice
Held annually in December
Friendly atmosphere and local community
additional: The race is part of the local sporting calendar. Results from 2025 are available online.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - prosinec
location: Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt loop. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is rewarded at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt loop covering just under two laps (3.2 km)
The children's course is 800 m long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and over, and children aged 12 and under (boys and girls). Every runner is timed, and the top three finishers in the adult and children's categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, by car, on inline skates, or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The course is a precisely measured asphalt loop; the children's course is 800 m long. The race is open to all age groups, with categories for men, women, boys, and girls. You can start by bicycle, on foot, by car, on inline skates, or by trolleybus No. 11.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - prosinec
location: Stromovka Park, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, including children up to 12 years old, who run 1.6 km. The race has a friendly atmosphere and encourages everyone to enjoy running, whether you want to improve your personal best or simply enjoy a pleasant run in a beautiful park. After the finish, everyone gets a warm cinnamon pancake. The course follows the park’s paved paths; adults run two laps and children one.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km); children up to 12 years old run 1 lap (1.6 km)
Beautiful setting in the Royal Game Reserve – Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate (below the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45. Pre-registration online is available for faster check-in. Categories are divided by age, with an age-adjustment coefficient used for the year-round Lívancový Cup. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop). Changing and bag-drop tents, a mobile valuables storage facility, and toilet cabins are available. Parking is recommended near the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou Street. 3.2 km course, road surface, registration is voluntary, and running without a bib is permitted.

name: LEKI WINTER SkyRace®
location: Ještěd, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: LEKI WINTER SkyRace® is a winter skyrunning race held at Ještěd, in the ski jump area. The race offers a challenging 22 km royal course with 1,180 metres of elevation gain, bringing the 2025 skyrunning season to a close. Shorter courses and children’s races are also available, welcoming a wide range of runners. The event atmosphere is rounded out by the winners’ ceremony and an accompanying programme.
course_highlights: Winter SkyRace® royal course: 22 km with 1,180 m of elevation gain
Other courses: Winter Trail 12 km / 520 m+, Winter Easy 6 km / 220 m+
Children’s races: 200 m, 500 m and 1,200 m
additional: The winners’ ceremony starts at 15:30. The race takes place in the ski jump area at Ještěd. Canicross races are also available over the same distances as the main courses. The race is part of the LEKI JEŠTĚD SERIES. winter mountain race, multiple courses, children’s races, canicross, registration, race equipment and refreshments

name: LEKI JEŠTĚD SkyRace®
location: Ještěd, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: LEKI JEŠTĚD SkyRace® is a trail-running race held on the Ještěd Ridge in the Liberec Region. It offers challenging courses with beautiful views and natural scenery, appealing to both experienced runners and fans of mountain running. The race is part of the JEŠTĚD SKYRACE series and is known for its friendly atmosphere, high-quality organization, and extensive accompanying program, including healthy refreshments and a partner zone. Participants can also purchase original merchandise for the race’s 10th anniversary.
course_highlights: Trails on the Ještěd Ridge with beautiful views
Challenging mountain terrain with courses of varying distances (22 km, 13 km, 6 km)
Extensive accompanying program, including healthy and varied refreshments
additional: Participants receive a specially stocked race bag. Healthy and varied refreshments are available, including meat, vegetarian, and vegan options, as well as quality coffee. The event also features a TV studio with interviews and competitions, and an expanded partner zone with equipment and accessories for runners. Original merchandise for the race’s 10th anniversary is available. Races on different courses, a series of summer and winter races, registration, results, and rules are available on the official website.

name: Čertovská 5
location: Unhošť, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Čertovská 5 is a traditional winter run in Unhošť over a distance of 5.7 km. It offers not only a sporting experience, but also a social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup results. Runners are welcome to wear devil costumes, adding a unique atmosphere to the race. The race is divided into categories by age and gender, allowing for fair competition. The event takes place at the Sokol hall and is popular with locals and visitors alike.
course_highlights: Traditional 5.7 km winter run
Runners in devil costumes are welcome
Sokol Cup results announced after the race
additional: The race takes place on 6 December 2025 from 08:00 to 11:00 in Unhošť, at the Sokol hall, Melicharova Street. Categories are divided by age and gender (men and women in different age groups). After the race, there is a social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup results. Terrain: winter course. Registration via naZávody.cz. The event is suitable for all age groups and fans of dressing up.

name: Běh do vrchu Ráztoka-Pustevny
location: Ráztoka, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Ráztoka–Pustevny Uphill Run is a traditional mountain race held in Ráztoky and around Pustevny. It offers a challenging course with elevation gain that tests runners’ endurance and strength in the beautiful setting of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids. The event is popular with athletes of all levels and has a rich history dating back to 1969. It welcomes everyone who enjoys mountain running and wants to experience the race’s unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Climb to Pustevny with 400 m of elevation gain
Course length of approximately 5.7 km
Mountain setting in the Moravian-Silesian Beskids
additional: The race is also suitable for children. Weather may affect conditions. Registration details are not provided. The event has a long tradition and is very popular.

name: Jested Series
location: Ještěd, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: Ještěd Skyrace is a technical trail-running race on the Ještěd Ridge, featuring challenging climbs and descents with up to 1,390 metres of elevation gain. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and professionals and includes several route options, including races for children. The event is part of a race series with a friendly atmosphere and a generous participant race pack.
course_highlights: Technical trail sections on the Ještěd Ridge
Challenging climbs and descents with up to 1,390 m of elevation gain
Route options from 6 km to 22 km, including children’s races
additional: Mandatory equipment is required. Race bibs and timing chips are provided. On-site registration is available, along with bag storage, changing rooms and toilets. Refreshments and an awards ceremony are provided after the finish. The race is livestreamed, and results are available online. The race also offers canicross options and children’s races on shorter routes. The series also includes children’s races. The listed Winter SkyRace distances are 22, 12 and 6 km; the date 5 December 2026 is not confirmed in the available information.

name: Last Man Standing Run VYSOČINA
location: Klášter Želiv, Želiv, Czech Republic
description: Last Man Standing Run Vysočina is a unique endurance race held on December 5, 2026, at Želiv Monastery. Competitors repeatedly complete a 6.7 km loop, starting every hour, with the aim of lasting as long as possible and lining up for another start on the hour. The inaugural edition is limited to a maximum of 24 hours and 24 loops, with the winner being the person who completes all 24 loops. The race is not about speed, but about endurance and the ability to overcome physical and mental challenges in the winter conditions of Vysočina.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km loop through the hilly terrain of Vysočina
A new start every hour, up to a maximum of 24 loops / 24 hours
The official time is set by the tolling of the church bell at Želiv Monastery
additional: The race is limited to a maximum of 24 hours and 24 loops. Every competitor must wear their race bib throughout the event and keep a timing chip on their ankle. Headphones are prohibited on the course for safety reasons. Registration is processed manually; payment details are sent by email after the application has been processed. A T-shirt can be ordered as an add-on for 490 Kč. The official race time is set by the tolling of the church bell, which also symbolically closes the finish gate on the hour. The entry fee includes participation, light refreshments and facilities. Mandatory equipment includes a red rear light, a reflective item, neck protection and a personal drinking container. Part of the route may run along roads open to regular traffic.

name: Veleslavín běží
location: Veleslavín, Prague, Czech Republic

name: Malá cena Velké Verandy
location: Choceň, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Malá cena Velké Verandy is a traditional forest cross-country race held in Choceň. The race is 4,300 metres long and follows forest roads and trails, with approximately 200 metres of elevation gain. The course is marked with ribbons and includes a short stretch of asphalt. The race is also the Jirka Švadlena Memorial and is popular with runners looking for challenging terrain with a hilly profile.
course_highlights: 4,300 m along forest roads and trails
Hilly profile with approximately 200 m of elevation gain
Course marked with ribbons, approximately 400 m of asphalt
additional: The race includes approximately 400 m of asphalt and is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting. It is part of the local sporting calendar.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - prosinec
location: Smetanovy sady, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque setting of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and compete primarily against themselves. It also includes a cup competition, with results adjusted using an age coefficient and runners collecting points throughout the year. Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The start is by the fountain in the park.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.2 km) course in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc
A race suitable for all ages and running abilities
A picturesque park setting, with the fountain as the starting point
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The race venue is by the fountain in Smetana Gardens, except for two races in June and August, which take place by the river on U Dětského domova Street. The top three finishers in each category receive awards. The race is held on an asphalt course. It is part of a series of runs in Olomouc, with multiple dates throughout the year.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Nižbor
location: Nižbor, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 390 Kč za závod, 1 900 Kč za 6 závodů, 2 900 Kč za celou sérii

description: The Berounka Running Series is a series of 12 races in the beautiful surroundings of the Berounka River, from Radotín to Nižbor, running from January to December 2026. The routes follow trails with stunning views and varied terrain, often near nature reserves and historical sites. The series is suitable for experienced runners and beginners alike, and aims to encourage regular running. Most starts are at accessible locations with train connections and facilities at local pubs. At the end of the series, winners are announced and prizes are awarded in 12 categories.
course_highlights: Trails with views of the Berounka River and the Český kras Protected Landscape Area
Challenging climbs and nature reserves, such as Klapice and Radotínské skály
Starts at accessible locations with train connections and facilities at local pubs
additional: Refreshments, baggage storage, changing rooms with showers, and race bibs are available at the race venues. Bringing a headlamp is recommended. Rankings are based on the 10 highest-scoring races in the series. Most starts are near train stations and at local pubs that provide facilities. Trail races in the Berounka area; starts mostly accessible by train; winners announced in December; 12 categories; scoring based on the 10 best races

name: Winter Milada Run
location: Chabařovice, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: WINTER Milada Run is a winter running race held in the unique landscape of a former brown-coal mine, transformed into the beautiful natural setting of Lake Milada, between the Ore Mountains and the Central Bohemian Uplands. The race takes place on 12 December 2026 in Chabařovice and offers 12.5 km and 5.3 km routes, as well as Olympia children’s races. The event marks the end of the running season in northern Bohemia and attracts hundreds of runners each year to the lake’s magical snowy and icy landscape. All races have a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere and are suitable for children, families and adult competitors.
course_highlights: Routes run through the natural surroundings of a former brown-coal mine transformed into Lake Milada
A winter run through the snowy and icy landscape of Lake Milada
Two main routes: a 12.5 km long route and a 5.3 km short route, plus children’s races
additional: A race pack and medal for every competitor. The official Milada Tour 2026 T-shirt can be ordered during registration and collected on race day. The first 100 children to register receive a children’s T-shirt free of charge. The race is limited to 500 competitors. The accompanying programme includes St. Nicholas, a devil and an angel, and the Olympia children’s corner. Terrain in the former mine area, winter/icy conditions, family and children’s categories, on-site registration, medals for all participants, official T-shirts available for purchase.

name: Mikulášský běh Úpice
location: Náměstí v Úpici, Úpice, Czech Republic
description: The St. Nicholas Run in Úpice is a traditional running race organized by the Maratonstav Úpice sports club. The race takes place in the square in Úpice and offers categories for children and adults. The race bib is valid for the entire series of races organized by the event organizer. The event is suitable for all age groups and runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the square in Úpice, by the A. Jirásek Theatre
Categories for children and adults, with separate starts
Friendly atmosphere and the option to take part in the race series
additional: The race office opens one hour before the first category starts. Registration closes at 13:30 for the children’s categories and at 14:00 for adults. The race bib is valid for the entire race series and must be brought to each subsequent race. Results are not announced after each individual race but are published on the organizer’s website. The race takes place on 12 December 2026 in the square in Úpice. The scheduled start times are 14:00 for children and 14:30 for adults. Registration takes place one hour before the start, and results are published online.

name: Zručský adventní běh
location: Zruč nad Sázavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zruč Advent Run will take place for the seventh time on December 12, 2026. It is both a charity event and a race. The aim is to encourage more people to take up sport, help those in need, and give participants a chance to unwind from pre-Christmas stress by running through Zruč, illuminated for Christmas. The route passes through the beautiful chateau park and surrounding area, filled with a festive atmosphere. You can preview it in a video or download the GPX file for your smartwatch. After the race, warm soup and mulled wine will be served to round off the event.
course_highlights: Run through Zruč, illuminated for Christmas
The route passes through the chateau park and surrounding area, filled with a festive atmosphere
Downloadable GPX route file for smartwatches
additional: The race is a charity event, and warm soup and mulled wine will be served to participants after the run. The overall male and female winners hold the course record with a time of 19:10. The route is illuminated for Christmas, and festive decorations add to the atmosphere. The event offers two distances, 900 m and 5,500 m, and is open to children and adults. It features a Christmas atmosphere and a downloadable GPX route file.

name: Předvánoční běh
location: Frýdek-Místek, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Pre-Christmas Run is a traditional running race with a history dating back to 1984, held in Frýdek-Místek. The race offers courses for both young people and adults. Young runners take on asphalt loops in the stadium grounds ranging from 180 m to 1.7 km. Adults run kilometre loops: men run 8 km and women 3 km, with various distances available in the stadium grounds. The race is suitable for the general public and is part of the TJ Slezan Frýdek-Místek athletics calendar.
course_highlights: Asphalt loops in the stadium grounds for young runners, from 180 m to 1.7 km
Kilometre loops in Staré Město for adults — 8 km for men and 3 km for women
Race with a long-standing tradition dating back to 1984
additional: A run in the stadium grounds, with on-site registration, refreshments in the stadium clubhouse, and various distances from 200 m to 8 km

name: Vranovský noční Trail
location: Samovýčep, Vranov u Brna, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Vranov Night Trail is a winter race run in the dark around Vranov u Brna, offering a challenging yet beautiful course. The race symbolizes the balance between day and night and is the first real running test of the new season. The start and finish are at the Samovýčep venue, which has facilities including a heated tent, hot coffee and tea. After the race, warm Italian food, mulled wine and a relaxed after-party await. The organizers emphasize quality refreshments and a friendly atmosphere that runners can enjoy after finishing.
course_highlights: A 21.3 km course in the Podkomorské forests and around the reservoir
The course is marked with red-and-white and yellow tape and reflective spray
A winter race run in the dark over challenging terrain
additional: Race facilities at the Samovýčep venue include a heated tent, hot coffee and tea. There is plenty of water and sports drinks on the course. After the race, there is warm Italian food, mulled wine and an after-party with the opportunity to share feedback and socialize. A headlamp is essential. Facilities include a heated tent, hot coffee and tea, a warm post-race meal and an after-party.

name: 406. Malá cena Monaka – Vánoční
location: Slatiňany, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Malá cena Monaka - Christmas is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. This Christmas race is part of the Malá cena Monaka series and gives runners the opportunity to compete in a pleasant pre-Christmas atmosphere. The race is suitable for the general public and is known for its friendly organization and sporting spirit. It is organized by KRB Chrudim, which has been organizing running events in the region for many years.
course_highlights: A traditional Christmas run in the picturesque surroundings of Slatiňany
A friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization
Part of the long-running Malá cena Monaka series
additional: The race takes place on 20 December 2026 in Slatiňany, Pardubice Region, and is part of the Malá cena Monaka series. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels.

name: Vánoční běh Opava
location: Opava, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Opava Christmas Run is a traditional running race organized by the BěhOpava association team. The race covers a 4.7 km course starting on Englišova Street and heading toward Gappay (Latarna) along a farm track with an asphalt surface, with several turns before returning to the finish. Kilometer markers are placed along the course to help runners track their performance. The race is open to various age categories, from pupils to men across several age groups. The organizers provide small prizes for the top runners and hold a prize draw for additional prizes.
course_highlights: A 4.7 km course along a farm track with an asphalt surface
Kilometer markers along the course for orientation
Start and finish by Englišova Street – the gate of the School Farm
additional: The course record is held by Petr Gebel, set in 1994 with a time of 13:39. Participants race at their own risk and are advised to take care when crossing roads and follow the organizers’ instructions. The finish judges are members and supporters of the BěhOpava association. The race takes place on an asphalt course with a slight uphill section, starts at the School Farm, and includes small prizes and a commemorative run.

name: Vánoční běh v Ďáblickém háji

It is mostly flat, with one gentle hill, making it suitable for runners of all levels. The event traditionally takes place on 24 December, with the first category starting at 10:00. Woodland setting in the health area

The route follows paved roads, with an elevation gain of 176 metres on the main course and 68 metres on the hobby course.
