description: Contica Run to Radhošť 2026 is the 3rd Moravia and Silesia Mountain Running Championship, held in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm. The race is part of the 40th edition of the Krakonoš Czech Mountain Running Cup and offers a 6.5 km course with 734 m of elevation gain, running from the Rožnov campsite to the summit of Radhošť, near the statue of Cyril and Methodius. The race is open to all runners over 15 and also features children’s races and an accompanying programme. The adults’ race starts on Sunday at 10:00. Registration is available online and on site. Refreshments, chip timing and a finisher’s medal are provided after the race.
course_highlights: 6.5 km course with 734 m of elevation gain
The first kilometre is on asphalt, followed by rocky and forest terrain
Finish by the chapel on Radhošť at an elevation of 1,129 m
additional: Children’s races take place on Saturday from 14:00 in Rožnov town park. Race check-in is on Saturday 25.4. from 17:00 to 19:00 and on Sunday 26.4. from 7:30 to 9:30 at Camping Rožnov. Bags will be transported to the finish by car from the start at 9:30; personal transport back from the summit of Radhošť is not provided. The awards ceremony will take place at around 13:00 at the Camping grounds. Vehicles without a permit are prohibited from driving to the summit of Radhošť. The race is intended for runners interested in mountain running who want to test themselves on challenging terrain in the beautiful surroundings of Radhošť. Registration details and the exact route are available on the official website.

name: Vratislavický Běhoun 2026
location: Koupaliště SLUNÍČKO, Vratislavice nad Nisou, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: Vratislavický Běhoun is a traditional cross-country race held at the SLUNÍČKO swimming pool complex in Vratislavice nad Nisou. This 32nd edition features a course along field and forest paths, with a small section on asphalt, offering varied and interesting terrain for all participants. The race is also the 28th edition of the Vratislavice nad Nisou Mayor’s Travelling Cup and is suitable for the general public and competitors in various categories. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and beautiful surroundings of the Liberec region.
course_highlights: The course runs through the SLUNÍČKO swimming pool complex
Runs along field and forest paths
A small section of the course is on asphalt
additional: The start and finish are at the SLUNÍČKO swimming pool complex. The race is part of the Vratislavice nad Nisou Mayor’s Travelling Cup. The course is suitable for various age groups and runners of different abilities. The start and finish are at the swimming pool complex; registration details are not specified. The event has a rich history, and results are documented on the website.

name: Hodinovka Veselí nad Lužnicí
location: Veselí nad Lužnicí, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Hodinovka Veselí nad Lužnicí is an hourly running race organized by the South Bohemian Marathon Club as part of the South Bohemian Running Cup. The race takes place on a tartan track and gives runners the opportunity to test themselves in a one-hour run. The start is at 10:00, and the race is suitable for the general public, including runners from other regions and countries. The organizer is Martin Gazda, who ensures the event runs smoothly and handles scoring for the cup.
course_highlights: One-hour run on a tartan track
10:00 a.m. start
Part of the South Bohemian Running Cup
additional: Registration for the South Bohemian Running Cup requires payment of a membership fee of 250 Kč, which can be paid by bank transfer. The race is also open to runners from other regions and countries. Results and photos are published online. The organizer handles scoring for the cup and team competitions. tartan track, one-hour race, results and registration available online

name: Bělkovický kros
location: Bělkovice-Lašťany, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Bělkovický Cross-Country Race is a traditional running event organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc and held in Bělkovice-Lašťany near Olomouc. It is part of a series of endurance races in the Olomouc Region and gives athletes the chance to test themselves on natural terrain. Liga stovkařů is known for supporting recreational and competitive running and organizes a range of races for different age groups. The race is suitable for runners of all levels who want to enjoy a run in the picturesque setting of central Moravia.
course_highlights: 10 km trail race on mixed terrain
Races for children and young people, including age categories from 0 to 17
The event is part of a series of running races in the Olomouc Region
additional: The race is part of a series of athletics events for young people comprising five races from April to July 2026. Course details and registration information are not specified in detail.

name: Běh metropole MČ Praha 6
location: Kejřův park, Praha 6, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: Běh Metropole is a series of public running races held in different districts of Prague. Its aim is to promote a healthy lifestyle and a sense of belonging to one’s district. The race in Prague 6 takes place in Kejřův Park and welcomes runners of all ages and abilities. Each participant represents their district and contributes to the competition to find Prague’s most athletic district. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with original medals and gifts for runners.
course_highlights: Race in Kejřův Park, Prague 6
Urban park with a pleasant natural setting
Promotes a healthy lifestyle and community spirit
additional: Race check-in: 18:45–19:15; start: 19:30. The race is part of the Běh Metropole series, in which each participant represents their Prague district and contributes to its score. Special medals for individual categories serve as a memento of the race. The event is part of a series of runs in Prague with multiple dates and locations, including Ladronka and Kejřův Park, with the chance to earn special medals and take part in the celebrations.

name: Lesní půlmaraton Říčany
location: Říčany u Prahy, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Říčany Forest Half Marathon is a cross-country and trail race taking place on April 26, 2026, in the picturesque surroundings of Říčany near Prague. It offers 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km courses, running mostly along forest paths with significant elevation gain. The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on natural terrain and wanting to enjoy the atmosphere of a well-organized running event. The main race starts at 11:00. The organizer is Jan Kalkus, who ensures the event runs professionally.
course_highlights: Forest and cross-country terrain with elevation gain
Course distances of 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km
Picturesque surroundings of Říčany near Prague
additional: The race is part of Český běh, a service of the Czech Athletics Federation for runners and running events. Organizer Jan Kalkus can also be reached by phone at 737 548 668. The race is a trail and cross-country event, with online registration available. The event emphasizes the natural surroundings and sporting experiences.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Abertamy
location: Abertamy, Karlovarský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s., Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. On 26 April 2026, Abertamy will host a main race of 6 to 9 km, an experience trail of 20 to 30 km, and a 5 to 8 km walk with checkpoints to find using a map. Children’s races will be held over distances from 200 to 1,600 metres. The series offers a unique opportunity to discover the nature and picturesque places of the Ore Mountains across six races in different locations.
course_highlights: Main race: 6–9 km in Abertamy
Experience trail: 20–30 km, with navigation using a map
Children’s races: 200–1,600 metres
additional: The series includes six races in different locations in the Ore Mountains. Alongside running, participants can take part in canicross, a walk with checkpoints to find using a map, and children’s races. Routes cater to different abilities and offer opportunities to enjoy the natural surroundings. Races take place in various locations in the Ore Mountains, including Abertamy, Lesná, Potůčky and others, with registration from 07:00 and starts from 07:30. The event is suitable for the general public, including families with children.

name: Štěpánkovický kros
location: Štěpánkovice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Štěpánkovice Cross-Country is a traditional cross-country race organized by TJ Sokol Štěpánkovice in the beautiful surroundings of the Moravian-Silesian Region. The 12.1 km course runs mainly along forest and off-road paths, offering runners an enjoyable challenge and a chance to connect with nature. The race is suitable for trail and cross-country running enthusiasts looking for a quality sporting experience in a friendly atmosphere. It is organized by the experienced TJ Sokol Štěpánkovice team, led by Jiří Bořucký.
course_highlights: 12.1 km off-road course
Cross-country / trail character
Scenery around Štěpánkovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region
additional: The organizer is TJ Sokol Štěpánkovice. Contact person: Jiří Bořucký, phone 773 482 572. The race takes place at the TJ Sokol sports ground in Štěpánkovice. It is included in the official Czech Running calendar and certified by the Czech Athletics Federation. The race takes place on April 26, 2026, at the TJ Sokol Štěpánkovice sports ground. Registration is available through the official website. The event includes running and walking, with refreshments and facilities for participants.

name: Chrastavská desítka
location: Náměstí 1. máje, Chrastava, Czech Republic
description: The Chrastava 10K is a popular 10 km road race starting from 1 May Square in Chrastava. The first edition was held at the end of August, and runners rated the course very positively. The race offers an enjoyable 10-kilometre route suitable for the general public and sports enthusiasts. The event is held under the auspices of the City of Chrastava and supports sporting life in the region.
course_highlights: 10-kilometre road course
Start at 1 May Square in Chrastava
Pleasant weather and a course popular with runners
additional: The race is part of the regional sports programme. Registration is online, a prize raffle is held after the race, and children’s races are free.

name: Sherwood kros
location: Ostrava-Poruba, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 350,- Kč on-line, 400,- Kč na místě pro dospělé; 100,- Kč on-line, 150,- Kč na místě pro děti

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dospělý účastník 350,- Kč on-line (platba nejpozději do 23. 4. 2026)

description: Sherwood Cross is a running race held in the Poruba forest area of Ostrava-Poruba. The route runs mainly along unpaved forest paths. This is not a road race but takes place in natural, more challenging terrain, so suitable trail shoes are recommended. The event also includes children’s races on an asphalt loop near Porubská Myslivna, with children competing in different age categories. The main race is divided into categories by age and gender, and every participant who finishes receives an original finisher’s medal. Trophies and prizes are prepared for the winners.
course_highlights: Run mainly along unpaved forest paths in the Poruba forest
Children’s races on an asphalt loop near Porubská Myslivna
More challenging natural terrain suitable for trail shoes
additional: The maximum number of participants is limited to 400. Check-in takes place on race day at Porubská Myslivna. The children’s races start at 10:00, with approximately 10-minute intervals between categories; the main race starts at 12:00. After the race, sweet treats are prepared for the children, and all participants receive original finisher’s medals. Trail and forest paths, children’s races on asphalt, online and on-site registration, maximum 400 participants, refreshments, raffle, access by foot or bicycle only

name: Nymburský půlmaraton a desítka
location: Nymburk, Nymburk District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Nymburk Half Marathon and 10K is a traditional running race held in the picturesque town of Nymburk, offering a pleasant course with no significant elevation gain. The race runs through the town park, along the Elbe cycle path and over two bridges, with the finish and facilities beneath the historic town walls. A shorter 10K on a flat route is available for less experienced runners. The event is suitable for recreational runners as well as those training for longer races, and offers good facilities and refreshments both on the course and at the finish.
course_highlights: The course runs through the town park and along the Elbe cycle path
Crossing two bridges over the Elbe River, with 60 steps
Flat course with minimal elevation gain
additional: Refreshments are provided at the start, finish and every 5 km along the course (water, isotonic drinks, fruit and chocolate). At the finish, runners can choose a hearty lunch or a baguette. Race numbers bearing runners’ names are mailed for payments made by 12 April 2026. Facilities are available in the park beneath the town walls, including a changing room, storage for belongings and bicycles, portable toilets and seating. Timing is electronic with a chip; results are available online, and runners receive an SMS with their finishing time. The time limit for the half marathon is 2 hours. Races take place in the park beneath the town walls. Registration opens on 19 May 2025. Race distances are 21.1 km and 10 km. Refreshments are available on the course and after the race. Facilities in the park include changing rooms, storage, toilets and drinking water.

name: Běh Škarmanem (Domažlice)
location: Domažlice, Plzeň, Czech Republic
organizer: Sportovní klub policie ŠPS Domažlice z. s.
description: Běh Škarman is a traditional cross-country race held in Domažlice in Škarman Forest Park. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska series and offers adults and junior athletes the opportunity to run in beautiful natural surroundings. The start is at 10:00, and the race has a friendly atmosphere that welcomes runners of all abilities. Participants can enjoy challenging forest trails that test their endurance and strength.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in Škarman Forest Park
Challenging terrain with natural obstacles
Picturesque setting in Domažlice
additional: The race starts at 10:00 in Škarman Forest Park in Domažlice. Entry fees differ for adults and junior athletes. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska series, which includes various running events in the region. Members of the Běžec Chodska association can enjoy benefits such as choosing a race number bearing their own name at selected races. The race is held in memory of Marek Kubalík, with results and categories, and is part of a regional running series. Registration and further information are available on the official website.

name: JAK
location: Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Jan Amos Komenský Operational Programme (OP JAK) supports the development of research, development and education in the Czech Republic, aiming to strengthen strategic intelligence, innovation and the modernisation of teaching methods. The programme focuses on supporting leading research teams, internationalisation and the development of the institutional environment of research organisations. OP JAK also emphasises equal opportunities and developing individuals’ potential, contributing to greater competitiveness for the Czech Republic and improved living conditions for its residents. The programme’s calls are open to projects with a nationwide impact in research, development and innovation (RDI) and education.
course_highlights: Held in Prague 4, Prague
Promotes a healthy lifestyle and community spirit
Open to the general public
additional: Applications for support are submitted through the IS KP21+ application from 3 April 2025 to 1 June 2026 at 14:00. The Managing Authority of OP JAK is the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports, with contact addresses in Prague 1 and Prague 9. A consultation helpline for OP JAK templates offers telephone support every working day from 9:00 to 15:00. Harfa Office Park is wheelchair accessible and has a lift. A contact form is also available for enquiries. The race is part of a wider programme focused on supporting research, development and education in the Czech Republic, with an emphasis on community involvement and a healthy lifestyle.

name: Přeštická desítka
location: Přeštice, Plzeň, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: startovné činí 150 Kč při online registraci

description: Přeštická desítka is a traditional running race in Přeštice, taking place for the tenth time in 2026. The race offers a fast, flat 10-kilometre course on soft terrain along the Úhlava River, ideal for everyone from competitive runners to recreational athletes. The event also includes shorter 5-kilometre races and children’s categories, so there is something for the whole running community. The facilities at the Loděnice complex provide comfortable amenities, including a buffet, changing rooms and showers. Přeštická desítka is part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup and promises a friendly atmosphere and a great sporting experience.
course_highlights: Fast, flat 10 km course along the Úhlava River
Soft terrain ideal for running
Categories for adults, children and a 5 km Fit Run
additional: Facilities at the Loděnice complex include an open buffet, heated changing rooms, hot showers and toilets. Runners do not have to return their race bibs. The race takes place in all weather conditions. The organiser may use photographs and video footage for promotional purposes without compensation. The event includes 10 km and 5 km races. Registration is available online or on site; the start is at 10:30, with registration from 9:00. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup.

name: 6666m
location: Chotěšov, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The 6666m race in Chotěšov is a cross-country run held on Sunday, April 30, 2026, starting at 16:00. The route passes through the picturesque České středohoří region and challenges runners with off-road terrain and natural obstacles. The event is suitable for all runners who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and the beauty of the surrounding landscape.
course_highlights: Cross-country run on the natural terrain of the České středohoří region
A 6666-metre route
Picturesque views and natural obstacles
additional: Registration is available online via the form on the website. The organizer is O. Maršík, who can be contacted by phone at 606 248 978. Results from previous editions are available on the website. The race offers a cross-country course, registration information, the date and time of the event, and is part of a race series with the option to take part in other disciplines and an after-party.

location: Horní Bečva, Vsetín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: DSO – Prostřední Bečva a Horní Bečva

description: Macur’s Memorial is a legendary race held in the picturesque surroundings of Horní Bečva in the Beskydy Mountains. The race offers a wide range of categories for children and adults, from the shortest distances for the youngest runners to the main 4.15 km race. The event starts in the grounds in front of the elementary school, while the main categories set off from Martinák. After the race, runners can shower and use the valuables storage. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and tradition, attracting runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Distances range from 170 m for the youngest runners to 4.15 km for adults
Start and finish in the grounds of the elementary school in Horní Bečva
Mass start for the main categories from Martinák, limited to 100 runners
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available in the small gym at the elementary school. Valuables storage is available; runners must have their race number. The main start from Martinák is limited to 100 runners; the last shuttle to the start leaves at 15:45. After the race, runners receive a timing chip, race number, a voucher for a beer or Kofola, and broth at the finish. The race takes place in the grounds in front of the elementary school in Horní Bečva. Registration is open from 1 April to 5 May 2026. The race is suitable for the general public, including families with children.

name: Běh Hvězdou - Memoriál Vladimíra Fiřta
location: Obora Hvězda, Praha 6, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Běh Hvězdou – Vladimír Fiřt Memorial is a running race held in Hvězda Game Reserve in Prague 6. The race offers two distances: 6.6 km for men and 3.3 km for women. It is part of the SABZO series and attracts runners looking to enjoy a run in a natural setting with a historic atmosphere. The race is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity to test your strength in a beautiful park with a rich history.
course_highlights: The course runs through Hvězda Game Reserve, a historic park in Prague 6
Two distances: 6.6 km for men and 3.3 km for women
Part of the SABZO running series
additional: A trail race in a natural setting. Registration by email or phone. Suitable for runners of different abilities.

name: Memoriál Luboše Svobody – cena Běžce Vysočiny
location: Lesopark Heulos, Jihlava, Vysočina Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 Kč - muži, junioři, ženy, juniorky přihlášené on-line

description: The Luboš Svoboda Memorial – Vysočina Runner’s Prize is a traditional running race held in Heulos Forest Park in Jihlava. The race offers various distances for all age groups, from the youngest children to veterans, with the main 8.8 km course for men, juniors, and veterans. The course follows paved and unpaved paths through the forest park, with scenic sections along the Jihlávka River and around the athletics stadium. The race also honors the memory of Luboš Svoboda, a prominent runner from the Vysočina region.
course_highlights: A 2.2 km loop on paved and unpaved paths through Heulos Forest Park
The main course runs along the left bank of the Jihlávka River and crosses footbridges near the ZOO and athletics stadium
Paved surfaces make up approximately 25% of the course
additional: The start takes place at the summer cinema venue in Heulos, Jihlava. Changing rooms and toilets are available beneath the cinema screen. Runners aged 3 and older may take part. Categories are divided by age, with distances ranging from 350 m for the youngest participants to 8.8 km for adults and veterans. A season entry pass can be used. The race is part of the Vysočina Runner series, which promotes an active lifestyle and sporting opportunities in the region. The start is scheduled between 17:15 and 17:30 at the summer cinema venue in Jihlava.

name: Běh na Doubravku
location: Hrad Doubravka, Teplice, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Doubravka is a traditional running race held at Doubravka Castle in Teplice as part of Sports Day at Doubravka. The course is 5,100 metres long with 170 metres of elevation gain and follows a forest trail. The race is open to the general public and offers an opportunity to celebrate spring through sport and fun. Diplomas are awarded to the top three in each category, winners receive a trophy, and the fastest team receives a perpetual trophy. The event also features a cultural programme and other sporting activities.
course_highlights: A 5,100 m course with 170 m of elevation gain
The course surface is a forest trail
Part of Sports Day at Doubravka Castle
additional: Diplomas are awarded to the top three in each category, and winners receive a trophy. The fastest team receives a perpetual trophy and diplomas. The event is part of the wider Sports Day at Doubravka, which also includes a cultural programme and other sporting disciplines. The race includes category awards and prizes for the top runners, and in the past it has also had virtual editions during the COVID-19 pandemic.

name: Karlovský kopcovák
location: Karlova, Benešov, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Karlovský kopcovák is a running race held on May 1, 2026, on the slope of Karlov in Benešov. The race is 4.5 km long and offers a sporting challenge on hilly terrain. Registration is available online only in advance. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka running series, which offers a varied calendar of running events in the Central Bohemian Region.
course_highlights: 4.5 km course
Hilly terrain on the slope of Karlov
Held in Benešov, Central Bohemian Region
additional: Registration is available online only in advance. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka series, which includes other running events in 2026. The race takes place on May 1, 2026, in Benešov, is part of the local running cup, and features challenging hilly terrain.

name: Běh KERMI
location: Areál společnosti KERMI, Stříbro, Plzeň, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné: 150 Kč, přihlášky na místě v areálu KERMI, školící centrum

description: The KERMI Run in Stříbro is a traditional 10.5 km race that runs mainly off-road, starting and finishing at the KERMI company premises. The race is suitable for runners of different levels, who can start either at 10:00 or in the main start at 10:30. After the race, there will be a results ceremony, a get-together and refreshments for participants. The event is organized by KERMI in cooperation with the Stříbro Endurance Runners Association, which supports amateur athletes and runners in the region.
course_highlights: A 10.5 km route, mainly off-road
Start and finish at the KERMI Stříbro premises
Option of an earlier start at 10:00
additional: The race starts at 10:30, but slower runners can also start earlier, at 10:00. After the race, there will be a results ceremony, a get-together and refreshments, including drinks. The route is mainly off-road. Registration is available on site. The start is at 10:30, and refreshments and an awards ceremony will be provided after the race.

name: Jarní přespolní běh Nýrsko
location: Areál pod Sjezdovkou, Nýrsko, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Spring Cross-Country Run in Nýrsko is a traditional athletics event organized by TJ Nýrsko z.s. and held at the venue below the ski slope. The event offers children’s categories starting at 13:00 and the main race from 14:00. The course runs through the sports complex below Pajrek, with an elevation gain of 20 metres per lap. The event is part of the Ešus League, a series of off-track races in the Klatovy District, and is suitable for the general public looking to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and nature.
course_highlights: The course runs through the sports complex below Pajrek
The elevation gain per lap is 20 metres
The race is part of the Ešus League, a series of off-track races in the Klatovy District
additional: On-site registration from 12:00; registration closes 15 minutes before the start of each category. Refreshments are available at the venue below the ski slope. Prizes are awarded to the first three finishers in each category, subject to the organizer’s resources. All participants take part at their own risk; children participate at their parents’ responsibility. The event includes various races, including the main race and a children’s race, and is part of the local sports calendar. The run is known for its tradition and friendly atmosphere.

name: Májový běh okolo rybníka Nezmaru
location: Jilešovice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The May Run around Nezmar Pond is a traditional running race organized by Maratón klub Seitl Ostrava, held in the picturesque village of Jilešovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. Founded in 1997, Seitl Ostrava brings together runners of all levels and supports sporting activities in the region. The race offers a pleasant atmosphere and a chance to meet the running community in beautiful natural surroundings. The organizers welcome both new runners and experienced athletes looking for a quality running experience.
course_highlights: A loop around Nezmar Pond in Jilešovice
Picturesque natural surroundings in the Moravian-Silesian Region
A traditional running event with a friendly atmosphere
additional: The event is part of a regional running series and emphasizes a community atmosphere and sporting activities for all age groups.

name: Boskovické běhy
location: Boskovice, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Boskovice Runs is a major sporting event in the region, offering routes of varying lengths for all age groups, including children. The main race, the Run for the Seven-Toothed Ridge, is 12.5 km long and features two long forest sections. The event is not only a sporting competition but also a social occasion that promotes a healthy lifestyle and a family-friendly atmosphere. It also includes a varied accompanying program and, new this year, a team race for teams of three. Walkers can join in and enjoy a shared day of activity and fun.
course_highlights: The main course is 12.5 km long
Two long forest sections on the main course
Children’s races for all age groups
additional: New this year is a race for teams of three. Race bibs can display the runner’s name. Walkers can take part in the group event. Special children’s races are planned. The information line is available on weekdays from 9:00 to 12:00 and from 16:00 to 19:00 at 776 762 602. The event includes various races, including children’s races, team races and the main race, and takes place in the South Moravian Region on May 1, 2026.

name: Memoriál Huberta Šuláka
location: Osada Údolí oddechu, Libečov, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Hubert Šulák Memorial is a running event held in the Osada Údolí oddechu settlement in Libečov. It aims to pay tribute to a notable runner and support the region’s running community. Exact details about the course distance and registration are not provided on the official website, but the event is open to all running enthusiasts who want to celebrate the spirit of sport and help preserve the running tradition. The event will take place on 1 May 2026.
course_highlights: Paying tribute to Hubert Šulák
Supporting the local running community
Held in the picturesque surroundings of the Osada Údolí oddechu settlement
additional: The event is associated with a place of rest and nature, and is suitable for various age groups and running abilities.

name: Jestřebí kros
location: Chlíve 62, Stárkov, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Jestřebí Cross-Country Race is a running event held in the scenic surroundings of the village of Stárkov in the Hradec Králové Region. The event is open to runners of all levels who want to enjoy nature and a sporting atmosphere. Exact course distances are not listed, but the race is part of the local running calendar and offers an opportunity to get active in beautiful surroundings. Registration details and the full schedule are available on the official website.
course_highlights: Scenic countryside in the Hradec Králové Region
Friendly atmosphere for runners of all levels
A chance to enjoy a race in natural surroundings

name: Běh zámeckým parkem
location: Zámecký park, Horšovský Týn, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run Through the Castle Park is a popular sporting event organized by Aktiv Sport Horšovský Týn. It takes place on May 1, 2026, in the picturesque Castle Park in Horšovský Týn. The event includes relay races around the pond, covering 4 x 600 meters, which are part of the Plzeň Region Youth Running Cup. It offers runners of all ages the chance to enjoy an active day in the park’s beautiful natural surroundings. The race is scheduled to start at 14:00 and is suitable for the general public and sports enthusiasts alike.
course_highlights: Relays around the pond in Castle Park
600-meter legs, with 4 legs per relay
Picturesque setting in Castle Park in Horšovský Týn
additional: The race is part of the Plzeň Region Youth Running Cup. It is organized by Aktiv Sport Horšovský Týn, z. s. The event features relays around the pond, covering 4 x 600 m. The race takes place in Castle Park, is open to all age groups, and is part of the regional running cup.

name: Vrcholy
location: Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Peaks of the Czech Mountains are a unique collectible challenge for all nature lovers and outdoor adventurers. This sticker set features the 25 highest peaks of the Czech mountains and ranges, which you can stick on your bottle as a reminder of your trips and achievements. Each sticker is hand-drawn and inspired by real peaks, and made from durable material with UV protection and water resistance to withstand even demanding conditions. This collection is ideal for anyone who wants to carry an original, personal touch of adventure with them wherever they go.
course_highlights: The 25 highest peaks of the Czech mountains and ranges
Hand-drawn and exclusively designed stickers
High-quality materials with UV protection and water resistance
additional: The stickers are water-resistant and have strong adhesive that holds on a variety of surfaces, even in adverse conditions. They are protected against fading by UV lamination. Some stickers are also dishwasher-safe.

name: Jestřebí kros
location: Chlívce u Náchoda, Náchod, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Jestřebí Cross is a pleasant cross-country race run almost entirely on paved forest trails around Chlívec near Náchod. The 10.8 km course starts with a longer climb, continues over rolling terrain, and finishes with a longer descent in open terrain. The race is suitable for runners who enjoy natural, forested surroundings and moderate elevation changes.
course_highlights: The course runs almost entirely on paved forest trails
A longer climb at the start
A longer descent to the finish in open terrain
additional: Children can enter for free. The organiser is BK Náchod. The race takes place by the U Lípy pub in Chlívec near Náchod. The first category starts at 9:30; the main category starts at 11:00. Terrain: forest trails. Registration: advance registration required. Notes: course with an initial climb and descent

name: Běh Krásné vyhlídky
location: Struhařov, Mnichovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč pro dospělé, zdarma pro děti a juniory
description: The Běh Krásné vyhlídky is a traditional running race held in Struhařov near Mnichovice, featuring a unique panoramic route along the new Krásné vyhlídky nature trail. The race is part of the Pohár Ladova kraje running series and welcomes a wide range of runners, including children, juniors, adults, and veterans. The start and race facilities are at Hliněný rybník, where accompanying races for the youngest age groups are also held. The main race is 7.4 km long and follows one loop along the nature trail. The race is made possible by the support of volunteers, local associations, and partners.
course_highlights: A unique panoramic route along the Krásné vyhlídky nature trail
A 7.4 km loop for the main race
Accompanying races for children and juniors around the pond
additional: Registration for the accompanying races is from 13:00 to 14:30, with the first races starting at 14:45. Registration for the 7.4 km main race is from 14:00 to 16:00, and the main race starts at 16:30. Categories include preschoolers (200 m), schoolchildren (620 m), juniors (1860 m), and adult men, women, and veterans (7.4 km). The fastest man and woman from Struhařov are recognized in the main race. The race is part of the regional Pohár Ladova kraje series, with starts at 14:45 and 16:30. Race distances include the 7.4 km main race and children’s races of 200 m, 620 m, and 1860 m.

name: Běh Údolím vzdechů
location: Sudoměřice u Tábora, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run Through the Valley of Sighs is a traditional cross-country race organized by TJ Sokol Sudoměřice u Tábora and held annually on May 1. In 2026, the event will take place for the 10th time, attracting runners of all ages, including children and adults. The race offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in the scenic surroundings of Sudoměřice u Tábora and is accompanied by a lively atmosphere and community spirit. Results and photos from previous editions are available online.
course_highlights: A cross-country race in the scenic valley of Sudoměřice u Tábora
A course suitable for children and adult runners
An annual tradition with a community atmosphere
additional: Results for the children’s and adults’ races are published online. Photos from the event are available in several online galleries. The event is organized by TJ Sokol Sudoměřice u Tábora, which also organizes other sporting and social events in the village. The race includes children’s events starting at 50 m, registration for adults costs 150 Kč, and the races take place on natural terrain, with participation open to the general public.

name: Běh údolím samoty
location: Radvanec u Nového Boru, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: The Run through the Samota Valley in Radvanec near Nový Bor is a traditional race in the Českolipsko District Running League, taking place on May 1, 2026. The race gives runners the chance to enjoy a run through a picturesque valley with natural scenery and a peaceful atmosphere. It is an ideal event for nature-running enthusiasts who want to combine athletic performance with the beauty of the surrounding landscape. The race is part of a wider series of running events in the region that promote an active lifestyle and community sports.
course_highlights: A picturesque valley with natural scenery
A peaceful atmosphere, ideal for running in nature
Part of the Českolipsko District Running League
additional: Race details and regulations are available to download; the event is part of a regional running series.

name: PM Consulting Choceňský půlmaraton
location: Choceň, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The PM Consulting Choceň Half Marathon is a 21.1 km running race along forest roads between Choceň and Horní Jelení. The course follows good-quality forest roads with gravel and some asphalt, making it suitable for running on light terrain. In addition to the half marathon, shorter 10 km and 5 km routes are available, suitable for juniors, veterans and anyone who wants to experience the race atmosphere. Race facilities are located at the swimming pool complex in Choceň, where medical services are also provided. The event is open to the general sporting public and takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Forest course on firm paths with gravel and asphalt surfaces
Race facilities at the swimming pool complex in Choceň
Czech Red Cross medical services at the start and finish area
additional: The race also includes a three-person team competition, with the times of all team members added together. An accompanying programme for children includes a bouncy castle. The race takes place in all weather conditions. The course runs along the Banda reservoir and is suitable for the general public. The event is part of a wider sports day in Choceň, with the option to take part in other accompanying activities.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Chomutov
location: Wakepark Chomutov, Chomutov, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 / 200,- Kč, 200 Kč - 300 Kč za měřené běhy, 100 Kč za rodinný běh

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: rodinný závod 1 km - registrace on-line/na místě od 100 Kč

description: The Run for the Memory of Nations in Chomutov is a sporting and community event held to support the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the lives of people who witnessed historical events and helps preserve their stories. The race takes place on May 1, 2026, at Wakepark Chomutov and offers a timed 5 km run and an untimed 1 km family run. The course follows a flat cycle path around the Banda reservoir and through Otvice, finishing in the car park by Banda. The event is suitable for all ages and promotes endurance and remembrance of freedom fighters.
course_highlights: Flat route along the cycle path around the Banda reservoir
Turnaround in the village of Otvice, followed by a return along the same route
Start and finish by Aquasvět and the car park by Banda
additional: Registration and race-bib collection are open from 8:30 to 9:45 for the 1 km run and until 10:30 for the 5 km run. Storage, restroom facilities, water at the finish, and refreshments are available. DJ Lukáš Budai will provide the music. Pupils, students under 18, members of the Memory of Nations Club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. The start is scheduled for 08:30. Registration is available online and on site; the event includes refreshments, bag storage, and music.

name: Král Zvičiny 2026
location: Lipnice, Zaháj, Dvůr Králové nad Labem, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč online (250 Kč na místě) pro hlavní závod; 100 Kč online (150 Kč na místě) pro děti
description: Král Zvičiny 2026 is a mass-start uphill road race for individuals and an ideal way to kick off the season. The race takes place on May 1, 2026, in the Dvůr Králové nad Labem - Lipnice - Zaháj area and offers two main routes: an adult race of approximately 10 km on asphalt with a continuous climb, and a 3 km children’s race. The main race finishes at Raisova chata on Zvičina, while the children’s race finishes in Dehtov. It is organized by the Carla Kupkolo.cz team from Dvůr Králové nad Labem.
course_highlights: Main race: approx. 10 km on asphalt with a continuous climb
The route passes through Lipnice, Dehtov and Třebihošť, finishing at Zvičina
Children’s race: 3 km, finishing in Dehtov
additional: Race-day check-in takes place in Dvůr Králové - Lipnice - Zaháj from 8:30 to 9:30. The awards ceremony is held at Motorest U Lípy in Třebihošť. Categories are divided by age and gender, including junior and veteran groups. The race is part of the cycling season and offers both competitive and amateur cyclists a great opportunity to enjoy the atmosphere and the uphill challenge. Registration is available online via sportchallenge.cz.

description: The Karel Rais Memorial is a traditional road race organized by the ELNA Počerady Athletics Sports Club, held on May 2, 2026, in Louny. The event features the 35th edition of the 15 km race and the 11th edition of the inline skating race. The course is certified by an AIMS measurer and runs on closed roads with gentle elevation changes. It starts near the village of Volevčice and finishes in Masaryk Gardens in Louny. The day also includes a fun run for all age groups and activities for families and children. The organizers provide transport to the start and facilities including changing rooms and showers.
course_highlights: The 15 km course follows closed class II and III roads with no motor vehicle traffic
Start elevation: 219 m; finish elevation: 178 m
Course certified by an AIMS measurer, valid for 10 years from 2016
additional: The race starts in four waves according to category. Bus transport from Louny to the start in Počerady is provided. Changing rooms and showers are available at the swimming pool sauna next to the exhibition grounds. Personal belongings are transported by van. The fun run is suitable for everyone, including people with disabilities, and participants receive a T-shirt. The program includes a Children's Day with athletics competitions and cultural activities. Registration is open until April 30, 2026. The race takes place on closed roads, with transport provided from Louny Municipal Swimming Pool. Race categories include different age groups and relay races.

name: Běh na 2 míle – Praha, Stromovka
location: Stromovka Park, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, including children aged 12 and under, who run the shorter 1.6 km course. It’s ideal for those who run for fun, want to improve their personal best, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful park setting. After the finish, every participant receives a warm cinnamon pancake. Everyone’s time is recorded, and results are published online and count toward the year-round Lívancový Cup.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km); children aged 12 and under run 1 lap (1.6 km)
Královská obora – Stromovka, a beautiful park setting
additional: Registration takes place near the Brussels Gate from 8:15 to 8:45. Online pre-registration is available for faster check-in. Categories are divided by age and gender, with an age coefficient for the year-round cup. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, by roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop). Tents are available for changing and leaving belongings, along with a mobile valuables deposit and toilet cabins. Parking is recommended near the bridge to Císařský ostrov on Za elektrárnou Street. The race is for all age groups, covers 3.2 km, and is suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike, with the aim of encouraging the joy of running. Parking is available near the bridge to Císařský ostrov, and changing facilities and toilets are provided.

name: Kačický lesní běh
location: Obora, Kačice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Kačice Forest Run is an appealing off-road race in the beautiful Obora Forest and surrounding area of Kačice, with a range of distances from 100 m to 900 m for young people and adults. The event takes place on 2 May 2026 and is open to all age groups, including children’s races with free entry. There are also social activities, including a sauna and refreshments after the race, creating a friendly atmosphere for the whole family. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup, making it a great opportunity to get together for sport in nature.
course_highlights: Cross-country running in Obora Forest, with distances from 100 m to 900 m
Races for all age groups, including children’s races
Post-race social activities, including a sauna and refreshments
additional: Cross-country running in Obora Forest, various race distances, children’s races with free entry, sauna and refreshments after the race

name: Maloskalský půlmaraton
location: Malá Skála, Český ráj, Czech Republic
description: The Maloskalský Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque Český ráj region, in Malá Skála. The race offers a half-marathon course with approximately 25 metres of elevation gain and a surface combining asphalt, gravel and dirt roads. The start is in the early evening, giving the race a unique atmosphere. The event also includes a 10 km course, suitable for a wide range of runners. The organisers provide a full service, including chip timing, refreshments on the course and at the finish, baggage storage and medical services.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course: 21.098 km, with approximately 25 m of elevation gain
Course surface: 80% asphalt, 10% gravel, 10% dirt road
The route follows a cycle path and hiking trails, crossing a railway bridge and passing Hrubý Rohozec Chateau
additional: Limit of 200 runners for the half marathon and 100 for the 10 km race. Race bibs can include the runner’s name for registrations made by 26 April. STOPNITO chip timing. Refreshments on the course at kilometres 5, 8, 13 and 16, and at the finish. Race check-in from 14:45 to 16:40; baggage storage available until 16:40. Race-logo T-shirt available to order. Course: 21.098 km; start at 17:00; registration from 14:45 to 16:40. The race includes refreshments, chip timing, gifts and medical services.

name: K6 Czech Ultramarathon Festival
location: Konstantinovy Lázně, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The K6 Czech Ultramarathon Festival is a prestigious ultramarathon held in Konstantinovy Lázně on a 2,854-metre loop. The festival includes six races of varying lengths, from 24 hours to a six-day run, attracting ultramarathon runners from many countries. In 2026, the 24-hour race will also be the Czech Republic Championships. The race is known for its difficulty and international participation, making it a significant event in Czech and world ultramarathon running.
course_highlights: A 2,854-metre loop in Konstantinovy Lázně
The longest race lasts six days
The 24-hour race is the 2026 Czech Republic Championships
additional: The race is held on an asphalt road course. The organiser is Rumning klap z.s. The first category starts at 12:00. The festival includes 50 km, 24-hour, 48-hour, 72-hour and 144-hour races, as well as a six-day run. The races take place on a 2,854-metre loop equipped with lighting and meeting international standards. The event is part of the international ultramarathon calendar and offers various race distances, including 50 km, 24 hours, 48 hours, 72 hours and 6 days.

name: Otrokovická 100
location: Otrokovice, Buchlovské hory, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Otrokovická 100 is a 100 km ultramarathon held in Otrokovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The event is part of a wider weekend program that also includes a 50 km option, and is intended for runners seeking a challenge in the beautiful surroundings of the Buchlov Mountains. The race is organized by the SKÁJ team and attracts participants from across the country who want to test their endurance over a long distance. The event emphasizes athletic performance, active recreation, and a community atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 100 km ultramarathon in the picturesque surroundings of the Buchlov Mountains
The option to take part in a 50 km event
Organized by the SKÁJ team, with an emphasis on athletic performance and community
additional: The race includes aid stations and is intended for active athletes and running enthusiasts, with an option to volunteer.

name: Avanti běh Lukov
location: Lukov u Znojma, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Avanti Run Lukov is a race in Lukov near Znojmo, featuring a 9 km main race for men and a 4.5 km race for women, along with children’s races of various distances depending on age. The course is mainly on firm surfaces, including asphalt and farm tracks, with a significant climb in the upper part of Lukov. After the race, the full Znojmo Running Cup series is celebrated with awards for the top runners and light refreshments. The event is organized by the Rabbits Znojmo team, which welcomes all runners to take part and meet up after the race.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly on asphalt and farm tracks
A significant climb in the upper part of Lukov
Two laps for men (9 km), one lap for women (4.5 km)
additional: Check-in and registration take place on site at Penzion Adalbert in Lukov near Znojmo. The children’s races start at 9:15, and the main race starts at 10:00. After the race, the full Znojmo Running Cup series is celebrated, with handmade trophies and prizes from sponsors. Light refreshments are provided for participants. The organizers welcome feedback and suggestions for improvement. The event is open to the general public, including children.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - květen
location: Madal Bal, Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and levels of running experience, from beginners to seasoned runners. The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt loop. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is rewarded at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt loop of just under two laps (3.2 km)
The children’s course is 800 metres long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and over, and children up to 12 years old (boys and girls). Every runner is timed, and the top three finishers in each category receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get there are by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates, or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The course is 3.2 km long, the start is at 9:00 by the Madal Bal company, registration is held on the first Saturday of the month from 8:15 to 8:55, and the run is open to all ages and focused on the joy of movement.

name: Kokina běh
location: Horka nad Moravou, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Kokina Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc and held in Horka nad Moravou. The race is 15 km long and is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix of Endurance Runners. The Liga stovkařů club specializes in recreational and competitive running and offers participants a quality sporting experience in the picturesque surroundings of Central Moravia. The race is suitable for runners of varying ability who want to test themselves on an interesting course.
course_highlights: 15 km race distance
Picturesque surroundings of Horka nad Moravou
Part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix of Endurance Runners
additional: Registration is open until 1.5.2026. Participants agree to the race rules and take part at their own risk. The organizer is not responsible for any injuries. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix of Endurance Runners series. It takes place as part of a regional series and offers not only a sporting experience but also the opportunity to meet the local running community.

The race is part of the year-round cup; start at 9:07, registration from 8:15 to 8:45, online registration available, parking by the bridge to Císařský ostrov, changing facilities and toilets available, participants are divided into age categories.

name: Letohradská pětka
location: Orlovna na Orlici, Letohrad, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic

Depending on the category, the course ranges from 100 to 5,000 metres and runs mainly along field and forest paths. The race offers a friendly atmosphere and is part of the Orel Running League. Registration takes place in the morning, and the main race starts at noon.

Course distances range from 100 to 5,000 metres, depending on the category
Start at the Orlovna in Orlice

The course runs along field and forest paths, with the start at the Orlovna in Orlice. The race is part of the ISCAREX CUP 2025 and the Orel Youth Running League.

The event offers a range of courses for all ages, from preschoolers to adults and veterans, with distances from 300 metres to 15,200 metres. Entry fees are paid at registration. The race is open to the general public and offers a chance to enjoy a day of sport in beautiful surroundings. It is organised by T. J. Sokol Roudnice nad Labem, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and good facilities for runners and spectators.
course_highlights: A range of courses from 300 m for preschoolers to 15,200 m for distance runners
Start and finish at Tyrš Stadium, with routes passing through the area around Mount Říp
Age- and gender-based categories, with courses in the Roudnice nad Labem area

name: Hornobludovická sedmička
location: Horní Bludovice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Hornobludovická sedmička is a traditional running race in Horní Bludovice, held on a challenging, hilly 7 km course with approximately 100 m of elevation gain, including 63 steps up to the Žermanice Reservoir dam. The race is part of the Karviná District Running Cup and offers a beautiful running experience on a mix of road, gravel and farm-track surfaces. After the race, there will be an awards ceremony, a raffle and refreshments at the FC Horní Bludovice football grounds, which provide facilities including changing rooms and showers. Runners of all categories and age groups are welcome, with prizes for the top three in each category.
course_highlights: 7 km course with approximately 100 m of elevation gain, including 63 steps up to the Žermanice Reservoir dam
Mixed surfaces: road, gravel and farm track
Challenging, hilly and varied course
additional: Race-day registration is from 9:00 to 10:00 at the FC Horní Bludovice football pitch. Refreshments at the start and finish are subject to the organiser’s arrangements. After the race, there will be a raffle and refreshments. Categories are divided by age and gender, with prizes for the top three in each category. Changing rooms and showers are available at the football grounds. Parking is available by the football pitch. The race takes place on 2 May 2026; registration runs from 1 January to 1 May 2026, and the race is part of the Karviná Cup 2026.

name: Běh Klobasnou
location: Lesy u Veselí nad Lužnicí, Veselí nad Lužnicí, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Klobasna Run is a traditional running race organised by the athletics club in Veselí nad Lužnicí, now taking place for the 64th time. The event offers various categories, including a 1 km family run and children’s races, where participants receive medals, trophies and prizes. Registration is available in advance or on race day, making organisation easier and reducing waiting times. The event takes place in a pleasant sporting atmosphere and is suitable for the general public, including families with children.
course_highlights: A traditional running race with a 64-year history
A 1 km family run and children’s categories
A pleasant atmosphere and a sports complex in Veselí nad Lužnicí
additional: Registration is available in advance or on race day from 9:00 to 11:00, no later than 30 minutes before the start. On race day, participants only pay the entry fee and collect their race number. Participants in the children’s categories and family run receive a finisher’s medal. The club also sells jerseys, caps and headbands. Parking is available at the sports complex. The race includes various courses, including children’s races and the family run, with registration available on-site or in advance, forest and gravel paths, and undulating terrain.

name: Mistrovství ČR v maratonu mužů a žen
location: Staroměstské náměstí, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Czech Republic Men’s and Women’s Marathon Championships is a prestigious race over the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km, held in Prague’s historic city centre, starting in Old Town Square. The race is for men and women over 18 who met the qualifying standards in previous years. It is organised by Juniorský maratonský klub, z.s. in cooperation with RunCzech. Runners can use modern timing services, and a professional photography service is available after the race. The start is traditionally at 08:00 in the morning.
course_highlights: Start and finish in historic Old Town Square in Prague
A 42.195 km route through central Prague
Professional timing and the option to download the GPX route
additional: The race office is open on 1 and 2 May 2026 at the Výstaviště exhibition grounds in Holešovice, in the Křižík Pavilions. Photography is provided by witisi.photo, with the option to pre-order during registration or order after the race. Applications are accepted only from runners who met the qualifying standards between 1 January 2025 and the registration deadline. Participation is subject to the qualifying standards and approval by the technical delegate. The available information relates to the 2025 and 2026 editions, not to the date 9 May 2027.

name: Barvám Neutečeš České Budějovice
location: Sokolský ostrov, České Budějovice, Czech Republic
description: Barvám Neutečeš is a colourful run and a full day of fun for all ages, families and friends, held on Sokolský Island in České Budějovice. Choose between two routes: 5 km with five colour zones, or 1.5 km with three colour zones and an interactive sports zone. It’s not about speed, but about joy, friendship and unforgettable experiences filled with colour, music and fun. Come and enjoy a day of laughter, dancing and shared energy, where nobody can escape the colours.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 colour zones
1.5 km route with 3 colour zones and an interactive sports zone
The colour zones cover runners from head to toe in colour
additional: The event runs from 9:00 to 16:00 on Sokolský Island. It includes musical performances, themed zones, photo booths, 360° video and an accompanying programme. The event is suitable for everyone, regardless of ability; children can take part on shoulders, scooters or in strollers. It takes place on 3 May 2026 on Sokolský Island in České Budějovice. Registration is available both on site and online, with different packages for individuals, teams and corporate participants. The event also has a charitable aspect and various accompanying city activities.

name: Běh na 2 míle, Zlín – Příluky
location: Průmyslová zóna Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic

At the finish, each participant is rewarded for their effort with a warm cinnamon pancake.

name: Prague International Marathon 2026
location: Staroměstské náměstí, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Prague International Marathon 2026 is a prestigious running event held in Prague’s historic city centre. The race offers a traditional 42.195 km marathon course that passes iconic city landmarks. The running weekend also includes accompanying races for families and children, creating a welcoming atmosphere for all age groups. The start is scheduled for May 3, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. in Old Town Square.

Start and finish in Old Town Square
A measured 42.195 km marathon distance
additional: The running weekend also includes the Active Breakfast Run (4.2 km), the dm Family Mile (1.609 km) and the dm bambini run (children’s races of 100–200 m). Runners can use the RunCzech mobile app for race information and a virtual race pack. The race is part of the RunCzech running league and offers special categories, including the Czech Marathon Championships for men and women. The 42.195 km race starts on Sunday, May 3, 2026, at 8:00 a.m.; registration also includes other events such as the Active Breakfast Run, the dm Family Mile and the dm bambini run.

name: Běh 2 míle Olomouc
location: Smetanovy sady, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Olomouc 2 Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and competing primarily against themselves. It also includes a cup competition, with results adjusted using an age coefficient and runners collecting points throughout the year. Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The top three finishers in each category receive awards.
course_highlights: Race in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, by the fountain
Course length: 2 miles (3.2 km); children’s course: 600 m
Friendly atmosphere for runners of all abilities and ages
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The race venue is by the fountain in Smetana Gardens, except for two races in June and August, which take place by the river on U Dětského domova Street. Results are adjusted using an age coefficient, and runners collect points for the cup competition covering September 2025–August 2026. The race includes categories for all age groups, with awards for the best finishers in each category; the course runs through Smetana Gardens and by the river, and registration is from 9:30 to 10:00.

name: ORLEN Maraton Praha, MČR v maratonu mužů a žen
location: Staroměstské náměstí, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The ORLEN Prague Marathon is a prestigious race held in Prague’s historic center and also serves as the Czech Republic Marathon Championships for men and women. It traditionally covers the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km, starting in Old Town Square. The race attracts thousands of runners and offers a unique atmosphere with beautiful views of Prague’s landmarks. It is part of the RunCzech Running League and is known for its professional organization and support for the running community.

Classic marathon distance of 42.195 km

The route is challenging but offers a unique running experience in Prague’s historic setting.

The race is suitable for runners who want to enjoy nature and the community atmosphere of the running series.

The event takes place at the Tatran Písařov sports field and offers a sporting experience in a friendly atmosphere. SK Pašerák has a long-standing commitment to organizing sports activities for children and young people in the region.

A traditional spring cross-country race in the village of Písařov

name: Běh lesoparkem Praha Hostivař
location: Lesopark Hostivař, Praha 10, Czech Republic
description: The Prague Hostivař Forest Park Run is a trail race offering two course options: 3.5 km for women and 7 km for men. The race takes place in the scenic Hostivař Forest Park in Prague 10 and is part of the SABZO series. It is suitable for anyone who wants to enjoy running in nature, with gentle elevation and a pleasant atmosphere. The race is ideal for trail-running enthusiasts and offers the chance to compete against other runners in the beautiful Hostivař forest.
course_highlights: Trail course in Hostivař Forest Park
Two distances: 3.5 km for women and 7 km for men
Part of the SABZO series
additional: Registration costs 50 Kč; members of TJ Zentiva and SABZO can enter for free. The race takes place in Prague 10-Hostivař, near the gazebo by the children's playground in Hostivař Forest Park.

name: Žďárák – Čerňák
location: Čerňák, Žďár nad Sázavou, Vysočina, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné: 50 Kč (startovné bude opět věnováno na dobročinnou sbírku, tentokrát pro Charitu, která podpoří Alexe Vondru, studenta ze Žďáru, který přišel o ruku a potřebuje peníze na sportovní protézu.)

description: Čerňák is a trail race along the paths of the Black Forest around Zelená hora and across meadows towards Vysoké. The 7 km route with 180 m of elevation gain features varied terrain, with 90% off-road and 10% asphalt, reminiscent of Scottish fellrunning races. The race is popular with local runners and offers beautiful views of the town of Žďár nad Sázavou and the UNESCO-listed Pilgrimage Church of St John of Nepomuk on Zelená hora. The start and finish are by the car park at the church on Zelená hora. The entry fee goes to a charity fundraiser for a sports prosthesis for student Alex Vondra.
course_highlights: 7 km trail race with 180 m of elevation gain
The route follows paths through the Black Forest and meadows towards Vysoké
A final climb up the steps to the UNESCO-listed church on Zelená hora
additional: Start and finish by the car park at the church on Zelená hora. Trail shoes are recommended. The entry fee goes to a charity fundraiser for a sports prosthesis. The route is marked. Race photos are available online. Events include trail, cross-country, road, gravel and MTB disciplines; registration and exact routes are listed on the website.

name: Noční běh pro Světlušku České Budějovice
location: České Budějovice, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Noční běh pro Světlušku České Budějovice

price_tiers.distance: Noční běh pro Světlušku České Budějovice

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in České Budějovice is a charity running event taking place on 6 May 2026, starting at 21:00 by the sports hall near Stromovka. Participants can choose between two distances—2.3 km (1 lap) and 4.6 km (2 laps)—and the event is suitable both for runners and for those who would like to walk the course. The entry fee is 500 Kč, half of which goes directly to support people with severe visual impairments. The event offers race packs with a headlamp or a sports headband, as well as an accompanying programme including a concert by the band Byt číslo 4.
course_highlights: Night run with a choice of 2.3 km or 4.6 km courses
Start and finish by the sports hall near Stromovka in České Budějovice
Charity run supporting people with severe visual impairments
additional: Registration desks open at 19:00. Capacity is limited for participants’ safety and comfort. Race packs are available in two versions—with a headlamp or a sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P cards who are accompanied by someone can enter for free; they can purchase a race pack on site for 250 Kč. An admission ticket with a unique code, either printed or on a mobile device, is required to enter the venue. The programme includes a concert by the band Byt číslo 4 from 20:00. Distances of 2.3 km or 4.6 km, accompanying programme, benefits for the Světluška project, registration via GoOut.cz, tickets with a code, holders of ZTP and ZTP/P cards enter for free

name: Mistrovství ČR v silničním běhu na 1 míli a 5 km mužů a žen
location: Lázeňská kolonáda, Poděbrady, Czech Republic
description: The Czech Road Running Championships for men and women over 1 mile and 5 km take place in the beautiful surroundings of the spa park in Poděbrady. The course is very fast, with no elevation gain and precisely measured 1 km laps along the spa colonnade, offering ideal conditions for personal records. The race is officially recognized by the Czech Athletics Federation and is part of the prestigious Poděbrady Walking program. The event also features an accompanying program and the chance to receive an original finisher’s medal featuring the spa fountain.
course_highlights: 5 km race over five 1 km laps along the spa colonnade
1 mile race featuring an opening 609 m section and a 1 km lap along the spa colonnade
Very fast, flat course certified for the European Race Walking Championships
additional: Registration is available online only, with payment due within 7 days of registering. Late registrations will have no name printed on the race bib. On-site registration is available until 30 minutes before the race starts. Registration can be transferred free of charge until 21.4.2026; a fee applies after that date. Finisher’s medal featuring the spa fountain. Accompanying program throughout the day along the spa colonnade. Available information about the program, registration, and prices applies to the 2026 edition; details for the date 14. 5. 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Běh vítězství Jihlava – Třešť
location: Jihlava, Vysočina, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč online, 200 Kč na místě pro dospělé; zdarma pro mládež do 17 let online, 50 Kč na místě
description: The Jihlava–Třešť Victory Run is an annual running event held on May 8, 2026, offering various race categories for adults, juniors, and children. The route runs from Jihlava to Třešť and includes both road sections and forest trails, with the main race covering 14.6 km. The event is part of the Vysočina Running Cup and offers not only sporting experiences but also prizes and in-kind awards for the winners. Registration is available online, and the race is suitable for a broad range of participants, including young people and children.
course_highlights: Main 14.6 km route from Jihlava to Třešť on roads and forest trails
Categories for different age groups, including children and young people
Part of the Vysočina Running Cup, with online registration available
additional: The route includes paved roads and forest trails; the race starts at approximately 8:45–9:45; race categories are available for children and young people; winners receive prizes and in-kind awards; refreshments and showers are provided.

name: Běh vítězství zámeckým parkem Lány
location: Lány, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: TJ Sokol Lány, Základní škola Charlotty Garrigue Masarykové Lány
price_range: 50 Kč pro děti a mládež, 100 Kč pro dospělé, zdarma pro účastníky akce 'Běh pro zdraví'

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Děti a mládež do 18 let 50 Kč

description: The Victory Run through the Lány Castle Park is a traditional running race with a history dating back to 1972. It takes place every year on May 8 in the castle park in Lány. The race offers a wide range of categories for children and adults, with distances from 60 metres to 7,800 metres. The courses are mostly on sand, gravel and grass, creating a pleasant and varied running environment. Races start at 8:20 and continue throughout the morning, and spectators are welcome to enjoy the atmosphere. The event is organised by TJ Sokol Lány and Charlotta Garrigue Masaryk Elementary School under the auspices of the Municipality of Lány.
course_highlights: The courses run mainly along sandy and gravel paths and over grass in the castle park
The women’s main race is 3,900 m (one lap), and the men’s is 7,800 m (two laps)
Children’s courses range from 60 m to 1,500 m, with colour-coded laps
additional: Race-day check-in is from 7:30 at the main entrance to the castle park, below the castle greenhouse. Runners must collect their race numbers no later than half an hour before their category’s start. Runners line up at the start 5 minutes before the start. Participants in the Run for Health start together on the 1,200 m course; the winner is determined by a draw. There is no entry fee for participants in the Run for Health. The race starts at 8:20; registration is available online or on site. The event has been part of the local sports calendar since 1972.

name: Čavisovská stovka
location: Čavisov, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Čavisovská Stovka is a long-distance walk in the area around Čavisov, with 30, 50 and 100 km routes. It is being held for the thirteenth time. The start and finish are at the TJ Sokol sports field in Čavisov. Routes follow hiking trails, cycle routes and the event’s own markings; using a digital track for navigation at night is recommended. The organisers provide refreshments and basic facilities, including toilets and a shower at the start. The event is open to everyone, regardless of gender or a dog’s breed, and dogs may take part without a time limit.
course_highlights: Routes follow hiking trails, cycle routes and the event’s own markings
A flagship 100 km route for experienced participants, a challenging 50 km route and an easier 30 km route
Four refreshment stations on the 100 km course (at 16, 26, 53 and 79 km)
additional: The start and finish are at the TJ Sokol Čavisov sports field. Routes are not marked on hiking trails or cycle routes, so a digital track on a watch or phone is recommended. The event ends on 10 May 2025 at 23:59 for all routes; anyone finishing after the time limit will be recorded as DNF. Dogs may take part without a time limit. Toilets and a shower are available at the start; hot water is limited by the capacity of the boiler. The event offers several distances, online registration, maps and elevation profiles for the routes. The walk is open to the general public, including families and endurance runners.

name: Memoriál obětí fašizmu Čechtice
location: Čechtice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Memoriál obětí fašizmu Čechtice is a 6 km running race that takes place on trails in the countryside around the village of Čechtice. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka Cup and gives runners the chance to test themselves amid the picturesque scenery of the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for anyone who enjoys trail running and wants to experience a sporting atmosphere in pleasant surroundings.
course_highlights: Trail course around the village of Čechtice
Race distance: 6 km
Part of the Běžec Podblanicka Cup
additional: The race is part of a solemn day of remembrance for the victims of fascism, highlighting the event’s historical and social significance.

name: Strážnická stovka
location: Strážnice, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Strážnická stovka is an extreme sporting event in the heart of the White Carpathians, open only to participants over 18. This ultratrail marathon features a challenging 100 km route, with a slightly modified hundred-kilometre course that tests runners’ determination and fitness. The start and finish are in Strážnice. The race includes aid stations and the option to transport drop bags. Each participant receives an original race bib bearing their name and, after completing the course, a beautiful metal finisher’s medal as a reward for pushing their limits.
course_highlights: 100 km route through the White Carpathians
Aid stations and drop-bag transport to OS Května
Race bib bearing your name and a metal finisher’s medal
additional: The race has two start groups: Limit 24h starts on Friday, 8 May 2026 at 19:30 for participants not aiming for a trophy; Limit 15h starts on Saturday, 9 May 2026 at 5:00 for runners aiming for a trophy. Accreditation takes place on Friday, 8 May from 17:00 to 19:00 and on Saturday, 9 May from 4:15 to 4:45 (drop bags are not available). The entry fee includes refreshments on the course and at the event base. Timing is provided by ORGSU chips, and entry can be transferred to a substitute. A T-shirt with the logo is an optional item available to order through the e-shop. Registration opens on 3 November 2025. The race is open to adults only, and the course includes challenging terrain and technical sections.

name: Poděbrady Running - MČR v silničním běhu na 1 míli a 5 km a veřejný běh na 5 km
location: Lázeňská kolonáda, Poděbrady, Czech Republic
description: Poděbrady Running is the inaugural open Czech Republic Road Running Championships over 1 mile and 5 km, complemented by a public 5 km race. The event takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the spa colonnade in Poděbrady and features certified, very fast and flat circuits where world records are set. This race is an ideal opportunity for runners looking to set a personal best and experience the atmosphere of competing alongside the best Czech athletes.
course_highlights: Certified circuits along the spa colonnade
A very fast, flat course suitable for personal bests
The beautiful surroundings of Poděbrady
additional: The event is organised by the Czech Athletics Federation. The first and main category starts at 12:00. The course is certified and suitable for fast times. The entry fee can be paid in advance or on site for an additional charge. The 5 km course consists of 5 laps of 1 km each. The race is certified for the European Race Walking Championships. Registration is available in advance and on site. The time limit for the 5 km is 38 minutes. The race is suitable for participants aged 15 and over.

name: Běh osvobození
location: Lišany, Díly, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: SK Lišany, z.s. / TJ Sokol Díly
description: The Liberation Run is a traditional road race between the municipalities of Lišany and Lužná in the Plzeň Region. The race is 7 km long and takes place on a lightly trafficked third-class road. The start is at 11:15 after registration at the U Hřiště restaurant in Lišany. The race is divided into six age categories and is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup. Cash prizes are offered to the top finishers in each category and for breaking course records.
course_highlights: A 7,000 m route on the lightly trafficked third-class road Lišany–Lužná–Lišany
Start and finish by the U Hřiště restaurant in Lišany
Cash bonuses for breaking course records
