name: Trail Modřanskou roklí VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
location: Modřanská rokle, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Trail Modřanskou roklí 2026 is a running race in Prague offering two routes—8.5 km and 15 km. The race takes place in the picturesque Modřanská Rokle, where runners can expect technical narrow trails, wide paths, and a climb up a rock with panoramic views. The event has a friendly atmosphere and is easily accessible by tram. The entry fee includes refreshments, medals and prizes for the top finishers in each category, as well as race results and a photo report.
course_highlights: Narrow technical trails and wide paths
A climb up a rock with panoramic views
A jungle among apartment blocks, accessible by tram
additional: Check-in from 17:00 at the blue tent by the turning circle near the Lipiny reservoir. The entry fee includes an isotonic drink and light refreshments after the race and along the course, as well as luggage storage in the organizers’ tent. Awards for the top runners in the 40− and 40+ categories. You can withdraw up to 24 hours before the start and have your entry fee credited toward another race. Good public transport access, parking at the start, and cycle route A21 from the Vltava. The race takes place on May 20, 2026. Registration is available online and on site. The event includes medals, refreshments, and race results.

The organizer, SABZO, offers this race as an opportunity for runners of all levels to test themselves and enjoy a sporting experience in a friendly atmosphere.

A friendly atmosphere and sporting experiences for runners of all levels

Organizers Pepa Krejčí and Honza Vočko look forward to a large turnout and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A traditional running route in Krčský Forest
Pleasant woodland surroundings
A popular route from pub to pub

A separate race is organized for children, with the loop distance announced before the start. The event is part of the Brno Running Series and is suitable for all age groups. Refreshments and baggage storage are available after the race.
course_highlights: A 5.5 km loop in the pleasant surroundings of Kohoutovice
Men and women start together
Children’s race with the loop distance announced before the start
additional: On-site registration opens at 17:15. The children’s race starts at 17:45 and the main race at 18:00. Water and a baggage-storage tent are available after the finish. Parking is limited. Public transport: trolleybus 37 to the “Voříškova” stop. The course runs through a city park. Registration takes place at the venue. The race is open to all age groups, with the start and finish at the Tatran sports ground in Kohoutovice.

description: Stonařov Alleys is a traditional running race dating back to 1978, held in the picturesque surroundings of Stonařov in the Vysočina Region. The main race follows farm and forest roads alongside a stream and along Zelená Alley to a hunting lodge. The course has a gentler elevation profile and is mostly soft underfoot. Races are offered for all age groups, from preschoolers to veterans, with a focus on a family-friendly atmosphere and an enjoyable sporting experience for every runner. Each participant receives a commemorative prize and a diploma; category winners receive prizes, and the overall winner receives the Běžec Stonařova travelling trophy.
course_highlights: The 10 km main course follows farm and forest roads and includes 30% asphalt.
The route runs alongside a stream and along Zelená Alley to a hunting lodge.
A gently undulating profile with mostly soft terrain.
additional: Start at the football pitch; categories for ages 3 and up; youth participants run for free; mass starts for categories A, B, C, D and P. Each participant receives a diploma and a small package. The top three in each category receive prizes. A travelling trophy is awarded to the best man and woman in the main race. A scenic course featuring historical and natural landmarks, with multiple categories including youth and children. The race is part of the Vysočina Running Cup.

name: Jistebnický VH maraton
location: TJ Jistebník, Jistebník, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100-200 Kč (za jednotlivé závody, dle registrace a délky)
description: The Jistebník Water Management Half Marathon is a traditional running race, now being held for the sixteenth year in the picturesque landscape on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area. It offers routes ranging from 3.6 km to a marathon, running through nature with beautiful views of the Beskydy Mountains. The start and finish of all races are at the TJ Jistebník sports complex, which also hosts a varied programme of side events, including a children’s Olympics. The race is suitable for the general public, including children and young people, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organisation.
course_highlights: Routes run through nature on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area
Landscape between Jistebník, Polanka nad Odrou and Klimkovice
Fantastic views of the Beskydy Mountains
additional: Registration for all races opens at 7:00 and closes 20 minutes before the start of the relevant race. The start and finish are at the TJ Jistebník sports complex. There are refreshments on the course; at the finish, one of the course refreshment stations is available, and additional refreshments are offered by the local pub, known for its Marathon Soup. Parking is available near the complex, though using train or bus connections is recommended. Changing rooms and showers are available after the race. Blood and blood plasma donors receive a 50% discount on the entry fee upon proof of their most recent donation. The races take place in a natural setting and offer various route distances, including children’s categories and a side programme. Online registration is available.

name: Vrané – Zvole
location: Vrané nad Vltavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Vrané - Zvole is part of the KOPEC series, which features uphill races in Prague and the surrounding area. This race offers a challenge in the form of a demanding climb and is intended for runners who want to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain. The KOPEC series is a long-standing, popular circuit where runners are automatically included in the overall standings without needing to register separately. The races are organised with an emphasis on fair play, safety and sportsmanship.
course_highlights: An uphill race through the terrain of Prague and Central Bohemia
A demanding climb and a hilly course profile
Part of the long-standing KOPEC series, with scoring and league standings
additional: Runners are automatically included in the overall KOPEC series standings by taking part in any race. The series standings are determined by the total points earned for placing in individual races, with a maximum of the 10 best results counted. Runners must follow the rules for starting and conduct on the course, including wearing a race number and not receiving assistance from other people or animals. If health is at risk, the race director may interrupt or end the race.

name: Štramberská desítka
location: Štramberk, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Štramberk Ten is a traditional road race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletics Club Kopřivnice. The race takes place in the picturesque town of Štramberk and offers a 10 km mixed-terrain course, mostly on roads. The event is open to the general public and is known for its friendly atmosphere and rich history. Participants can expect refreshments at the finish and prizes for the top runners in various categories. The race takes place in traffic, and each participant runs at their own risk.
course_highlights: 10 km course, mixed terrain with mostly road running
Refreshments at the finish and traditional Štramberk ears
Course records: men 37:26.6, women 47:26.5
additional: Race-day registration is open from 9:15 to 10:40 at the gymnasium of Štramberk Primary School. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Sokol Hall in Štramberk. Prizes are awarded in age and gender categories, including cash bonuses and non-cash prizes. The race is part of the Ing. Petr Bayer Memorial. Registration is from 9:15 to 10:40 at the primary school gymnasium in Štramberk; refreshments are provided at the finish, and changing rooms and showers are available at the Sokol Hall. The race takes place in traffic, and participants run at their own risk.

name: Berounská desítka
location: Zdejcina, Beroun, Czech Republic
price_range: drahší poplatek na místě, přesná cena není uvedena
description: Berounská desítka is a revived running race with a long tradition, taking place on 23 May 2026 in the village of Zdejcina near Beroun. It offers three distances: the 10 km main race for experienced runners, a shorter 4 km route suitable for everyone, and a free 500 m children’s run. The course follows forest trails with 252 metres of elevation gain and reaches its highest point at the Děd lookout tower, 491 m above sea level. Runners can look forward to refreshments during and after the race, as well as a welcoming atmosphere that revives the local running tradition.
course_highlights: Paved and unpaved forest trails
Highest point at the Děd lookout tower (491 m above sea level)
252 metres of total elevation gain
additional: Race-number collection is open from 8:00 to 10:00 on race day. Runners in the 10 km race can get refreshments at approximately 6 km, and fruit and water after finishing. The 500 m children’s race starts at 10:15; the 4 km and 10 km races start together at 11:00. Payment on site is possible, but costs more. The race takes place in all weather; suitable footwear for wet terrain is recommended. Parking is available on Hudlická Road; runners are advised not to try to park directly in the village. Course with 252 m of elevation gain; refreshments before the start, at 6 km and after finishing; parking on Hudlická Road; weather may vary; race takes place in all weather.

location: Olešnice v Jihomoravském kraji, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Orel Run through Skalky Forest Park is a traditional sporting event organized by Orel, a Christian sports organization, in Olešnice in the South Moravian Region. The Prof. P. Leopold Benáček Memorial gives runners the opportunity to compete in the beautiful natural setting of Skalky Forest Park. The event is part of Orel’s broader program, which supports sport for all in the spirit of fair play and a healthy lifestyle. The race is suitable for the general public and contributes to the development of sporting activities in the region.
course_highlights: Skalky Forest Park, with natural running trails
Beautiful natural surroundings near Olešnice
A traditional memorial race dedicated to Prof. P. Leopold Benáček
additional: The race is part of the OBL 2026 race schedule, offers rules and results, and takes place in May 2026

name: Hannah Pilsen Trail Letkov
location: Letkov u Plzně, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Hannah Pilsen Trail Letkov is a traditional outdoor running race near Plzeň, offering scenic courses of varying lengths and difficulty. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Letkov and is part of the celebrations marking the municipality’s 750th anniversary. The route passes Jandova skála and Čilina, and also includes a marathon with climbs to Maršál and Radyně. A multigenerational relay is available for children and families, encouraging active movement across all generations.
course_highlights: 8.5 km course via Jandova skála
21 km course via Čilina
Marathon with climbs to Maršál and Radyně
additional: The race is part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup. Children’s races and the multigenerational children-and-parents relay “Běžíme pro Totem” are also available. The race is one of the events celebrating Letkov’s 750th anniversary. The event offers various course distances, including 8.5 km, 21 km and a marathon, as well as family relays and children’s categories. Registration opens at the end of 2025, and the races take place in a natural setting, with refreshments and medals for participants.

description: Tisá Ultra Trail is a new event that continues the tradition of the Libouchec Ultramarathon. It offers several routes of varying lengths and difficulty in the beautiful surroundings of Tisá and the surrounding area. The races run mostly off asphalt roads, along forest and field roads and trails, with clear course markings. The race facilities are well equipped, with showers, changing rooms and refreshments, as well as the option to stay overnight in your own tent or car. The organizers emphasize safety and environmental responsibility, for example by limiting the use of plastic cups at aid stations.
course_highlights: The routes run mostly off asphalt roads, along forest and field roads and trails
Aid stations are placed every 15–20 km and offer a varied selection of food and drinks
Race facilities include changing rooms, showers, toilets and the option to stay overnight in your own tent or car
additional: The start and finish are behind the football pitch in Tisá. Facilities include changing rooms, toilets, showers, seating and refreshments in a covered tent. You can stay overnight in your own tent or car. Parking is available at the Burg grounds. Mandatory equipment for the 100 km race includes a race timing chip and a fully charged mobile phone. Aid stations offer water, cola, sports drinks, fruit, bread, cheese, biscuits, muesli bars and salt. Soup and a main meal are served at the finish; bringing your own dishes and cutlery is recommended. The 10 km race starts at 12:00, and the 100 km race at 5:00. Registration and drop-bag handover take place the day before the race. Course options range from 25 km to 100 km, with children’s races, facilities at the football pitch and in the Libouchec hall, the option of a tent campsite, ceramic medals and participant T-shirts.

The Běhej lesy series is known for its community atmosphere and respect for nature.

Conti Speed Section — a 150-metre speed section marked with Continental flags
Generali Investments Finish — an extended 500 m finish straight with a timed section
additional: In Brdy, runners compete on the Nova 12 km and ČSOB 22 km routes. The prize for the Conti Speed Section is a tyre voucher and a running shirt. The fastest man and woman across all routes will each receive a Craft technical running shirt and the title GENERALI INVESTMENTS FINISHER #1. The event features various distances from 4 to 22 km, children’s races, an accompanying programme and options for families to take part. It takes place in the natural surroundings of the Brdy Protected Landscape Area, with an emphasis on ecology and community spirit.

The races follow rolling and flat paths, with beautiful views of the lake and surrounding countryside. The race’s high standards and popularity are confirmed by the participants themselves.

The accompanying program includes an Olympia children’s corner and childcare. The event features courses around Milada Lake, children’s races, medals for all participants, and an accompanying program.

name: Brdské rokle

description: Brdské rokle is a trail race held in the picturesque setting of the Forest Theatre in Řevnice, offering three courses of varying lengths and difficulty. All routes run through the forest over varied terrain, including climbs, descents and beautiful views of springtime nature. The race is known for its technical sections and undulating profile, which challenge both runners and experienced trail enthusiasts. You can have your name printed on your race bib, and runners can make use of facilities with refreshments and a kids’ corner for families with children.
course_highlights: Forest routes with 200–360 m of elevation gain, depending on course length

Beautiful views and spring nature in full bloom

The facilities at the Forest Theatre include toilets, baggage storage and refreshments at the finish (Corny bars, bananas, water and Ionilyte isotonic drink). A kids’ corner with arts and crafts activities and supervision by an experienced teacher is available for children. Travelling by train is recommended due to limited parking in Řevnice. Trail races in nature, technical sections, refreshment stations, 10 km and 15 km routes, starting from the Forest Theatre in Řevnice.

description: SeziRun is a traditional running race held in Sezimovo Ústí on May 23, 2026. The 10th anniversary edition offers a wide range of races for children and adults, including a half marathon and 12 km, 6 km, and 4 km distances. The race is suitable for all ages and ability levels, with winners announced in individual categories. Parking is available near the start and finish, making it easier for participants to get there. The atmosphere is sporty and friendly, with photos shared and a limited-edition headband available for participants.

The race is popular for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization, attracting runners of all levels.

A grand prize for the overall winner of the MAXI zajíci category over 5,555 m
Part of the Ladův kraj Cup, with prize money for a course record over 10,555 m
additional: You can register online until 22 May or in person on race day. Starts are staggered by category from 9:00 to 12:50. Parking is available near the start and is signposted from the entrance to Zaječice. The race counts toward the Ladův kraj Cup and the Central Bohemian Regional Ski Association. The HOLE category is Nordic walking, with technique judged. The race offers medals, prizes, certificates, race packs, refreshments for all participants (a biscuit, juice or tea, and soup), and online registration. The event is suitable for the whole family and also includes activities for children.

name: Krok za Šimonka
location: Skalka, Nový Jičín, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Krok za Šimonka is a sporting event held to support a fundraiser for Šimonka, a boy with the rare metabolic disorder Lesch–Nyhan syndrome. The event offers a fun-filled day of sports for the whole family at Skalka near Nový Jičín. Its aim is not only to support treatment and rehabilitation, but also to raise awareness of the disorder and the strength of the community. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and the chance to support a good cause.
course_highlights: A 13 km run combining paved and trail routes
Supporting children with serious illnesses, especially Šimonka, who has Lesch–Nyhan syndrome
Accompanying activities, a raffle, and a fundraiser to support healthcare
additional: The event is a fun-filled day of sports for the whole family, with refreshments. Support also includes selling T-shirts, with part of the proceeds going toward Šimonka’s treatment. The event takes place at the Skalka amphitheatre; online registration is available, and the proceeds go toward rehabilitation, assistive devices, and medical examinations. The programme includes races for children and adults, activities, and a fundraiser.

name: Běh pro úsměv – Pelhřimovský půlmaraton
location: Pelhřimov náměstí, Pelhřimov, Vysočina, Czech Republic
price_range: startovné při registraci do 30. dubna 2026 (cena není explicitně uvedena)
description: Běh pro úsměv is a sporting event for the whole family, held at Masaryk Square in Pelhřimov. This Pelhřimov half marathon is suitable for both sporty and non-sporty families, active seniors, and children from 1 year old. You don’t have to run the race—you can walk it. Half of the entry fees go to the Julinka Endowment Fund, which works to combat childhood obesity. The children’s and parents’ races take place one after the other, and while waiting for their parents, children can enjoy activities such as face painting, a bouncy castle, riding scooters, or learning first aid.
course_highlights: The 5 km, 10 km, and half-marathon courses are certified
Children’s races have no placing awards; they are all about fun and smiles
Start and finish at Masaryk Square in Pelhřimov
additional: Race bib collection and race-day registration open at 8:30. Bibs must be collected at least 20 minutes before the start. Runners in the 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon are timed using disposable chips attached to their race bibs. Registration by 30 April 2026 includes a medal, a race bib with the runner’s name, and Rajec water. Parents accompanying children run for free. A bag drop is available for runners. The event is hosted by Ondřej Havlík (En.dru) and Petr Cerha (Nasty). The races are suitable for all age groups, including children and seniors, with activities for children and a charitable purpose.

name: Memoriál Ivana Belobrada
location: Dlouhoňovice, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Ivan Belobrad Memorial is a traditional running race held in Dlouhoňovice and part of the ISCAREX Cup. The race offers courses of up to 9 km along village roads, forest paths and field tracks, with varied surfaces. It is suitable for the general public, including young people and children, with a flexible start time for the youngest participants. The event takes place in a pleasant sports complex and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: A course of up to 9 km along asphalt roads, forest paths and field tracks
Varied surfaces: asphalt, paved and unpaved terrain
Dlouhoňovice Sports Complex serves as the start and finish venue
additional: Registration is open from 8:00 to 8:30, the first category starts at 9:00, and the main course starts at 11:00. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup. A fun run with a flexible start time is available for the youngest children. Registration is available online and on site, with different entry fees. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2026 series and includes various categories; exact course details are not specified.

name: Přibyslavský kros
location: Přibyslav u Nové Paky, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Město Přibyslav ve spolupráci s ACO Industries k.s.
description: Přibyslav Cross Country is a cross-country and trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Přibyslav near Nová Paka in the Hradec Králové Region. The race offers two routes, 8 km and 4 km long, through natural terrain and forest paths. The main category starts at 11:00, making it convenient for both the general public and competitive runners to take part. The event is organized by the Town of Přibyslav in cooperation with ACO Industries k.s. and David Myslivec, who ensure the event is well organized.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail routes
8 km and 4 km routes through natural surroundings
Forest paths and natural terrain
additional: The first category starts at 10:00 and the main category at 11:00. The event is organized by the Town of Přibyslav in cooperation with ACO Industries k.s. and David Myslivec (telephone 728 334 590). The race features cross-country and trail routes, with starts scheduled for 10:00 and 11:00; registration conditions are not specified.

name: Běh do vrchu Poniklá – Rezek
location: Tuláčkova Návsi, Poniklá, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: The Poniklá–Rezek uphill run is a traditional sporting event held in the village of Poniklá. It starts at Tuláčkova náves and climbs uphill to Rezek. The event is suited to runners who enjoy challenges on natural terrain and want to spend an active day outdoors in beautiful surroundings. The organiser is Petr Holec, who ensures the race runs smoothly.
course_highlights: Start at Tuláčkova náves in Poniklá
Uphill run finishing at Rezek
Natural terrain and scenic views
additional: The race starts at Tuláčkova náves. There are various distances, including 2 km and 9.2 km, and the course features a demanding climb and a final ascent to Rezek. The event is supported by the local community and also offers an evening programme.

name: Gočárův běh
location: Hradec Králové and Pardubice, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
description: Gočár’s Run is a unique race connecting the two regional capitals of Hradec Králové and Pardubice, following in the footsteps of architect Josef Gočár. Runners take on a 33-kilometre course combining road and natural-surface sections, with Gočár’s buildings as a backdrop, from the schools in Hradec to the iconic Automatic Mills in Pardubice. The race is open to individuals, pairs, four-person relay teams and children, offering not only a sporting challenge but also a cultural and social experience, with a supporting programme and live music. Gočár’s Run is quickly becoming a tradition in the East Bohemian region, attracting hundreds of runners and thousands of fans every year.
course_highlights: 33 km course from Hradec Králové to Pardubice
A mix of road and natural-surface sections
Gočár’s buildings along the route, including the Automatic Mills
additional: The race pack includes original Eleven socks, a medal, a pack of Hradecký Klenot beer, a race bib with logo, an electronic timing chip, refreshments on the course and at the finish, a digital certificate and a supporting programme. Facilities and services include changing rooms, baggage storage with transfer to the finish, medical services, catering, race photos and video, Craft shoe testing and taping at a reduced price. The VIP experience includes a personalised T-shirt, a certificate and a rooftop experience at the Automatic Mills. The supporting programme features live music, children’s activities, various race categories and the chance to share the experience with friends.

name: Běhej lesy Brdy
location: Skořice, CHKO Brdy, Příbram, Czech Republic
description: Běhej lesy Brdy is a trail race taking place on 23 May 2026 in the Brdy Protected Landscape Area, near Prague and Příbram. The event offers short and long routes, including a charity race, and is part of the international UTMB Index Races. Runners can compete on the Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish timed segments, which offer extra motivation and rewards. The route winds through the beautiful Brdy countryside and is suitable for all trail-running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: UTMB Index Races - international trail race ranking
Conti Speed Section - a 150-metre speed section marked with Continental flags
Generali Investments Finish - a 500 m finishing straight with a timed section and rewards
additional: Online transfer of registration and change of entry fee available via SportID. A charity race is part of the event. Results and performance analyses are available on the website and in the SportID app. Race bibs are already sold out for some dates, so early registration is recommended. 12 km and 22 km routes, charity race and UTMB Index ranking, speed sections, online registration and results, routes available to download in GPX format.

name: Bóžovo 59ka
location: Aš, Karlovarský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Bóžovo 59ka is a traditional race organized by the Jasan Ski Club in Aš, Karlovy Vary Region. The race takes place on May 23, 2026, and offers a sporting experience in beautiful surroundings, with club members and the public welcome to take part. Jasan is known for its long tradition and active approach to training and racing in the region.
course_highlights: The course includes hills around Aš
The race takes place on May 23, 2026
The organizer offers sporting experiences in a natural setting
additional: Registration until January 31, 2026; the race course includes hills and natural terrain around Aš; start and registration information is available on the official website.

name: Běh o štěně okolo Poděbrad - memoriál Zdeňka Slepičky
location: Olomoucké Hejčín, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Běh o štěně - Zdeněk Slepička Memorial is a 7.2 km cross-country race held in Hejčín, Olomouc. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners and offers runners an interesting course through natural terrain. The event is suited to cross-country running enthusiasts who want to test themselves on a more challenging course with varied surfaces. The race has a long tradition and is named in memory of Zdeněk Slepička.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through natural terrain
7.2 km course
Part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners
additional: The event is open to the wider running community and supports the regional running community.

description: Žlutavská 11 is a running race that takes you through the scenic hills around the village of Žlutava. It offers routes for all ages, from the youngest children to a race of over 11 km. Runners can enjoy ample refreshments and comfortable facilities, including changing rooms and showers. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and beautiful countryside around Žlutava.
course_highlights: Main route: 11.3 km with 227 m of elevation gain
Course surface: asphalt (35%), grass and dirt (30%), gravel (35%)
Scenic hills around the village of Žlutava
additional: Runners have access to chip timing, refreshments (drinks and fruit), a meal and drink voucher for online registrants in the main races A and B, participation medals for children, and prizes for the top three in each age category. Changing rooms and showers are available. IZS categories have special conditions, and part of the entry fee is donated to the Military Solidarity Fund. A route of over 11 km, refreshments, showers, parking by the football pitch, registration online and on site, various age categories, start date: 23.5.2026.

name: Salomon Valašský Hrb
location: Solanec pod Soláněm, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Salomon Valašský Hrb is a daytime running race for individuals along the ridge of the Beskydy Mountains, through the beautiful forests around Solanec pod Soláněm. The course avoids roads, follows marked hiking trails, and offers gently rolling terrain with inspiring views. The race is suitable for fans of cross-country and trail running looking for a challenge in the beautiful Beskydy countryside.
course_highlights: The course follows the ridge of the Beskydy Mountains, avoiding roads except for one secured road crossing
Marked hiking trails across gently rolling terrain
Beautiful forest scenery with inspiring views
additional: Organized by 3THX sportovní klub, Tomáš Knop-Kostka. This is a daytime race for race walkers and runners competing individually. Distances: 50 km, 30 km, 20 km, and 10 km. The course avoids roads; the one road crossing is secured. Course distances: 50 km / 30 km / 20 km / 10 km; trail and cross-country terrain; entry fees depend on registration order.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Brno
location: Brno, Pavilon Anthropos, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: registrace on-line od 400 Kč / štafeta od 2 000 Kč

description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Brno is a sporting and social event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of eyewitnesses and helps them. The race takes place at the Anthropos Pavilion and offers timed 6 km and 10.5 km runs, a 4 x 2.5 km relay, as well as untimed family and children’s runs. The route follows the Svratka River on paved paths and asphalt. Participants’ entry fees help fund the recording and preservation of eyewitness stories and educational programs.
course_highlights: Route along the Svratka River toward Kamenná Colony and Kamenný Bridge
Paved paths and asphalt
Timed runs: 6 km (1 lap) and 10.5 km (2 laps)
additional: Start and finish at the Anthropos Pavilion. Changing rooms, baggage storage, restroom facilities, water for rinsing off, and refreshments to replenish energy are available. Pupils, students under 18, members of the Memory of the Nation Club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. On-site registration is available at a higher entry fee. The event includes not only sporting activities but also an accompanying program with music, refreshments, and facilities including changing rooms and water stations. Registration is available online and on-site.

name: Jistebnický vodohospodářský půlmaraton
location: Sportovní areál TJ Jistebník, Jistebník, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč (pro mladistvé do 19 let registrované do 17.5.2024), 200 Kč na místě
description: The Jistebník Water Management Half Marathon is a traditional running event now being held for the sixteenth year in the picturesque landscape on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area. Races range from 3.6 km to a marathon, including relays and a children’s Olympics, and both start and finish at the TJ Jistebník sports complex. The routes pass through nature, with beautiful views of the Beskydy Mountains, and run between the villages of Jistebník, Polanka nad Odrou and Klimkovice. The event also features a varied accompanying program and is suitable for a wide range of runners and families with children.
course_highlights: Routes pass through nature on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area
Landscape between Jistebník, Polanka nad Odrou and Klimkovice
Views of the Beskydy Mountains
additional: The start and finish of all races are at the TJ Jistebník sports complex. Registration opens at 7:00 and closes 20 minutes before the start of each race. Refreshments are available on the course, and one of the refreshments is included in the entry fee at the finish. Trying the Marathon Soup at the local pub is recommended. Parking is available near the complex and along the main road; using train and bus connections is ideal. The event also includes a children’s Olympics and an accompanying program from 10:00 to 15:00. Blood and blood plasma donors receive a 50% discount on the entry fee upon proof of their most recent donation. The course runs through natural areas, the event includes multiple race categories and children’s activities, and it takes place in May 2026.

name: Krušnej seběh
location: Nové Hamry, Karlovarský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Krušnej seběh is a traditional running race organized by Bike Team Nejdek, held in the picturesque setting of Nové Hamry in the Karlovy Vary Region. The race offers two courses: the longer FullHD, approximately 14 km, and the shorter HD, 7 km. They run mainly along forest trails and surfaced paths through hilly terrain with technical sections. Both the start and finish are in Nové Hamry, and the start has been moved earlier so the race takes up only part of the morning. The race is suitable for all runners looking for a challenging but attractive cross-country run in the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Loop course of 14 km (FullHD) and 7 km (HD)
Forest trails, surfaced forest paths, and asphalt sections
Hilly terrain with demanding climbs and technical descents
additional: The race starts in Nové Hamry by the Velká sjezdovka. The course is a loop, with a refreshment station along the route for FullHD participants and at the finish. Transport to the start is provided, so there is no need to travel by train. Results are announced before noon, so the race takes up only the morning. Course options: FullHD (18.9 km) and HD (11 km); hilly profile; bus transfer from registration to the start; on-site and online registration; changes to the route and schedule compared with previous editions.

name: Běšinský běh
location: Běšiny u Klatov, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Běšinský Run is a traditional running race held in Běšiny near Klatovy, offering a 4.8 km course. The race is mixed and also includes a hill-climb bonus, adding to its appeal and challenge for runners. The start is at the football field, and the race takes place in all weather. It is organized by Sokol Běšiny, which ensures a friendly atmosphere and a safe event.
course_highlights: A 4.8 km course in Běšiny near Klatovy
A mixed race with a hill-climb bonus
Start at the football field
additional: The race takes place in all weather. Each participant takes part at their own risk and is responsible for their own health. Children enter for free. The course goes through the football field; registration is at your own risk; race in all weather; hill-climb bonus.

description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Olomouc is a sporting and community event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses. The race takes place on 23 May 2026 in Smetana and Čech Gardens and offers timed 5 km and 10 km races and a 4 × 2.5 km relay, as well as untimed children’s and family runs. The start and finish are by the collection greenhouses in Smetana Gardens. The event is suitable for all ages and celebrates heroism and freedom.
course_highlights: The route follows marked loops through Smetana and Čech Gardens
The 5 km race consists of 2 loops, and the 10 km race of 4 loops
The relay consists of 4 legs of 2.5 km each
additional: Pupils, students under 18, members of the Friends of the Memory of the Nation Club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Changing rooms, a baggage drop, sanitary facilities, and water at the finish are available. The accompanying programme includes stalls with games for children, a relaxation and science zone run by Palacký University, workshops, and prize competitions. Race numbers are distributed during check-in on race day. The event includes refreshments, water, a family- and child-friendly programme, and supports remembrance of the past and the fight for freedom.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Jihlava
location: Český mlýn, Jihlava, Vysočina, Czech Republic
organizer: Post Bellum, z. ú. a Parlament Gymnázia Jihlava
price_range: on-line registrace od 200 Kč, na místě od 300 Kč
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Jihlava is a sporting and community event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The race takes place at the Český mlýn complex, with the start and finish behind the skatepark. Runners can choose timed 4 km and 10 km races, or untimed children’s and family races. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant setting on paved cycle paths. The entry fee is a donation for a good cause and supports the Memory of the Nation.
course_highlights: The course follows paved cycle paths in the Český mlýn complex
The start and finish are located behind the skatepark in the complex
Offers timed 4 km and 10 km races, as well as untimed children’s and family races
additional: Pupils, students under 18, members of the Memory of the Nation club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Sanitary facilities, water at the finish, and refreshments are available. Registration and race-number pickup take place on race day at the specified times. Results are announced after the competitors finish. Paved paths, registration details, support for different race categories

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Kladno
location: Libčice nad Vltavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Libčice nad Vltavou is a sporting and community event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the lives of people who witnessed history and helps them. The event offers timed 5 km and 10 km runs with a mass start, following paved paths and asphalt through a forest park and along a cycling path. It is suitable for all age groups and supports remembrance of history and the courage of freedom fighters. Race bibs are issued at the registration desk on race day. The event also includes a children's run and the option of a symbolic “Anywhere!” run outside the official courses.
course_highlights: Start by the entrance at Sletiště
The course runs through the forest park along a cycling path
Paved paths and asphalt
additional: Pupils, students under 18, members of the Friends of the Memory of the Nation Club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Registration and race-bib pickup take place from 9:00 to 9:30 on race day. Participants are advised to write any medications, allergies, and an emergency contact on the back of their race bib in case of medical complications. The terrain includes paved and asphalt paths; registration is available online and on site; the event is part of a series of runs supporting national remembrance.

name: Půlmaraton údolím Moravské Sázavy
location: Zábřeh na Moravě, Olomouc, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_2

description: The Half Marathon through the Moravská Sázava Valley is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Zábřeh na Moravě. The 21.0975 km course is certified according to IAAF rules and runs mostly over flat terrain, with a gentle climb between Nemile and Hněvkov. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Running Series and offers good facilities, including refreshment stations and a children’s race. The start is at the swimming complex in Zábřeh, which is also the finish venue. Participants receive a commemorative medal and refreshments at the finish.
course_highlights: Certified 21.0975 km course with a mostly flat profile
Surface: asphalt, with sections of gravel, cobblestones and concrete
Four refreshment stations serving sports drinks, water and fruit
additional: Runners expecting to finish in 2:30–3:00 hours may start as early as 9:30. The race time limit is 3 hours. After the race, participants can enjoy a buffet with drinks (Welzl beer and draft lemonade) and pasta salad. A children’s race is held after the adults’ start. Lockers are available for 10 Kč. Parking is available by the swimming pool and in the surrounding area; please follow the instructions of the parking attendants. The course is free of restrictions and construction work. The race takes place on 24 May 2026, registration is open, and the event is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners, with various categories and team competitions.

name: Lesní půlmaraton Říčany
location: Říčany, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Říčany Forest Half Marathon is a running race held entirely on beautiful forest roads and trails, with no asphalt. The surrounding countryside near Říčany is especially picturesque in late May, adding to the enjoyment of the run. The race is suited to lovers of natural terrain and cross-country running who want to experience the forest atmosphere and the challenge of a half-marathon distance. The organizers welcome runners of all levels and encourage them to share their race experiences.
course_highlights: The course runs entirely on forest roads and trails
No asphalt on the course
Beautiful surroundings with tall, old beech trees
additional: Race distances: 5 km, 10.5 km and 14.5 km; elevation gain approx. 120–350 m; routes run entirely on forest roads and trails.

name: Příbramský půlmaraton
location: Příbram, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Příbram Half Marathon is a traditional running race in Příbram, offering a half-marathon course, a relay race, a fitness run, and children’s races. The race is known for its new route and magical atmosphere, especially on the descent to the square. It attracts a broad running community every year and offers quality facilities, including refreshments and parking.
course_highlights: New half-marathon route
Descent to the square with a magical atmosphere
Relay race with team spirit
additional: The race offers several categories: individual half marathon, half-marathon relay, fitness run, and children’s races. Online registration in advance is recommended. Refreshments and parking are available near the start. The race takes place on 24 May 2026. Registration is available via the website, and the race is suitable for a range of ages and ability levels.

name: Běh cestou necestou 13 km Prahou 13
location: Praha 13, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Běh cestou necestou is a running race held in Prague 13, offering 13 km and 5 km courses. The race passes through the picturesque corners of Stodůlky Central Park and Prokopské údolí Nature Park. The start is on Sunday, May 24, 2026, at 13:13:13, and runners can use refreshment stations along the course and at the finish. The race is open to everyone and takes place in the spirit of fair play, with an emphasis on staying on the marked course.
course_highlights: The course passes through Stodůlky Central Park and Prokopské údolí Nature Park
Refreshments at the 8 km mark and at the finish of the 13 km course; refreshments at the finish of the 5 km course
The start and finish are close to the Kuželkárna refreshment venue
additional: It is also possible to register for the race in person on race day, May 21, 2026. Awards are presented to the top three finishers in each age category, provided the category has at least 4 runners. Runners under 18 may participate only with the consent of a legal guardian. The organizer reserves the right to make changes to the program and rules without prior notice. Photographs and video recordings may be used to promote the race without compensation. The race takes place on May 24, 2026; registration is available online and in person, and the event also includes training runs and safety rules.

name: Teplýšovický běh
location: Teplýšovice, Benešov, Czech Republic
description: The Teplýšovice Run is a charity race held in the picturesque village of Teplýšovice near Benešov. In 2026, its 6th edition will feature 5 km, 10 km and 15 km trail races, an 11 km Nordic Walking event and children’s races. The main course passes Špulka Lookout Tower and offers beautiful scenery and a challenging route. All courses are timed using chip timing, and every participant receives a medal. Part of the entry fee supports the restoration of fruit-tree avenues in the surrounding area.
course_highlights: The main 15 km trail passes Špulka Lookout Tower
The fast 5 km course crosses a local pasture, where runners may encounter cows
The 11 km Nordic Walking route follows the main course
additional: Registration is also possible on race day, but medals may not be available for everyone. Most courses are timed using IRONTIME chip timing. Children’s races are divided into age categories, and there is also a 650 m children’s obstacle race. Entry fees contribute to purchasing mature fruit trees to restore the avenues in the surrounding area. Course options: 15 km trail, 5 km run, 1,300 m children’s course, 10 km Nordic Walking, 650 m children’s obstacle race; online registration until 25.5.2023 or 22.5.2025; proceeds go toward planting trees and restoring the landscape.

tiers.description: Kč 100,- děti při platbě na místě

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Suchdol Runs is part of the seventh edition of the Běhej s námi 2026 running series, which is open to the general public. The race takes place on Sunday, 24 May 2026, in Prague 6 - Suchdol. The start and finish are at the Community Garden. The course follows paved field and forest paths and has 96 metres of elevation gain. It offers runners a pleasant flat section, a descent into the valley, and a return along forest paths. Categories are divided into children and adults by age group. Runners under 18 may take part only with written consent from a legal guardian.
course_highlights: The course follows paved field and forest paths
A descent to Roztoky and the Únětice Stream
Adult course elevation gain: 96 m
additional: Children start at 11:00 and adults at 13:00. Check-in must be completed at least 30 minutes before the start. Chip timing is used; the bib with the chip must be worn on the upper front of the body throughout the race. The race takes place in all weather, but the organizer reserves the right to cancel it in extremely adverse conditions. Starts are scheduled for 11:00 for children and 13:00 for adults. Online registration is available. Parking is provided on Suchdolská Street. The race course is the same as in previous editions.

name: Půlmaraton údolím Moravské Sázavy
location: Zábřeh, Olomoucký kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: přihlášení do 15.5.2026 – 500 CZK – po tento termín bude jméno závodníka vytištěno na čísle

description: The Moravská Sázava Valley Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the scenic surroundings of Zábřeh and the surrounding area. The 21.0975 km course is certified under IAAF rules and runs mostly over flat terrain, with a gentle climb between Nemile and Hněvkov. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners and offers quality facilities, including refreshment stations and chip timing. The race starts at 10:00 from the Zábřeh Swimming Complex; runners expecting to finish in over 2:30 can start at 9:30. After the race, a refreshment buffet is available, and all participants receive a medal.
course_highlights: Certified 21.0975 km course over mostly flat terrain
Surface: asphalt, with some gravel, cobblestones, and a concrete cycle path
Four refreshment stations offering isotonic drinks, water, and fruit
additional: The start is at the Zábřeh Swimming Complex. Runners expecting a time of 2:30–3:00 can start at 9:30. The race time limit is 3 hours. There are 4 refreshment stations along the course with isotonic drinks, water, bananas, apples, raisins, and salt. At the finish, there is a buffet with drinks (Welzl beer and draught lemonade) and pasta salad. Lockable lockers are available for 10 Kč. Parking is at the swimming pool above Oborník Street; the race finish is directly in front of the pool, where parking is not allowed. A children’s race for the youngest participants is also held. Registration is open until 21 May 2026; running shirts can be ordered. Certified course, start at 10:00.

name: TEMPO MAKERS RUN Plzeň – květnový závod
location: Baumax, Plzeň, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: TEMPO MAKERS RUN Plzeň is a regular running race held in Plzeň, offering an 8 km course. The race takes place on the cycle path in the Pytel area and is open to all age groups. The start is scheduled for the evening, allowing runners to enjoy a pleasant atmosphere and spend time together with fellow running enthusiasts. The organizers emphasize safety and fair play. The race is manually timed and takes place in all weather conditions except extreme conditions.
course_highlights: The course follows the cycle path in Pytel
The race distance is 8 km
The race starts in the evening at 18:00
The course is flat and runs alongside the Úslava River
additional: The race is manually timed, with a time limit of 1 hour and 15 minutes. Runners must wear their race number visibly pinned to their chest. The race takes place in all weather conditions; the organizers reserve the right to cancel it in the event of extreme weather conditions. The race is open to all age groups; participants under 15 must be accompanied by someone aged 18 or older. The race supports charitable projects. Registration is available online or on site.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - květen
location: Pytle, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli is a running race organized by Plzeňští Tempo Makers, who organize running races, charity runs, and running training sessions. The event takes place in the picturesque Pytle area of Plzeň and offers an opportunity for runners of all levels. The race is part of a running community that promotes an active lifestyle and enthusiasm for sport.
course_highlights: Flat course along the Úslava River
A distance of 7.5 km, suitable for runners of all levels
Pleasant setting in central Plzeň and along the river
additional: The race takes place in Pytli. Registration is available online or on site. The event is part of the running community in Plzeň.

name: Okolo svaté Juliány
location: Praha-Přední Kopanina, Praha, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné: 50 Kč (junioři, juniorky a veteráni nad 70 let dobrovolné)

description: Okolo svaté Juliány is a running race in Prague-Přední Kopanina with a 5,600-metre course that runs mostly along forest paths with minimal elevation gain. The start and registration take place by the tourist shelter on the cycle path on K Juliáně Street, easily accessible by public transport. The race is open to various categories, including juniors, adults and veterans, and offers a friendly atmosphere with parking available nearby. The entry fee is symbolic, with a voluntary fee for some categories.
course_highlights: 5,600 m course, one lap
Mostly forest paths, with the first 600 m on asphalt
Minimal elevation gain
additional: The start and registration are by the tourist shelter on the cycle path on K Juliáně Street. Signs point the way from public transport stops served by routes 161 and 312 (about a 5-minute walk). Parking is available on nearby streets, preferably on K padesátníku Street. Categories: junior men, junior women, men and women up to 39, and veterans in various age groups. The race is suitable for runners and cyclists and offers an opportunity to discover the historic site of Svatá Juliána and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in nature.

name: Koutecká vertikála
location: Ski areál Kouty nad Desnou, Kouty nad Desnou, Šumperk, Czech Republic
description: Koutecká Vertikála is a 2.5 km uphill race with 510 metres of elevation gain, held at the Kouty nad Desnou ski resort. The race has interval starts and is part of the Chlapácký běh series, which includes cross-country races in Šumperk and the surrounding area. It offers a demanding, dynamic uphill run, ideal for mountain-running enthusiasts and fans of vertical challenges.
course_highlights: 2.5 km route
510 m elevation gain
Interval start at the Kouty nad Desnou ski resort
additional: An uphill race and part of a cross-country race series. Children can take part. The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain.

name: Rasokros
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: Rasokros is a running race in Krčský les in Prague 4, offering men a 7.5 km course and women a 2.5 km course. The race is part of the SABZO series and is suitable for runners looking for an enjoyable cross-country run in a natural setting. The route runs through woodland and offers the chance to enjoy running in a quiet part of Prague. The race is open to the general public and welcomes all runners who want to test themselves in this attractive event.
course_highlights: Woodland terrain in Krčský les
7.5 km course for men and 2.5 km course for women
Part of the SABZO series
additional: The race is very demanding, with approximately 315 m of total elevation gain for men. The start is at 17:00. Online registration is available. The race takes place in Krčský les near Hotel Nosál.

name: 3. Pekelný kilometr
location: Peklák, Česká Třebová, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Pekelný Kilometr is an uphill running race held at the Peklák ski resort in Česká Třebová. The race is part of the 2026 ISCAREX Cup series and features a 1 km course with staggered starts. Depending on the weather, the route climbs the ski slope over grass, snow and paths. The children’s race starts at 17:00, and the main 1 km race begins at 18:00. The event is suitable for a wide range of age categories and is known for its atmosphere and challenging climb.
course_highlights: Uphill run on the ski slope
Staggered starts, except for the youngest children
Course surface: grass, snow and paths, depending on the weather
additional: Registration is available on site. Awards are presented immediately for the youngest categories. For the other categories, the three best times count, with the awards ceremony held after the last race on 26. 8. 2026. The race is part of the 2026 ISCAREX Cup, and the overall results count toward the cup. The event takes place on Wednesday evening. The course is short and steep and crosses the ski slope and forest paths. Races are open to a wide age range, from children to adults.

location: Kunětická hora, Ráby, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic

description: Kunětická Devítka is a traditional Wednesday cross-country running series in the area around Kunětická Mountain, offering two routes: a short 4.5 km loop suitable for everyone and a long 9 km loop for more experienced runners. The race is known for its relaxed atmosphere, bringing together runners with different ambitions, and focuses on enjoying the race and the good spirits after the finish. The event takes place at the car park by Staročeská Hospoda and is the largest weekday running event in the Pardubice Region. The organizer invites all runners to enjoy the race and the beautiful surroundings of Kunětická Mountain.
course_highlights: A short 4.5 km loop suitable for everyone
A long 9 km loop with long flat stretches, off-road terrain, and a climb up the steps to Kunětická Mountain
Start and finish at the car park by Staročeská Hospoda, below Kunětická Mountain
additional: Race-day registration takes place at the finish area from 17:00 to 17:50 from April to August. An isotonic drink is available after the race. A series race number can be purchased for a one-time fee of 50 Kč at the first race of the year. Categories are divided by age and gender. Runners take part at their own risk; younger runners must have written parental consent. Cross-country run, start at the car park by Staročeská Hospoda, race takes place on 27 May 2026

name: BĚKODO – květen III
location: Teplice-Doubravka, Teplice, Czech Republic
description: BĚKODO is the 40th edition of a traditional running stage race in Teplice, open to recreational, fitness and competitive runners aged 15 and over. The race consists of the ten highest-scoring starts during the season; in the event of a tie, the faster time decides. The timekeeping limit is 35 minutes, after which runners are recorded as 35+. A separate Mladé BĚKODO series is available for younger runners. The event is organised by TJ Lokomotiva Teplice and BK Běkodo.
course_highlights: A stage race with the ten best starts counting towards the overall standings
A 35-minute timekeeping limit; runners may still finish after the limit
For runners aged 15 and over, with a separate series for younger runners
additional: Only runners aged 15 and over (born in 2011 or earlier) may take part. Younger runners may enter the separate Mladé BĚKODO series. The race is held mostly on Wednesdays, except for the third round, which takes place on Saturday, 18 April (the Čudla Vorlíček Memorial). The race uses a multi-stage format, with the option of counting the 10 best performances. Registration is open to runners aged 15 and over. The race takes place in the natural surroundings below Teplická Doubravka.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (6) – květnový
location: Praha 4-Braník, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Come and run on a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava in Prague’s Braník district, where personal records are often set! The race is part of the 16th season of VAŠE LIGA’s regular 5 km and 10 km runs, held every month. You can compare yourself with other runners and track your progress throughout the year. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the opportunity to run a qualifying time for the Czech Republic Championships. After the race, enjoy a relaxed atmosphere with refreshments and an awards ceremony for the top runners.
course_highlights: Fast course along the Vltava in Prague’s Braník district
Course measured by a certified course measurer
Opportunity to run a qualifying time for the Czech Republic Championships in the 10 km
additional: The race is timed using chip timing, and each runner also receives a chip time. Check-in takes place in the blue tent by the cycle path near U Kempinku 2, Prague. After the race, you can replenish your energy and vitamins at the restaurant in the Hamr Braník complex. Toilets are available at the Hamr Braník complex (300 m from the start). Luggage can be stored in the organizers’ tent. You can withdraw from the race up to 24 hours before the start and receive a refund of the entry fee. The races include various types of terrain, from urban courses to trail sections, and are open to runners of all levels. Registration is available online, and the series offers regular updates to results and schedules.

name: Tolarova pětka
location: Stříbro, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Tolar’s Five is a running race held in Stříbro, offering a 5-kilometer course. The race is part of the Sdružení vytrvalců Stříbro calendar and is intended for amateur and recreational runners. The route passes through the town park and is suitable for all age groups. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and refreshments for participants.
course_highlights: The route passes through the town park and crosses the Svatováclavská footbridge
The race takes place in the evening, starting at 18:00
A friendly atmosphere and the option to run in a group
additional: The race is part of the Běžec Tachovska series. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and refreshments. It is organized by Sdružení vytrvalců Stříbro, z.s., which supports amateur and recreational athletes. Registration details and prices are not explicitly listed on the website. The race is part of the local sports calendar; exact distances and categories are not specified.

name: Černovírská osmička
location: Olomouc-Černovír, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Černovírská osmička is a traditional running race organized by the Central Moravian Association of Endurance Sports in Olomouc-Černovír. The race is part of the Haná Running Cup, which offers courses of various distances and is open to all runners regardless of age or ability. The course passes through the picturesque surroundings of the Olomouc Region and is suitable for both beginners and experienced distance runners. The organizers emphasize a relaxed atmosphere and high-quality race organization.
course_highlights: The route passes through the picturesque surroundings of the Olomouc Region
Part of the Haná Running Cup, with courses from 5 to 42 km
The race is open to all ages and abilities
additional: Registration is handled through a credit system using a chip card, which is used for electronic timekeeping. The entry fee is paid from prepaid credit in an account at Fio Bank. Runners can also top up their credit in cash after the results ceremony. The race is part of the year-round Haná Running Cup series, in which points are awarded for placements in individual races. The event features a trail/cross-country run, starts at 18:00, offers web registration, and starts in Olomouc-Černovír by the Bulgarian Club.

name: Kamenická 15
location: Kamenice u Jihlavy, Vysočina, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč (online), 150 Kč (na místě), zdarma pro mládež do 17 let

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 Kè - muži, junioři, ženy, juniorky přihlášené on-line.

description: Kamenická 15 is a traditional running race in Kamenice u Jihlavy. Adult runners take on a 15 km loop along paved roads and paths. Young runners can choose shorter 1.75 km and 0.4 km loops on paved roads in the village. The course passes through scenic spots including the settlement of Brodek, Zátiší Chateau and the Cípy forester’s lodge, finishing at the start. The race is suitable for a wide range of ages, from 3 years old, and offers a friendly atmosphere, refreshments, and prizes for winners and young runners.
course_highlights: A 15 km loop along paved roads and paths
The course passes through the settlement of Brodek, Zátiší Chateau and the Cípy forester’s lodge
Youth loops of 1.75 km and 0.4 km in the village
additional: Every participant receives a voucher for refreshments at the U Raimunda restaurant. Prize money for breaking the course record: men 1000 Kč, women 500 Kč. Bus transport to and from Jihlava is provided. Children’s and youth categories are divided by age, with the option of changing routes. The main race is 15 km on paved roads; shorter loops are available for young runners. Online registration is available before 12:00 on race day. The event includes refreshments and prizes for winners.

name: Kapličkobraní
location: Ludgeřovice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné od 170 Kč 100% jde na charitu

description: Kapličkobraní is a charitable, non-competitive run that passes 13 chapels around Ludgeřovice and Markvartovice, with 14 stops in total, including the finish. The 10–12 km route is suitable for running, walking, cycling, Nordic walking, or even pushing a stroller. The event has a deeper purpose: all proceeds go to the family of Jan Rieml to support his sons Šimon and Matěj. Participants receive a commemorative magnet, light refreshments at the finish, and a tasting of sacramental wine at one of the chapels. Kapličkobraní received an award for the best low-budget sports project for small organisations.
course_highlights: The route passes 13 chapels around Ludgeřovice and Markvartovice
The 10–12 km route is suitable for running, walking, cycling, Nordic walking, and strollers
A tasting of sacramental wine at one of the chapels
additional: The first 200 participants to check in receive a commemorative medal-design magnet. Light refreshments are available at the finish. Changing rooms, showers, and convenient parking are available. The event is charitable, and 100% of the proceeds go to the family of Jan Rieml to support his sons. Companies can pay employees’ entry fees by invoice or donation agreement and receive free registration codes. The event offers various activities, refreshments, parking, changing rooms, and showers. The route is suitable for running, walking, cycling, and Nordic walking.

name: Běh mimoňským parkem
location: Zámecký park, Mimoň, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: The Run through Mimoň Park is a race held in the chateau park in Mimoň, offering a flat course on paved paths along the Ploučnice River. The race is run in 7-kilometre laps, with distances of 7 km and 21 km available. The event is suitable for the general public and competitive runners, and is organized by Lenka Zeťová. The main category starts at 17:00, while the first category starts at 9:00. The race is part of the Czech Running Club and is held under the auspices of the Czech Athletics Federation.
course_highlights: Flat course on paved paths
7 km loop along the Ploučnice River
Start in the chateau park in Mimoň
additional: Race registration takes place by the swimming pool, and the start is on Vranovská Alley. The race is mixed, with distances of 7 km and 21 km. It is organized by Lenka Zeťová, who can also be contacted by phone at 777 909 842. Races take place in the picturesque setting of Mimoň Park, with children and adults welcome to take part, and are part of a running league. Registration and further details are available on the official website.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Nové Město na Moravě
location: Vysočina Arena, Nové Město na Moravě, Vysočina, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: rodinný závod 2 km - registrace on-line/na místě od 100 Kč

description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Nové Město na Moravě is a charity event held in support of the non-profit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of eyewitnesses and helps preserve historical memories. The race takes place in and around Vysočina Arena, with 2 km, 5 km and 10 km routes; the 5 km route is one lap and the 10 km route is two laps. The event offers timed and untimed runs, including family and children’s races, and is suitable for the general public, including pupils, students and seniors, with a possible discount on the entry fee. The start and finish are at the Vysočina Arena stadium, which has facilities including changing rooms, a bag drop and refreshments.
course_highlights: Routes run on asphalt, paved paths and forest trails in and around Vysočina Arena
The 5 km route is one lap; the 10 km route is two laps
Start and finish at the Vysočina Arena stadium, with full facilities
additional: Registration and race-number collection take place on race day from 15:00 to 16:30. Pupils, students up to 18 years old, members of the Memory of the Nation Club and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Changing rooms, a bag drop, sanitary facilities and water at the finish are available. Route distances: 2 km, 5 km, 10 km; terrain: road; registration fee: 100–400 Kč; race in Vysočina Arena.

name: Čertovskej Trail
location: Houska, Blatce, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné stejné pro obě trasy: 1 222 Kč

description: Čertovskej Ultratrail is a challenging trail run through the mountains, valleys, castles and waters of the mysterious Kokořínsko and Máchův kraj regions. It offers a main 66.6 km route that is also suitable for beginner ultrarunners thanks to well-stocked aid stations and a friendly atmosphere. A shorter 33.3 km course, called Letní půlčert, is also available. The race is part of the prestigious Ultracup series and offers ITRA points to runners. Capacity is limited, so early registration is recommended.
course_highlights: A trail run through the mountains, valleys, castles and waters of Kokořínsko and Máchův kraj
Well-stocked aid stations along the course
Scenic countryside and a family-friendly race atmosphere
additional: A personal drinking cup is mandatory equipment. You can order one during registration, along with a Čertovskej cup, T-shirt or socks. Race capacity is limited. Categories are available for individuals and relay teams, including a family relay with a child under 15. The route is marked with ribbons and arrows. The time limit for the Čertovskej Wintertrail is 7 hours. Post-race refreshments are provided at the finish, including soup, a main course and drinks. The race is part of the UTMB Index Races and ITRA National League. A personal cup is mandatory at the aid stations. A running cup, T-shirt or socks can be ordered during registration.

name: Běh osvobození – Lišanská silniční sedmička
location: Lišany, Rakovník, Czech Republic
description: The Liberation Run – Lišany Road Seven is a traditional road race over a 7 km course between the villages of Lišany and Lužná. The race is run on a low-traffic third-class road and is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup. The start is in Lišany, where registration also takes place, and the finish is by the U Hřiště restaurant. The race has four men’s and two women’s categories and offers cash prizes, as well as a bonus for breaking course records. The start time is 11:15. Entries are accepted on site on race day.
course_highlights: 7 km course along the low-traffic third-class road: Lišany – Lužná – Lišany
Start and finish by the U Hřiště restaurant in Lišany
Bonus available over the first approximately 500 m and the opportunity to break course records
additional: Runner registration begins at 9:30 at the U Hřiště restaurant (Sokol hall) in Lišany. Entries are accepted on site no later than 30 minutes before the start. The race office is open from 9:30. The awards ceremony is at approximately 12:30. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup. Cash prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, and diplomas to the top six. Bonuses are also offered to the winners and for breaking course records. Responsibility for the runner’s health requirements rests with the sending organization or the runner. The race features a 7 km category on a lightly trafficked road; registration is also available on site, and the event is part of a regional running cup. Exact times and conditions are published on the official website.

name: Běh Emericha Ratha
location: Cyklodomu Broumov, Broumov, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
description: The Emerich Rath Run is a revived cross-country race held in Broumov, inviting runners to take part in the picturesque surroundings of Schroll Park near Cyklodům Broumov. The race offers a chance to enjoy running in nature, with access to services such as bicycle rental, luggage storage and an e-bike charging station. Check-in takes place in the morning before the start, traditionally at 10:00. The organizers warmly invite all runners to join this sporting event with its friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country run in Schroll Park in Broumov
Start and check-in at Cyklodům Broumov
Natural surroundings, with bicycle rental and storage available
additional: Runner check-in takes place from 8:30 to 9:45 at Cyklodům Broumov. Available services include bicycle and e-bike rental, bicycle and luggage storage, an e-bike charging station and toilets. The race takes place on 31 May 2025, starting at 10:00 at Cyklodům Broumov. Online registration is available until 28 May 2025. A race is also planned for 2026, including 10 km and 7 km courses.

name: Tuháčkův běh
location: Chrást u Příbramy, Příbram, Czech Republic
description: Tuháček’s Run is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Chrást u Příbrami as part of the Brdy Running Cup. The main race is approximately 8.2 km long and runs mostly along paved and gravel cycling paths around Chrást. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who can take part in dedicated children’s races. The main race starts at 11:00 at the Valcha grounds. The event offers a friendly atmosphere and the chance to compete with other runners in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: One lap along paved cycling paths around Chrást
Mostly paved and gravel surfaces
Main race distance: 8.2 km
additional: The race takes place at the Valcha grounds. Children’s races are also held alongside the main race. The course is mostly paved and gravel. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup. Training activities can be followed on Garmin and Strava in the Brdy Running Cup group. Road race, paved and gravel cycling paths, races for children, online registration, course approximately 8.2 km, race held at the Valcha grounds.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton České Budějovice 2026
location: Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., České Budějovice, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Running Festival České Budějovice 2026 invites you to an unforgettable half marathon through the heart of the city’s historic centre. The start is on the Czech Republic’s second-largest square, Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., and the course offers a unique atmosphere and views of historic buildings and distinctive places. This race is part of the popular RunCzech running series and is suitable for all runners who want to experience the charm of the South Bohemian capital on a day of sport. Join thousands of runners and enjoy a great sporting event in České Budějovice.
course_highlights: The course runs through the historic centre of České Budějovice
Start on Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., the second-largest square in the Czech Republic
Run past numerous historic buildings and distinctive places
additional: The race starts at 15:30. The festival also includes other races, such as the Vodafone 5K Run, dm Family Mile, dm bambini run, half marathon relay, and more. The RunCzech mobile app is available to help with navigation and provide race information. The race takes place in the city centre; maps and GPX files are available to download, and online registration is available.

name: Chlum třikrát jinak
location: Chlum u Plzně, Plzeň-sever, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Chlum Three Ways is the fourth race in the Moving Lookout Towers series, held near Plzeň. Runners tackle the prominent summit of Chlum in three ways: a mass-start uphill run, an interval hill climb, and a climb up the steps to the lookout tower. The overall ranking is based on the combined times from all three events, with bonuses for the top three places. Ten age categories are offered for children, with courses around the lookout tower. A relay race is also available, with teams of three runners completing all three disciplines.
course_highlights: 1.75 km uphill run with 111 m of elevation gain
450 m interval hill climb with 59 m of elevation gain
Climb up 121 steps to the lookout tower, with 22 m of elevation gain

Cycle path surface
Charity run with proceeds going towards helping people in need

The race is a challenge not only for experienced athletes, but also for those who want to push their limits and experience an off-road adventure. After the mass start at 22:00, runners plan their own route between checkpoints, within a 30-hour time limit. Race facilities are at ZŠ Žerotínova in Valašské Meziříčí, where a gym, showers and a dining hall are available. Valašské Kilo offers the freedom to navigate the terrain and is one of the best ultramarathons in Czechia.

Challenging Valašsko terrain with hills and natural beauty

Each runner must provide their own map of the route. The race focuses on endurance walking and running, with an emphasis on resilience and the ability to tackle the challenging terrain of the Valašsko region.

description: Dopesace Backyard Ultra is an endurance race held in the Aš Forests, where runners complete a loop of just under 7 kilometres every hour. The race continues until only one runner remains who can complete one more lap than the others. This unique format puts the emphasis not only on speed, but above all on endurance and determination. The winner receives a silver coin and the opportunity to represent the Czech Republic at the team world championships in October 2026. The race atmosphere is unforgettable, and the event is also linked to a charitable project.

description: Chotucká šlapka is a traditional running race in Křinec. It began in 2012 as a duathlon and has been held as a trail-only run since 2020. The race offers two courses: the main 11 km course and a shorter 5.5 km course, both running mostly along trails with a small amount of asphalt. The start and finish are in the castle park, and the route passes through scenic countryside with several hills and aid stations. The race is open to the general public, with capacity limited to 100 runners. Participants receive personalized bibs, refreshments, and wooden medals.
course_highlights: The course is a 5.5 km loop comprising 80% trail and 20% asphalt
The main race covers two loops (11 km); the shorter race covers one loop (5.5 km)
The route passes through the castle park, Bažantnice, the cemetery, Chotuc, and other natural areas
additional: Race capacity is limited to 100 runners. Bibs are personalized with the runner’s name for registrations received by 30.05.2026. Men’s and women’s changing rooms are available, along with refreshments on the course and at the finish and wooden medals for all participants. Results are announced after the last runner finishes. Children’s races begin at 11:00, with staggered starts from 12:00. The race takes place on 7 June 2026, also offers children’s races, and is part of the Postřižinská Running League.

price_range: 400,- Kč pro hlavní závod, 50,- Kč pro dětské závody
