description: Babický Trail 1/4 Marathon is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Babický Forest. The event offers two main routes, 10.55 km and 5.95 km long, running mostly along forest roads and trails with gentle elevation changes. Children’s categories with shorter distances are also available. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and emphasizes a community atmosphere and the joy of exercising outdoors. The main race is limited to 200 participants, so early registration is recommended.
course_highlights: The route runs mostly along forest roads and trails in Babický Forest
The main race is 10.55 km long with 160 m of elevation gain
Children’s races feature distances from 300 m to 1,500 m
additional: Registration and race bib collection take place from 08:30 to 09:45. The children’s races start between 09:45 and 10:01, and the main race starts at 11:00, with the 1/4 and 1/8 marathons starting together. The main race is limited to 200 participants. Parking is available at the Babice Sports Complex and on surrounding streets; participants are asked not to park in front of driveways to family homes. The main race route is 38% forest roads, 56% forest trails, and 6% road. The event offers participant medals, online registration, limited capacity for the main race, and results services.

name: Skalecký kros
location: Skalka, Mníšek pod Brdy, Středočeský, Czech Republic
description: Skalecký Cross-Country Run is a traditional running race held in the picturesque Baroque grounds of Skalka in Mníšek pod Brdy. It offers 10 km and 5 km courses, as well as children’s races, running along forest paths and paved roads. The main race starts at 11:30 and is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children and teenagers. The event is organized by SK Mníšecko, z.s., which ensures professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs along forest paths and paved roads
Start and finish in the Baroque grounds of Skalka
The main course is approximately 10 km long
additional: Registration is available online and on site. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup. Children’s races are available. Results are published in the system and as a PDF. The organizers provide timing and statistics. Start and finish in the Baroque grounds of Skalka. The event offers courses of various distances; the main race starts at 11:30, the terrain includes forest paths and paved roads, and children’s races are also included.

name: Červenkovská desítka
location: Červenka, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Červenkovská desítka is a 10 km road race held in Červenka, near Olomouc. The race is part of the 2026 Haná Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners. The out-and-back course runs from Červenka through Dětřichov to Renoty and back, mostly on roads. Runners are divided into age categories, and category winners receive prizes in kind. The results ceremony will take place at the race venue, Hostinec u Nádraží, and results will be published on hanackybeh.cz.
course_highlights: Out-and-back course from Červenka through Dětřichov to Renoty and back
The course runs on roads
Start and finish at Hostinec U Nádraží in Červenka
additional: Race-day registration takes place at the venue. Runners must have a chip card with a balance of at least CZK 150; otherwise, they must top it up. The race is governed by road-running rules, and everyone runs at their own risk. The race is at the participants’ own risk; registration is conducted using a chip card and is subject to the credit requirements. Participants can look forward to small prizes in kind for category winners.

name: Milada Run
location: Milada Lake, Chabařovice, Ústí nad Labem District, Czech Republic
description: Milada Run is a popular sporting event held in the unique landscape of a former lignite mine, transformed into the beautiful natural setting of Lake Milada. The event offers various routes, including a half marathon, 10 km race and children’s races, along undulating and flat paths with views of the lake. The atmosphere is family-friendly and welcoming, making it suitable for all ages and running levels. All races are part of the Milada Tour series, which runners themselves praise for its high standards and popularity.
course_highlights: The half-marathon route has two loops, one with views directly over the lake
The 10 km route follows paved paths with a flat profile, suitable for all runners
Children’s races of 500 m and 1 km take place near the main beach, with parents supervising
additional: A race bib printed with your name is available if the entry fee is paid by 16 May 2026. Medals for all participants. The official Milada Tour 2026 T-shirt can be ordered during registration and collected on race day. A free children’s T-shirt for the first 100 children to register. The event has a capacity of 500 participants. Family-friendly and welcoming atmosphere. Series points are awarded for the main adult races. Routes: half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and children’s races; the event takes place at Lake Milada; children’s activities; registration and winners’ awards.

name: Konopišťská desítka
location: Konopiště u Benešova, Benešov, Czech Republic
description: The Konopiště Ten is a traditional 10 km running race held in the beautiful setting of the Konopiště open-air theatre and park near Benešov. The race is part of the Benešov Running Festival and offers the chance to compete in the main race, relays and children’s categories. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to enjoy a run in scenic surroundings with high-quality organisation. The 30th anniversary edition will take place on 7 June 2026.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Konopiště open-air theatre and park
A 10 km race with relay and children’s categories
Scenic surroundings, with high-quality technical support and timing by SPORT BASE
additional: The race is part of the Benešov Running Festival. The programme includes children’s races, relays and the Buď Fit run. Timing is provided by SPORT BASE. The organisers provide technical support, and the awards ceremony takes place at the venue. Results are available online and in PDF format. The race takes place on 7 June 2026; online registration is available, and the event includes various age categories and relays.

name: Bolfánek třikrát jinak
location: Chudenice, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Bolfánek Three Ways is a running race organised by the Pro Sport Activities agency in Chudenice, in the Plzeň Region. The race is part of the Rozhledny v pohybu series and offers an unusual format in which competitors complete the course in three different ways. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own categories. The organisers emphasise the sporting experience in beautiful natural surroundings and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Three different ways to complete the course in a single race
Beautiful natural surroundings and terrain around Chudenice
Children’s categories with appealing routes for young runners
additional: A relay race is possible: each team consists of 3 runners, each of whom runs one section of the race. Relay entries should be sent by email. Prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in each category and relay. Pupils from the Kryry nursery and primary schools, and residents of the town of Kryry, can enter for free. The event consists of three runs featuring an uphill climb, stairs and a forest trail. Registration is available online or on site. The event is part of the Rozhledny v pohybu series.

name: Mnichovická běhna
location: Mnichovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Registrační poplatek : 150 Kč/osoba (při platbě předem). Platba na místě: 200 Kč

description: Mnichovická běhna is an amateur running race through the beautiful Central Bohemian countryside, featuring a challenging course approximately 7–8 km long with around 200 metres of elevation gain. The race offers varied terrain with steep climbs and descents, running on paved paths, through forest, meadows and pastureland, accompanied by domestic and wild animals. The start and finish have been moved to the sports complex at Šibeniční vrch, at the Podhorky sports field. All runners receive a commemorative medal and certificate; category winners receive trophies and a small surprise. Mnichovická běhna is part of the Ladův kraj Cup running series, and everyone who finishes the race safe and sound is a winner.
course_highlights: 7–8 km course with approximately 200 m of elevation gain
Terrain includes paved paths, forest, meadows and pastureland
Challenging sections with steep climbs and descents
additional: All participants receive race numbers and medals; the first three finishers in the women’s and men’s categories receive trophies and a surprise. Check-in and race-number collection take place from 9:00 to 9:45. There are drinking-water stations along the course, and additional refreshments are available at the Šibeniční vrch restaurant. Dogs are not allowed on the course. The race is limited to a maximum of 100 runners. Parking is available on Bezručova Street by the elementary school. The race is open to adults aged 15 and over. Registration takes place from 9:00 to 9:45. Refreshments are included in the entry fee, and all participants receive a medal. Parking is available by ZŠ Bezručova and at the Podhorky sports field. Dogs are not allowed on the course.

name: Babický Trail 1/4 maraton
location: Babice u Říčan, Praha-východ, Czech Republic
price_range: 400,- Kč za hlavní závod, 50,- Kč za dětský závod na 300 m, 150,- Kč za dětský závod na 1000 m

description: The Babice Trail Quarter Marathon is a traditional running race held in the beautiful Babice forest near Říčany. It offers two main routes, 10.55 km and 5.95 km long, with 160 m and 60 m of elevation gain, respectively, running mostly along forest roads and trails. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children, who have their own shorter courses. The event has a community-focused feel, and the organisers emphasise a friendly atmosphere and support for the running community in Babice.
course_highlights: The main race route runs through the Babice forest, with 160 m of elevation gain over 10.55 km
Mostly forest roads and trails, with very little asphalt
Children’s races on courses from 300 m to 1,500 m, suitable for different age groups
additional: Registration and race-number collection take place from 08:30 to 09:45. Children’s races start from 09:45 to 10:01, and the main race starts at 11:00, with the quarter and eighth marathons starting together. The main race is limited to 200 participants. Online registration is available, as is registration on race morning for a 100% surcharge. Parking is available by the sports complex and on nearby streets; please do not park in front of driveways to family homes. Forest course; limited capacity for the main race; unlimited places in the children’s races; start at the Babice Sports Complex.

name: Mladé BĚKODO
location: Doubravka, Teplice, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Mladé Běkodo is a series of running races for children and young people aged 2 to 15, held around Doubravka in Teplice. The races offer courses ranging from 200 to 1,650 metres and are divided into age categories. Results for individuals and teams are announced after each race. BK Běkodo is part of TJ Lokomotiva Teplice and has a long tradition dating back to 2001.
course_highlights: Running courses around Doubravka, from 200 m to 1,650 m
Categories for children and young people aged 2 to 15
Results announced approximately 10 minutes after the last category finishes
additional: Categories 6 and 7 start together, but may be split if the limit on the number of runners is exceeded. The team competition is divided into categories 1–4 and 5–8, which are scored separately. Times are approximate; please follow the organisers’ instructions. This series of races for children and young people takes place on 9 June 2026 and supports an active lifestyle and the sporting development of young people in the region.

name: Běh Advenťáka BRNO
location: Medlánecký rybník, Brno, Czech Republic

description: Běh Advenťáka Brno 2026 is a charity running race held on June 9 by Medlánecký Pond in Brno. The race offers a 6.45 km route on paved paths, suitable for runners of all levels, with trail shoes recommended. The event also includes children’s categories with shorter routes. Participants’ entry fees support people facing difficulties in life, and they can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere, sports prizes, and other benefits.
course_highlights: The route follows paved paths around Medlánecký Pond
Trail shoes are recommended for greater comfort
Categories for adults and children, with different route lengths
additional: A race bib with the option to have your name printed is available for payments made by May 29. Every participant receives a diploma with their time by email, a gingerbread treat baked by elves, water from Mattoni, baggage storage, and a supervised kids’ corner. Children can also get an Advenťák-themed temporary tattoo. Sports prizes and a small surprise are prepared for adults. The race is part of a series of charity runs, offers great prizes, diplomas, and tattoos for children, and supports disadvantaged children.

name: Pivní míle Heřmanův Městec
location: Bažantnice, Heřmanův Městec, Czech Republic
description: The Beer Mile in Heřmanův Městec is a unique race on the Bažantnice athletics track, where runners complete four 400-metre laps with beer breaks. This unconventional sporting experience combines running and fun in a friendly atmosphere. This year marks the 10th edition of this popular event, which is part of the Heřmanův Městec running club.
course_highlights: Bažantnice athletics track in Heřmanův Městec
4 × (400 m run + beer) — an unconventional combination of sport and fun
Around the training football pitch
additional: The race is part of the Heřmanův Městec running club, which supports sporting activities in the region. The event is open to anyone interested in sport and fun in Heřmanův Městec. The race takes place on the Bažantnice athletics track, includes several heats, and results are published. The event is part of the local running cup.

name: Běh pro Zuzanku
location: Milíčovský les, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Běh pro Zuzanku is a traditional race in Prague, held in Milíčovský Forest. This race is not a charity event, but a race for the enjoyment of Zuzanka Nováková and all participants. The course is approximately 6.2 km long, and the race has a long-standing tradition; this year marks its 11th edition. The race is supported by the Prague 4–Újezd Municipal District.
course_highlights: The course runs through Milíčovský Forest
The race is 6.2 km long
The race has a long-standing tradition; this year is its 11th edition
additional: Online registration for the 2026 edition is closed; registration is available only in person at the start. The 6.2 km course offers the option to register in advance or on-site. The event includes both trail and road running and is suitable for all age groups, including children.

name: Otevřený přebor SABZO v přespolním běhu
location: Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The SABZO Open Cross-Country Championship is a traditional running race organized by the SABZO Running Club in Prague. The race gives amateur runners the chance to test themselves in a cross-country event in a welcoming sporting atmosphere. SABZO is known for its long history and for regularly organizing running events in Prague and the surrounding area. The race is part of the club’s wider calendar of running events, which promotes an active lifestyle and a running community.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in Prague 4
An opportunity for runners of all levels
Organized by the SABZO club
additional: The race is part of the running calendar and offers the chance to follow results and other activities of the running community in Prague.

name: Běh Advenťáka OSTRAVA
location: Komenského sady, Ostrava, Czech Republic

description: Běh Advenťáka Ostrava 2026 is a charity running race taking place on 10 June in Komenského sady. The race offers two main categories: adults running 6.45 km and children running distances from 0.2 to 1 km. The course follows paved and compacted paths, so road-running shoes are recommended. A large portion of the entry fee supports heroes who face challenges in life, and participants receive a race bib, certificate, gingerbread and other benefits. The event is friendly, charitable and suitable for all age groups.
course_highlights: The course follows paved and compacted paths in Komenského sady
Adult course: 6.45 km; children’s distances: 0.2–1 km
Road-running shoes recommended
additional: Race bib, with the option to have your name printed if you pay by 25 May; certificate with finishing time sent after the race; sports prizes for category winners; Advenťák gingerbread; baggage storage and a supervised children’s corner; drinking water from Mattoni at the finish; a temporary tattoo for children; a small surprise for adults. Registration includes a race bib, certificate, prizes, refreshments and the children’s corner; a virtual run is also available.

name: Trail Zlíchovskými vyhlídkami VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
location: Dívčí Hradec, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The VAŠÍ LIGY Trail through Zlíchov’s Viewpoints is an amateur trail race held in Prague, offering runners the experience of running in nature across varied terrain with interesting views. The races are part of VAŠÍ LIGY, the largest amateur league in the Czech Republic, which promotes the joy of sport and a community atmosphere. Participants can look forward to a friendly environment and the chance to compete with runners of all age groups. The races are regularly held, with medals awarded to the best runners in the under-40 and 40+ categories.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with views in Prague’s natural surroundings
Running in the setting of Modřany Gorges and the Zbraslav sawmill
Races with the atmosphere of an amateur league and community running
additional: At each race, the 3 fastest runners in the under-40 and 40+ categories are announced and awarded medals by Garko. The value of prizes for the best and regular runners is 44,000 Kč. A race number and a pistol start make the race an unforgettable experience for competitors. The race is aimed at trail runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting who want to enjoy beautiful views and technical sections along the course.

name: Trail Zlíchovskými vyhlídkami VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
location: Praha-Zlíchov, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Trail Zlíchovské Lookouts 2026 is a running race in Prague, offering two routes of 7 and 14 km. The race follows a scenic route from Dívčí Hrady via Děvín to Prokopské Valley, including well-known spots such as Foglar’s Steps and a hidden pond. Participants can enjoy beautiful panoramic views of Prague and a friendly race atmosphere. The start is easily accessible by metro from Radlická station, and the entry fee includes refreshments, a medal and race results.
course_highlights: The route passes through Dívčí Hrady, Děvín and Prokopské Valley
Includes Foglar’s Steps and a hidden pond
Panoramic views of Prague
additional: Registration takes place from 17:00 by the blue tent near the Przewalski’s horse enclosure at Dívčí Hrady. The entry fee includes an isotonic drink, light refreshments, a medal and prizes for the top finishers in the 40- and 40+ categories. Bag storage is available in the organizers’ tent. Recommended public transport: Radlická metro station, Zlíchov or Lihovar tram stops, Praha-Žvahov train station and the Dívčí hrady bus stop. Parking is available nearby. A trail race in Prague-Zlíchov, part of a series of running events with routes of various lengths.

name: Červnová Krásná Morava
location: Olomouc-Hejčín, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The June Krásná Morava is a running race organized by the Central Moravian Association of Endurance Sports in Olomouc-Hejčín. The race is part of the rich tradition of running events in the Olomouc Region, which are open to all ages and levels of runners. It offers a chance to experience the picturesque Haná countryside and join a community of sports enthusiasts. STMSVS is known for its long-standing organization of endurance sports and its support for running, cycling, and triathlon disciplines in the region.
course_highlights: A running race through the picturesque Haná countryside of the Olomouc Region
Part of the Haná Running Cup, with distances from 5 to 42 km
A traditional running event with an open start for all age groups
additional: Registration is handled through a credit system using a chip card for electronic timekeeping. Entry fees are paid from prepaid credit held in an STMSVS bank account. The race is part of the year-round Haná Running Cup series, where competitors earn points based on their placements in individual races. The race takes place on 11 June 2026; on-site registration is available, and results are published online.

name: Yellow Ribbon Run
location: Obora Hvězda, Praha 6, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
organizer: Czechia Yellow Ribbon Run (Gabriela Slováková a podporující organizace)
description: Yellow Ribbon Run is a running event taking place on June 11, 2026, in Hvězda Game Reserve in Prague 6. It symbolizes second chances and supports the integration of people with criminal records. The run brings together sport, solidarity, and the courage to help those who want to start a new life and become valued members of society. The event offers various race categories, including the main relay, the easy relay, and a children’s run, while also raising awareness and helping to reduce recidivism. Join the largest community in the Czech Republic working to break down prejudice and support second chances.
course_highlights: Run in the beautiful surroundings of Hvězda Game Reserve in Prague 6
Various race categories: main 5 km relay, 2.5 km easy relay, and children’s run
A symbol of second chances and support for the reintegration of people with criminal records
additional: The event includes the main 5 km relay, the 2.5 km easy relay, the Connecting Hearts Race for Children, and VOL FANWALK. The project raises awareness about people with criminal records and gives institutions and companies the opportunity to take part in the run as a CSR project. The organizers welcome volunteers to help with preparations and the event itself. The event aims to raise awareness about the challenges of reintegrating people after serving a sentence and to support their social inclusion. Registration is available through Stopnito.cz.

name: Krakonosova stovka
location: Vrchlabí, Czech Republic
description: Krakonošova stovka is a traditional long-distance hike with a history dating back to 1966. The 100 km route crosses the challenging mountain terrain of the Krkonoše Mountains, with over 3,000 metres of elevation gain. It starts and finishes in Vrchlabí and passes notable places such as Špindlerův Mlýn, Sněžka and Pec pod Sněžkou. In addition to the main K100 route, shorter options are available: K50, K25 and the B25 running route. The event is for endurance hikers and runners who want to experience the beauty of the Krkonoše Mountains within a challenging 24-hour time limit.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain terrain with over 3,000 m of elevation gain
The route passes through Špindlerův Mlýn, Sněžka and Pec pod Sněžkou
Start and finish in Vrchlabí
additional: UMARA isotonic drinks are available at selected checkpoints. UMARA sports nutrition can be purchased before the start. Parking is limited due to a road closure; participants are advised to use the designated car parks and not obstruct traffic. According to the official website, registration for the 2027 edition is expected to open on 1 February 2027. Information on the price, time limit and refreshments available for K100 applies to the 2026 edition.

name: Přes tři hráze Opatov
location: Opatov, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: Přes tři hráze Opatov is a traditional running race held in Opatov in the Vysočina Region and is part of the Pohár Běžce Vysočiny series. The race offers several distances, including the 8.8 km main course for men and veterans up to age 69, and shorter courses for women, veterans aged 70 and over, juniors, youth and children. The course runs mainly along field and forest paths, including crossings over the dams of three local ponds, giving the race its unique character. The event is open to a broad range of age groups and focuses on the sporting experience and supporting the local running community.
course_highlights: The course crosses the dams of three ponds near Opatov
Distances range from 210 m to 8.8 km for different age groups
Part of the Pohár Běžce Vysočiny series
additional: The main loop is 4.4 km, running along field and forest paths (30% asphalt). Children’s races range from 210 m to 1.5 km. The event caters to a broad range of ages, including veterans.

name: Revírní POHO běh
location: Masarykovo náměstí, Karviná, Czech Republic
description: Revírní POHO Run is a traditional running race held in Karviná, with its hub at Masaryk Square. The race offers various distances, including 50 km, a half marathon, 10 km, 6 km, and relays, with routes through the scenic countryside around Karviná Sea and the Olše River. The course is mostly flat with minimal elevation gain and offers beautiful views of nature and the lake, making it an enjoyable experience for runners of all levels. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square, where runners also traditionally loop around the fountain. The race is suitable for experienced runners, families, and amateurs alike.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Masaryk Square in Karviná, with the traditional loop around the fountain
The route passes through Božena Němcová Park and around Karviná (Darkov) Sea, with beautiful views
Mostly flat course with minimal elevation gain, on pleasant paved paths through reclaimed floodplain meadows
additional: Participants can order a POHO50 technical T-shirt for 390 Kč and collect it on race day with their race pack. Relay teams can add or edit members after payment. Runners can use the opened barrier on the road to Karviná Sea for easier access to the course. The 50-kilometre race is also the Czech Republic Championship.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton Olomouc 2026
location: Horní náměstí, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc 2026 is a traditional half marathon that takes you through the historic beauty of Olomouc. The start and finish are at Horní náměstí, where you can admire the Holy Trinity Column and the town hall with its unique astronomical clock. During the race, you’ll enjoy the city’s atmosphere, historic buildings, and beautiful parks. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and also offers an accompanying program.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Horní náměstí, with landmarks including the Holy Trinity Column and the astronomical clock
The route passes through Olomouc’s historic center and beautiful parks
Enjoy the city’s atmosphere and rich history during the race
additional: The race is part of the Mattoni Running Festival, which also features events such as the Šantovka 5 km Run, the dm Family Mile, the dm bambini run, and a half-marathon relay. Starts are divided into several time waves from 15:00 to 19:00. The RunCzech mobile app provides all race information and a virtual package. The course covers historic streets, parks, and city roads; it is certified and fully closed to traffic. The race offers technical support, refreshment stations, and medical services.

name: Horem dolem Chospílem
location: Postřekov, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Horem dolem Chospílem is a 9.2 km interval-start running race that follows meadows and dirt roads around Postřekov in the Chospíl area. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska series and offers runners pleasant terrain and a natural atmosphere. Its interval start makes for an interesting race format. It is suited to runners looking for a combination of nature and sporting challenge in the Plzeň Region.
course_highlights: A 9.2 km course through meadows and along dirt roads
Interval start
Natural surroundings near Postřekov in Chospíl
additional: The race takes place on June 13, 2026. Results and participant lists are available on the website. Exact registration details are not provided.

name: Sokolovský  ¼ maraton
location: Sokolov, Karlovarský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Živý kraj – Destinační agentura pro Karlovarský kraj, z.s.
description: The Sokolov Quarter Marathon is a running event taking place on June 13, 2026, in Sokolov, in the Karlovy Vary Region. The route runs mainly through scenic parts of the town and the surrounding countryside, and the race is approximately 10.5 km long. The event is intended for recreational runners as well as those who want to experience the atmosphere of a race in beautiful surroundings. The organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and a sporting experience for all participants.
course_highlights: A scenic route through Sokolov and the surrounding natural landscape
An approximate distance of 10.5 km, suitable for recreational and competitive runners
A relaxed and friendly race atmosphere
additional: The race is part of the Sokolov Colour Run. Registration details and further information are not specified. The race is suitable for the general public.

name: Barevný běh Sokolov
location: Sokolov, Karlovarský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Barvám Neutečeš is a colourful run and a full day of fun for all ages, families and friends. Choose between two routes: 5 km with five colour zones, or 1.5 km with three colour zones and an interactive sports zone. It’s not about speed, but about joy, friendship and unforgettable experiences filled with colour, music and laughter. The event takes place in Sokolov on 13 June 2026 and is part of a year-round colour tour visiting several cities.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 colour zones
1.5 km route with 3 colour zones and an Urban Challenge zone
The colour zones shower runners in colour from head to toe
additional: Enjoy a full day of fun from 9:00 to 16:00, with music, themed zones, photo booths and a 360° video. The race pack includes a T-shirt, race number, medal and other accessories. The event is also suitable for children, who can take part on shoulders, scooters or in strollers. There is no timing; the focus is on fun and sharing the experience. Registration is open. The event takes place on 13 June 2026 in Sokolov. The routes pass through Sokolov Island and the surrounding area, with a focus on fun and community.

name: Run Labe Run
location: Špindlerův Mlýn, Krkonoše, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné pro ročník 2026 je 17 000 Kč za tým.

description: Run Labe Run is a relay race for teams of up to 12 runners, held on June 13–14, 2026. The route runs from Špindlerův Mlýn to Děčín along the Elbe River and covers a total of 380 km, divided into 36 stages of varying difficulty. The race starts in 8 waves between 5:00 and 11:00. Categories include mixed teams of 10–12 runners, mixed teams of 6–9 runners, women’s teams, and veterans. Teams compete for prizes in several categories, and registration is open until March 31, 2026, or until capacity is reached.
course_highlights: A 380 km route divided into 36 stages, with difficulty levels from 1 to 5
Start in Špindlerův Mlýn, finish in Děčín by the chateau
The race starts in 8 waves between 5:00 and 11:00
additional: The maximum team size is 12 runners. The captains’ meeting will take place online on May 24, 2026, at 19:00. Teams from previous editions have priority registration from June 26, 2025. The race starts in 8 waves between 5:00 and 11:00. A team is not considered registered until its payment has been credited to the account. Registration opens on July 1, 2025; the deadline is March 31, 2026, or until capacity is reached. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the Krkonoše Mountains and the Elbe River.

name: JEŠTĚD SUMMER RUNNING WEEKEND
location: Skokanský areál u Ski Ještěd, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Ještěd Summer Running Weekend is a trail-running weekend event held in the beautiful setting of the Ski Ještěd ski jumping complex in the Liberec Region. It offers a range of running disciplines, including a 24-hour run, a marathon, a half marathon and shorter races. The event is suitable for a wide range of runners, from experienced ultramarathoners to families with children. The routes follow scenic mountain terrain with significant elevation gain and beautiful views of the Ještěd Ridge. The event is part of the prestigious Ještěd Skyrace series and provides quality facilities and a great atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Scenic mountain routes on the Ještěd Ridge
Significant elevation gain of up to 1,390 m on the longer routes
A range of distances, including a 24-hour run, a marathon and shorter races
additional: The event offers a range of running disciplines, including a 24-hour run, a marathon, a half marathon and shorter races. The routes are challenging, with significant elevation gain, and run through mountain terrain. The event also includes facilities with refreshments and accommodation options. Shorter races are available for children. The races take place on terrain around the ski jumps; registration and route details are available on the website. The event also includes trail camps, merchandise, a partner zone and environmental measures.

name: Dobročinný běh po stopách Silver A
location: Pardubice, Pardubice District, Pardubice Region, Czech Republic
price_range: startovné na charitativní účely, přesná částka není uvedena
description: Join the 3rd annual charity run and walk, In the Footsteps of Silver A, organized by the Zámeček Memorial in Pardubice. The event is suitable for athletes and non-athletes, children and adults, and the entry fee goes to charity. The run offers two routes—a shorter 5 km route and a longer 10 km route—as well as a children’s race of approximately 1 km. There will also be a guided walk through the city to places associated with the Silver A parachute group, starting from the Zámeček Memorial.
course_highlights: Two running routes: 5 km and 10 km
Children’s race of approximately 1 km
Guided city walk in the footsteps of the Silver A parachute group
additional: Registration opens at 14:00, and the event is expected to end at 18:00. The entry fee includes a public transport ticket. Online registration is available until 11 June; after that, registration is available at the venue on the day of the event. Proceeds from the entry fees will go to charity, specifically towards buying a stroller for four-year-old Viktorka, who has autism spectrum disorder. Routes: 5 km, 10 km and a children’s race; guided city walk; start from the Zámeček Memorial; entry fee includes a public transport ticket; supports local charity and historical awareness.

name: Hradecký koloběh
location: Biřička, Nový Hradec Králové, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Hradecký Koloběh is a mixed-pair race held in the beautiful surroundings of the city forests, starting at Biřička. The race combines running and cycling: one team member runs while the other rides a bike, and they can switch at any time during the race, adding strategy and dynamism. The event promotes team spirit and the joy of movement, with OPEN and FAMILY categories. It is held with the support of the City of Hradec Králové and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality event organisation.
course_highlights: Beautiful surroundings of the city forests
A combination of running and cycling, with teams free to switch at any time
Start at Biřička in Nový Hradec Králové
additional: The race pack includes a race number, event organisation, baggage storage, toilets, race marshals, refreshments at the finish, and photographs (a photo for every participant is not guaranteed). Toilets, baggage storage, catering, and parking are available. Parking is recommended at the parking lot on Partyzánská Street. Stopping is prohibited on Mužíkova Street, where the situation is monitored by the municipal police. Prizes are awarded to places 1–3 in each category. Terrain: 90% forest trails, 10% asphalt roads. Elevation gain: 108 m. Categories: OPEN and FAMILY. Start at Biřička, Nový Hradec Králové.

name: Jinecký kros
location: Jince, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Městys Jince a Jinečáček, z. s.
description: Jinecký kros is a traditional running race held in Jince. It offers a challenging course of approximately 5.7 km with around 178 metres of elevation gain. The start and finish are on the football pitch by the Bio Swimming Pool, which provides facilities for runners, including parking, changing rooms, showers and refreshments. The course runs on asphalt, forest paths and meadows, and includes a crossing over a wooden footbridge, asphalt roads and a climb up Vystrkov Hill. The race is suitable for adults and children, who have their own categories. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: The course crosses a wooden footbridge over the Ohrazenický Stream
A challenging climb up Vystrkov Hill with approximately 30 m of elevation gain
A mix of asphalt, forest paths and meadows
additional: Race facilities include parking, changing rooms, showers, toilets and a refreshment stand. Registration is open until 13.6.2026 at 17:00, and is also available on race day. Children’s races are part of the programme. The course has +178 m and -187 m of elevation change. The start and finish are at the SK Jince 1921 sports complex. Course: approx. 5.7 km; terrain: asphalt, forest paths and meadows; children’s races; start on the football pitch by the Bio Swimming Pool.

name: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc
location: Olomouc, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc is a popular running event held in the historic center of Olomouc. The race offers an attractive route through the city’s picturesque streets, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational athletes. The event is part of the RunCzech running league and offers a unique atmosphere and professional organization. Runners can enjoy excellent facilities and support throughout the race.
course_highlights: The route passes through the historic center of Olomouc
Pleasant urban surroundings with cultural landmarks
Part of the RunCzech running league, professionally organized
additional: The event includes various race categories, an expo and accompanying activities. Registration is available through the RunCzech website. The races are certified and suitable for all age groups.

name: Jindřichohradecký půlmaraton
location: Jindřichův Hradec, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Jindřichův Hradec Half Marathon 2026 is the 10th anniversary edition of a running event offering a unique experience that combines the city’s picturesque historic centre, sections along the water and natural trails with significant elevation gain. The race is open to individual runners covering 21.1 km, as well as relay teams, families and schools taking part in shorter races. The atmosphere is enhanced by spectators, music and event services including refreshment stations and showers. A special Rebel Run for schools is also planned, focusing on teamwork rather than time. The race starts on 13 June 2026. Participants will receive an original medal and may win prizes.
course_highlights: A beautiful combination of city and countryside: historic lanes and peaceful landscapes around Jindřichův Hradec
Sections along the water and natural trails with considerable elevation gain
An unforgettable atmosphere, with spectators, music and encouragement along the course
additional: The event schedule includes the Rebel Run starting at 15:00, the Family Run at 16:00, and the half marathon and relay races at 17:00. Refreshment stations, showers, a baggage area, and professional photos and video from the course and finish are available. The Rebel Run is a special team race for primary schools, where teamwork and everyone’s participation matter more than time. The event features a course through the historic centre and natural trails, various races including relays, family and school runs, refreshments, showers, facilities, medals and prizes.

name: LEKI JEŠTĚD SUMMER - Running Weekend
location: Ještěd, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: LEKI JEŠTĚD SUMMER - Running Weekend is part of the prestigious Ještěd Skyrace series, which offers challenging and beautiful routes in the mountain terrain of the Ještěd Ridge. The races are intended for a wide range of runners, from children to experienced skyrunners, with distances ranging from 200 metres to 42 km. The event takes place in the picturesque setting by the ski jumping hills at Ještěd and offers a unique experience of running in nature with significant elevation gain. The running weekend is complemented by activities, refreshments and accommodation options close to the races.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain routes with up to 1390 m of elevation gain
Distances ranging from children’s races to a 42 km ultramarathon
Picturesque Ještěd Ridge setting with views and technical sections
additional: The winners’ ceremony takes place from 16:00. The races are held at the ski jumping hills at Ještěd. Children’s races, refreshments and an accompanying programme are available. Accommodation and volunteer support are also available. The routes are technically challenging, with significant elevation gain. The race emphasises ecology, for example by not using disposable cups, and offers a wide range of activities throughout the weekend.

name: Neveklovské běhy
location: Zámecký park, Neveklov, Czech Republic
organizer: kulturní a sportovní komise města Neveklov
description: Neveklov Runs is a traditional running event held in the picturesque Castle Park in Neveklov. The race gives runners of all abilities the chance to enjoy a run in the park’s pleasant setting and friendly atmosphere. It is part of the wider Běžec Podblanicka race calendar, which promotes an active lifestyle and brings the region’s sporting community together.
course_highlights: Run in Neveklov Castle Park
Peaceful natural park setting
Traditional regional running event
additional: The races are part of the Běžec Podblanicka Cup, with distances ranging from 50 m to 5 km, and offer an outdoor sporting experience for the general public.

name: 7 pohoří Jeseníky
location: Dolní Morava, Jeseníky, Olomoucký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Jeseníky 2026 race is a technical trail run in the beautiful countryside below Králický Sněžník, offering three routes of different lengths and elevation gains. The routes have been prepared by members of the local mountain rescue service and run mainly through natural terrain. Participants can enjoy a professionally marked course, chip timing, refreshments on the course and at the finish, and a commemorative medal. The event takes place in all weather and is suitable for all trail-running enthusiasts who want to experience epic views and an atmosphere they won’t find elsewhere.
course_highlights: Main course: 23.5 km with 830 m of elevation gain
Alternative course: 11.3 km with 410 m of elevation gain
Kari Traa RUN: 7 km with 230 m of elevation gain
additional: The race time limit is 4 hours; after that, a runner is marked as DNF. Participants can leave small items at the registration tent. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The entry fee includes a race bib, chip timing, refreshments on the course and at the finish, and use of the facilities at the start and finish area. The event takes place in all weather, and participation is at the runner’s own risk. The race offers registration, timing, medals, and other facilities. The routes run through mountainous terrain with technical trail sections and are suitable for both experienced and beginner trail runners. The race takes place in June 2026.

name: Okrouhelský běh
location: Okrouhlá, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Okrouhlá Run is a traditional race in the Českolipsko District Running League, held in the picturesque village of Okrouhlá in the Liberec Region. The race offers an opportunity for runners of all levels to enjoy running in a natural setting with a friendly atmosphere. The Okrouhlá Run is part of a series of regional races that promote an active lifestyle and community sport.
course_highlights: Natural terrain around the village of Okrouhlá
Picturesque views and peaceful surroundings
Part of the Českolipsko District Running League
additional: Part of a series of regional races, including cross-country races and half marathons; exact race distances are not specified

name: Extrem Run 5Hills
location: Vojtanov, Karlovy Vary District, Czech Republic
description: Extrem Run 5 Hills is an ultratrail running race in the westernmost part of the Czech Republic, offering a challenging 91-kilometre course with 2,174 metres of elevation gain. The route crosses five Egerland peaks and combines paved roads, cycling and hiking trails, and forest terrain. The race is for experienced runners looking for an extreme sporting challenge and stunning panoramas. The organisers place an emphasis on accurate timekeeping and runner safety. The race takes place in the picturesque area of Vojtanov and also offers relay and two-person duathlon formats.
course_highlights: 91 km course with 2,174 m of elevation gain
Five Egerland peaks: Kapellenberg, Háj Aš, Zelená hora Bismarck, Dyleň, Lesný
A combination of paved roads, cycle paths, and forest terrain
additional: The race starts by the municipal office in Vojtanov. Timing is provided using highly accurate passive or active chips. Runners receive a technical T-shirt with the logo and a finisher medal. Refreshments are provided during the race and at the finish. The relay race is for teams of 3–6 runners, with at least one woman on each team. The two-person duathlon combines a runner and a cyclist, with the order of the legs fixed. The race is authorised by Lesy ČR and the Slavkov Forest Protected Landscape Area. Registration requires a team with at least one woman. The time limit is 18 hours, and the entry fee is 2,400 CZK, payable in cash on site. Accommodation is not provided.

name: Běh na Pajrek
location: Nýrsko, Nýrsko, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Běh na Pajrek is the second edition of a running race organized by TJ Nýrsko, taking place on June 13, 2026, at the grounds below the ski slope in Nýrsko. Men run 8.6 km (2 laps) and women 4.2 km (1 lap), with 152 meters of elevation gain per lap. The finish is at the same location as the start. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Ešus League, with refreshments available at the venue. The organizers note that the course may change due to construction work and provide prizes in kind for the top finishers in each category.
course_highlights: Men’s course: 8.6 km (2 laps); women’s course: 4.2 km (1 lap)
152 m of elevation gain per lap; an uphill and downhill course
The finish is at the same location as the start, at the grounds below the ski slope
additional: On-site registration is open from 12:00 to 13:45. Payment by bank transfer; include your first name, surname, and year of birth in the payment reference. All participants compete at their own risk. Refreshments are available at the venue. Prizes in kind for the top three in each category. The organizer reserves the right to change the course due to construction work. The race takes place at Pajrek; on-site registration is available. The event is part of a series of local running races. Registration is open from 12:00 to 13:45 on race day.

name: Běh zámeckým parkem Kravaře
location: Zámecký park, Kravaře, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run through Kravaře Chateau Park is a traditional running race organized by the Prajzský běžecký klub Kravaře, held in the picturesque chateau park in Kravaře. The race offers an 8.7 km course for adults and shorter courses for children, divided by age category. The surface consists of gravel paths, and the course follows three loops through the park. The event is suitable for recreational runners and families with children, with welcoming facilities and refreshments for all participants.
course_highlights: The course follows three loops through the chateau park
The surface consists of gravel paths
The main course for adults is 8.7 km long
additional: Children’s check-in takes place from 8:30 to 9:10, and children start at 9:15. Children’s categories are divided by age, with course distances ranging from 150 m to 1,800 m. Adults are provided with cake and drinks, while children receive a sweet reward. Facilities include changing rooms and showers at the MFK Kravaře complex. A trail run on gravel paths in the chateau park, registration for adults and children, various age categories, refreshments and prizes.

name: Půlmaraton okolo Prahy 4
location: Žluté lázně, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Prague 4 Half Marathon is a unique individual running event offering a meditative running experience on the varied terrain of an urban trail. The course is approximately 21 kilometres long and follows the perimeter of the Prague 4 district, giving participants a chance to get to know the area and test their own running fitness. There is no mass start: runners set off individually or in small groups between 9:00 and 10:00, eliminating stress and congestion at the start and on the course. Following a successful debut, the half marathon is being held for the second time and is suitable for anyone who wants to combine athletic effort with an enjoyable experience in nature and the city.
course_highlights: Urban trail with varied terrain
Approximately 21 km loop around Prague 4
Individual start between 9:00 and 10:00, with no mass gathering
additional: The event is run individually, with a flexible start between 9:00 and 10:00. Participants can run alone or in small groups, using a map on their phone or on paper. With no congestion at the start, on the course or at the finish, the event offers a relaxed experience. Individual course, marked route, start between 9:00 and 10:00, event is part of the Trail Running Cup series, run at your own risk, take extra care when crossing roads

name: Přespolní běh areálem zdraví Chábory
location: Chábory u Dobrušky, Chábory, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Chábory Health Centre Cross-Country Run is a traditional race organized by the Chábory Volunteer Fire Brigade, held in the picturesque health centre grounds near Dobruška. The event features a main 10,000-metre race and other categories on a 3,330-metre loop, for men, women, juniors and the general public aged 4 to 90. It is part of the East Bohemia Grand Prix in running and welcomes all generations under the motto “GET FIT!”. Participants can look forward to certificates, prizes and a raffle, while the overall winner of the main race receives a perpetual trophy.
course_highlights: A 3,330 m loop along field and forest paths
Main race: 10,000 m
Categories for everyone aged 4 to 90
additional: Race check-in takes place from 8:00 to 9:30. The 50 Kč entry fee is paid at check-in as a contribution towards administration and refreshments. The results announcement and prize presentation are scheduled for 11:25. Competitors take part at their own risk and must comply with current hygiene measures. The race takes place on 14 June 2026; registration is open until 13 June 2026 at 20:00. In addition to the main 10,000 m race, shorter distances are also available. Certificates, prizes and a trophy for the overall winner are up for grabs.

name: Chaloupecký kros
location: Chaloupky, Komárov, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Chaloupecký Cross-Country Race is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Chaloupky near Komárov. It offers two main routes of approximately 8 km and 4 km, running on asphalt, forest paths, and meadows. The main race starts at 10:00, giving participants a combination of natural beauty and sporting challenge. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup and is suitable for the general public. There are no children’s categories.
course_highlights: Surface: asphalt, forest paths, meadows
Route distances: 8 km and 4 km
Start in Chaloupky near Komárov
additional: The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup. Children’s races are not part of this event. The route surface combines asphalt, forest paths, and meadows. Routes: 8 km and 4 km; start at 10:00; no children’s races; different distances for different categories.

name: Běh na Hraničář
location: Lesní divadlo u Úhlavy, Nýrsko, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Běh na Hraničář is a traditional and prestigious hill race held in the picturesque surroundings of the forest theatre by the Úhlava River in Nýrsko. The 5 km route, with 380 metres of elevation gain, passes the ruins of Pajrek Castle and finishes at the summit of Hraničář, with a stunning view of Mount Ostrý. The race is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup and has been held again since 2020 after a three-year break. After the race, participants must make their own way back to the start.
course_highlights: Start by the forest theatre on the Úhlava River
380 metres of elevation gain over a 5 km course
Finish at the summit of Hraničář, with a view of Mount Ostrý
additional: The race is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup. After the race, participants must make their own way back to the start. The event includes a 5 km main category and children's races; on-site registration is open from 9:15 to 10:15; the course is mostly trail, with a hilly profile and a climb to the summit of Hraničář.

name: Dobývání Dívčích hradů
location: Hlubočepy, Praha 5, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Conquering Dívčí Hrady is a 2 km uphill race with 135 metres of elevation gain, held in Hlubočepy, Prague 5. The race is part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series and offers runners the challenge of a demanding climb. The course runs through scenic terrain with beautiful views, making the race appealing to fans of mountain running and uphill running. It is suitable for anyone looking to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain.
course_highlights: 2 km course with 135 m of elevation gain
Demanding uphill race in Hlubočepy, Prague
Part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series
additional: The race is part of the cycling section—a duathlon, with the option to compete in various categories and results recorded for over 78 runners in the past.

name: Unicredit Pražská štafeta RunCzech
location: Výstaviště Praha Holešovice, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The UniCredit Prague Relay is a team running event taking place on 16 June 2026 in Prague, featuring a relay race with four 5 km legs. The race starts at 18:00 in Stromovka Park, directly in front of Výstaviště Praha Holešovice, which is easily accessible by tram. The event is designed for teams and is suitable for corporate team-building, school events, and other groups looking to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and have fun together. After the race, a Team Box with comfortable facilities and catering is available for participants and their fans.
course_highlights: Team relay race: 4 x 5 km
Start and finish in Stromovka Park, Prague
Easy tram access to the Výstaviště Holešovice stop
additional: The Team Box offers a fully equipped tent with catering, alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, an electrical connection, and branding for 50 visitors. Only runners whose race number ends in "A" will be allowed to enter the start area. The use of skates, bicycles, and strollers is strictly prohibited, as is running with dogs or taking children onto the course. The event takes place in Stromovka Park and offers team registration, refreshments, and an accompanying programme including an evening party. The start and finish are at Výstaviště Praha Holešovice.

name: Kros Otakara Pachmanna
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Otakar Pachmann Cross-Country Race is a 4.4 km race through the beautiful natural surroundings of Krčský les in Prague 4. It is part of the SABZO series and gives runners the chance to enjoy natural terrain and a woodland atmosphere. It is suitable for anyone who enjoys running in nature and wants a sporting challenge in a peaceful forest setting.
course_highlights: 4.4 km course
Off-road running in Krčský les
Part of the SABZO series
additional: The race is part of the SABZO series, which offers various course distances, including 6 km, 3 km and 12 km, as well as activities for families with children in Krčský les.

name: 401. Malá cena Monaka
location: Restaurace Monako, Slatiňany, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Malá cena Monaka is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The race is part of the long history of running events organized by the KRB Chrudim club and gives athletes the opportunity to test themselves on interesting courses. It is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to experience the atmosphere of a high-quality sporting event in pleasant surroundings.
course_highlights: The race takes place near the Monako restaurant in Slatiňany
A traditional running event with a long history in the Pardubice Region
Friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization by the KRB Chrudim club
additional: The race is scheduled for June 17, 2026. Exact information about the course distance and registration is not currently available.

name: Běh olympijského dne
location: Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Olympic Run is a traditional sporting event organized by the Czech Olympic Committee, held as part of Olympic Day on June 17, 2026, in Zlín. The run brings together different generations and levels of runners, from children to adults, and promotes Olympic values such as friendship, fair play, and respect. Participants can choose from shorter and longer routes, and the race is accompanied by sporting and educational activities. Entry fees support children’s participation in sport through the Czech Olympic Foundation. The event is open to everyone who wants to enjoy being active and support a good cause.
course_highlights: Routes for adults and children in various age categories
Chip timing
Start and registration on the meadow by the Komec sports complex, Brno-Komárov
additional: Registration is online only until June 5, 2026; on-site registration is not available. The first 150 adults and 70 children to register by March 31 will receive a free T-shirt (select the registration option with a T-shirt and choose a size). The route is not suitable for wheelchairs or handcycles. A changing room, baggage storage, and toilets are available. Timing is provided by chip timing. Registration opens on June 19, 2026; the event takes place in Zlín as part of Olympic Day and focuses on promoting friendship and Olympic values.

name: Olympijský běh - Zlín
location: Stadion mládeže, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Olympic Run in Zlín is a traditional sporting event held at the Youth Stadium. The race features a classic 5-kilometre course on the tartan track for adults, as well as several shorter children’s races. The event supports sports activities for children from socially disadvantaged families, with part of the entry fee donated to the Czech Olympic Foundation. Registration is online, and the race starts at 18:00, with the start broadcast on Czech Radio.
course_highlights: 5 km course on the tartan track at the Youth Stadium in Zlín
Children’s races over 200 m, 400 m, 800 m and 1,500 m
The course is accessible to wheelchair users and handcyclists

The routes pass through the beautiful natural scenery of the Ore Mountains and suit a range of sporting abilities, as well as recreational participants. The start and finish are at 2nd Jirkov Primary School. The event takes place on 20 June 2026.

The race offers a main 5 km run along a pleasantly shaded, flat cycle path, suitable for runners and walkers alike. Children can take part in a short 300 m run, and there is an exhibition race for the youngest participants, aged up to 4, right on the farm grounds. After the race, participants receive a commemorative medal, a refreshing drink, and light refreshments. There is also an accompanying program for the whole family.

name: Velíšskej přespolňák
location: Louny, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Velíšskej Přespolňák is a traditional cross-country race with a long history, held in Louny in the Ústí nad Labem Region. The race is open to all age groups and offers a range of distances, from children’s races to the men’s 7,800-metre race. The Lucka Náprstková Memorial commemorates a tragic event and is part of the sporting event. It is organised by the Czech Union of Sport, which encourages the general public to stay active and take part in sport.
course_highlights: A range of distances for children and adults
Cross-country running on natural terrain in Louny
The Lucka Náprstková Memorial is part of the race

Registration and the schedule are available at www.askelna.cz. The Lucka Náprstková Memorial commemorates a tragic event in the High Tatras in 2002. The event is part of a wider series of sporting events in the Czech Republic, aimed at encouraging the general public to stay active and take part in sport.

description: Běhej lesy Týmovka is a unique team relay race held in the heart of the Vysočina region, offering an adventure for teams of 4 to 8 runners. The race consists of three different loops with a total distance of approximately 27.5 km, which each runner must complete over the weekend. The race also takes place at night, with headlamps, adding to its distinctive character and challenge. Alongside the race, there is a packed program of sports activities, cultural events and workshops. The facilities include a comfortable campsite with sanitation and refreshments.

Night running with a headlamp as part of the relay race
Forest trails in the heart of the Vysočina region, with loops of varying difficulty

Facilities include a campsite with space for tents and motorhomes, showers with hot water, refreshments in the PENNY tent, and a program of sports activities, concerts and workshops. There are no disposable cups at the refreshment stations, so runners must bring their own container (Speedcup). The race includes various team and individual categories, with the option to take part overnight and as part of the Běhej lesy race series, including ultramarathons and charity runs.

The race is open to all age groups, including children, and encourages active leisure in nature. Part of the Primátor Cup series, it is ideal for sports enthusiasts and families looking for an activity to enjoy together. The race takes place on the last Saturday in June, with other shorter routes and children’s categories also available.

Suitable for all age groups and families

It offers a range of distances, from children’s races to 3, 5 and 10 km, as well as a half marathon. The race takes place in the centre of Plzeň and is part of a series of events held across the Czech Republic. Participants can enjoy not only the race, but also a programme of activities for the whole family and high-quality support from start to finish.
course_highlights: 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km routes in the centre of Plzeň
Children’s races over 500 and 1,000 metres, with a children’s corner and childcare

The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, themed categories, and valuable prizes for winners and participants. Each edition has a new theme, adding a unique atmosphere and joy of movement to the race.

The course is flat and consists of five equal-length laps, running partly through nature and partly through shaded sections. The organizers provide electronic timekeeping and support at key points along the course. The race is suitable for all runners who want to welcome summer actively and enjoy the unique experience of running at dawn.

Part of the course runs through nature and shaded sections

The course consists of two 5 km loops over gently rolling terrain, highlighting both the beauty and the challenge of the race.

The race offers runners a challenging yet appealing course in the beautiful natural surroundings of Beroun in the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for fans of mountain running and uphill running who want to test their endurance and strength on a short but intense route. The race is open to the public and welcomes all runners looking to enjoy a sporting challenge in a pleasant atmosphere.

The course runs mostly on grass, with some gravel sections, making for an interesting and challenging terrain. Racers will follow in the footsteps of the legendary Giacomo Casanova and take on a fast course with beautiful views of the Ore Mountains, the Central Bohemian Uplands, and the foothills of the Bílina mine. The race features modern, certified obstacles on professional ALU structures, with an emphasis on safety and quality. A knightly theme adds to the atmosphere, bringing together physical challenge and the values of honor, loyalty, and cooperation. A varied program and facilities, including refreshments and support services, are available for racers and fans.

The race takes place at Duchcov Castle and offers various routes from 6 to 12 km, with obstacles and scenic surroundings. Registration and pricing details are available on the official website.

The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník District Runners’ Cup and offers runners an interesting combination of asphalt and trail sections. The course is suitable for runners looking for a challenge with a gentle climb and varied surfaces. The race takes place in the picturesque Podkozí area of the Central Bohemian Region and attracts runners from a wide surrounding area.
course_highlights: Course distance: 14.2 km
Elevation gain: approx. 170 m
The course runs on both asphalt and trails
additional: The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník District Runners’ Cup, offers a varied course for runners looking for a challenge, and takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Podkozí.

name: Králický Sněžník Beze stopy
location: Heřmanice u Králík, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Králický Sněžník BEZE STOPY is a challenging mountain race covering 14 km with 1,050 m of elevation gain. It starts in Heřmanice and runs via Klepáč and Malý Sněžník to the summit of Králický Sněžník. The route features beautiful ridge running with views of Poland’s Kłodzko Basin and the Lower Morava Valley, as well as short, demanding descents. The race is for lovers of mountain terrain and is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Iscarex Cup. A shorter 5 km race with 440 m of elevation gain is available for younger runners. The main race starts at 9:30, and the junior race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: Mountain trails with 1,050 m of elevation gain over 14 km
A ridge route with views of Poland’s Kłodzko Basin and the Lower Morava Valley
Demanding descents and chamois trails
additional: The junior race starts at 11:00, with transport to the start leaving at 10:15 from the accreditation area. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Iscarex Cup. It takes place on 11 July 2026. Online registration opens on 1 January 2025. The start and finish are in Heřmanice u Králík. The course includes border paths and chamois trails, with a short stretch of asphalt after the start.

name: Hvězdonice - Ondřejov
location: Hvězdonice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Hvězdonice - Ondřejov is a 5.75 km uphill race with 255 meters of elevation gain, starting in Hvězdonice. This running race offers challenging terrain and beautiful views in the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for runners looking for a climbing challenge and wanting to test themselves in a mountain race. The race is part of the Svět běhu running calendar and attracts runners from the surrounding area.
course_highlights: Route length: 5.75 km
Elevation gain: 255 m
Start in Hvězdonice
additional: The race is held regularly in July. Registration and further information are not explicitly provided, but the event is well known among the regional running community.

name: MiniTMMTR - TransMoravský Masochistický Terénní Běh
location: Lomnice, Jihomorava, Czech Republic
organizer: Česká atletická unie (ČAU) ve spolupráci s Tomášem Ruskem
description: MiniTMMTR is a challenging 100 km trail run starting in Lomnice in the South Moravian Region. The route passes through beautiful places in the Blansko District to Luleč, where runners turn around, and then follows the same route back. The race is part of the TransMoravian Masochistic Trail Run, known for its distance, challenging profile, and typically warm summer weather. It offers a chance to discover some of Moravia’s most beautiful places and enjoy running in the forest and along quiet country roads. The race was founded by Czech ultrarunner Tomáš Rusek and is playfully called “masochistic” to reflect its difficulty.
course_highlights: The route passes through beautiful places in the Blansko District
Turnaround in Luleč; out and back along the same route
Running in the forest and along quiet country roads
additional: Trail race, marked route, refreshment stations, online tracking available, registration and accommodation in the area

name: S-Race
location: Kolonáda Ferdinandova pramene, Mariánské Lázně, Karlovarský kraj, Czech Republic
description: S-Race is an OCR run in Mariánské Lázně, held in front of the Ferdinand Spring Colonnade. The race offers 6 km, 12 km and 18 km courses, which run mostly along paved forest paths and feature more than 20 obstacles per lap. Races adapted to different age groups are available for children. The start and finish are right by the colonnade, where facilities include changing rooms, toilets, a baggage storage area and refreshments. The race is suitable for a wide range of ages and features staggered starts, with activities for children during the main race.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly along paved forest paths
More than 20 obstacles on the 6 km lap, 40+ on the 12 km course, and 60+ on the 18 km course
Start and finish in front of the Ferdinand Spring Colonnade in Mariánské Lázně
additional: The main race starts at 120-second intervals, with five runners per start. The 18K course starts first, followed by the 12K and 6K courses. Registration and chip collection on race day are open from 8:00 to 9:15 for the main race and from 12:30 to 13:45 for the children’s race. Participants under 18 must have written consent from a legal guardian. Men’s and women’s changing rooms, toilets, baggage storage and refreshments are available. Activities for children are provided during the main race. The terrain includes paved forest paths and obstacles. The race is suitable for the general public, including younger participants born in 2011 or earlier, who need parental consent. The race takes place on 12 July 2026.

name: Koblížkový pasecký běh
location: Paseka u Olomouce, Olomouc District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: The Koblížkový Pasecký Run is a traditional road race in Paseka near Olomouc, offering an 8.2 km course. The race runs on asphalt, paving stones and park paths, passing through the village, along the cycle path to the sanatorium and through the park of the Specialist Treatment Institute, before returning to the start at the municipal office. The first categories start in the afternoon, creating a pleasant atmosphere for runners and spectators alike. The organiser is Ivan Elischer, who ensures the event runs smoothly and supports the runners.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt, paving stones and park paths
It passes through Paseka and along the cycle path to the sanatorium
It includes the park of the Specialist Treatment Institute
additional: The race starts at the municipal office in Paseka. The course is suitable for running on asphalt, paving stones and park paths. The organiser is Ivan Elischer, who can be contacted for information. The race takes place on 12 July 2026; registration and further information are available on the official website. The event is open to the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.

name: Halda Trail Run
location: Kuřimská Nová Ves, Brno-Country District, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: HALDA TRAIL RUN is an off-road running adventure in Kuřimská Nová Ves, following the picturesque landscape of the Halda stream valley and the Libochovka River. The longest route is approximately 24 km and includes 23 stream crossings that are runnable and pleasantly refreshing in summer. The race offers three route distances (4, 14 and 24 km), which connect to one another and allow runners to change distance during the race. The route runs mostly through forests and meadows, away from the main hiking trails, with panoramic views, two short, steep climbs and varied terrain—something both recreational runners and ambitious trail runners will appreciate.
course_highlights: 23 ankle-deep stream crossings that are runnable and refreshing in summer
Panoramic views and two short, steep climbs with gradients of over 30%
The route runs mostly through forests and meadows, away from the main hiking trails
additional: The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours. The timing checkpoint at the start of the second lap (14.5 km) closes at 12:00; slower runners will be stopped and classified on the middle-distance route. The 4, 14 and 24 km routes connect to one another, and runners can change route distance during the race. The route surface combines challenging terrain (rocks and roots), easy terrain and asphalt. The route will be clearly marked with arrows and flagging tape. Trail, stream crossings, scenery, challenging terrain; registration details are not specified.

name: Běh letním ránem
location: Štítná nad Vláří, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 300 CZK předem, 500 CZK na místě; děti a mládež do 18 let 100 CZK předem, 200 CZK na místě

description: Běh letním ránem is a trail running race held in Štítná nad Vláří - Popov, offering two routes of approximately 7 and 15 km. The race traverses varied terrain, including asphalt, forest trails and hills, with beautiful views and challenging sections that test runners’ fitness. The start and finish are by the pub in Popov. The race has a friendly, family atmosphere, with an emphasis on participants’ safety and responsibility. It is part of the Běhy Zlín series and is organized by the Martinát family and their friends.
course_highlights: A trail race combining asphalt and forest trails
A challenging climb to the saddle below Hložecká Chapel
Beautiful views of Popov and the surrounding countryside
additional: Online registration is available until 2 business days before the race, and on-site registration is available until 9:30. Timing uses Race Result chip technology. Water and Kofola are available on the course; sweets, fruit and goulash for pre-registered participants are available at the finish. The start and finish are by the pub in Popov. Parking is by the bus stop, as directed by the organizer. Children under 15 must be accompanied by someone over 18; participants aged 15–18 may start with written consent from a parent or legal guardian. The race takes place on 12 July 2026, starts at 10:00, and registration closes 2 days before the race. Chip timing. Suitable for runners aged 15 and over.

name: Běh o Ludgerův meč
location: Hořičky, Náchod, Czech Republic
description: The Run for Ludger’s Sword is the third edition of a running race organized by Běžecký klub Náchod in cooperation with the municipality of Hořičky. The race is part of the Primátor CUP running series and the Velká cena východních Čech cup. The routes run around Hořičky, offering beautiful views of the Kladské pomezí, across gently rolling terrain with gravel and forest paths and very little asphalt. Courses are available for children, as well as an 8 km main race and a 4 km FIT course. The start and race check-in take place at the grounds by the football pitch in Hořičky.
course_highlights: 8 km main race on gently rolling terrain with gravel and forest paths
4 km FIT course with very little asphalt
Beautiful views of the Kladské pomezí
additional: Race check-in opens at 8:00 at the grounds by the football pitch in Hořičky. Check-in closes 30 minutes before each children’s category starts and at 10:00 for adults. Children’s races start between 9:00 and 9:35, according to age category. The main race and FIT course start at 10:30. The entry fee includes chip timing; homemade cakes, pastries, juice and tea are served at the finish. Parking is available by the football pitch; please follow the organizers’ instructions. Prizes are awarded to the fastest children, with medals and non-cash prizes in the adult categories. Cash prizes go to the first three men and women overall in the main race (600 Kč, 400 Kč, 200 Kč). Terrain: gently rolling, with gravel and forest paths and very little asphalt. Online registration via sportchallange.cz. The race includes medals and prizes and takes place at the grounds by the football pitch in Hořičky.

name: Dvě kola při zdi
location: Obora Hvězda, Praha 6, Czech Republic
price_range: 50 Kč děti online, 100 Kč na místě; dospělí 250 Kč na místě po online uzávěrce
