tiers.description: 150 Kč při registraci online uzávěrka online registrací: 6. července – do tohoto termínu nutno zaplatit startovné.

description: Dvě kola při zdi is a traditional cross-country race in Prague’s Hvězda Game Reserve, offering courses for men, women, and children. Men run the main 7.8 km course along the reserve’s perimeter walls. Women have a shorter 4 km course, but may also run the men’s course. Two shorter loops are prepared for children. After the race, participants can enjoy a raffle and hearty refreshments.
course_highlights: The course runs along the perimeter walls of Hvězda Game Reserve
The main men’s course is 7.8 km long, with approximately 120 m of total elevation gain
The women’s course is 4 km long, with approximately 60 m of elevation gain; women may also run the men’s course
additional: On-site registration is available from 16:30 to 18:00 (for children, from 16:00 to 16:30). Runners receive an electronic chip for accurate timekeeping. The start and finish are in Hvězda Game Reserve, by the main entrance from Vypich. Hearty refreshments are available, including soft drinks, beer, and bread with English bacon. A raffle with prizes takes place after the race. Portable toilets are available. The race offers refreshments, electronic timekeeping, a raffle with prizes, and various age categories, including children.

name: Halda
location: Tuchlovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: HALDA TRAIL RUN is an off-road running adventure through the beautiful landscape of the Halda stream valley and the Libochovka River. It offers three connected routes of 4, 14 and 24 kilometres, allowing runners to change distance during the race. The route runs mostly through forests and meadows, away from the main hiking trails, and features 23 stream crossings, two short, steep climbs and panoramic views. The race is suitable for both relaxed runners and ambitious trail runners, and is clearly marked with arrows and ribbons.
course_highlights: 23 ankle-deep stream crossings that are runnable and refreshing in summer
Panoramic views and two short, steep climbs with gradients of over 30%
The route runs mostly through forests and meadows, away from the main hiking trails
additional: The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours. At the start of the second lap (14.5 km), the time checkpoint closes at 12:00; slower runners will be stopped and classified on the middle-distance route. The route combines challenging terrain (rocks and roots), easy terrain and asphalt. Runners may switch to a shorter route during the race. Routes: 4 km, 14 km, 24 km; trail terrain, brooks, scenic views, 3-hour time limit.

name: Běh o Neplachovský Hrneček
location: Neplachov, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Neplachov Mug Run is a traditional running race held in Neplachov, South Bohemia. Its 14th edition takes place on Friday, July 17, 2026. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is supported by the South Bohemian Region’s budget. The event offers a sporting experience in the region’s beautiful surroundings and attracts runners from the wider area. The organizers warmly invite all runners to take part in this popular event.
course_highlights: 10 km course with paved and natural-surface sections
Includes various age categories, including children
Part of the South Bohemian Running Cup
additional: The course consists of two 5 km loops. Registration is available through the website, and results are published online. The run is supported by the South Bohemian Region.

name: Kružberský Tesák
location: Kružberský přehradní areál, u přehrady Kružberk, Kružberk, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kružberský Tesák is a sporting event held at the Kružberk Dam grounds, offering courses and categories for experienced runners, intermediate participants, and complete beginners. The race is suitable for solo runners, walkers, and families with children. The event also includes Pejskiáda, a fun dog show and competitions for dogs of all sizes and breeds. Organizers Kateřina and Lucie, nature lovers and fans of sports with dogs, aim to create a friendly atmosphere and make the event enjoyable for everyone.
course_highlights: Courses suitable for runners of all levels, from beginners to experienced athletes
The area around Kružberk Dam, with beautiful natural scenery and views
Pejskiáda, featuring a dog show and competitions for dogs of all breeds and sizes
additional: Registration opens in May 2026. After submitting the entry form, you will be sent a variable payment reference for paying the entry fee to the organizer’s account. Payment must be made as soon as possible after registration. The event also includes dog competitions and shows, and is suitable for families with children and dog lovers. A two-day event with the option of camping in tents, competitions, and a traveling trophy for the winner.

name: Zkus Noční Kuks
location: Kuks, Trutnov District, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
description: Zkus Noční Kuks is a night running race in the picturesque Baroque setting of Kuks. It offers two routes—10 km and 5 km—that pass historic landmarks such as Braun’s Nativity Scene and Kuks Hospital. Running in the dark, lit only by headlamps, offers a unique experience and an atmosphere that runners will remember for a long time. The 10 km route includes the 21st Century Stations of the Cross pilgrimage route, while the shorter 5 km route follows the Elbe at night and the Count’s Avenue, lined with 222 trees.
course_highlights: The 10 km route leads through the magical heart of the Baroque landscape, past Braun’s Nativity Scene and the 21st Century Stations of the Cross
The 5 km route starts at the hospital and runs along the Elbe at night and the Count’s Avenue, lined with 222 trees
A night run illuminated by headlamps, with an unforgettable atmosphere beneath the illuminated façade of Kuks Hospital
additional: The entry fee includes a race bib and chip. Entry can also be purchased as a gift voucher with a unique code. Registration takes place online via myresult.cz; the contractual relationship begins upon payment of the entry fee. The race is organized by TURN ON EVENTS s.r.o. from Hradec Králové. The race offers 5 km and 10 km routes, the option to run with a headlamp, refreshments during and after the race, and dogs are allowed. Registration is available via the website; the entry fee is payable within 14 days of registration.

name: ČEZ RunTour Olomouc
location: Smetanovy sady, Olomouc, Olomouc District, Czech Republic
description: ČEZ RunTour Olomouc is a family-friendly running event offering 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km races for recreational and elite runners, as well as children’s races of 500 and 1,000 metres. The event takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Smetana Gardens and is part of a nationwide series featuring unique courses. The organisers focus on excellent service, safety and fun for the whole family, including a programme of activities and a charitable element. Every participant receives a race pack and can look forward to refreshments and support from the pacer team. ČEZ RunTour is not only a sporting event, but also a full-day experience for all ages.
course_highlights: 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km races, plus children’s races of 500 and 1,000 m
Start and finish in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc
A programme of activities and a charitable element
additional: The event offers 2 x 5 km and 4 x 2.5 km relay races as part of the 10 km race. The pacer team helps runners achieve their target time. There are refreshment stations on the course, including at least two on the half marathon. Children receive a race pack and can enjoy activities in the children’s zone. A dedicated emergency medical service phone line is also available during the race. The event includes various race distances, family activities, charitable support, medals, photos and facilities for runners. The start and finish are in Smetana Gardens, and capacity is approximately 1,700 runners.

description: Noční běh Rusava is an unforgettable night race in the Hostýnské Mountains, offering a 12-hour run on a single loop as well as a 5 km race. The event is suitable for both individuals and relay teams, and participants are not required to run for the full 12 hours. Race facilities include a gymnasium for resting, an all-night buffet, and aid stations. The event takes place in the scenic surroundings of the ski slope and forests around Rusava, offering a unique sporting experience beneath the starry sky.
course_highlights: A night run on the ski slope and through the forests of the Hostýnské Mountains
A single 5 km loop that can be repeated for 12 hours
All-night aid stations and facilities at the local school
additional: Race facilities include a gymnasium at the local school for resting, where participants can bring sleeping bags and sleeping mats. A buffet and aid stations serving drinks, fruit, and food are open throughout the night. Parking is available in designated areas in the village. You do not have to run for the full 12 hours; you can also walk with poles. A belt for attaching the race bib is available for 150 Kč. Terrain: forests and ski slope; registration; relay system; environmental requirements for cups; refreshments throughout the night.

name: 7 pohoří Krušné Hory
location: Abertamy, Krušné hory, Czech Republic
description: The Krušné hory 2026 race is a technical trail run that takes you through the beauty of the Krušné Mountains and a former mining landscape listed by UNESCO. The route starts in Abertamy and passes the former Eva mine, Jelení, Švýcarská chata on Plešivec, Merklín, the former settlement of Kaff, Pstruží and the ski area before reaching the finish. It offers three courses of varying lengths and elevation gains, suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. The race takes place in all weather conditions, and participants receive a commemorative medal and refreshments on the course and at the finish.
course_highlights: A scenic route through the Krušné Mountains and UNESCO-listed mining landscape
Main course: 22 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain
Alternative courses: 13 km and 8 km with 510 m and 220 m of elevation gain
additional: The race has a time limit of 4 hours; after this time, a runner is marked DNF. Participants can store small items at the registration tent. Recommended equipment includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The entry fee includes a professionally marked course, race bib, chip timing, a commemorative medal, and refreshments on the course and at the finish. The event takes place in all weather conditions, and participation is at your own risk. The entry fee includes the course, medal, refreshments, facilities, and recommended equipment, including a windbreaker and a mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The race is organized by a local mountain rescue team.

name: Rokytnice nad Jizerou - Dvoračky
location: Dvorská bouda, Rokytnice nad Jizerou, Krkonoše, Czech Republic
description: The route from Rokytnice nad Jizerou to Dvoračky is a popular hiking trail in the western Krkonoše Mountains. It starts at Horní náměstí in Rokytnice. Marked blue, the trail follows the Huťský stream to the picturesque Huťský Waterfall and continues to the Dvoračky mountain lodge, known for its history and traditional cheese-making. The route offers beautiful natural scenery, especially in autumn, when the surrounding beech forests are ablaze with colour. It is suitable for hikers, ski mountaineers and cross-country skiers, who can enjoy the snowy landscape and refreshments at the Štumpovka restaurant in Dvoračky.
course_highlights: Blue-marked trail following the Huťský stream
Huťský Waterfall, surrounded by beech forests with beautiful autumn colours
Historic Dvoračky mountain lodge, known for traditional cheese-making
additional: Parking is available at the Tesco car park on Dolní náměstí in Rokytnice. Refreshments are available at the Štumpovka restaurant in Dvoračky and the U Vocta pub in Rokytnice. The route is also suitable for winter hiking, ski mountaineering and cross-country skiing. Please respect the groomed ski tracks and do not enter them. The race is part of the local sports calendar, with several distances available, including an uphill race to Dvoračky. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and offers beautiful views and a rewarding sporting experience.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Fojtovice
location: Fojtovice, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. Across six races in different destinations, you can choose from main races of 6 to 9 km, adventure routes of 20 to 30 km, a walk with checkpoint-finding, and children’s races. The series is suitable for runners, canicross participants, children, and walkers, and offers a varied selection of routes through the picturesque Ore Mountains. The Fojtovice race takes place on 19 July 2026 and offers a main race, an adventure route, a walk, and children’s races.
course_highlights: Main race of 6–9 km through the picturesque Ore Mountains
Adventure route of 20–30 km, following a map
Children’s races from 300 m to 1,600 m
additional: The series includes 6 races in different locations in the Ore Mountains. In addition to running, participants can take part in a walk with checkpoint-finding using a map and in canicross. Children’s races are divided by age and course distance. The organizer is Živé Sokolovsko z.s., in cooperation with Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s. The races include different distances and categories, including walking and children’s races; the series takes place at several locations in the Ore Mountains region.

name: Šachty - Štěpánka
location: Vysoké nad Jizerou-Sklenařice, Vysoké nad Jizerou, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Český Ski klub Vysoké nad Jizerou
description: Běh Šachty - Štěpánka is a traditional race organized by the Czech Ski Club in Vysoké nad Jizerou. The race is part of the Maratonstav Czech Cup in hill running and offers runners a challenging course in beautiful Krkonoše surroundings. The event attracts athletes and hill-running fans, who can enjoy both the challenge and the atmosphere of a mountain race. The organizers welcome all runners who want to test themselves on this traditional course.
course_highlights: A challenging course in the Krkonoše Mountains
A hill run with beautiful views
Part of the Maratonstav Czech Cup
additional: The race is part of a hill-running series with a long-standing tradition and offers challenging terrain suitable for experienced runners and mountain-sports enthusiasts.

name: Běh za Sliveneckou saní
location: Praha 5-Velká Chuchle, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Běh za Sliveneckou saní is an uphill race in Prague 5-Velká Chuchle, covering 2.54 km with 130 meters of elevation gain. The race is part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series and challenges runners with a demanding climb. It is suitable for anyone who wants to test their strength and endurance on hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Course length: 2.54 km
Elevation gain: 130 m
Uphill race in Prague 5-Velká Chuchle
additional: The race takes place as part of a series of hill races, with starts in three waves and results published by category. The event is suitable for runners of all levels who want to tackle a hilly course in pleasant surroundings.

name: 402. Malá cena Monaka
location: Slatiňany, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Little Monaco Race is a traditional running event organized by the KRB Chrudim club, held in the picturesque surroundings of Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The race gives athletes the opportunity to compete over various distances and enjoy the atmosphere of the running community. Part of a long-standing tradition, the event attracts runners of all ages. The organizers emphasize quality event management and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A traditional running race in the picturesque surroundings of Slatiňany
Various distances suitable for a wide range of runners
Part of the long-standing running tradition of the KRB Chrudim club
additional: The race takes place in July 2026; exact courses and registration information are not specified.

name: Tobiášův běh Kazín - Cukrák
location: Kazín, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Tobiášův běh Kazín - Cukrák is part of the KOPEC series, which features hill races in Prague and the surrounding area. This traditional race gives runners the chance to test themselves on challenging hilly courses in the scenic surroundings of Kazín. The KOPEC series is known for its community atmosphere and support for runners in all categories, who are automatically included in the overall standings. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys running in nature and the challenges of hilly terrain.
course_highlights: A hill race in Prague and the surrounding area
Challenging hilly courses in Kazín’s natural surroundings
Part of the traditional KOPEC series, with points and a league
additional: By taking part in any KOPEC series race, competitors are automatically included in the league’s overall standings. The series rankings are determined by the total points from a maximum of 10 best races. Competitors must follow the category-specific start rules and wear their race number visibly pinned on. If health is at risk, the race director may interrupt or end the race. The event is part of a series of hill races in Prague; the exact course distances are not specified. The race has a long tradition and is popular among local runners.

name: Smilovice pomáhají - Běh pro Theu
location: Sportcentrum Smilovice, Smilovice, Česká republika

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dobrovolné startovné při online registraci + zdarma zařazení do tomboly

description: Run for Thea is a charity race organized by the Smilovice Help Foundation, taking place on July 25, 2026, at the Sportcentrum Smilovice grounds. The race supports the treatment and rehabilitation of young Thea, who is facing serious health complications. Participants can choose from several routes of different lengths and age categories, whether they want to race or simply take a walk. The event is open to everyone who wants to support a good cause and enjoy being active in a community atmosphere.
course_highlights: The routes run along paved and compacted paths and are also suitable for strollers and wheelchair users (barrier-free course).
Available routes: 600 m children’s race (ages 0–5 and 6–10), 2 km junior race, 4 km hobby race, and 12 km main race.
The start and finish are at the Sportcentrum Smilovice grounds, where parking is available.
additional: Registration and bib-number collection take place from 8:00. Starts are staggered by category from 9:30 to 11:11. Proceeds from the entry fees go entirely toward supporting Thea’s treatment and rehabilitation. Raffle tickets are available for purchase. Routes are marked in different colors according to distance (green for 4 km, red for 12 km). running, charity event, fundraisers, charity ball, support for Thea and Klárka

name: Běh na Lysou horu
location: restaurace Zlatník, Krásná-Nižní Mohelnice, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Lysá hora is a traditional race held every year on the last Saturday in July in Krásná - Nižní Mohelnice. This 41st edition welcomes runners from the Czech Republic and Poland, who aim to conquer Lysá hora, the queen of the Beskydy Mountains. The race starts near the Zlatník restaurant at the crossroads to Lysá hora, where registration and the awards ceremony also take place. The course follows an asphalt road along a service road managed by Lesy ČR all the way to the summit of Lysá hora.
course_highlights: Start near the Zlatník restaurant at the crossroads to Lysá hora
The entire course follows an asphalt road along a service road managed by Lesy ČR
Finish at the summit of Lysá hora, the queen of the Beskydy Mountains
additional: The race is open to runners from the Czech Republic and Poland, takes place in the Beskydy Mountains, and is part of regional and national running competitions.

name: Borovská desítka
location: Havlíčkova Borová, Vysočina, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 Kč při přihlášení na webu do 30.6.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 150 Kč při přihlášení na místě v den startu

description: Borovská desítka is a traditional running race held in the picturesque village of Havlíčkova Borová in the Vysočina Region. The race offers a 10 km course with moderate elevation gain, running mostly through forests and along paved roads. The trees provide pleasant shade, even on sunny days. The start and finish are in the centre of the village, with aid stations on the course and at the finish. After the race, refreshments are provided, followed by an awards ceremony for the winners in various categories.
course_highlights: 10 km course with a total elevation gain of 139 m
The first third of the course runs along a forest path; the rest is on a paved road
Aid stations at the 5 km mark and at the finish; the course runs through forest, offering pleasant shade
additional: Registration for the main category is open from 14:30 to 16:15, and the main race starts at 17:00. Showers, changing rooms, toilets and luggage storage are available. Refreshments are provided at the finish throughout the event, including drinks, grilled food, draft beer and ice cream. Timing is provided by a chip integrated into the race bib, with a timing mat placed at the finish only. The race is part of a local running tradition; results can be viewed online, and children’s categories are also available.

name: Běh na Kozubovou
location: Dolní Lomná, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Elektronické přihlášení do 24.7.2026 ráno, bez nároku na tričko

description: The Kozubová Run is a traditional mountain race held in Dolní Lomná. It follows marked hiking trails and features a challenging elevation gain. The race starts by the bakery in Dolní Lomná and runs via Polana and the saddle below Kykula to the mountain hut on Kozubová. The course is approximately 5 km long, with around 500 metres of elevation gain, challenging runners with steep climbs and beautiful mountain views. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from juniors to veterans, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and generous prize raffle for participants.
course_highlights: The entire course follows blue and green hiking trail markers
A challenging climb with approximately 500 metres of elevation gain
Start by the bakery in Dolní Lomná; finish at the mountain hut on Kozubová
additional: Race check-in takes place at the museum, 300 m from the start by the bakery. Runners who register in advance receive a race number bearing their name and a T-shirt. After the race, there is a generous prize raffle featuring prizes from local sponsors. All categories start together at 10:00. Prizes and cash awards are presented in each category and overall for men and women. Start at 10:00 by the bakery in Dolní Lomná; registration deadline: 21.7.2026; extensive accompanying programme; prizes for the top three in each category; accommodation available; photo gallery from previous editions.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka
location: Plzeň, Plzeň-město, Czech Republic
description: The Emil Zátopek Golden Marathon is part of Zátopek’s Golden Week, a series of running races held in Plzeň in honour of Emil Zátopek’s Olympic victories. The main marathon takes place on 27 July and also offers accompanying races, including a half marathon, marathon and half-marathon relays, and a 10.5 km road race. The start is in the afternoon in Štruncovy sady and the surrounding area, with a varied programme and categories for men, women, and young people. The race is known for its tradition, high-quality organisation, and welcoming atmosphere for all runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Plzeň, in Štruncovy sady and the surrounding area
Options to enter the marathon, half marathon, relays, and shorter races
Categories for all age groups, including young people
additional: The start for marathon runners with an expected finish time of over 5 hours is at 13:00. Registration opens at 12:00; race check-in and bib pickup are in Plzeň at Pallova 19. The entry fee includes a race bib, chip-use fee, refreshments, a commemorative medal, and a T-shirt for marathon runners. Changing rooms and showers are available at the venue. The race offers several distances, online registration, technical and medical support, and has a capacity of approximately 1,000 participants.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - červenec
location: Řeka Úslava, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Tempo Makers Osmička is a regular running race in Plzeň, held along the Úslava River. The race is open to men and women aged 16 and over and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners who share a passion for running and spending time together. The field is limited to 75 starters, making for a small-scale, relaxed event. The start and finish are at the same location, with parking nearby. After the race, the top finishers are announced and a raffle is held.
course_highlights: An 8 km course along the Úslava River
Start and finish at the same location in Pytel, Plzeň
Friendly atmosphere, with the field limited to 75 runners
additional: Registration and race-number pickup take place from 17:00 to 17:45. After the race, the top male and female runners are announced at 19:05, followed by the post-race raffle at 19:15. Parking for participants is available near the start and finish. The course is flat. Registration is available in advance or on-site. The race takes place on 28 July 2026.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (8) – červencový
location: Praha 4-Braník, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The 5 km and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 race in Prague-Braník offers a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava, where personal records are often set. This race is part of the 16th season of regular monthly runs, giving runners the chance to compare their performances with others. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the opportunity to achieve the qualifying time for the Czech Championships. After the race, enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, refreshments, and awards for the top runners.
course_highlights: A pleasant, fast course along the Vltava in Prague-Braník
Course measured by a certified measurer
Opportunity to achieve the qualifying time for the Czech Championships in the 10 km race
additional: Registration opens at 18:00; the 10 km race starts at 19:00 and the 5 km race at 19:05. After the race, refreshments are available at Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage is available in the organizers’ tent. A post-race prize draw offers prizes such as free entry to the next race, a massage voucher, and more. The course is suitable for runners of all levels, from beginners to professionals. First-place finishers in the categories receive prizes worth 103,000 Kč. The races are part of a series of running events in Prague.

name: Krkonošská 50
location: Špindlerův Mlýn, Krkonošský národní park, Czech Republic
description: Krkonošská 50 is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque setting of Krkonoše National Park, starting in Špindlerův Mlýn. The race offers a challenging 50 km course with 1,784 metres of elevation gain, following marked paths and mountain trails. The field is limited to 300 runners, and the race is divided into several age categories for both men and women. The organizers emphasize environmental responsibility and safety, including a requirement to carry a mobile phone and a ban on littering outside refreshment stations.
course_highlights: 50 km course with 1,784 m of elevation gain
The route follows marked paths in Krkonoše National Park
Refreshment stations at 13, 18, 27, 33 and 39 km, and at the finish
additional: The field is limited to 300 runners. Start and finish at the Svatý Petr complex in Špindlerův Mlýn. Parking at the central car park in Špindlerův Mlýn. Runners may switch from the long course to the short course after notifying the checkpoint at Svatý Petr – Hotel Horal. The route is marked with black arrows on a yellow background only at junctions and turns. A mobile phone is mandatory equipment for all runners. Trail race on marked paths, online registration, limited to 300 participants, categories for men and women, and the possibility of route changes.

name: Běhej lesy Bílá
location: Bílá, Beskydy, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Běhej lesy Bílá is a mountain trail race held in the beautiful Beskydy Protected Landscape Area. The race offers several routes, including short and long options, with the long ČSOB 20 km route included in the international UTMB Index. Runners can take the cable car to the summit and look forward to special speed sections, the Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, which add extra competitive challenges and rewards. The race is suitable for all mountain trail running enthusiasts who want to experience the beauty of the Beskydy Mountains while competing on well-marked routes.
course_highlights: Routes run through the Beskydy Protected Landscape Area, with respect for nature and a ban on leaving marked trails
Conti Speed Section – a timed 200-metre speed section on the Nova 11 km and ČSOB 20 km routes
Generali Investments Finish – an extended 500 m finishing straight with a timed section and performance analysis
additional: The race is part of the UTMB Index Races, with international ranking points. A cable car to the summit of the Bílá ski resort is available. At the finish, there is an extended 500 m straight with the timed Generali Investments Finish section, where the fastest men and women are announced and receive a Craft technical running shirt. Trail routes of varying lengths, a cable-car ride to the summit, speed sections, a charity race, respect for the Beskydy Protected Landscape Area, and GPX routes available for download.

name: Zlatá stezka
location: Stožec, Šumava, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Golden Trail is a historic international hiking route connecting Bohemia with the Danube region, passing through the beautiful landscapes of the Šumava and Bavarian Forests. The 631 km route offers a unique experience by linking up with Germany’s Golden Trail and passing through several national parks and nature reserves. Hikers can discover historic towns, castles, observation towers and cultural landmarks along the trail, which is equipped with information boards and rest areas. The Golden Trail is ideal for hiking and exploring the natural and historical attractions of the South Bohemian and Plzeň regions.
course_highlights: The route passes through Šumava National Park and the Bavarian Forest, the largest forested areas in Central Europe
The historic towns of Prachatice, Vimperk and Kašperské Hory, with cultural landmarks and museums
A cross-border connection with Germany’s Golden Trail, with 13 border-crossing points
additional: The route is marked with the Golden Trail logo and equipped with information boards and rest areas. It offers various stages of differing difficulty and length. Cultural and natural attractions near the route include the Volary Museum, Libín Lookout Tower, and historic landmarks such as Hus Castle and Vimperk Castle. The route offers different distances and difficulty levels, including an ultra challenge and sports challenges, with the option to register in advance. The event is suitable for runners, cyclists and hikers who want to explore the region actively and with respect for nature.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - srpen
location: Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt loop. The race also includes an 800-metre children’s course. Every participant can enjoy a warm cinnamon pancake at the finish. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration from 8:15 to 8:55 and the start at 9:00.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt loop, just under two laps long (3.2 km)
The children’s course is 800 metres long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 to 127, and children up to 12 years old. Every runner is timed, and the top three in each category receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get to the start are by bicycle, on foot, by car, on roller skates, or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The course is 3.2 km long with an asphalt surface; the children’s course is 800 m. The run is for all age groups, including children up to 12 years old. It takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration from 8:15 to 8:55 and the starting gun at 9:00.

name: Běh na Kamenný stůl
location: Rataje nad Sázavou, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run to the Stone Table is a traditional running race held in Rataje nad Sázavou, celebrating its 10th anniversary this year. The race offers a challenging and beautiful course from the castle courtyard to the Stone Table landmark, with varied surfaces and hilly terrain. It is open to professional runners, amateurs, and families with children, for whom shorter routes are available. The race is part of the Run the Castles series, which brings together running events at attractive castle locations.
course_highlights: The course leads to the Stone Table landmark and includes varied surfaces: cobblestones, asphalt, and paved and unpaved forest paths
Hilly terrain, with part of the course running through the forest and along field paths
Start and finish directly in the courtyard of the castle in Rataje nad Sázavou
additional: Race bibs with a chip and name, water, a biscuit, promotional materials, and a castle admission ticket. Children receive a voucher for ice cream and adults a voucher for a sausage. Fruit, cakes, and refreshments are available at the event facilities. Parking is available at the sports field on Zámecká Street and at other nearby locations. Results are announced after participants finish each route. Registration includes a race pack, refreshments, and castle admission; races take place under normal traffic conditions.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - srpen
location: Stromovka Park, Praha 7, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running levels, including children under 12, who run 1.6 km. The race is friendly and focused on the joy of running, whether you want to improve your personal best or simply enjoy a pleasant run in beautiful surroundings. The course follows the park’s paved paths; adults run two laps and children one. At the finish, everyone is rewarded with a warm cinnamon pancake.
course_highlights: The course follows the paved paths of Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km); children under 12 run 1 lap (1.6 km)
The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Královská obora–Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Bruselská brána area from 8:15 to 8:45, with online pre-registration available for faster check-in. Categories are divided by age and gender; results are adjusted using an age coefficient and count toward the year-long Lívancový pohár. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop). Changing and bag-drop tents, a mobile valuables-storage facility, and toilet cubicles are available. Parking is recommended near the bridge to Císařský ostrov on Za elektrárnou Street. The race takes place in Stromovka Park, starts at 9:07, and registration is open from 8:15 to 8:45. Online registration is available; there are categories for different age groups, parking near the bridge to Císařský ostrov, changing facilities, and toilets. The race is held regularly on the first Saturday of each month.

name: Mšecká sedmička
location: Mšec, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Městys Mšec a TJ Sokol Mšec
description: Mšecká sedmička is a traditional running race held in Mšec, in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is 7 km long and follows forest and field paths, offering runners a pleasant natural setting. It starts at the TJ Sokol Mšec football field and is suitable for the general public. It is organized by the Municipality of Mšec and TJ Sokol Mšec, who provide a friendly atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: 7 km course
Forest and field paths
Start and finish at the TJ Sokol Mšec football field
additional: The race is organized by the Municipality of Mšec and TJ Sokol Mšec. It is a mixed-type race on forest and field paths. It starts at the TJ Sokol Mšec football field. The course includes forest and field paths; registration requirements are not specified.

name: Libeř - Radlík
location: Libeř, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Libeř - Radlík is a 2.47 km uphill race with 170 m of elevation gain, part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series. The route is not entirely uphill: it includes several flat sections and one downhill, adding interest and variety to the race. The atmosphere is friendly, and the entry fee is symbolic, with generous prizes for the winners from Botanicus. The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain near Prague.
course_highlights: 2.47 km route with 170 m of elevation gain
The route includes flat sections and one downhill
Part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series
additional: The entry fee is symbolic, and the winners receive generous prizes from Botanicus. The route follows wide, partly gravel roads, which some runners mention in comments as a drawback compared with forest trails. The race has a friendly atmosphere despite somewhat punk-rock conditions. The route is not entirely uphill, with a few flat sections and one downhill; it follows wide, partly gravel roads; part of the Běhy do kopců series.

name: Trail Running Cup - Krkonošská padesátka
location: Špindlerův Mlýn, Krkonoše, Czech Republic
description: The Krkonoše 50 is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Špindlerův Mlýn in the Krkonoše Mountains. The race offers a challenging 50 km course with 1,784 metres of elevation gain, following marked paths and mountain trails. The start is at the Svatý Petr resort, and participants can use the central car park in Špindlerův Mlýn. The race is limited to 300 starters. Overall male and female winners are announced, along with winners in ten age categories for both men and women.
course_highlights: 50 km course with 1,784 m of elevation gain
The route follows marked paths and mountain trails in the Krkonoše Mountains
Checkpoints at 13, 18, 27, 33 and 39 km, and at the finish
additional: The race starts at the Svatý Petr resort in Špindlerův Mlýn. Parking is available at the central car park in Špindlerův Mlýn. A mobile phone is mandatory for all starters and must be working and fully charged. Littering outside aid stations is strictly prohibited. Switching from the long route to the shorter one is possible after notifying the checkpoint at Svatý Petr – Hotel Horal. The route is marked with black arrows on a yellow background only at junctions and turns. The participant limit is 300 runners. The race is open to men and women, registration is online, and race day is 1 August 2026.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - srpen
location: Smetanovy sady, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The event focuses on the joy of running and personal achievement, with everyone competing primarily against themselves. It is usually held in Smetana Gardens by the fountain, except for the June and August races, which take place by the river on U Dětského domova Street. The event also includes a cup competition, where results are adjusted using an age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year.
course_highlights: 2-mile (3.2 km) course; 600 m children’s race
The course usually runs through Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, by the fountain
The June and August races take place by the river on U Dětského domova Street
additional: Registration is from 9:30 to 10:00. The top three finishers in each category receive awards. Results are adjusted using an age coefficient, and points are accumulated in the cup competition for the period September 2025–August 2026. The event includes a 3.2 km asphalt course and a 600 m children’s race; registration is from 9:30 to 10:00; the event takes place on 2 August 2026.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Moldava
location: Moldava, Krušné hory, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in different locations, including Moldava, with routes for runners, canicross participants, children, and walkers. Each race offers a main running race of 6 to 9 km, an adventure route of 20 to 30 km navigated by map, a 5 to 8 km walk with checkpoints to find, and children’s races from 200 to 1600 metres. The series is suitable for the general public who want to explore the beauty of the Ore Mountains actively and through sport.
course_highlights: Main race: 6–9 km through the natural landscapes of the Ore Mountains
Adventure route: 20–30 km, navigated by map with orienteering elements
Children’s races and a 5–8 km walk with checkpoints to find
additional: The series includes 6 races in different locations across the Ore Mountains. The routes are suitable for runners, canicross participants, children, and walkers. Children’s races range from 200 to 1600 metres. The adventure routes are navigated by map, and the walking route includes finding checkpoints. The races are part of a series with an overall ranking and winners announced at the final race in Stříbrná; the event also includes races with dogs and children’s categories.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Karlštejn
location: Autokemp Karlštejn, Karlštejn, Středočeský, Czech Republic
price_range: 240 Kč (voucher na 12 závodů), 316 Kč (voucher na 6 závodů)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 240 Kč (v rámci voucheru na celou sérii 12 závodů)

description: The Berounka running series in Karlštejn is a community trail race held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Autokemp Karlštejn. The route crosses fields, meadows and forests to the Malá Amerika quarry, continues along the red-marked St. James’ Way to Karlštejn Castle, and finishes with a downhill run to the finish line. The race offers a friendly atmosphere, a marked route, refreshments and a place to store belongings. Each participant receives a race number, and the top finishers in each category receive diplomas and medals.
course_highlights: The route crosses fields, meadows and forests to the Malá Amerika quarry
It continues along the red-marked St. James’ Way to Karlštejn Castle
The route finishes with a downhill run towards the finish line
additional: The route is marked with red-and-white ribbons and red arrows on the ground. Refreshments and a place to store belongings are available on site. The top three finishers in each category receive diplomas and medals. The recommended latest arrival time is 17:45. Race number, refreshments, storage for belongings, start by 17:45, marked route, online or on-site registration available.

name: Rozdělovský čtvrtmaratón
location: Kladno-Rozdělov, Kladno, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Rozdělov Quarter Marathon is a running race organized by Maratón klub Kladno and held in Kladno-Rozdělov. The club focuses on endurance running and organizing races in the region. The race offers runners of all levels the opportunity to test themselves on a quarter-marathon course in the pleasant surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region. The event is part of the club’s running calendar and supports the running community around Kladno.
course_highlights: A quarter-marathon course in Kladno-Rozdělov
Organized by Maratón klub Kladno, which focuses on endurance running
The race is part of the regional running calendar
additional: The race takes place on a Wednesday or Thursday in the first half of August, starting at 18:00. The route follows forest trails. The event has an intimate atmosphere, and participant numbers are growing.

name: Krčský lomcovák
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Czech Republic
description: Krčský lomcovák is a traditional running race held in Krčský les in Prague 4. The race offers a 5 km route starting near the Velký altán, suitable for both men and women, with different start times. The event is part of a sports and fun afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, where participants and families with children can try various activities such as slacklining, sack races and disc golf. The race is organized by Krčák žije magazine, which covers activities and news in and around Krčský les.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through Krčský les
Start near the Velký altán
Mostly forest terrain with natural features
additional: Men start at 18:30, and women start half an hour earlier. The start is near the Velký altán. The event is part of a sports and fun afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, with accompanying activities for families with children. The race is open to all age groups, offers various running disciplines and is part of a community sports day in Prague 4.

name: Měřínský kros
location: Měřín, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: Měřín Cross-Country is a traditional cross-country race through the beautiful Vysočina countryside. It features a 13 km main race over Dědkovská hora and a relaxed 8 km course suitable for recreational runners. Children aged 5 to 12 can take part in the Junior Cross obstacle race, with a giant bouncy castle also available. The race is timed using chip timing, and an evening volleyball tournament with refreshments takes place after the run. The start and finish are at the sports field behind the elementary school in Měřín, where parking, a baggage drop, toilets, changing rooms and showers are available.
course_highlights: The 13 km main course runs mostly on dirt and forest roads and trails (about 70%), with the remainder on paved sections in the village
The route crosses Dědkovská hora, with new views thanks to bark beetle damage
A small refreshment station along the route
additional: Junior Cross is a free obstacle race for children aged 5–12, with 700 m and 1,400 m courses. A giant bouncy castle is available after the race. Parking is available at Měřín Elementary School. On-site registration closes 20 minutes before the start. The entry fee includes a sausage and a drink. The race is limited to 100 runners. Participants race at their own risk; no insurance is provided. An evening volleyball tournament with refreshments takes place after the run. The course is mostly on dirt and forest roads, with a marked route; the race is limited to 100 runners. Children’s obstacle races are free, and an evening volleyball tournament takes place after the race.

name: Barvám Neutečeš Pardubice
location: Pardubice, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Barvám Neutečeš is a colourful run in Pardubice offering two routes: 5 km and 1.5 km. The event isn’t about speed, but about joy, friendship and fun as participants make their way through colour zones where they are showered with colour. The run is suitable for all ages and is ideal for families, friends and individuals looking for a day full of colour, music and a great atmosphere. The event also includes a music programme and various fun activities.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 colour zones
1.5 km route with 3 colour zones and an interactive sports zone
Colour zones, music and fun activities along the route
additional: The event runs from 9:00 to 16:00 in Park Na Špici, Pardubice. The music programme features Pavel Calta and others. The event is charitable, and participants can contribute by purchasing a symbolic heart. There is an opportunity to enter an Instagram prize competition with prizes from partner STANLEY. The event offers BASIC and WOW race packs, and registration is available online and on site. It is suitable for team-building and charitable activities, with rules including paid entry fees and wearing a visible participant T-shirt.

name: Mořice Run
location: Mořice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Mořice Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque village of Mořice near Olomouc. The race is part of a series of running events focused on fitness and performance running, organized by the club in central Moravia. Liga stovkařů is known for supporting regular running and endurance races, and Mořice Run gives runners of all levels the opportunity to enjoy a quality race atmosphere. The club also provides support and advice to runners who want to get started or improve their training.
course_highlights: An 8 km course on paved roads around the château in Mořice
A 1.5 km children's run as part of the event
A friendly atmosphere and facilities for competitors at the local venue
additional: The race takes place on August 8, 2026, as part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region. Start at 9:00. Registration and further details are not specified.

name: Slatinická sedmička
location: Slatinice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Slatinická sedmička is a 7 km charity run that follows mostly off-road routes around the village of Slatinice near Olomouc. The race is held in memory of Šárka Krčková and offers runners a pleasant route with a natural feel. The event is suitable for all runners who want to combine sport with supporting a good cause.
course_highlights: A 7 km route that is mostly off-road
Around the village of Slatinice near Olomouc
A charity run held in memory of Šárka Krčková
additional: The run is part of charitable activities supporting cancer care, and the event is linked to fundraising and support for local sport.

name: Vnorovská desítka
location: Vnorov, Vnorovy, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: platba přes bankovní účet, ceny nejsou explicitně uvedeny
description: Vnorovská Desítka is a popular 10 km running race held every August in the village of Vnorovy. It is part of the Moravian-Slovak Running Cup and attracts more than 200 runners from various countries, including Czech elites and African runners. The course follows a closed asphalt loop with minimal elevation gain, with both the start and finish by the elementary school. The race has a lively atmosphere thanks to the large crowds and high number of participants; nearly 700 runners take part across all categories.
course_highlights: 4 × 2.5 km course on an asphalt road with minimal elevation gain
Closed loop with traffic excluded
Start and finish by the elementary school in Vnorovy
additional: Online registration is open until 6 August; registration on race day is not possible. The main race is timed using AMB chip technology. Women and men over 70 run a shorter 2 × 2.5 km course. The main race awards ceremony will take place at the Ajax pub grounds in Lidéřovice. Race bibs for runners starting at 17:00 are entered into a running raffle with valuable prizes. 4 × 2.5 km race on a closed loop, online registration until 6 August, start at 17:00, start and finish by the elementary school, spectator atmosphere and raffle

name: Dačického 12
location: GASK Kutná Hora, Kutná Hora, Czech Republic
description: Dačického 12 is a traditional cross-country running race in Kutná Hora, now being held for the 18th time. The race offers 12 km and 6.7 km courses, as well as shorter children’s races. The route runs through the scenic Vrchlice and Bylanka valleys, passing historic landmarks such as St. Barbara’s Church and the Cathedral of the Assumption of Our Lady and St. John the Baptist in Sedlec. The race is suitable for the general public and offers an enjoyable sporting experience in the beautiful surroundings of Kutná Hora.
course_highlights: The route runs through the Vrchlice and Bylanka valleys
The course passes between St. Barbara’s Church and the Cathedral in Sedlec
Refreshment station near the Holy Trinity
additional: Children’s races are divided into categories by year of birth, with course lengths ranging from 300 m to 1,000 m. The start is at the Jesuit College/GASK on Barborská Street. The route includes sections along Pod Hrádkem and Na Podskalí streets, past the Šafrán guesthouse and the Great Pond. After the race, custom badges can be ordered for clubs or events. The event includes a main 12 km course, a 6 km course, children’s races in four categories, online registration, and a start and finish at GASK Kutná Hora. The event also features music and supports the Světluška charity collection.

name: Černovírský kros
location: Černovír u Ústí nad Orlicí, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Černovír Cross is a traditional running race held in Černovír near Ústí nad Orlicí. Its routes cross hilly terrain and combine paved and unpaved forest and field paths with asphalt. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and adults. The start and registration are at the Sokol hall in Černovír, and the main race covers a distance of up to 5 km. The atmosphere is friendly, and the event is popular with both local and visiting runners.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain with a mix of paved and unpaved forest and field paths
Mixed surfaces, including asphalt
A route of up to 5 km, suitable for children and adults
additional: On-site registration from 9:00. Children's race starts at 10:00; main race at 11:30. Entry fee: 100 Kč for adults, 20 Kč for children. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The route is up to 5 km and has varied surfaces. The event offers various distances, from 0.08 km to the main 4.85 km race, and is part of a sports series supporting running in the region.

name: Běh na Krušnou horu
location: Hudlice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Krušná hora is a traditional uphill race held in the village of Hudlice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race starts at the end of Dolejší Street by the forest and follows a wide forest gravel path to the Máminka lookout tower at the summit of Krušná hora. The course is 2.7 km long with 190 metres of elevation gain, offering runners a challenging but beautiful experience in nature. The race is organised by TOBI Sport s.r.o. and is part of the Czech Running Club.
course_highlights: 2.7 km course
Run along a wide forest gravel path
Finish at the Máminka lookout tower on the summit of Krušná hora, with 190 m of elevation gain
additional: The race starts near the village of Hudlice, 9 km from Beroun, at a crossroads by the forest. It is organised by TOBI Sport s.r.o.; the contact person is Pavel Kundrát. The course is certified, and the race is part of the Czech Running Club. The event includes trail running in the forest, registration is available on the KOPEC website, and the race is suitable for runners of different levels.

name: Stezka mužů
location: Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Men’s Trail is a 3 km road race that is part of the SABZO series and will take place on 12 August 2026 in Prague 4. The race is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity to spend time actively in a friendly atmosphere. Although the main focus is on running, the event is part of a larger sports and social programme in the region. Come and compete, and enjoy a day full of exercise and fun.
course_highlights: 3 km road course
Part of the SABZO series
Friendly atmosphere and suitable for the general public

name: 6. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park B. Němcové, Karviná, Czech Republic
description: Běh pro zdraví is a charity series of seven runs held in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run offers a 3 km route that everyone can complete at their own pace. Proceeds from entry fees go to help people in need, giving the event purpose and added value. Check-in begins at 17:00 and the start is at 17:45 at Lodičky. Everyone is warmly invited to take part and support a good cause.
course_highlights: 3 km route in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park
Cycling path surface
Charity run with proceeds going to help people in need
additional: Check-in begins at 17:00, with the start at 17:45 at Lodičky. A series of seven runs, each covering 3 km. Proceeds from entry fees go to help people in need. Terrain: cycling path; Registration: check-in from 17:00, start at 17:45; Series of seven runs from March to August 2026

name: Reuter Run Boršov nad Vltavou
location: Kemp Poslední štace, Boršov nad Vltavou, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Reuter Run in Boršov nad Vltavou is a 12.5 km running race held on 15 August 2026 from 11:00 at Kemp Poslední štace. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and gives runners the chance to test themselves on an interesting course in the South Bohemian Region. It is organised by Zdeněk Richtr and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including registered Cup members and other runners. The course surface is not specified in detail, but the race is part of a long-running series with clear rules.
course_highlights: 12.5 km course
Start at Kemp Poslední štace, Boršov nad Vltavou
Part of the South Bohemian Running Cup
additional: Registration for the South Bohemian Running Cup requires payment of a membership fee of 250 Kč, valid for the entire Cup season. Registration is available online, with payment made by bank transfer and the runner’s name and year of birth included as the payment reference. For registrations made during the year, points from races are counted retroactively for a maximum of 3 months. The race includes trail and cross-country terrain, with the start and finish at Kemp Poslední štace; on-site registration is available until 10:00. The event also includes an 800 m children’s race.

name: Běžecký mítink Bohuňovice
location: Bohuňovice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The running meet in Bohuňovice near Olomouc is a cross-country race, offering men a 12.2 km course and women a 6.1 km course. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners’ Grand Prix and attracts runners who enjoy challenging terrain. The meet is suitable for anyone who wants to test their strength in a natural setting with varied surfaces. The event is a traditional gathering for the region’s running community.
course_highlights: Cross-country terrain with varied surfaces
Course distance: 12.2 km for men and 6.1 km for women
Part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners’ Grand Prix
additional: The race is part of a series of running events in the region, offers the option to register and borrow running equipment, and attracts runners from a wide area.

name: 7 pohoří Šumava
location: Železná Ruda, Šumava, Czech Republic
description: The Trail Run Series 7 Mountains is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you across seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The races feature technical trails, epic views and a unique atmosphere that will test every runner’s strength, willpower and determination. Whether you are an experienced mountain runner or a beginner, 7 Mountains challenges you to conquer every route and become a legend. The Šumava race offers routes crossing the peaks of Špičák and Pacíř, passing glacial lakes and deep forests, with up to 900 m of elevation gain.
course_highlights: The route crosses the peaks of Špičák and Pacíř, with views of the glacial lakes Černé and Čertovo
Mostly natural terrain, with 900 m of elevation gain on the main 23.5 km course
An atmospheric race and technical trails prepared by mountain rescue service members
additional: The race time limit is 4 hours; after that, runners are marked as DNF. Participants can leave small items at the registration tent. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The entry fee includes a professionally marked course, race bib, chip timing, commemorative medal, refreshments on the course and at the finish, and use of the facilities at the start and finish area. The races include registration with chip timing, medals, refreshments and the option to take part in different distances in the beautiful surroundings of Šumava.

name: Jablonská osmička
location: Jablonné nad Orlicí, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Jablonská osmička is a running race in Jablonné nad Orlicí, taking place on August 15, 2026. This fifth edition features an 8 km main race, children’s races, and a fun beer relay for teams of four. After the race, the program continues with a Food Festival and Jabloffest, featuring music and activities for children at the swimming pool grounds. The event is suitable for both competitive athletes and recreational runners, and includes a generous raffle and gift bags for registered participants.
course_highlights: An 8 km road course with gentle elevation changes
A beer relay featuring a 100 m sprint and beer or non-alcoholic beer
Children’s races divided into three age categories
additional: Main race registration is open from 9:00 to 10:30, children’s races start at 10:15, the 8 km main race at 11:00, and the beer relay at 12:15. A T-shirt and gift bag are available only to those registered by 31.7.2026. The race commentator is biathlete Vlastimil Vávra. After the race, there is a generous raffle and an accompanying program including the Food Festival and Jabloffest. Registration by 31.7.2026; start and finish at the athletics track; T-shirts for registered participants; a generous raffle and gift bags.

name: Křivinský kros
location: Křivice, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Křivinský Kros is a running race held in Křivice, featuring a 7.5 km main course with 275 metres of elevation gain and an 800-metre children’s course. The race runs mostly along forest roads and trails through hilly terrain, making for a challenging and interesting run. Starts are staggered from 9:30 a.m., with children first, then juniors, and finally the main categories. The race is part of the Velká cena východních Čech series and is open to the general public, with a voluntary entry fee. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a short raffle for participants.
course_highlights: Main course: 7.5 km with 275 m of elevation gain
90% of the course runs along forest roads and trails
Hilly terrain on Křivina
additional: You can register on site before the race or in advance by email. The entry fee is voluntary. The start for all categories is about 150 m from the registration area. The course is marked with red-and-white plastic ribbons and white arrows on trees or stakes, or with white spray paint on the ground. The awards ceremony takes place after the race at approximately 11:30, followed by a raffle. Before the race, participants can join a group training session and run the main course. The race features hilly terrain, forest roads and trails, and is part of the Velká cena východních Čech series.

name: Žebrácká pětadvacítka
location: Žebrák, Křivoklátsko, Czech Republic
description: Žebrácká Pětadvacítka is a traditional August road race along the roads and forest trails of the Křivoklátsko region, held every year in Žebrák. It offers several distances, including the main 25 km race, a 10 km run, a 10 km walk and a family run for children. The main race starts at 10:00 by the Primary School in Žebrák, while the senior categories start at 9:00. The race is held as part of the celebrations of the St. Lawrence Pilgrimage and offers a wonderful sporting experience amid the picturesque scenery of the Křivoklátsko region.
course_highlights: Roads and forest trails in the Křivoklátsko region
Two loops around the housing estate in Žebrák at the start of the race
Family run with activities for children on a 1.1 km loop
additional: The family run with Točníček and Žebráček starts on race day at 9:30 in front of the Primary School in Žebrák. The course is 1.1 km long, open to all ages, with a reward for children at the finish. The main 25 km race starts at 10:00, and the senior categories start at 9:00. After the main race starts, a non-competitive 10 km run and a 10 km walk with poles (Nordic walking) also start. Online registration, with the option to order a T-shirt, closes on 20 July 2025. On-site registration is available on race day from 7:30 to 9:15 at the Cultural Club. The race is suitable for all age groups, including children and families, and is open to participants in all weather, with dogs and with wheelchair access.

name: MFB MarathOn LABE
location: Kolín, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: MarathOn LABE is a traditional international running festival held in Kolín and Poděbrady, offering a marathon, half marathon, 10 km race, and other running events. The marathon course is an out-and-back route on forest, paved, and asphalt roads, certified by the Czech Athletics Federation (ČAS). The event is suitable for runners of all levels and features a rich program, including children’s races and family entertainment. It is organized by the Kolínská 14 association, which has supported an active and healthy lifestyle in the region since 2011.
course_highlights: Out-and-back marathon course certified by the Czech Athletics Federation (ČAS)
Terrain: forest trails, paved roads, asphalt
Marathon starts on Kmoch Island in Kolín
additional: The marathon starts at 8:00 on Kmoch Island in Kolín. The half marathon and 10 km race start at 9:00 (the half marathon in Poděbrady and the 10 km race in Kolín). Free overnight camping in your own tent is available at the amphitheatre. Bus transport from Kolín to the half-marathon start in Poděbrady is provided by reservation. Check-in and race-bib collection take place on Saturday and on Sunday morning. Parking and changing facilities are available in Kolín. The event takes place on August 16, 2026, features various race categories and a festival atmosphere, and offers online registration.

name: Tyršův běh na Sokol
location: Malá Skála, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Tyrš’s Run to Sokol is a traditional forest race in Malá Skála, offering a challenging 2 km course with 300 metres of elevation gain. The race is intended for nature-running enthusiasts who don’t mind hills and technical terrain full of roots, holes and rocks. Runners start at one-minute intervals, and the race has a long-standing tradition; in 2021, it was held for the 36th time. Everyone interested in this type of race is warmly welcome.
course_highlights: Forest course with technical terrain full of roots, holes and rocks
2 km long with 300 m of elevation gain
Starts at one-minute intervals
additional: The course includes forest and gravel paths, stairs, and only the first 100 metres are asphalt. Registration and further information are available on the event website or Facebook page.

name: Žvahov - Ivův běh
location: Děvín, Praha 5, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: Žvahov - Ivův běh is a 3.7 km trail race held in the Děvín area of Prague 5. Part of the SABZO series, it gives runners the chance to enjoy a run in natural surroundings, with gentle hills and interesting views. The race is suited to anyone who enjoys short but more challenging off-road courses. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and test yourself against other runners in the beautiful Děvín hills.
course_highlights: A 3.7 km trail course
Natural surroundings in the Děvín hills
Part of the SABZO series
additional: The race starts on the road below the TJ Zlíchov football pitch. It is also suitable for beginners and families with children.

name: ČEZ Lipno Sport Festival
location: Lipno nad Vltavou, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 200-400 Kč (dle věkové kategorie a místa registrace)

price_tiers.distance: Cyklozávod ČEZ Kolem Lipna (60 km a 20 km)

description: The ČEZ Lipno Sport Festival is a traditional sporting event in Lipno nad Vltavou, offering a wide range of races for all ages and sports enthusiasts. The festival includes running events such as the Lipno Half Marathon, the 10 km COOP RUN and a family run, as well as cycling races with 60 km and 20 km gravel and MTB routes. The event also features children’s races and evening runs along the scenic Čertovy proudy cycle path. Participants can enjoy the beautiful Šumava countryside and a varied programme of cultural activities.
course_highlights: Running routes follow the Čertovy proudy cycle path
Cycling races on the quieter side of Lipno, with 60 km and 20 km routes
Children’s off-road cycling races on a cyclocross course in six categories
additional: The 400 m and 800 m children’s runs start at 9:00 and 9:20, respectively, by the lower cable-car station above the Stodola restaurant. The start and finish of the main running races are at the ČEZ Lipno Sport Festival grounds and by the lower cable-car station. Registration for the children’s races is also available on race day. Race packs can be collected in advance from 17 August at the festival’s Active Point. The race office opens at 7:30 on race day. The event includes cycling routes, running courses, a cultural programme, sporting activities and registration, likely via the website. It is suitable for all age groups and offers a varied programme for families and sports enthusiasts.

name: Běh okolo Olympie
location: Olympie, Chrlice, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je 150 Kč. Platba startovného probíhá před závodem při registraci závodníků.

description: Běh okolo Olympie is a running race in Brno, taking place on August 20, 2026, in the Chrlice area. The race features a 5.3 km course, with men and women competing together in one category and starting at the same time. A separate race is planned for children, with the course distance announced before the start. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant atmosphere, refreshments, and on-site baggage storage.
course_highlights: A 5.3 km course in the Chrlice area
Men and women start together
Children’s race with the course distance announced before the start
additional: On-site registration opens at 17:15. The children’s race starts at 17:45, and the main race at 18:00. Water and a baggage-storage tent are available after the race. Recommended transport: bus route 78, Zámecká stop. Parking is limited on a nearby street, or available in the car park by Decathlon. Terrain: urban; registration on-site or online; timing using MYLAPS chip technology; public transport and parking available; refreshments after the race; baggage storage; start and finish near Olympia in Brno.

name: Šárecká 5
location: Divoká Šárka, Praha 6, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: Šárecká 5 is a 5.3 km cross-country race held in the picturesque natural area of Divoká Šárka in Prague 6. This varied race gives runners the chance to enjoy one of Prague’s most beautiful areas on more challenging terrain. It is organized by SABZO Praha under the direction of Michal Procházka and is part of the Czech Athletics Federation’s running activities. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys trail running and natural scenery.
course_highlights: A 5.3 km course over varied terrain
Cross-country/trail race format
The picturesque natural area of Divoká Šárka in Prague 6
additional: The organizer is SABZO Praha; the contact person is Michal Procházka (tel. 724 845 241). The race is part of the Czech Athletics Federation’s services for runners and running. It takes place in the early evening, with the first category starting at 18:00. The race is held in the beautiful setting of the Divoká Šárka Nature Reserve. Online registration is available, and the course is suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Běh městem Strakonice
location: Letní kino, Strakonice, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
organizer: Město Strakonice, Okresní sdružení Česká unie sportu Strakonice
description: The XXIII Strakonice City Run is a traditional running race held on August 21 at the Summer Cinema in Strakonice. Runners of all ages can test themselves on 3.3 km and 6.6 km routes through the city. Both routes start together at 18:00. All participants have a chance to win prizes in a large raffle, drawn using race numbers. Entries can be submitted by email or on race day.
course_highlights: Two routes through the city: 3.3 km and 6.6 km
Start and finish at the Summer Cinema
All runners start together at 18:00
additional: Entries can be submitted by email until August 20 or on race day, no later than 60 minutes before the start. All race numbers will be entered into a large raffle. The race features an accompanying program with military vehicles and is part of the city's traditional sporting calendar.

name: Morava Run - proti proudu
location: Pohansko, Břeclav, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné na VI. MORAVA RUN (2026) je stanoveno na 11.000,- Kč / A tým (7-9 členů)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné na VI. MORAVA RUN (2026) je stanoveno na 15.000,- Kč / B tým (10-12 členů)

description: Morava Run – Upstream is a relay running race across Moravia along the course of the Morava River, held in teams of 7 to 12 members. The approximately 280 km route is divided into 30 legs of around 9 km, which teams assign according to their abilities and strategy. The race starts in southern Moravia in the Soutok Protected Landscape Area and follows the river upstream through Slovácko, Haná, the Litovelské Pomoraví Protected Landscape Area and on to the source of the Morava on Králický Sněžník. The event is aimed at amateur runners and emphasizes teamwork and team building, with no pace limit.
course_highlights: The route follows the Morava River upstream from Břeclav to Dolní Morava
30 legs in total, each approximately 9 km long
Passes through the Soutok Protected Landscape Area, Slovácko, Haná, the Litovelské Pomoraví Protected Landscape Area and the Jeseníky Mountains
additional: The race starts in Břeclav by Pohansko Castle and finishes at the Dolní Morava campsite, where participants can also camp overnight. Teams start in waves, and there is no pace limit. Each team plans its logistics and distributes its effort across the 30 legs. The organizer provides an emergency hotline for unexpected events and a WhatsApp group for team leaders. The race is for teams of 7–12 members and includes logistics, support along the route and the option of facilities at the campsite. The event is intended for both athletes and team-building groups, with an emphasis on experiences and cooperation in nature.

name: Brdský půlmaraton
location: Kytín, Kladno District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Brdy Half Marathon is a traditional trail running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Kytín in the Central Bohemian Region. The race offers two routes: a more challenging 21 km course with 430 m of elevation gain and a shorter 9 km course with 158 m of elevation gain, both with refreshment stations. Overall winners and age and gender categories are recognized on the longer course, while the shorter course awards the fastest men and women overall. The race is part of the Trail Running Cup series and is suitable for nature-running enthusiasts, with beautiful views and varied terrain.
course_highlights: 21 km course with 430 m of elevation gain
9 km course with 158 m of elevation gain
Refreshment stations along the course with water and isotonic drinks
additional: The 21 km course has refreshment stations at 3.7 km, 9 km and 17 km, serving water and isotonic drinks. The 9 km course has refreshments at 3.7 km, and water, an isotonic drink and light refreshments are available at the finish. Children's races are free. Age and gender categories are recognized on the 21 km course, and overall winners on the 9 km course. The race offers 21 km and 9 km courses, suitable for trail runners and families with children, with registration available through the official website.

name: Hrabovský 1/2 a 1/4 maraton
location: Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Czech Republic
description: The Hrabová Half and Quarter Marathon is a traditional running race held in Ostrava-Hrabová, offering half-marathon and quarter-marathon distances. The race is part of the Hrabová Cup and the Moravian-Silesian Running Cup. Participants receive medals, and refreshments, changing rooms, and an accompanying program are available. The start and race-day check-in take place at the TJ Sokol Hrabová sports ground. The route passes through an urban setting with a pleasant atmosphere and is suitable for a wide range of runners.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course: 21.1 km
Quarter-marathon course: 10.5 km
Start and finish at the TJ Sokol Hrabová sports ground
additional: The race bib is returnable and includes a chip. Refreshments are provided along the course and at the finish, along with changing rooms and toilets. An accompanying program is part of the event. Online registration is available, with payment by bank transfer required within 5 days of registration. Race-day check-in and registration take place at the TJ Sokol Hrabová sports ground, Paskovská 209, Ostrava. The event includes not only races, but also children's races, Nordic Walking, a raffle, and other fun activities. The event takes place on August 22, 2026.

name: Jesenický maraton
location: Jeseníky mountains, Czech Republic
description: The Jeseníky Marathon is a legendary and challenging mountain marathon in the Czech Republic, held in the Jeseníky Mountains since 2009. The marathon and half-marathon follow the same course each year, but changeable weather and mountain terrain make it feel different every time. Runners follow the ridges of forested mountains, passing springs, primeval forests, stone fields and peat bogs, creating a unique atmosphere and challenge. The Jeseníky Marathon is intended for experienced endurance runners who want to conquer the highest mountain range in Moravia and Silesia.
course_highlights: Ridges of forested mountains with rounded peaks
Springs of fresh water and deep valleys
Centuries-old primeval forests, mountain tundra and stone fields
additional: The race is limited to 700 runners. The time limit for completing the marathon is 6 hours and 30 minutes. Refreshments are available at several stations, with water, isotonic drinks, fruit and energy foods. Hot food and drinks can be purchased at the finish. Runners with a valid registration by 30 June 2026 will receive a T-shirt unless they choose otherwise. The organizer may cancel the race in the event of adverse weather, without compensation for damages. The course is mountainous, with refreshments at two stations, free parking, free bus transport from the start, a time limit and an age limit of 18+.

name: Panevropský půlmaraton
location: Stadlern, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Pan-European Half Marathon is a cross-border running race from Stadlern in Bavaria to Poběžovice.
