The course runs through the picturesque countryside of the Bavarian-Czech border region, including the former “Iron Curtain” and a low pass in the Bohemian Forest near the source of the Radbuza River. The race is accompanied by a rich cultural programme at both the start and finish, with activities for children. The start is traditionally at 10 a.m., and the finish is in Míru Square in Poběžovice. The organisers warmly invite athletes and spectators to come and support the runners.
course_highlights: Cross-border course from Germany to the Czech Republic
Passes through the former Iron Curtain via the Švarcava border crossing
Undulating course with two climbs to low passes in the Bohemian Forest
additional: Refreshment stations on the course at 6, 9, 12, 15 and 18 km, serving water and isotonic drinks. After the finish: hot food, drinks, fruit, muesli and chocolate. Race-day registration is available at the start in Stadlern for 600 CZK in cash. Bus transport to the start and back after the race. Winners are announced and prizes presented immediately after the race. Every runner receives a commemorative medal and a T-shirt bearing the race emblem. Buses to the start depart from Poběžovice and Domažlice. The race takes place in August 2026. The course is mostly on asphalt and features varied terrain. Part of the Běžec Chodska series.

name: Běh na Svatý Hostýn
location: Bystřice pod Hostýnem, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Svatý Hostýn is a mountain race held in Bystřice pod Hostýnem in the Zlín Region. It is part of the Czech Cup in Mountain Running and offers a challenging 5 km race with 422 metres of elevation gain, with most of the course on asphalt. The race is open to both experienced runners and the general public, attracting running enthusiasts from across the country. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and the beautiful surroundings of Svatý Hostýn.
course_highlights: 5 km course with 422 m of elevation gain
Runs mostly on asphalt, with a challenging climb
Part of the Czech Cup in Mountain Running
additional: Registration is also available on-site. The race uses chip timing and takes place in August 2026.

name: Běh k Božímu hrobu
location: Svatý Hostýn, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run to the Holy Sepulchre is a traditional running event held at Svatý Hostýn in the Zlín Region, part of the wider range of pilgrimages and sporting events at the site. The event features an uphill race finishing at the Holy Sepulchre and is an important part of the regional sporting calendar. Get ready for the atmosphere of this pilgrimage site and enjoy a sporting experience in the beautiful surroundings of Svatý Hostýn.
course_highlights: Uphill race at Svatý Hostýn
Part of the Czech Hill Running Cup
Pilgrimage and sporting atmosphere, with the option to take part during pilgrimages
additional: The event includes a run to Svatý Hostýn and the Holy Sepulchre and is part of the pilgrimage activities. Registration and results are available on the website.

name: Běh na Čupek
location: Metylovice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Čupek is a newly established running race in Metylovice that has already attracted two hundred runners. The course is scenic and challenging, making for an engaging experience for participants. The race is part of the Slezan Frýdek-Místek Physical Education Association calendar, and its future place in the schedule is being watched with anticipation.
course_highlights: A challenging course in Metylovice
Scenic running surroundings
The race has already attracted two hundred runners
additional: Entry fee: 50 Kč for youth and 150 Kč for adults; the race takes place at the football pitch in Metylovice; changing rooms, showers, toilets, stadium facilities, a restaurant, and parking are available.

name: Vavřinecký běh Moravským krasem
location: Vavřinec, Moravský kras, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Vavřinec Run through the Moravian Karst is a sporting event held in the village of Vavřinec in the South Moravian Region, and is part of the District Running League. The event takes place on August 22, 2026, and offers various running categories suitable for the general public. It is an ideal opportunity for running enthusiasts to discover the beauty of the Moravian Karst and enjoy an outdoor sporting experience.
course_highlights: Held in the picturesque Moravian Karst
Part of the District Running League
Various age categories and race distances
additional: The race is suitable for all age groups, with entry fees of CZK 200 for adults and CZK 50 for children. The event promotes an active lifestyle and exploring the region’s natural beauty.

name: Slopenská desítka
location: Slopné, Luhačovice, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: pro běžce ze Slopného na místě

description: Slopenská Desítka is a traditional cross-country race held in the picturesque village of Slopné near Luhačovice. The race features a challenging course with varied terrain, including paved roads, steep climbs, and descents through forest terrain. The start is located below the church and the finish is at the sports field, where runners are greeted by enthusiastic cheers from spectators. The event is suitable for the general public, including junior categories and family relays. The race is part of the year-round Běhy Zlín competitions and the KRAKONOŠ Czech Mountain Running Cup.
course_highlights: Start on a paved road below the church, with plenty of space for runners
A long 1,500 m climb on paved road and a steep climb through the forest up to the 2.5 km mark
The final three kilometres are entirely downhill, ending with a finishing straight at the sports field
additional: The family relay has three members and is run in three legs. Members must be related, with a minimum age difference of 18 years between two members. Registration closes 5 minutes before the start of the category. The overall winner receives a cash reward for every second under the set time. The main race starts about 100 m from the sports field, on a paved road below the church. The race is part of the local sports calendar and also offers family relays and prizes in various categories.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Stříbrná
location: Stříbrná, Krušné hory, Czech Republic
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beautiful Ore Mountains. The series comprises 6 races in different locations, including Stříbrná, where the main race covers 6 to 9 km and the experience route covers 20 to 30 km. Children’s races and walking routes with checkpoints to find using a map are also available. The event is suitable for runners of all levels, canicross participants, children, and walkers, and offers a beautiful natural setting in the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Main race: 6–9 km through the Ore Mountains
Experience route: 20–30 km, navigated using a map
Children’s races: 200 m to 1,100 m
additional: The series comprises 6 races at different locations in the Ore Mountains. In addition to running routes, walking routes with checkpoints to find using a map and children’s races are available. The organizer is Živé Sokolovsko z.s., in cooperation with Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s. The races include various categories, including dog trekking and walking. Routes are unmarked, with checkpoints along the course; overtaking is prohibited. The series includes multiple locations and races in the Ore Mountains.

name: Běh pro Střížák
location: Střížovický vrch, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Běh pro Střížák is a traditional race held on Střížovický Hill in Ústí nad Labem, now in its 16th year. The course is a loop run three times, with one significant climb and descent; otherwise, it is gently undulating. The event also includes shorter children’s and youth races, making it accessible to the wider community. The race has an interesting story: the course passes through an area once threatened by a planned development, which was cancelled after residents objected.
course_highlights: The loop is run three times
One challenging climb (220 m, 25 m elevation gain)
Gently undulating terrain with one descent of approximately 20 m over a 400 m section
additional: Shorter children’s (700 m) and youth (2.7 km) races are available. The course passes through an area once threatened by a planned indoor ski slope for year-round downhill skiing, which was cancelled after residents objected. The event includes a raffle and refreshments and is part of the local cross-country cup, with children and young people also welcome to take part.

name: Běh Smetánkou
location: Praha 9, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Smetánka Run is a 3.5 km off-road race held in Prague 9 and is part of the SABZO series. It offers runners the chance to enjoy a run in a natural setting with varied terrain. It is suitable for anyone looking for a short but dynamic race in a pleasant atmosphere. The race is a traditional part of Prague’s running season and attracts runners from the surrounding area.
course_highlights: 3.5 km off-road course
Part of the SABZO series
Natural setting in Prague 9
additional: The race is intended for runners of all levels; registration and exact details are not explicitly provided.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (9) – srpnový
location: Praha 4-Braník, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY is a regular running series in Prague-Braník, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava. The races are suitable for runners of all levels, from beginners to professionals, and personal bests are often set here. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the opportunity to run a qualifying time for the Czech Championships (MČR). After the race, participants can get together and refuel at a local restaurant. The series is part of its 16th edition and rewards not only the top runners but also loyal participants.
course_highlights: Pleasant, fast course along the Vltava in Prague-Braník
Course measured by a certified course measurer
Opportunity to run a qualifying time for the Czech Championships (MČR) in the 10 km race
additional: Check-in from 18:00; 10 km start at 19:00; 5 km start at 19:05. Post-race refreshments (food, beer, sports drink) at Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage is available in the organizers’ tent. Toilets are available in the Hamr Braník complex. You can withdraw up to 24 hours before the start and receive a refund of the entry fee. Public transport is recommended; P+R parking is available at Nádraží Braník. Prizes for the top runners and loyal participants, plus a post-race raffle. Registration includes the option to sign up early, with possible discounts. The races are open to runners of all levels, from beginners to professional competitors.

name: Běh Modřanskou roklí - Memoriál Zdeňka Buriana
location: Modřanská rokle, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Běh Modřanskou roklí - Zdeněk Burian Memorial is a 4 km race on a gently undulating course in the Modřanská rokle Nature Reserve in Prague 4. The race is part of the SABZO series and features a staggered start, allowing the event to run smoothly. The course is suitable for runners who want to enjoy a run in nature with gentle elevation changes. It is ideal for anyone looking for a short but technically interesting run in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: 4 km course in the Modřanská rokle Nature Reserve
Gently undulating terrain with natural features
Staggered start for a smooth race
additional: The race has a staggered start. It is part of the SABZO series. The course is gently undulating and runs through the Modřanská rokle Nature Reserve in Prague 4. The race is part of the SABZO series, which supports the running community in Prague. Exact registration and entry fee details have not yet been published.

name: Beskydská sedmička
location: Třinec, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: IMOS Beskydská sedmička is an extreme mountain marathon across the entire Beskydy Mountains, running from Třinec to Frenštát pod Radhoštěm. This challenging race, approximately 101 km long with 5,500 m+ of elevation gain, is the Czech Championship in individual mountain marathons and is open to individuals and pairs. The race starts at night at 23:00 from the athletics stadium in Třinec, and the finish gate closes 28 hours later on Sunday morning. The race offers a unique experience of the Beskydy mountain landscape and well-equipped aid stations along the course.
course_highlights: Approximately 101 km with 5,500 m+ of elevation gain across the main Beskydy range
Starts in Třinec at 23:00 and finishes in Frenštát pod Radhoštěm, with a 28-hour time limit
Aid stations along the course in locations including Ostravice, Pustevny, Morávka, and others
additional: Accreditation takes place on Friday, 28 August 2026, from 13:00 to 22:00 at the STARS sports hall in Třinec. Free shuttle transport from Frenštát pod Radhoštěm to the start in Třinec is provided for competitors. Soup and sausages are available at the aid stations, though soup is offered only at designated stations. Competitors can use baggage storage, with bags identified by race number. The athletics stadium stands will be open to supporters and fans, making the start a memorable experience for them too. The race includes aid stations, course changes compared with previous editions, the option to download a GPX file, a 28-hour finish limit, a 23:00 start, and a finish at 3:00 the following day.

name: Kácovský běh
location: Náměstí kněžny Toskánské, Kácov, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Kácov Run is a traditional running race held on the last Saturday in August in the picturesque Posázaví region. It offers three main routes—the Devatenáctka, the Desítka and the Kolečko—with varied terrain and elevation that challenge both experienced runners and beginners. The start and finish are in the centre of Kácov, with refreshment stations on the longer routes. The race is timed using chip timing and accompanied by a varied programme, including children’s races and a raffle.
course_highlights: Devatenáctka: 18.8 km with 380 m of elevation gain, a mix of surfaces including forest trails and asphalt
Desítka: 10.4 km with 160 m of elevation gain, similarly varied terrain to the Devatenáctka
Kolečko: 2.9 km with 20 m of elevation gain, suitable for children and beginners
additional: The race uses chip timing, with instructions on how to position the chip correctly. Refreshment stations are available along the course and at the finish for the Devatenáctka and Desítka. A bonus competition for the fastest Kácov man/woman is available to permanent residents of Kácov. Children’s races have a voluntary entry fee and are divided by age. The race includes various categories, the surface combines roads and trails, registration is available online and on site, and the event supports local tourism.

name: Cross Parkmaraton
location: Krásná Lípa, Česká Švýcarsko, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Cross Parkmarathon in Krásná Lípa is a traditional race set in the picturesque surroundings of Bohemian Switzerland National Park. The course runs through hilly terrain, mainly along forest trails, with beautiful views of the Lusatian Mountains. The event offers various disciplines, including a marathon, half marathon, shorter runs, Nordic walking, canicross, and relay races. It is suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts of all ages. In 2019, it received the Bohemian-Saxon Switzerland Regional Product certificate as a certified experience.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain, mainly along forest trails
Picturesque scenery in Bohemian Switzerland National Park
Views of the Lusatian Mountains
additional: Start times: Canicross and marathon at 8:00; all other races at 10:00. Relay teams have four members, each running approximately 5 km. Each team is responsible for transporting its members to the relay handover points. Awards are presented in age and gender categories. The marathon time limit is 15:00. Runners who cannot finish the marathon within the time limit may switch to the half marathon. The entry fee includes a race number. The race is part of Bohemian Switzerland Day and attracts regional and international runners. The event offers aid stations along the course and support from local sponsors and craftspeople.

description: The Chomutov Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque town of Chomutov in the Ústí nad Labem Region. The race offers a fast and attractive course that passes through the historic town centre, around the unique Kamencové Lake and through beautiful natural areas such as Bezruč Valley. The event also includes children’s categories and relay races, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. Participants in the main race can look forward to refreshments along the course and at the finish, as well as a participant medal.
course_highlights: The historic town centre, with its Town Tower and diverse architecture
The world-unique Kamencové Lake and extensive recreational area
Romantic Bezruč Valley and the Chomutovka stream
additional: Registration for adults and the Kamencové Circuit is online from 8:00 to 10:30; children up to 15 years old can register on site from 11:00 to 13:30. The entry fee includes refreshments along the course and at the finish (fruit, water and an isotonic drink) and a participant medal. Free headbands are available with online registration and advance payment; T-shirts can be purchased together with headbands. Children’s races start at 14:00. The organiser reserves the right to change the order of the individual races. Trail course, online and on-site registration, refreshments at the finish and along the course, medals, T-shirts and free headbands with registration.

name: Běhej lesy Jizerská
location: Bedřichov, Jizerské hory, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běhej lesy Jizerská is a trail race held on 29 August 2026 in the picturesque Jizera Mountains in Bedřichov. It offers a range of routes, including short and long distances and an ultramarathon, passing through beautiful natural areas such as Hřebínek, Smědava, Jizerka and Olivetská hora. The race is part of the Běhej lesy series and is included in the UTMB Index Races, providing international ranking points. Runners can also take part in the Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, which add competitive elements and prizes.
course_highlights: Routes pass through Hřebínek, Smědava, Jizerka and Olivetská hora
Conti Speed Section — a 150-metre speed segment on the Nova 11 km and ČSOB 23 km routes
Generali Investments Finish — a 500 m finish straight with a timed segment and prizes for the fastest men and women
additional: The race is part of the UTMB Index Races, with international ranking points. The Conti Speed Section is a speed segment with a prize worth 5,000 CZK. Generali Investments Finish is a 500 m finish straight with a timed segment and special jerseys for the winners. Online and on-site options are available to transfer registration and change the entry fee. The race includes a charitable component and offers fast, scenic routes in the Jizera Mountains. The start is at the cross-country skiing stadium in Bedřichov.

name: Mizuno Neon Run Praha
location: Bohnice, Praha 8, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Mizuno Neon Run Prague is a night running event full of glowing neon lights and colorful zones, offering a unique experience rather than a race focused on speed. The run takes place in Bohnice, and participants receive a starter pack with a neon glow stick and a beautiful Unicorn medal at the finish. The event is held under the auspices of the mayor of Prague 6, and registration proceeds are donated to nonprofit organizations. After the race, there is an after-party with DJ René, adding to the evening’s overall atmosphere.
course_highlights: Night run with neon lights and colorful zones
Start and finish in Prague 8 – Bohnice
Glowing neon experience, with a neon glow stick included in the starter pack
additional: The race is split into start waves for the 5 km run and walk, including the charitable 2 km Fénix Run. After the race, the NEON NIGHT RUN after-party takes place with DJ René. You can purchase the SUPER package for an additional 300 Kč until 20.08.2026. The starter pack includes a neon glow stick. Registration and check-in take place from 17:00 to 20:00; the bag drop is open until 21:45. Neon glow sticks, medals, a festive evening atmosphere, online and on-site registration, and support for FénixRun charitable projects.

name: Proběhni si Zoo Ústí nad Labem
location: Zoo Ústí nad Labem, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Run through Ústí nad Labem Zoo is a running event held on the grounds of the zoo in Ústí nad Labem. The run offers a unique opportunity to combine physical activity with a visit to the zoo and the chance to admire animals in their natural surroundings. The event is suitable for all age groups and encourages spending free time actively in nature. We look forward to your participation and sharing a memorable experience in the beautiful setting of the zoo.
course_highlights: Run through the zoo grounds with views of the animals
The route passes through varied terrain and natural scenery in the zoo
Combine a sporting challenge with a family visit to the zoo
additional: The zoo is open 365 days a year, and admission is charged at the zoo’s standard rates. Discounts are available for visitors with disabilities. The event is part of the zoo’s events calendar, which may be updated during the year. The event is primarily intended to support animal protection and nature conservation, with an emphasis on environmental education and community involvement.

name: Běh teplickými skalami
location: Teplicích nad Metují, Náchod District, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
price_range: Základní 200 Kč, zvýšené 300 Kč, dodatečné 400 Kč (La Sportiva Cross); 100 Kč, 150 Kč, 200 Kč (Bufo Cross)
description: The Run through the Teplice Rocks is a public cross-country race held every year on the last Sunday in August in Teplice nad Metují. The race has been a tradition since 1994 and is part of the sporting programme of the International Mountaineering Film Festival. The 9 km course follows the Metuje River to the rock city, includes sandy sections and stairs, and returns along the same route. Since 2011, the event has also included a children’s race with age categories. The start and finish are at the TJ Slavoj football field.
course_highlights: 9 km course along the Metuje River and the Teplice rock city
Sandy sections and stairs on the sightseeing route
Start and finish at the TJ Slavoj football field
additional: Online registration until 26 August 2026 at the standard entry fee; 27–29 August 2026 at the increased entry fee; late registration on race day at double the entry fee. The children’s race starts in age categories on loop courses. The race office is located in the start and finish area at the football field. The race is part of the Primátor Cup 2026 series. A 9 km cross-country course with sandy sections and stairs; races for different age categories; online registration; the race takes place at the TJ Slavoj football field; part of the Primátor Cup 2026 series.

name: Běh zámeckou zahradou
location: Zámecký park, Lysá nad Labem, Czech Republic
organizer: Tělocvičná jednota Sokol Lysá nad Labem
description: The Run Through the Castle Garden is a traditional running race held in the castle park in Lysá nad Labem. The 62nd edition takes place on August 30, 2025, and is open to a wide range of participants, from preschoolers to seniors. The race offers a pleasant setting in a historic park and encourages people of all ages to take part in sport. It is organized by T. J. Sokol Lysá nad Labem, which has long supported sport for everyone.
course_highlights: Castle Park, Lysá nad Labem
A route suitable for all age groups
A pleasant setting in a historic garden
additional: The race is part of Sokol’s long-standing tradition and is open to the general public, including children and seniors. It is organized by T. J. Sokol Lysá nad Labem. Information about the race is available on Sokol’s website in the events section. The race takes place in the castle park, is part of a long-standing tradition, and offers different categories for all age groups.

name: Běh Bezděkovem
location: Bezděkov pod Třemšínem, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh Bezděkovem is a traditional cross-country race with a course approximately 9 km long, held in the picturesque surroundings of Bezděkov pod Třemšínem. The course runs mainly along forest paths over varied terrain with gentle elevation changes and includes a mix of asphalt and rocky sections. The race starts by the hunting lodge and features a challenging climb with gradients of up to 7%, putting runners’ fitness to the test. After this demanding section comes a final descent and a flat finish, giving runners a chance to show their pace. Children’s races are also part of the event, making it appealing to a wide audience.
course_highlights: 90% forest paths over varied terrain, 10% asphalt
Clockwise loop with gentle descents and climbs
A 360-metre climb with gradients of up to 7% as a test of fitness
additional: Children’s races are part of the event. The start and finish are by the hunting lodge in Bezděkov pod Třemšínem. The course runs mainly along forest paths over varied terrain. Results are available from the organizers in PDF format. The course is approximately 9 km long; children’s races are available, and registration is possible in advance or on the day. The race takes place amid the Brdy countryside, with various categories and course lengths.

name: Kolínská desítka
location: Sportovní stadion Mirka Tučka, Kolín, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Kolínská desítka is a 10 km out-and-back race that runs on asphalt and a well-maintained forest path around the Mirek Tuček sports stadium in Kolín. The race is part of the Kolín Grand Prix and offers runners a pleasant mix of asphalt and natural surroundings. It is suitable for anyone looking for a fast yet scenic run in nature. Come and enjoy the race atmosphere and test yourself against other runners in the beautiful surroundings of Kolín.
course_highlights: A 10 km out-and-back course
A mix of asphalt and well-maintained forest paths
Start and finish at the Mirek Tuček sports stadium in Kolín
additional: The course is gently hilly, with an edge in the area around Veltruby. Registration is online. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners.

name: Rakovnická 15
location: Rakovník, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Rakovnická Patnáctka is a 15 km road race whose start alternates each year between the towns of Rakovník and Křivoklát. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup and gives runners the chance to test themselves on an attractive course in the beautiful surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for anyone looking for a quality road race with tradition and the atmosphere of a regional running cup.
course_highlights: 15 km road course
The start alternates each year between Rakovník and Křivoklát
Part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup
additional: The race takes place in 2026, with the start scheduled for August 30 in Křivoklát. The course includes climbs and descents and is part of the region’s running cup.

name: Sázava - Lázek
location: Sázava u Lanškrouna, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Sázava-Lázek is an uphill race covering 7.9 km with 375 metres of elevation gain. The course starts on asphalt and continues along field and forest paths, with the steepest climb near the finish. This race offers challenging and varied terrain for runners seeking an outdoor challenge in the Pardubice Region.
course_highlights: 7.9 km course with 375 m of elevation gain
Route runs along asphalt, field and forest paths
The steepest climb is in the final section of the race
additional: On-site registration is available until 9:00; the race starts at 9:30. The race is open to runners of all levels, and the course offers technical challenges and beautiful natural scenery.

name: Běh okolo Hříšné Milady
location: okolí České Lípy, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Hříšná Milada is a cross-country race in the area around Česká Lípa in the Liberec Region, offering two courses of 12 km and 6 km. The route runs mostly along forest roads and footpaths that are open to regular use. The race is part of the District Running League and is suitable for trail-running enthusiasts looking for natural, technically interesting terrain. The main category traditionally starts at 11:45, making it convenient for a wide range of runners to take part.
course_highlights: The route runs mostly along forest roads and footpaths
Cross-country/trail character
Around Česká Lípa in the Liberec Region
additional: The race is part of the District Running League (www.oblcl.cz). The organizer is Pavel Souhrada; contact: 736 138 052. The race offers courses for children and adults, with loops of different lengths, and takes place around Česká Lípa at a water reservoir. Registration and further details are not specified.

name: 3 x 1 km
location: Atletický stadion v Novém Jičíně, Kopřivnice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Atletika Nový Jičín, SVČ Fokus Nový Jičín
description: Atletika Nový Jičín and SVČ Fokus Nový Jičín are organizing a 3 × 1.5 km running race at the athletics stadium in Nový Jičín. The race is part of the Novojičínská běžecká liga and takes place on a varied surface comprising trails, asphalt and tartan. It is intended for adult runners divided into age categories by year of birth. Registration is online, and the race is scheduled to start at 17:00. The event offers an opportunity for sport and competition in the friendly atmosphere of the athletics complex.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the athletics stadium, in the Bocheta complex and on the asphalt surface of the former gardens of Gymnázium Nový Jičín
The course surface includes trails, asphalt and tartan
Race distance: 3 × 1.5 km
additional: Adult registration is online, with the following schedule: 16:00–16:45 registration, 17:00 start, followed by the awards ceremony. Categories are divided by age and gender, from men and women born in 1987 or later to older age groups. The race takes place on 2 September 2026. Registration is online, and the event is open to the general public, including children and adults.

name: Běh Anny-Marie
location: Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Anna-Marie Run is a race held in Prague 4, featuring a 6.6 km course over mixed terrain through Milíčov Forest and over an artificial hill. The event is organized by the SABZO Praha association and is part of its running series, attracting runners of all levels. The course includes both forest trails and paved sections, making the race appealing to different types of runners. The race takes place on September 2, 2026, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy nature and a sporting atmosphere in Prague.
course_highlights: 6.6 km course through Milíčov Forest
Mixed terrain including forest trails and paved sections
Organized by the SABZO Praha association
additional: The race is part of the SABZO series and is intended for runners of all levels, with the opportunity to enjoy nature in Prague 4.

name: SOKOLOVSKÁ 12/24 RUN
location: Koupaliště Michal, Sokolov, Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic
price_range: plné startovné, sleva do 15.6.2026 (-50%), do 31.7.2026 (-20%), na místě +200 Kč
description: Sokolovská 12/24 RUN is an endurance running race lasting 6, 12 or 24 hours, for individuals, pairs and teams of four. The race takes place on an easy, gently rolling loop around the Michal Natural Swimming Pool in Sokolov. It starts on Saturday, 5 September 2026, at 11:15 and offers camping accommodation with full facilities. The race is suitable for a broad range of sports enthusiasts and offers various age and team categories, with teams able to change runners in the transition area by the buffet.
course_highlights: An easy, gently rolling loop around the Michal Natural Swimming Pool
Categories for individuals, pairs and teams of four
Facilities including a buffet and a relay transition area
additional: Registration takes place on 4 September 2026 from 18:00 to 21:00 and on 5 September 2026 from 7:30 to 10:00. The results ceremony takes place on Sunday, 6 September 2026: the 6H and 12H categories at 9:00, and the 24H category at 12:30. The entry fee includes camping accommodation (for personal tents, caravans and shelters) and a commemorative ceramic item or medal. Toilets, showers, electricity and catering are available at the campsite. The race is part of a larger multisport weekend that also includes MTB races and kick scooter events. Registration takes place on 4 September 2026 from 18:00 to 21:00 and on 5 September 2026 from 7:30 to 10:00.

name: Běh kolem Světa
location: Třeboň, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: Běh kolem Světa is a traditional running event held in Třeboň, following a route around the Svět pond. Since its launch in 2012, the race has gained a loyal following and offers an attractive 11.7 km course that follows the Svět Nature Trail. The event takes place regularly in September and is popular for its natural scenery and varied terrain, including dirt, mud, sand, grass, wooden footbridges, and sections of asphalt. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners, and entry can also be purchased as a Christmas voucher.
course_highlights: The course follows the shores of the Svět pond through beautiful natural scenery
The 11.7 km course is suitable for recreational and competitive runners
Terrain includes dirt, mud, sand, grass, wooden footbridges, and sections of asphalt
additional: 11.7 km course, held in September, electronic chip timing, option to purchase an entry voucher

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - září
location: Průmyslová zóna Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all age groups and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The event also includes an 800-metre children’s course. Every participant receives a warm cinnamon pancake at the finish as a reward for their effort. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration before the start and timing for all runners.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt circuit of just under two laps (3.2 km)
The children’s course is 800 metres long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 to 127, and children up to age 12; age categories apply throughout the calendar year. The first three finishers in the men’s, women’s and children’s categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get to the start are by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates or by trolleybus no. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). Monthly registration takes place on the first Saturday of the month from 8:15 to 8:55, with the start at 9:00. The event includes an 800 m children’s course. Location: Příluky-Zlín Industrial Zone, starting in front of Madal Bal.

name: Kosiřské žiganec
location: Drahanovice, Olomouc District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné: 150 Kč za každého účastníka, dětský závod ZDARMA

description: Kosiřské žiganec is a traditional running race held in Drahanovice on Velký Kosíř, and is part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners’ Grand Prix. The race offers 10 km and 5 km courses along field and forest paths with mild to moderate elevation gain. Shorter 400- and 1,500-metre races are available for children. The event is open to the general public and, in addition to the sporting experience, offers refreshments and informal entertainment after the race. The start and registration take place at the football pitch, followed by the results announcement and prizes for the top runners in each category.
course_highlights: The 10 km course follows field and forest paths with 180 metres of elevation gain
The 5 km course also follows field and forest paths, with 50 metres of elevation gain
Children’s races over 400 and 1,500 metres; the route will be confirmed on site
additional: Registration for the main race is available only through www.liga100.cz; children’s categories register on site. The 10 km race is limited to 150 participants. Medical services will be present, and all participants compete at their own risk. Refreshments and informal entertainment are provided after the race. Special prizes are awarded to the top runners in each category, as well as to the fastest healthcare workers and local residents. Registration takes place on site; the races are open to all age groups, and race day includes registration, start times and the winners’ announcement.

name: Podhostýnská 10
location: Zámecký park, Bystřice pod Hostýnem, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: Podhostýnská 10ka is a running race held in Bystřice pod Hostýnem, offering 10 km and 5 km courses, as well as children’s races. The event takes place in the castle park and is part of the Běhy Zlín running series. It is suitable for the general public and runners of all ages who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in beautiful surroundings. The organizers emphasize tradition and high-quality race organization.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the castle park grounds in Bystřice pod Hostýnem
Two main distances: 10 km and 5 km
Children’s races are also included
additional: Race check-in takes place in the castle, in the stables area. The race is part of the year-round Běhy Zlín running series, which includes 13 races ranging from 5 km to a half marathon. The organizers emphasize ecology and care for the natural environment. The races take place in the castle park in Bystřice pod Hostýnem. Registration is available online and on site. The course runs mainly on roads and park paths. The event also includes children’s races and medals for participants.

name: Běh Plzeňské teplárenské kolem Boleveckých rybníků
location: Bolevecké rybníky, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Plzeňská teplárenská Run around the Bolevec Ponds is a traditional running event organized by Pro Sport Activities, offering races for children and adults in the picturesque surroundings of the Bolevec Ponds in Plzeň. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Youth Running Cup and is suitable for the general public, including the youngest runners. Entry is free, and the first 300 people to register will receive a voucher for refreshments. In addition to the races, there is an accompanying program for children and an athlete autograph session.
course_highlights: Courses range from 300 m for the youngest children to 5.5 km with hills for adults
Picturesque surroundings of the Bolevec Ponds, with both flat and hilly sections
Chip timing and results service provided by APACHI s.r.o.
additional: Entry is free for all participants. The first 300 people to register will receive a voucher for refreshments (a sausage with bread and mustard, 0.33 l of beer or a non-alcoholic drink). Chip, race number and safety pins are available to borrow; an original commemorative medal is awarded at the finish. The accompanying program includes face painting, a bouncy castle and an athlete autograph session. Parking is available in car parks around the Bolevec Pond; cars are not permitted to enter the start and finish area without authorization. Courses range from 300 m to 5.5 km; registration through Apachi; race office by Ostende at the Great Pond; parking around the Bolevec Pond; accompanying program including face painting and a bouncy castle.

name: Birell Večerní Běh na 10 km Praha
location: Praha 1, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Birell Prague 10K Evening Run is a traditional night race offering a unique atmosphere on Prague’s illuminated streets. The race starts at dusk, allowing runners to experience the city’s beauty in an unusual light. You can participate individually or as part of a team and enjoy the magical nighttime atmosphere beneath the starry sky. The race is part of the RunCzech running series and attracts thousands of runners every year.
course_highlights: A night run along Prague’s illuminated streets
A dusk start with a magical atmosphere
A 10 km route through central Prague
additional: The race is open to individual runners and teams (women’s, men’s and mixed teams). The RunCzech mobile app provides all information about the race, the accompanying programme and the virtual pack. The 2026 edition will be the race’s 29th, with up to 8,500 runners. The race takes place on 5 September 2026, starting at 19:30. Distance: 10 km. Team option available, refreshments along the route, medical support, online results and certificates.

name: adidas Běh pro ženy 5 km Praha
location: Praha 1, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Come and run the adidas 5 km Women’s Run in Prague, the largest race created specifically for women. The 5 km course is suitable even for runners without prior training, with a 50-minute time limit. Enjoy a unique atmosphere and the support of thousands of women at an exclusive race with no men on the course. Sign up with your friends and share the joy of running and solidarity.
course_highlights: 5 km course in central Prague
50-minute time limit, suitable even for beginners
Exclusive race for women only
additional: The race is exclusively for women; there are no men on the course. Race bibs can be collected at the pre-race EXPO, and someone else can be authorised to collect one. The RunCzech mobile app provides information about the race and accompanying programme. The race is suitable for beginners, team participation is available, and registration is online. The event is also available as a virtual option.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - září
location: Stromovka Park, Praha 7, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running levels, including children up to 12 years old, who run 1.6 km. The race is ideal for those who run for fun, want to improve their personal best, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in beautiful park surroundings. After the finish, every participant receives a warm cinnamon pancake. Everyone’s time is recorded, and the results are published online and count toward the year-round Lívancový Cup.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (2 miles, 3.2 km); children run 1 lap (1 mile + 70 m)
Beautiful surroundings of Královská obora – Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Bruselská Gate area from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option to register online in advance for faster check-in. Arrival by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram is recommended (Výstaviště stop). Parking is available by the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou Street. Tents are available for changing and leaving belongings (unattended), along with a mobile valuables storage facility and portable toilets. Categories are divided by age and gender; every runner’s time is recorded, and results are published online. Road course, 3.2 km, run without bib numbers, registration is voluntary, start at 9:07, registration from 8:15 to 8:45, parking by the bridge to Císařský Island, refreshments at the finish, categories for adults and children, open to all age groups

name: Barokomaraton
location: Plasy, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Barokomaraton is the 19th edition of a cross-country race held in the picturesque surroundings of the town of Plasy and the Střela River valley. The race is for experienced runners as well as those who run for enjoyment and want to take in the beautiful autumn scenery. Runners can expect routes along forest and field paths, with regular aid stations. The organizers are also preparing a cultural program, entertainment for children, and refreshments, making the Barokomaraton an enjoyable day of sport and relaxation for the whole family.
course_highlights: Forest and field paths in the Střela River valley
Regular aid stations with water, sports drinks, and fruit
Start and finish at the Velká louka venue in Plasy
additional: Race registration takes place at the Velká Louka venue in Plasy on 4 September from 18:00 to 20:30 (until 23:30 for the ultra) and on 5 September from 7:30 to 9:20. The time limit is 6 hours for the marathon and 16 hours for the 100 km ultra. Running with a dog (canicross) is prohibited. Runners are encouraged to bring their own collapsible cup for use at the aid stations; a limited number of cups will be available for purchase on site. Team relay entries are available for teams of three on the 10 km, half-marathon, and marathon routes. Races include various distances, including the 100 km ultra, and are suitable for runners of all levels. The event also offers cultural and accompanying activities, including an expo and entertainment for children.

name: Strážný nahoru a dolů
location: Dolní Dobrouč, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Strážný Uphill and Downhill is part of the ISCAREX Cup, a traditional series of running races in the Pardubice Region. The race offers a challenging uphill and downhill run in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Dobrouč. The organisers provide a great sporting atmosphere and facilities for all participants. The event is suitable for experienced runners as well as recreational athletes who want to try running on hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Uphill and downhill run on the terrain of Dolní Dobrouč
Technically interesting course profile with elevation gain
Picturesque natural surroundings in the Pardubice Region
additional: The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2025 series. Registration opens at 8:00, and the start is at 10:00. The race takes place outdoors on hilly terrain, with the finish at the summit of Strážný.

name: Lupenická dvanáctka
location: Lupenice, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Lupenická dvanáctka is a traditional running race in Lupenice, now being held for the 33rd year. The race features a 12 km course with 98 metres of elevation gain, entirely on asphalt and clearly marked. The start is at the Lupenice sports complex, and the race is part of the East Bohemia Grand Prix. All participants run at their own risk, and runners under 18 must provide parental consent.
course_highlights: 12 km course with 98 m of elevation gain
100% asphalt surface
Marked route in the Lupenice sports complex
additional: Registration takes place on-site from 8:00 to 10:00 for CZK 250. The entry fee includes a race number, refreshments along the course and at the finish, and facilities at the start and finish area. The entry fee is non-refundable if you do not participate. On-site registration is also available. The race starts at 10:30. The event is open to the general public, including families with children.

name: Jenštejnská pětka
location: Jenštejn, Jenštejn, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Jenštejnská pětka is an annual 5 km running race held in the village of Jenštejn since 2014. In addition to the main race, other running categories are also offered, welcoming a wide range of runners. The event is a traditional sporting gathering in the Central Bohemian Region and offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in the picturesque surroundings of Jenštejn.
course_highlights: A 5 km race in the village of Jenštejn
Various running categories for all age groups
An annual tradition since 2014
additional: The race takes place on 5 September 2026. The event is part of the local sports calendar, offers various categories and is popular with both locals and visitors.

name: Zbraslavská Závist
location: Nádraží v Praze-Zbraslavi, Praha-Zbraslav, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Zbraslavská Závist is a trail hill race starting in Prague-Zbraslav near the former mini-zoo and leading to the former Celtic hillfort at the top of Závist. The course is 3.5 km long with 190 metres of elevation gain, offering a challenging and engaging running experience. The race is suitable for athletes ready for a fast start and a demanding climb. It is organised by the KOPEC, z.s. association under the auspices of the Czech Athletics Federation and is part of Prague’s traditional running calendar.
course_highlights: Trail hill race with 190 metres of elevation gain
Start near the former mini-zoo in Prague-Zbraslav
Finish at the former Celtic hillfort at the top of Závist
additional: The race is recommended for athletes in good shape who can handle a demanding climb. The course is initially flat, then climbs all the way to the observation tower. The organiser is KOPEC, z.s., Petr Schovánek. The course is 3.5 km long with 190 m of elevation gain; the start is at the railway station in Prague-Zbraslav. The race offers beautiful views from the top of the Závist hillfort. Registration is available online or on site, and the race is open to all age categories.

name: Vorkloster run (1. etapa)
location: Předklášteří u Tišnova, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic

description: Vorkloster Run is a stage race held in the picturesque foothills of the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands and in the medieval atmosphere of Porta Coeli Monastery. The race features three stages of varying lengths and profiles, from a fast, flat stage to more challenging hilly sections. It is organised by the experienced DálRunDál team in cooperation with the Porta Coeli Monastery Brewery, adding to the authentic experience. The routes are carefully marked and run mostly away from traffic, with beautiful views of the surrounding landscape and historical sights.
course_highlights: Stage 1: 5 km, a fast, flat route on quality asphalt and a cycle path along the Svratka River, with views of Květnice Hill
Stage 2: 11.4 km, a hilly route on paved forest and field roads, with panoramic views of the foothills of the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands
Stage 3: 14.7 km, a moderately challenging route with one hill and a flat finish, passing beneath unique railway viaducts
additional: The first stage starts at 10:00 on Saturday. The route runs mostly away from traffic, along cycle paths and on quality asphalt. Bus transport is available approximately 10 minutes before the start from the car park near the start. Accommodation is available on the grounds of Porta Coeli Monastery in Předklášteří near Tišnov. The routes are carefully marked with arrows and course tape. The starting number must not be started on the bridge over the Svratka River, where an intermediate time is recorded. The race includes multiple stages with different distances and terrain, including team relay options. The event takes place in the beautiful setting of the historic monastery and surrounding countryside, with different start times and routes.

name: Běh s Klokanem
location: Olomouc-Hejčín, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Běh s Klokanem is a traditional cross-country race in Olomouc-Hejčín, held every year in late September. The race is open to children and young people as well as adult athletes, and is part of the Olomouc Region Children’s and Youth Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Distance Runners. Men run 9 km and women 7 km, while shorter courses are available for children according to age group. The event is both sporting and social, with activities for children and parents, including games, scooter rides, puzzles and a raffle. Check-in takes place at Hospoda U Travise by Mlýnský potok.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on trails by Mlýnský potok in Olomouc-Hejčín
Men run 9 km, women 7 km, and children’s courses range from 60 m to 1.5 km depending on age
Part of the Olomouc Region Children’s and Youth Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Distance Runners
additional: Check-in takes place at Hospoda U Travise. The accompanying programme includes scooter rides, sack races, puzzles, horse rides, a kangaroo-themed photo booth, an educational trail about kangaroos, a performance by the band 3+1 and a raffle with valuable prizes. All children receive sweets at the finish. Cross-country terrain, registration at Hospoda U Travise, an event for the whole family

name: Ostrava City Marathon
location: Masarykovo náměstí, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: 600-1500 Kč podle druhu závodu a data registrace
description: The Ostrava City Marathon is the oldest marathon in the Czech Republic and a summer running festival full of fun for all runners. It takes place on 6 September 2026 in the centre of Ostrava, at Masaryk Square, and offers distances for different ability levels, including a minimarathon, 10 km, half marathon and marathon. The event is for competitive runners and recreational runners alike, and also includes a charitable MiniMarathon. Alongside the races, a rich programme of activities will bring sport and culture to the city centre.
course_highlights: The course passes through Ostrava’s historic, industrial and green areas
Refreshment stations are placed approximately every 5 km and offer water, isotonic drinks and food
The start and finish are at Masaryk Square in the centre of Ostrava
additional: Runner check-in takes place on Saturday 5 September 2026 from 14:00 to 19:00 and on Sunday 6 September 2026 from 6:30 to 8:00 at the University of Ostrava City Campus. Timing chips are attached to the race bibs, which are non-refundable. Portable toilets and baggage storage are available at Masaryk Square. Showers and changing rooms are available in the City Campus building. Refreshments are available approximately every 5 km and at the finish. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square in the centre of Ostrava. Men over 70 and women over 60 can enter the marathon for free after obtaining a registration code by emailing info@ostravacitymarathon.cz. On-site registration is also available. The event offers refreshments, showers, medals and other participant amenities.

name: Podčerchovský kros
location: Chodov u Domažlic, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Podčerchovský Cross-Country Race is a challenging cross-country run held on Babí hora near Chodov. The course follows forest paths and includes several difficult climbs. The longest loop is 2.5 km and is suitable for runners wearing spikes. The race is open to all age groups, with distances ranging from children’s races to the men’s main race. Results are announced shortly after the race, and winners receive medals and prizes; cash prizes are also awarded in the main category.
course_highlights: The course follows forest paths
The longest loop is 2.5 km and includes several challenging climbs
Spikes may be worn
additional: Results for all categories are announced at 12:30. Categories have different distances: 1,100 m (2 × 550 m), 4,000 m (2 × 2,000 m), 5,000 m (2 × 2,500 m), and 7,500 m (3 × 2,500 m). Cash prizes are awarded in the men’s main category and to the women’s overall winner, subject to the organizer’s means. Runners can register in advance or on site. More than 100 runners take part, including children and young people, and the race is part of the Běžec Chodska series.

name: Běh na Lahti
location: Děčín, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: We invite you to the 47th edition of the traditional Běh na Lahti running race, taking place on September 6, 2026, in Děčín. The race offers two courses: the main course is almost 10 km long with 230 metres of elevation gain, passing the Kvádrberk viewpoint and continuing above the village of Ludvíkovice; the shorter course is just under 5 km long with 130 metres of elevation gain. The route runs through the terrain of the Děčín forests above the sandstone canyon of the Elbe River, offering beautiful views and a challenging run. Check-in and registration take place at the start from 8:00 to 9:45. The race starts at 9:00.
course_highlights: Off-road route through the Děčín forests above the sandstone canyon of the Elbe River
Main course: 9.8 km with 230 m of elevation gain; starts at the Kvádrberk viewpoint
Short course: 4.9 km with 130 m of elevation gain; turnaround point by the cemetery in Ludvíkovice
additional: Check-in and registration at the start (Kvádrberk viewpoint) from 8:00 to 9:45. Children’s races are 100 to 1,000 metres long, depending on category. The main course is a loop with a turnaround point after 5 km; the short course has a turnaround point after 2.5 km. Registration is available online and on site. Course maps and GPX files are available on the race website. The race takes place above the sandstone canyon and offers different course lengths suitable for a wide range of participants.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - září
location: Smetanovy sady, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Olomouc 2 Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. It takes place in the scenic Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and compete primarily against themselves. The event also includes a cup competition, in which results are adjusted using an age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year. Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. Winners are announced in each category.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.2 km) course in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc
Suitable for runners of all ages and abilities
Scenic setting by the park fountain, except for the June and August races, which take place by the river
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The top three finishers are announced in each category. The race is part of a year-round cup competition, with results adjusted using an age coefficient and points accumulated for taking part in multiple races. The race is run on paved paths in Smetana Gardens. Registration is optional and takes place from 9:30 to 10:00. The event focuses on the joy of movement and promoting sportsmanship.

name: Rychnov pomáhá během
location: Rychnov nad Kněžnou, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Rychnov Helps Run is a charity running race held in Rychnov nad Kněžnou, offering routes for children and adults in various age categories. The race takes place in early September and is known for its friendly atmosphere, accompanying program, and support for those in need. Every participant receives a race pack and a medal, and the top runners in each category win valuable prizes. The event also includes an autograph session and a fun prize quiz, contributing to a family-friendly atmosphere and community spirit.
course_highlights: Routes for children from 400 m up to 10 km for adults
Start and finish at Poláčkovo Square in Rychnov nad Kněžnou
Childcare available during the race
additional: The accompanying program includes free taping and physiotherapy for runners, Spartan obstacles for children, a bouncy castle, creative workshops, face painting, InBody body composition analysis, and a photo booth. Food and drinks include sweet and savory options, lemonade, coffee, beer, and grilled specialties. A storage area, changing room, and toilets are available. The event supports charitable causes, offers online and on-site registration, and features photo galleries and support for female athletes.

name: Běh mezi mosty
location: Písek, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh mezi mosty is a charity sporting event organized by Domácí hospic Athelas and Spolek Přátelé Kamenného mostu Písek. This run, which revives the tradition of the original race, is for everyone who wants to support seriously ill patients and their families. Participants can run, walk, or make a symbolic contribution. The entry fee is a donation that helps provide care at home for those who can no longer run. The event takes place in Písek and offers a range of routes, including children’s runs and family walks.
course_highlights: Routes run over concrete, asphalt, cobblestones, footbridges, and forest terrain
The courses are mostly flat, with a hilly elevation gain of 144 m
The race takes place around the Stone Bridge in Písek, with safety measures and volunteer support
additional: Registration is available online and on site on race day by the Stone Bridge. Race numbers and timing chips are distributed from 11:00. The program starts at 12:00, with a warm-up for children at 13:00. Children’s races start from 13:15, and the main races from 14:00 to 15:30. Routes are marked with white arrows, and there is a lead cyclist and volunteers along the course. Parking, facilities, and refreshments are provided. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a raffle. Terrain: concrete, asphalt, cobblestones, footbridge, forest terrain; T-shirts available to buy on site; various age categories and route lengths.

name: Jihlavský půlmaraton
location: Jihlava, Vysočina, Czech Republic

description: The Jihlava Half Marathon is a traditional 21.0975 km race run over two laps in the centre of Jihlava. The race is open to individual runners, pairs and teams of four, and features an officially measured course with kilometre markers. The event also includes a Family Run and children’s races, which support a charity project for Filípek. It takes place at the Český mlýn complex and offers quality facilities, chip timing and refreshments for runners.
course_highlights: Officially measured 21.0975 km course over two laps
Course marked at every kilometre
Start and finish at the Český mlýn Sports and Recreation Centre in Jihlava
additional: The race bib includes a timing chip, which does not need to be returned. The time limit for the half marathon is 3 hours; the course will close at 15:00. T-shirts can be ordered during online registration for 250 Kč, or purchased on site for 300 Kč while supplies last. The event also includes relay races for pairs and teams of four, a Family Run (1.1 km) and children’s races. Race-day check-in takes place from 8:00 to 10:30 at the Český mlýn complex. The race is run over two laps, with the start in the centre of Jihlava. Registration is available online or on site. The time limit is 3 hours, and race day is 6 September 2026.

name: Běžíme pro náhradní rodiny
location: Litoměřice, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: We Run for Foster Families is an event organised by CPNRP, o.p.s., which supports children growing up in alternative family care and their foster and adoptive parents. The event aims to raise awareness of these children’s needs and to support a stable, loving environment for their development. The run gives the general public an opportunity to show support and solidarity with alternative families. The organisation has long provided professional counselling, training, and support for foster and adoptive families.
course_highlights: A choice of route distances, including 4 km, 8 km, and 1 km for strollers and walkers
Proceeds support alternative families and children in care
Family activities, face painting, and an accompanying programme
additional: The event takes place on 6 September 2026. It is part of a wider charitable project supporting child care, with online registration and accompanying activities.

name: Horský čtvrtmaraton Jablonné nad Orlicí - Suchý vrch
location: Jablonné nad Orlicí, areál koupaliště, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: The Jablonné nad Orlicí–Suchý vrch Mountain Quarter Marathon is a mountain race taking place on September 6, 2026, in Jablonné nad Orlicí. The course crosses mountain terrain to Suchý vrch and is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Krkonoše Mountain Running Cup. The race covers approximately 10 km with around 580 metres of elevation gain. The course challenges both endurance and trail-running technique. On-site registration is available, and the race is for runners looking for a challenge in nature.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain around Suchý vrch
Approximately 580 metres of elevation gain over a course of around 10 km
Part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup
additional: The race starts at the swimming pool grounds in Jablonné nad Orlicí. The course runs over mixed terrain. On-site registration is available. The start is at 10:30, and registration closes before the race begins.

The route starts by the railway station and passes over the Srbsko footbridge, by the Bubovice Waterfalls and through the Kačák Valley along the Berounka River to the finish. The race offers beautiful natural scenery, a friendly atmosphere, and refreshments and bag storage on site. Every participant receives a race number, and the top three in each category receive certificates.
course_highlights: The route follows the Heart of the Bohemian Karst Educational Trail, marked in red and white
A climb past the Bubovice Waterfalls and over Doutnáč Hill
Running through the Kačák Valley alongside the stream and the Berounka River
additional: Registration is available online and on site. Every participant receives a race number. Please arrive by 17:45 at the latest. Refreshments and bag storage are available on site. The top three finishers in each category receive certificates. The race is part of a series of 12 trail races held around the Berounka River, from Radotín to Nižbor, with varying distances and elevation gain. The start is generally accessible by train; races have water stations and category awards. The race takes place on 7 September 2026 in Srbsko.

name: S kopečka do kopečka
location: Olomouc, Olomouc District, Czech Republic

The race is part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners Grand Prix and is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the running community in Central Moravia. The race is ideal for anyone looking to enjoy a run in beautiful surroundings and take on hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Challenging hilly terrain in Olomouc
Part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners Grand Prix
Traditional endurance run with a long history
additional: A 7.8 km cross-country race in Olomouc, taking place on 9 September 2026. The race is open to runners of all levels and offers the chance to take part in a friendly atmosphere with support from the local running community.

name: Okolo Lováku
location: Šumperk, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Okolo Lováku is a running race in Šumperk that is part of the Šumperk Winter Running League. The course runs through the picturesque countryside around Sklený vrch and Lovák, features interesting off-road sections, and offers an opportunity for athletes of all levels. The race is popular with local runners and promotes an active lifestyle in the region. It is organized by the Šumperská sportovní project, which supports sports and leisure activities in Šumperk and the surrounding area.
course_highlights: The route runs around Sklený vrch and Lovák
Interesting terrain with natural panoramas
Part of the Šumperk Winter Running League
additional: The race is part of the winter running league in Šumperk. It is organized by the Šumperská sportovní project, which supports sports and leisure activities in the region. Runners can look forward to an interesting course and a friendly atmosphere. The race is part of a winter running series, registration is available online, and the race includes timing and refreshments after the race.

name: Novostrašecký běh - Memoriál Vildy Šubrta
location: Nové Strašecí, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic

The race takes place at the SK Nové Strašecí football stadium and in the surrounding area, on a mix of asphalt, dirt roads and forest trails. The main category is scheduled to start at 18:00. The race is open to the general public; the entry fee for adults is 100 Kč, while children can take part for free. Online registration is available even on race day, making it easy to enter.
course_highlights: The course follows asphalt, dirt roads and forest trails
Start and finish at the SK Nové Strašecí football stadium
Mixed-terrain race with a distance of 6 km
additional: Online registration is available even on race day. The race is organized by the town of Nové Strašecí; the contact person is Ivana Rezková. Children can take part for free. The race takes place at the football stadium and in the surrounding area. Online registration; an event suitable for the whole family.

name: Geofyzikální běh
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Geophysical Run is a traditional running event organized by the Institute of Geophysics of the Czech Academy of Sciences, held in the picturesque surroundings of Krč Forest in Prague 4. It has a long history dating back to 1985 and offers a sporting experience in nature with a scientific setting. The event is suitable for the general public and combines physical activity with the promotion of geophysics and the natural sciences.
course_highlights: The route runs through picturesque Krč Forest in Prague 4
The run is part of a traditional event held since 1985
Natural terrain suitable for recreational and competitive runners
additional: The event is organized by the Institute of Geophysics of the Czech Academy of Sciences and is part of the institute’s social activities. The run is held regularly in September and is associated with promoting science and geophysics. The website also lists other institute activities, but specific information about registration and entry fees is not published. The race is held annually, with both scientists and members of the public taking part, and is part of a broader series of runs in Prague.

Each run offers a 3 km course that everyone can run at their own pace. Proceeds from entry fees go to help those in need, giving the event purpose and added value. The start is traditionally at 17:45 at Lodičky, with check-in beginning at 17:00. Everyone is warmly invited to take part and support a good cause.
course_highlights: A 3 km route in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park
A running-friendly cycle path surface
A charity run with proceeds going to help those in need

description: Witzenmann Opavská míle is a prestigious one-mile (1609 m) running race that continues the tradition of the Stanislav Mikeska Memorial. The race is open to a wide range of participants, including professionals, amateurs, children, families, corporate and school teams, people with disabilities, and wheelchair users. It takes place in Opava and is supported by its general partner, Witzenmann Opava. The course record is held by Filip Sasínek, with a time of 3:55 minutes set in 2023. The race is held regularly and is one of the most significant running races in the Czech Republic.
course_highlights: A course exactly one mile long (1609 m)
An official middle-distance athletics event
Suitable for all age groups and different types of teams (corporate, family, and school)
additional: Race categories include men and women in various age groups, children’s categories, and corporate, family, and school teams, with rules for team composition and scoring. The race takes place on 4 September 2025, with payment by card or bank transfer, and is part of the TIPSPORT SPORTUJ S NÁMI 2025 series. Historical results and information about previous editions are available on the official website.

The entry fee is CZK 500, half of which supports the Světluška project and half of which goes toward direct assistance for people with severe visual impairments. The event offers an accompanying program, including a concert, and race packs with a headlamp or a sports headband for those who register early.

Participants run at their own risk and can use public transport and nearby parking.

Children's race, with the loop distance set before the start

name: Prajzské kilo
location: Ludgeřovice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Prajzské kilo is an ultratrail race through the Hlučín region, recalling the historic borders and stories of a region divided in 1742. The race offers three distances—30, 50 and 100 km—with different time limits and elevation gain. You’ll run through a landscape of old roads, chapels and field tracks, bearing the marks of history and local identity. The race is scored as part of the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup and also offers UTMB Index and ITRA points. It includes a unique medal, a T-shirt, refreshments on the course and at the finish, and childcare for the shorter distances.
course_highlights: 30, 50 and 100 km routes with 270, 350 and 600 m of elevation gain
Run through the Hlučín region, passing historic landmarks and chapels
7 aid stations on the 100 km route, GPS live tracking and online tracking
additional: The entry fee includes a unique metal finisher’s medal, a commemorative magnet, a cotton logo T-shirt, a hot meal at the finish (meat or vegetarian), refreshments on the course, GPS live tracking (100 km), childcare for the 30/50 km distances (registration required), online tracking at checkpoints (30/50 km), timing, and scoring in the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup, with UTMB Index and ITRA points. Course records are waiting for your time; race distances: 30 km, 50 km and 100 km; time limits: 6–24 hours; childcare for 30/50 km; GPS live tracking; scoring for UTMB and ITRA points.

name: Okolo Kolovrat

The courses run mostly along tree-lined country, meadow, and forest paths, offering a wonderful running experience in nature. The race is suitable for all runners looking to improve their time or set a personal course record.

Mostly tree-lined country, meadow, and forest roads and paths
The main course crosses beyond Prague’s borders to Říčany, along the 50th parallel

Trail running, distances of 11 km and 21 km, relay option, beautiful natural scenery, event held in September 2026, support for the local community, and refreshments at the start and finish area.

Online registration only. Start and finish on Masaryk Square in Přelouč. The event supports patients with butterfly skin disease (DEBRA ČR).

Aid stations on the half-marathon course and other longer courses

name: Běh na Boží horu

The event is part of the wide range of activities organized by the Ivančice Leisure-Time Centre, which has a long-standing tradition and support from the town. name: Strojařská desítka

The start is always at 10 a.m. by the headquarters of the Road Maintenance Administration on K Majáku Street. Registration is available in advance or on the day; results are available online.

name: Běh přátelství Klenčí pod Čerchovem - Waldmünchen

description: The Run of Friendship Klenčí pod Čerchovem–Waldmünchen is part of the Běžec Chodska running series, which offers a diverse range of races around the Chodsko region. The course is suited to nature lovers and trail runners, while the race atmosphere encourages a friendly gathering of the running community. name: Bezdězský půlmaraton

description: The Bezděz Half Marathon is a running race held in the picturesque Máchův kraj region around Bezděz Castle. The route is marked with streamers, signs and flour, with approximate markers every kilometre. Registration is available via the official website. The race takes place in September 2026, and the course includes natural terrain and forest roads.

name: 7 pohoří Krkonoše
location: Benecko, Krkonoše, Czech Republic
description: The Trail Run Seriál 7 pohoří is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The races feature technical trails, epic views and an atmosphere you won’t find anywhere else. Whether you’re an experienced mountain runner or a beginner, 7 pohoří will test your strength, willpower and determination. Conquer all the mountain ranges and become a trail-running legend.

Epic views of prominent peaks and landscapes, including Ještěd, Bezděz, Kozákov, Trosky, Zvičina and Velká Deštná
Routes follow mountain paths, ancient trails and natural areas in national parks

Every participant receives a commemorative finisher’s medal and has access to refreshments on the course and at the finish. Recommended equipment includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. Small items can be stored at the registration tent. The event takes place in all weather conditions, and participation is at your own risk. The course includes mountain trails, technical sections and scenic viewpoints. Registration includes a course map, chip timing, a medal and refreshments.

Refreshments and a raffle are available after the race, and public transport can be used to return from the finish area.

Trail race with 696 m of elevation gain, starting at the White Bridge over the Elbe and finishing at the Hanč and Vrbata Memorial. Registration is available online and on site.
