description: Dětmarovická 10 is a traditional running race held in the village of Dětmarovice, featuring a main 10 km race, a 2 x 5 km relay, and children’s races called Cipísek’s Run. The route runs mainly along asphalt roads and forest trails, combining fast sections with gentle challenges and offering scenic corners of the village. The race is intended for both experienced runners and enthusiastic amateurs, with the joy of running and sporting atmosphere more important than performance. Short children’s courses with a cheerful atmosphere and illustrations of Cipísek are also on offer. Registration is online, with the option to sign up on site. Participants receive a race number with a timing chip and gifts from the event’s partners.
course_highlights: The route runs mainly along asphalt roads and forest dirt-and-gravel trails within the cadastral area of Dětmarovice
A combination of fast sections and gentle challenges suitable for experienced and amateur runners
Scenic corners of Dětmarovice with a unique atmosphere
additional: The start and finish are by the Dětmarovice Sports Hall. Participants receive a race number with a timing chip. Refreshment stations are at the 6 km mark and at the finish. Medical services are available at the finish. Transport between relay legs is provided for the 2 x 5 km relay. Children’s races are divided by age into 100 m, 200 m, and 400 m distances. On-site registration is possible, but the same benefits as with online registration are not guaranteed. The race includes electronic registration, chip timing, medical coverage, refreshments, and a raffle. The route includes asphalt, forest, and gravel paths and is suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Okolo Muňáku
location: Munice u Hluboké nad Vltavou, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
price_range: Dospělí: online 300 Kč, na místě 500 Kč; děti: online 100 Kč, na místě 200 Kč; štafety: online 550 Kč, na místě 750 Kč
description: Okolo Muňáku is a family running race in Munice near Hluboká nad Vltavou, offering a relaxed atmosphere and a fast course around Munický Pond. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is open to all age groups, including children’s races. Each year, it supports the Centrum Bazalka charity, which receives part of the entry fees. After the race, a varied accompanying programme is prepared, including a raffle and prizes for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: 10 km course with 35 metres of elevation gain
Mostly paved cycle paths (60% asphalt, 40% gravel)
The route goes around Munický Pond, Hluboká, the ZOO and Bažantnice
additional: Children’s registration takes place from 9:30 to 10:30, and the main race starts at 13:30. A race bib printed with your name can be ordered until 10 September. Members of #tymdejvid can enter for free. After the race, there is a raffle, and children receive a ZOO ticket and a medal. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup; the course is fast and flat. Starts take place from 9:30 to 15:30, and registration is open until 13 September 2026.

name: Vrchlabský 1/2 Maraton
location: Náměstí T. G. Masaryka, Vrchlabí, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Vrchlabí City Half Marathon is the first edition of a half marathon held in the heart of the Krkonoše Mountains, at T. G. Masaryk Square in Vrchlabí. During the race, participants will enjoy a sporting challenge on paved roads and field and forest paths, as well as a cultural programme and a friendly atmosphere. In addition to the main half marathon, shorter 2 km and 9 km routes are available for children, juniors and families with children, taking them through the town and its side streets. The event brings together running, experiences and community, and is co-financed by the State Environmental Fund of the Czech Republic.
course_highlights: The course follows paved roads and field and forest paths
Start and finish at T. G. Masaryk Square in Vrchlabí
The town’s side streets are part of the shorter routes for children and juniors
additional: The 2 km race starts at 13:00, with age categories 7–9, 10–12 and 13–15. The half marathon (21.1 km) starts at 15:00, with age categories 18–29, 30–39, 40–49 and 50+. Parking is available in the town centre; some car parks charge a fee, while others are free. The larger car park near the monastery is temporarily closed. The car park by the cultural centre is recommended; it is within a 10-minute walk of the square. The course includes paved roads and field and forest paths; registration is available using the contact details on the website.

name: Forestova čtrnáctka
location: Záluží u Třemošné, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Forestova čtrnáctka is a 14 km running race around Záluží near Plzeň, featuring a mix of field, forest and gravel roads with light trail terrain. The race is suitable for the general public, including children and young people, who can take part for free. Runners can look forward to plenty of refreshments, a participant medal and race photos. Check-in begins at 9:00 and the start is scheduled no later than 9:45. The race takes place in all weather. The organizer emphasizes participants’ safety and fitness to compete; everyone takes part at their own risk.
course_highlights: 14 km route along field, forest and gravel roads with light trail terrain
Pink arrows on the ground, supplemented by red-and-white tape, mark the course
Plenty of refreshments at the finish, including drinks, fruit and homemade cake
additional: Check-in begins at 9:00. On-site registration is available until 30 minutes before the start, and the organizer issues race numbers 20 minutes before the start. Runners receive a participant medal and refreshments at the finish. Toilets are provided by Johny servis mobile toilets. The start is in Záluží near Plzeň, which is best reached by tram no. 4. Each participant takes part at their own risk and is not insured by the organizer. Registration takes place 30 minutes before the start; the start is scheduled for 9:00 in the morning. The race is part of a series of trail events in the region and is suitable for the general public.

name: Králický Lískovec
location: Chata Amálka, Králíky, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Startovné dorost a juniorské kategorie 50,- Kč

description: Králický Lískovec is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Lískovec Hill and its environs in Králíky, Pardubice Region. The race offers various distances, from short children’s categories to the 8 km main race, which is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The main race starts at 11:30, while the children’s categories start from 10:30. The race is suitable for the general public and offers prizes to winners in individual categories. Entries can be submitted on-site on race day from 8:00 to 9:45.
course_highlights: The 8 km main race takes place on the mountain terrain of Lískovec Hill
Additional distances for children and youth, from 200 m to 5 km
The race is part of the 2026 ISCAREX Cup
additional: On-site entries are open on race day from 8:00 to 9:45. The overall male and female winners of the main race will receive separate prizes. The pre-school category starts during the race. The race starts at the Amálka cottage and focuses on mountain running in nature, with on-site registration available from 8:00 to 9:45. The event is part of a cup series and offers different distances for various age categories and levels of runners.

name: Kokořínský kros
location: Mšeně, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kokořínský Kros is a trail run held in the picturesque Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, near Prague. The race offers three main routes of 15 km, 10 km and 5 km, winding through romantic ravines and past unique sandstone towers. The start and finish are at the municipal spa complex in Mšeno, where facilities include refreshments and a children's corner. The race is suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced athletes, and offers a wide range of categories, with the option to change route distance even on race day.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the picturesque landscape of the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, with sandstone rocks and ponds
Romantic ravines and unique sandstone towers, which are rare in the Czech Republic
Start and finish at the municipal spa complex in Mšeno, with the option to go swimming
additional: A children's corner for children aged 3 to 10, with art activities and supervision by an experienced teacher. Route distance can be changed during race-day registration. Finish-line refreshments include Corny bars, bananas, water and Ionilyte sports drink. Parking is available in a designated car park approximately 200 m from the race facilities. Dogs are not allowed in the swimming pool complex. Trail courses with registration available, gift vouchers, on-site parking and refreshments, and the option of individual entry fees with a personalized race number.

name: Hostivařská 15°
location: Hostivař, Praha 10, Czech Republic
price_range: 500 Kč online / 700 Kč na místě (15 km), 400 Kč online / 500 Kč na místě (5 km), 200 Kč online / 250 Kč na místě (děti)
description: Hostivařská 15 is a family-friendly trail race in the natural surroundings of Prague’s Hostivař district, offering more than just a test of performance. The race takes place around the reservoir, golf course and meanders of the Botič, mostly on forest trails with very little asphalt. The race is run without timing equipment; the winner is the person who most accurately predicts their finishing time. It has a nature-inspired, brewery-themed atmosphere and is suitable for all ages, including children.
course_highlights: Forest trails with very little asphalt
Around the reservoir, golf course and meanders of the Botič
Family-friendly, nature-inspired atmosphere with brewery facilities
additional: Race pack collection is from 8:00 to 10:30 at the Hostivar 2 brewery, with a bag drop available. Refreshments are provided on the 15 km course and at the finish. Participants who register online receive a commemorative gift. The accompanying programme includes a raffle, a dance show and entertainment for families with children. Parking at the brewery is limited; additional parking is available nearby. Public transport: Praha-Horní Měcholupy, buses 154, 183, 224 and 240, and train. Forest surface; online registration until 11. 9. 2026; start at the Hostivar brewery; refreshments on the course and at the finish; accompanying programme; raffle; family-friendly atmosphere.

name: 4Drun
location: Dubany u Prostějova, Prostějov, Olomoucký kraj, Czech Republic
description: 4Drun is a traditional running race organized by Sportovní klub DDsport, z.s., held in the picturesque surroundings of Dubany near Prostějov. The race features a 10.2 km course through the area around Dubany, neighboring villages, and nearby cycle paths, combining paved and cross-country sections. The program also includes a 2 × 5 km relay, a 4 km family run, and children’s races, making the event suitable for all age groups. A varied program of accompanying activities is planned for race day, and every participant receives a commemorative medal.
course_highlights: The 10.2 km course runs through the area around Dubany, the neighboring villages of Hablov and Bystročice, and a newly built cycle path
A combination of paved and cross-country sections
A 4 km family run, suitable for participation with a stroller
additional: Race packs and bib numbers can be collected at the 4Drun Expo at Sokolovna Dubany on Friday 11.9 from 16:00 to 18:00, Saturday 12.9 from 9:00 to 10:00 and 18:00 to 19:00, and on race day 13.9 from 8:00 to 12:30. On-site registration on race day is not possible. Every participant who finishes the race receives a commemorative medal. Participants are advised to collect their race pack well in advance, ideally one hour before the start. Only runners aged 18 and under may place on the podium in the family run. The accompanying program includes children’s races, the family run, relay races, and a prize draw. Advance online registration is required; the race is part of multiple categories and accompanying events.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - září
location: Plzeň, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli is a regular 8 km running race held in the pleasant surroundings of Plzeň. The race is for all runners who share a passion for running and spending time together. The start and finish are at the same location, with parking available for participants. The event offers a friendly atmosphere and is suitable for various age groups.
course_highlights: An 8 km course in the Pytel area of Plzeň
Start and finish at the same location, with parking for participants
Age categories for runners aged 16 and over
additional: Registration and race-number pickup take place from 17:00 to 17:45. After the race, the top runners are announced and a raffle is held. The race is limited to 75 participants. Each participant takes part at their own risk. The race is part of a series of runs in Plzeň, including events of various distances and charity events, and is held regularly throughout the year.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (10) – zářijový
location: Praha 4-Braník, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY is a regular running series in Prague’s Braník district, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava where personal bests are often set. The races are part of the 16th annual edition and suit runners of all levels, from beginners to pros. The course is certified, and the 10 km race allows runners to achieve the qualifying standard for the Czech Championships. After the race, participants can get together and refuel at a local restaurant, adding to the relaxed running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Fast course along the Vltava in Prague’s Braník district
Certified course, with the 10 km race offering the chance to achieve the qualifying standard for the Czech Championships
Friendly atmosphere and the option to enjoy refreshments after the race
additional: Registration opens at 18:00; the 10 km race starts at 19:00 and the 5 km race at 19:05. After the race, refreshments are available at Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage is available in the event tent. After the race, there is a prize draw with prizes such as free race entries, massage vouchers and more. The course is measured by a certified course measurer. Cancellation is possible up to 24 hours before the start, with the entry fee refunded. The race is part of the VAŠÍ LIGY running-event series in Prague, which includes various distances and categories. Registration is available in advance, and the event supports both regular and recreational runners.

name: Podzimní běh okolo Europlantu
location: Praha Horní Počernice, Praha, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné: 100,- Kč, členové SABZO startovné neplatí

description: The Autumn Run around Europlant is a traditional running race held in Prague-Horní Počernice. The race is 7.5 km long and follows a combination of paved and off-road sections. It starts in the early evening, with slower runners starting earlier. The event is open to all runners and is supported by the Prague 20 municipal district. After the race, potatoes provided by sponsor Europlant are ready for participants.
course_highlights: 7.5 km course
Combination of paved and off-road sections
Early-evening start, with faster and slower runners starting at different times
additional: Registration is available at the start venue until 17:45. Slower runners start at 17:30. Transport: Metro Line B to Černý Most, then a bus to the Vojická or Vysokovská stop. Runners participate at their own risk. Organizer: Tomáš Procházka, contact: 606629062. After the race, potatoes are provided for participants by sponsor Europlant šlechtitelská spol. s r.o. Course: 7.5 km on paved and off-road sections; on-site registration until 17:45; start: 17:30 for slower runners; participation at your own risk; the organizer is not responsible for belongings left unattended.

name: Běh proti násilí
location: Obora Hvězda, Praha 6, Praha, Czech Republic
organizer: Asociace pro práci s lidmi, kteří se dopouštějí násilí z.s.

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Run Against Violence is a traditional charity run held in Hvězda Game Reserve in Prague 6. It supports the Stop Violence programme and clients taking part in long-term therapies focused on managing anger and aggression. The event brings together runners of all ages who want to show their support and offer hope to people working to change their behaviour. The 5 km course is suitable for anyone who wants to support a good cause while enjoying exercise outdoors. It is organised by Diakonie ČCE, a major provider of social services in the Czech Republic.
course_highlights: The course runs through Hvězda Game Reserve in Prague 6
The main course is 5 km long
A charity run supporting the Stop Violence programme
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day at the registration tent; they are labelled by gender and T-shirt size. A baggage storage area, changing facilities, refreshments during the race and at the finish, and free massages before and after the run are available. Race numbers and chips are non-transferable and must be worn visibly on the chest. The race is a charity event supporting the Stop Violence programme. The programme includes children’s races, the 5 km main race, activities in the children’s corner, relaxation techniques and massages. The event supports therapy programmes and violence prevention.

name: Běh pro hospic Červený Kostelec
location: Červený Kostelec, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Děti: jednotné startovné 100 Kč (online i na místě)

description: The Run for Hospice is an open charity race held in Červený Kostelec, with courses for all age groups. The race takes place on September 19, 2026, and includes children’s courses along a forest path, as well as 2, 5 and 10 km courses on rolling mixed terrain, mostly asphalt with some forest and field paths. The event is part of the Primátor CUP running series and supports hospice services provided by the Červený Kostelec Regional Charity. Participants can enjoy the pleasant countryside around the Kostelec ponds, with views of the surrounding mountains.
course_highlights: The children’s courses follow a forest path
The 2, 5 and 10 km courses follow rolling mixed terrain, mostly asphalt
Beautiful countryside around the Kostelec ponds, with views of the Orlické Mountains, the Krkonoše Mountains and Hejšovina
additional: Online registration is available until September 19, 2026, at 6:00; on-site registration is also available for a higher entry fee. A small gift is prepared for the first 300 registrants. Parking is available on a grassy meadow near Náchodská Street, approximately a 10-minute walk from the race venue. The race is part of the Primátor CUP 2026 running series, with fair-play rules and no accompanying participants (dogs, bicycles, scooters, etc.). The event is part of the Primátor CUP series, and all proceeds will support Anežka Česká Hospice.

name: Zátopkova 10
location: Lomená alej, Stará Boleslav, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 600 Kč od 1. 1. 2026 až do závodu (v případě volné kapacity)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 1200 Kč od 1. 1. 2026 až do závodu (v případě volné kapacity)

description: Zátopkova 10 is a traditional running race held in Lomená Alej in Stará Boleslav. It consists of two 5-kilometre laps on forest paths. The race is part of the Trail Running Cup 2026 series and offers a 10 km main race, a two-runner relay, and children’s races over 500 and 1,000 metres. The course is mostly flat, with staggered starts and an on-course refreshment station. Runners receive a race bib with a timing chip, a commemorative medal, and other services, including refreshments and course photos.
course_highlights: Two 5 km laps on forest paths
The course is practically flat
An on-course refreshment station with isotonic drinks, water, and fruit
additional: Starts are staggered. The main race has a capacity of 500 runners and the children’s races a capacity of 100 runners. The entry fee includes a race bib with a timing chip, a commemorative medal, an SMS with the result, an electronic certificate, photos from the course or finish, and refreshments on the course and at the finish. Parking is near the start and finish. Trail terrain, forest paths, online and on-site registration; race categories include the main race, relay, and children’s races.

name: Li.T.R. – Lipno.trail.run.
location: Lipno nad Vltavou, South Bohemia, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Registruji dítě na dětský závod 250 Kč

description: Li.t.r. is a weekend trail festival featuring a 108 km main race with over 2,000 metres of elevation gain around Lipno. The race offers a unique opportunity to discover the little-known landscape of the Lipno region, its history and stories during a challenging ultratrail. It is open to both solo runners and teams, with a programme of accompanying events from Friday to Sunday. The atmosphere is friendly and community-minded; the event is organised by runners for runners, with respect for nature and local culture.
course_highlights: A 108 km trail with over 2,000 metres of elevation gain
The route follows narrow forest trails around the Czech Republic’s largest body of water, Lipno
The route is divided into 8 stages (8–14 km); all relay points are easily accessible by car
additional: The race starts and finishes in front of the Stodola restaurant in Lipno nad Vltavou. Changing rooms, showers and parking are available at the start. The route is divided into 8 stages, with relay points accessible by car. The entry package includes a drop bag for solo runners, refreshments at relay points (water, isotonic drinks and fruit), timing and results services. The accompanying programme runs from Friday to Sunday and includes talks, music and group activities. Entry fees are non-refundable but transferable. Participants must be aged 18 or over, or 15 or over with the consent of a legal guardian. Children under 6 may attend only when accompanied. A multi-segment trail race with an accompanying programme, accommodation options, and opportunities to experience local cuisine and history.

name: Mattoni Running Festival Ústí nad Labem
location: Ústí nad Labem, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Running Festival Ústí nad Labem 2026 is a traditional running event with a fast, flat course that runs along the Elbe River and through the local chemical plant. This half marathon is known as the “Ferrari among races” for its speed and the records that often fall here. During the race, runners can enjoy beautiful views of the Central Bohemian Uplands and Střekov Castle. The festival offers several race distances, including the half marathon, half-marathon relay, 10 km race and family runs.
course_highlights: Fast, flat course along the Elbe River
Route through the local chemical plant
Views of the Central Bohemian Uplands and Střekov Castle
additional: Another person may be authorised to collect the race bib. Start times for the various races throughout the day: half marathon from 09:00, other races at 11:00, 14:30 and 14:45. 16th edition, with approximately 3,500 runners. The race is part of running series and offers the RunCzech mobile app for participants. The event takes place on 19 September 2026 and includes various races, an expo with official merchandise and the option to register. The course passes through city landmarks as well as industrial areas and is suitable for all age groups.

name: Mladé Běchovice
location: Běchovice, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Mladé Běchovice is a traditional running race for children aged 1 to 18, held on a grass field in Prague-Běchovice. The race offers courses of various lengths, from 50 to 1,300 metres, to accommodate a wide range of ages. Approximately 800 children take part each year, making it an important sporting event for young runners. In 2026, the popular race will be held for the 61st time.
course_highlights: Courses from 50 to 1,300 metres, suitable for children aged 1 to 18
The race takes place on a grass field
Approximately 800 participants each year
additional: The race is suitable for children and takes place on a grass field in Prague-Běchovice. It is organised by the Mladé Běchovice, z.s. association. The organisers can also be contacted by phone at +420 606481222. The race is intended for children and young people and takes place in September 2026. It attracts approximately 800 participants and promotes sport and a healthy lifestyle among young people.

name: Běh Moravským krasem
location: Sloup v Moravském krasu, Blansko, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run through the Moravian Karst is part of the Blansko District Running League, which has a tradition dating back to 1976. This race gives runners from the Blansko area and beyond the opportunity to test their strength in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Moravian Karst. It is suitable for the general public and is part of a year-round competition that promotes running in the region. The organizers aim to provide quality services and a welcoming atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: The route passes through the picturesque terrain of the Moravian Karst
The race is part of the traditional Blansko District Running League
Natural scenery and quality race facilities
additional: The race takes place on September 19, 2026, in Sloup in the Moravian Karst. It is part of a regional running league with multiple events throughout the year.

name: Litovelská nealkoholická čtrnáctka
location: Litovel, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Litovel Non-Alcoholic 14K is a traditional running race organised by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque town of Litovel in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of a running series and offers an opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the running community in Central Moravia. The race is suitable for the general public, and its name, which refers to the event’s non-alcoholic nature, adds to its friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs through the picturesque surroundings of Litovel
Mostly asphalt and paved surfaces, suitable for fast running
Part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Endurance Runners
additional: The race is part of a series of local running events in and around Olomouc, with equipment available for organisers and other races in the region.

name: Podzimní běh Heřmanův Městec
location: Zámecký park, Heřmanův Městec, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Autumn Run in Heřmanův Městec is a traditional running race held in a beautiful château park. It offers two main distances, 5 km and 10 km (two laps), as well as children’s races in the start and finish area. The race is part of the Vládce Mrdic sports league and attracts runners of all ages, who enjoy the pleasant autumn atmosphere and quality facilities.
course_highlights: The course runs through the château park in Heřmanův Městec
Two race distances: 5 km and 10 km (two laps)
Children’s races in the start and finish area
additional: The race is part of the Vládce Mrdic sports league, which includes a series of races and open timed training sessions throughout the year. The race takes place on 19 September 2026. Registration is available on the official website. Exact course profiles are not provided, but the routes run through the countryside around Heřmanův Městec.

name: Hořovický cvoček
location: Hořovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 CZK v předprodeji, 200 CZK na místě
description: Hořovický cvoček is a traditional running race held in Hořovice, offering a course approximately 12 km long. The route follows forest paths and paved roads. The race starts on Valdecká Street by the water tower, heading towards Hvozdec. The main race starts at 10:00 and is for adult runners; there are no children’s categories. The entry fee is CZK 150 with pre-registration and CZK 200 on the day. The race is part of the Brdský běžecký pohár and has a long history, with results and statistics available.
course_highlights: Approximately 12 km course combining forest paths and paved roads
Starts in Hořovice, on Valdecká Street by the water tower, heading towards Hvozdec
Traditional race with a history and results dating back to 2014
additional: There are no children’s categories. The start and finish are on Valdecká Street by the water tower, heading towards Hvozdec. Results are available in the system and in PDF format. The race is part of the Brdský běžecký pohár, which includes other races during the season. The course features varied terrain, and registration is available in advance or on the day.

name: Kačina Run
location: Kačina, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kačina Run is a running race held in the beautiful grounds of Kačina Chateau and its expansive park. It is part of the BĚHEJ ZÁMKY STŘEDNÍ ČECHY series. The race offers courses of up to 800 metres for children and 5 km and 10 km courses for adults, mainly on crushed-stone and forest paths. The event is suitable for everyone who loves exercise and nature, and offers a welcoming atmosphere with refreshments along the course and at the finish. The start and event facilities are located at the rear of Kačina Chateau, where registration and the awards ceremony also take place.
course_highlights: Routes pass around Kačina Chateau and through its expansive park
70% crushed-stone path, 30% forest path
Refreshments along the course and at the finish (bananas, orange, apple, water)
additional: Registration opens at 9:00 for the children’s races and at 12:30 for the adults’ races, at the rear of the Kačina Chateau grounds. Children receive a participation medal as soon as they finish. Parents may run with children in the 2–3 and 4–5 age categories. The race takes place in all weather; participants must observe safety guidelines and fair play rules. A disposable race bib with safety pins must be attached to the chest. Parking is available as shown on the parking map; please do not park on the road shoulders. Course maps and videos are available on the website; the race takes place in Kačina Chateau Park.

name: Leskros Mácháč
location: Doksy, Máchovo jezero, CHKO Kokořínsko, Czech Republic
description: Leskros Mácháč is a new event this season, with beautiful routes ideal for running and canicross in the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, near Lake Máchovo. The routes follow soft, sandy ground covered with pine needles, making for a pleasant running experience in a natural setting. The event offers various distances, from children’s races to 21 km, with running, canicross, walking/running and dog-trekking categories. Facilities include refreshment stations for people and dogs, massages, taping and canine physiotherapy advice, helping all participants feel their best.
course_highlights: Soft sandy routes covered with pine needles
Location in the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area near Lake Máchovo
Refreshment stations for people and dogs at the finish and along the route
additional: Race registration opens at 8:00. Facilities include a bag check, changing room, Leskros kids’ club (10:30–14:00), massages and taping for runners, canine physiotherapy advice, canicross equipment available to borrow by prior arrangement, and parking and toilets near the start. The event includes charity activities, children’s races, equipment rental, refreshments and an accompanying programme in the natural setting of the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area near Lake Máchovo.

name: Štramberský Jasoň
location: Frýdlant nad Ostravicí, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Spolek Bezva běh pro bezva lidi z. s.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Do 30.4.2026 390 Kč nad 15 let a dospělí

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Do 30.4.2026 300 Kč děti v kočárku (s nárokem na medaili, start. číslo se jménem atd.)

description: Štramberský Jasoň is a traditional hiking and running event taking place on 19 September 2026 in Frýdlant nad Ostravicí and the surrounding area. It offers 22 routes of varying lengths, from 6 km to 67 km, including both race and hiking options. Participants can choose routes passing through Lysá hora, the Palkovické hůrky, Velký Javorník and other scenic locations in the Moravian-Silesian Region. At the finish in Štramberk, all registered participants receive an original medal and can order a printed T-shirt. The event is suitable for the general public, including families with children, and also offers routes suitable for strollers and seniors.
course_highlights: 22 routes from 6 km to 67 km, including both race and hiking options
Routes pass through Lysá hora, the Palkovické hůrky, Velký Javorník and other natural attractions
Finish in Štramberk, with an original medal for all participants
additional: Registration is available online only. A printed cotton T-shirt can be ordered during registration for 390 Kč (children’s T-shirt: 350 Kč). Registration can be transferred to another participant until 11.9.2026 at 20:00 by emailing redakce@bezvabeh.cz or in person at the event. The finish in Štramberk closes at 21:00. The event offers routes of various lengths, online registration, medals for participants, optional T-shirts and detailed route maps available for download.

name: Havlíčkova pětka
location: Havlíčkův Brod, Vysočina Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 200 Kč: zvýhodněné startovné při on-line registraci a zaplacení na účet do 31. května 2026

description: Havlíčkova pětka is a running race of approximately 5.2 km, held mostly on cycle paths and sidewalks along the banks of the Sázava River in Havlíčkův Brod. It is suitable for those who do not have a relay team or find a half marathon too challenging. The race starts in Havlíčkovo Square, and part of the entry fee goes toward supporting sports equipment for young people. The race is part of the Běžec Vysočiny running series and offers refreshments at both the start and finish.
course_highlights: The route follows public cycle paths and sidewalks, much of it along the Sázava River
No significant elevation gain (up to 20 m)
Surface: 95% asphalt paths, 5% trail or paving
additional: Refreshments are available at the start and finish. Race numbers for registrations paid by September 1, 2026, include the runner’s name. The race offers a medal, refreshments on the course and after the race, facilities including a changing room and storage for belongings and bikes, portable toilets, drinking water, music, and professional electronic chip timing with online results. Fifteen percent of each entry fee goes toward supporting secondary schools and youth sports programs in the town. The route includes asphalt paths, trails, and paving; registration is available online or on site. The race supports youth sports activities and offers various additional events as part of the running day.

name: Běh rodným krajem Emila Zátopka
location: Kopřivnice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 400 Kč - platí pro závodníky přihlášené do 17. září 2026 - startovné se hradí na účet

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 800 Kč - platí pro závodníky přihlášené 19. září 2026 (v den závodu) - startovné se hradí při prezentaci

description: The Run Through the Homeland of Emil Zátopek is a traditional race honoring the legacy of the famous Olympic athlete Emil Zátopek. It is held each year on the Saturday closest to his birthday, September 19. The race starts in his hometown of Kopřivnice, by the statue of Emil Zátopek, and finishes at the Wallachian Open Air Museum in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm, after a challenging 22.3 km course with a hilly profile. The race is open to participants aged 15 and over and also offers accompanying runs for children and the public. After the race, a ceremonial awards presentation takes place with distinguished guests in attendance.
course_highlights: A 22.3 km course from Kopřivnice to Rožnov pod Radhoštěm
Asphalt and gravel surfaces on forest sections
375 m elevation gain, with a rolling, hilly profile
additional: There are three refreshment stations and one water station along the course. The race takes place on roads open to traffic. The time limit is 3 hours from the start, with an intermediate cutoff of 1:20 hours to Veřovice. Changing rooms are available at the Cultural Centre in Kopřivnice and at the Wallachian Open Air Museum in Rožnov. Luggage is transported by bus to the finish. The organizer provides bus transport from Rožnov to the start and back after the race. Accommodation is available at Hotel Stadion in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm at the runner’s expense. Runners under 18 require consent from a legal guardian. The event also includes accompanying runs for children and the public. The route includes asphalt and forest paths; registration is required. Team and relay races are available, transport and accommodation are provided, and prizes are awarded.

name: Kocelovice-Hornosín-Kocelovice
location: Kocelovice, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Kocelovice–Hornosín–Kocelovice cross-country race is a traditional sporting event organized by the municipality of Kocelovice in the South Bohemian Region. The race takes place on Saturday, September 19, 2026, and participants can expect a route from Kocelovice to Hornosín and back. The event is suitable for running enthusiasts and anyone looking for an active day out in scenic terrain popular with hikers and cyclists. The start and finish are at the former school building in Kocelovice, which also serves as the race headquarters. The event lasts approximately 4 hours.
course_highlights: The route passes through scenic South Bohemian countryside with ideal terrain for hiking and cycling
Start and finish at the former school building in Kocelovice
A cross-country race connecting the villages of Kocelovice and Hornosín
additional: The event lasts approximately 240 minutes (4 hours). The start and finish are at the former school building in Kocelovice. The organizer is the Municipality of Kocelovice. The race is held annually in autumn; the most recent edition was in September 2023, and the next is planned for September 2026. The course is approximately 18 km long, with varying levels of difficulty and terrain.

name: Havlíčkobrodský půlmaraton
location: Havlíčkův Brod, Vysočina, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 400 Kč: zvýhodněné startovné při on-line registraci a zaplacení na účet do 15. března 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 1200 Kč: zvýhodněné týmové startovné při online registraci a zaplacení na účet do 18. září 2026 (do 12:00)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 200 Kč: zvýhodněné startovné při on-line registraci a zaplacení na účet do 31. května 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 50 Kč: zvýhodněné startovné při online registraci a zaplacení na účet do 18. září 2026 (do 12:00)

description: The Havlíčkův Brod Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in Havlíčkův Brod, celebrating its 14th edition in 2026. The main half marathon follows public cycle paths and pavements, mostly along the Sázava River, and passes through Havlíčkův Brod Square. Alongside the main race, the event includes children’s races, relays, and the shorter Havlíčkova Pětka, welcoming participants of different ages and ability levels. The race offers quality facilities, refreshments on the course and after the race, professional timing, and a varied accompanying programme.
course_highlights: The course follows public cycle paths and pavements, mostly along the Sázava River
The 5.2 km loop is run four times for the half marathon
Start and finish at Havlíčkův Brod Square, with no significant elevation gain
additional: The entry fee includes a race bib (with the runner’s name for registrations paid by 1 September 2026), a medal, refreshments on the course and after the race, free admission to an amusement park in the Vysočina Region, facilities (changing room, storage for belongings and bicycles, portable toilets, drinking water, and seating), music, event announcing, professional electronic chip timing, online results, medical services, and race organisation. The half-marathon time limit is 3 hours. 15% of each entry fee goes toward supporting secondary schools and sports programmes for children in the city. Results from the children’s races and Havlíčkova Pětka count toward the Běžec Vysočiny running cup. The event is traditionally held in September and offers a varied programme for all age groups and ability levels, including relays and children’s races.

name: Běh pro Hospic Anežky České
location: Červený Kostelec, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Děti: jednotné startovné 100 Kč (online i na místě)

description: The Run for Anežka České Hospice is an open charity race held in Červený Kostelec, with courses for all age groups. The race takes place on 19 September 2026 and includes children’s courses along a forest path, as well as 2, 5 and 10 km courses over undulating mixed terrain, mostly asphalt with some forest and field paths. The event is part of the Primátor CUP running series and supports hospice services. Race bibs are distributed from 8:15, and the main race winners’ awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.
course_highlights: The children’s courses follow a forest path
The 2, 5 and 10 km courses follow undulating mixed terrain, mostly asphalt
Beautiful scenery around the ponds of Červený Kostelec, with views of the Orlické Mountains, the Krkonoše Mountains and Hejšovina
additional: Race bibs are distributed from 8:15; registration closes 30 minutes before the start. A small gift is available for the first 300 registered participants. Parking is available on the grassy meadow by Náchodská Street, about a 10-minute walk from the race venue. The race is part of the Primátor CUP 2026 running series, with fair-play rules and no accompanying dogs, scooters or bicycles. The race takes place on 19 September 2026 in Červený Kostelec and supports hospice services. Registration and further details are available on the website.

name: Jilemnice - Žalý
location: Jilemnice, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Jilemnice - Žalý is a hill race with a total elevation gain of 569 metres, held in the scenic surroundings of Jilemnice in the Liberec Region. The race is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup and features a challenging 9.5 km course. The start is in Jilemnice’s town square, and the race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain. It is organized by ČKS SKI Jilemnice, z.s., which provides professional organization and support for the runners.
course_highlights: 9.5 km course with 569 m of elevation gain
Hill race in the scenic surroundings of Jilemnice
Start in Jilemnice’s town square
additional: The race is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup. It is organized by ČKS SKI Jilemnice, z.s. Contact person: Roman Koucký, tel. 602 265 857. The race regulations are available to download on the official page. The race takes place on a mountain course; registration details are not specified, results are announced at the finish line, and the event is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup.

name: Soběchlebský Š-krpál
location: Soběchleby, Olomouc, Czech Republic
organizer: místní běžečtí nadšenci ve spolupráci s obcí Soběchleby a SDH Soběchleby
price_range: 200 Kč dospělí, 150 Kč kondiční běh, děti zdarma
description: Soběchlebský Š-krpál is a traditional running race held in the area around the village of Soběchleby since 2017. The main course is approximately 11.7 km long with 268 m of elevation gain and runs 90% on unpaved farm and forest roads. Since 2024, the event has also included a 6 km fitness run, suitable for beginner runners and walkers. The start and finish are at the football field in Soběchleby, which has facilities including changing rooms, showers and refreshments. The accompanying program includes children’s races for different age groups.
course_highlights: Main course: 11.7 km with 268 m of elevation gain
The route runs 90% on unpaved farm and forest roads
6 km fitness run with 137 m of elevation gain, suitable for beginners
additional: Registration for the children’s races is always available on site on race day. The main race and fitness run can be entered online or on site until 11:30. Facilities at the football field include changing rooms, showers and toilets. Refreshments are provided after the race (soup, beer/non-alcoholic drinks). Parking is available in the immediate vicinity of the venue. The route runs on farm and forest roads; the start and finish are at the football field; refreshments and showers are available; parking is nearby.

name: Černošický běh
location: Černošice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Černošice Run is a traditional running race held in Černošice, offering courses for different age groups, from the youngest children to adults. The race takes place at the sports field at the end of Husova Street and includes short children’s races, a family relay, and longer courses for adult runners. Starts take place in stages from 14:00 to 15:40, allowing participants in different age groups to take part comfortably. The event is suitable for families and for runners looking for a sporting challenge in a pleasant town setting.
course_highlights: 200 m course for children born in 2018 or later
Family relay: 3 x 900 m
Longer 3 km and 10 km courses for adults and older youth
additional: Registration opens at 13:00 and closes 30 minutes before the start of each category. Starts take place in stages from 14:00 to 15:40. The event is held at the sports field at the end of Husova Street in Černošice. Categories are divided by age and course distance, including a family relay. The course is cross-country in style, running on paved and unpaved paths; competitors take part at their own risk; the event is sponsored by community activities in Černošice.

name: Trail Český ráj
location: Branžež, Český ráj, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Trail Český ráj is a popular off-road half marathon that takes you through the heart of Český ráj, including the courtyard of Kost Castle, pine groves and sandstone cliffs. This race continues the eleventh edition of the popular ELEVEN PŮLMARATON ČESKÝ RÁJ and offers what is probably the most beautiful off-road half-marathon route in the Czech Republic. The start is at Komárovský Pond, and every runner has a finish to look forward to. The race also offers a wide range of services for participants, including refreshments, changing rooms and medical support.
course_highlights: The route passes through the courtyard of Kost Castle
Surroundings featuring pine groves and sandstone cliffs
An off-road half marathon with beautiful natural scenery in Český ráj
additional: The start and registration are at the race centre by Komárovský Pond. Changing rooms, baggage storage, toilets, catering and parking are available near the race centre. Participants receive an original medal, a race pack and an electronic timing chip, and can use the medical service. Photos and certificates can be downloaded after the race; a programme of accompanying activities and prizes for the top three in each category are provided. The event offers medals, race packs, refreshments, medical support and parking. Online registration is available, with late entry also possible. The event also includes obstacle races and special categories for dogs and children.

name: PoHodová devítka
location: Velká Bíteš, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: PoHodová Devítka is a traditional running race in Velká Bíteš, held in September after the local festivities. The main course is 9 km and is suitable for runners of all abilities; children can race shorter distances. The event offers a friendly atmosphere and is open to the general public, including children’s and youth categories. About one third of the route is on asphalt and two thirds on unpaved roads. The race takes place in open traffic, and each participant runs at their own risk.
course_highlights: Main course: 9 km
Approximately one third asphalt and two thirds unpaved roads
The race takes place in open traffic
additional: Children start by category from 11:00, beginning with the youngest, followed by the younger and older pupils. The fun run starts immediately after the main race. Children can enjoy a bouncy castle and face painting, and every child receives a small prize. Race bib numbers are entered into a raffle for a voucher for an extended PoHodová Devítka running weekend. Registration includes entry into the draw for a weekend running package. The race is part of the local festivities and offers various age categories and distances.

name: Memoriál Matěje Mauera
location: Capartice, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Matěj Mauer Memorial is a 9 km running race that follows mostly forest trails, with one longer climb. The race takes place in the scenic location of Capartice near Plzeň and is part of the Běžec Chodska series. It gives runners the opportunity to test themselves in a natural setting on a more challenging course. It is suited to runners looking for a trail challenge and wanting to enjoy the atmosphere of a traditional race.
course_highlights: 9 km course
Mostly forest trails
One longer climb
additional: The race is part of the “Best Runner of Chodsko” competition, offers various age categories and detailed results from previous editions, and takes place on September 20, 2026.

name: 404. Malá cena Monaka
location: Slatiňany, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: The Small Monaco Race is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. It has a long history and is part of the KRB Chrudim club’s running calendar. The race offers a sporting atmosphere and an opportunity to test yourself on an interesting course in beautiful surroundings. It is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels.
course_highlights: A traditional running race with a long history
The course runs in the area around Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region
Organized by KRB Chrudim, a club with a rich running tradition
additional: The race includes courses of various distances, including a half marathon and other races; exact route and registration details are not specified.

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Zlín
location: Náměstí Míru, Zlín, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in Zlín is a charity running event taking place on 24 September 2026 at Míru Square. The start is at 20:00, and participants can choose a route according to their preference, or walk it. Starter packs are available in two options—with a headlamp or a sports headband. Part of the entry fee goes toward helping people with severe visual impairments, underscoring the event’s charitable purpose. An accompanying program is also planned for all participants.
course_highlights: Choose your route on site—run or walk
Start at Míru Square at 20:00
Starter packs with a headlamp or sports headband
additional: Registration desks are open from 18:00. An entry ticket with a unique code (printed or on a mobile device) is required to enter the venue. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P cards may enter free of charge with an accompanying person; they can purchase a starter pack on site for 250 Kč. The run’s capacity is limited for participants’ safety and comfort. Details of the accompanying program will be announced later. Route selection at the start; accompanying program; capacity limited for safety

name: Běh okolo Campusu
location: Bohunice, Brno, Czech Republic
organizer: Běžecký spolek z.s. a Sportuj s námi, z.s.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je 150 Kč. Platba startovného probíhá před závodem při registraci závodníků.

description: Běh okolo Campusu is a running race in Brno, held in the Bohunice area. The race features a 5.6 km course, with men and women competing in a single category. The programme also includes a children’s race for children of any age, with the loop distance determined before the start. The event is friendly and open to all runners, offering the chance to discover interesting places in Brno.
course_highlights: A 5.6 km loop in the University Campus area in Bohunice
Start and finish on Netroufalky Street, with public transport access (bus routes 50, 60, 61 and 69, and trolleybus routes 25 and 37)
Friendly atmosphere, a children’s race and refreshments after the finish
additional: Registration takes place at the race venue from 16:15. The children’s race starts at 16:45 and the main race at 17:00. Water and a tent for storing belongings are available after the finish. Runners participate at their own risk. Parking is available on nearby streets. 5.6 km course, pre-race registration, start in Bohunice, refreshments after the race, public transport, facilities at the venue

name: Eleven Večerní běh
location: Areál pivovaru VOLT, Jablonec nad Nisou, Czech Republic
price_range: 250 Kč pro dospělé, 100 Kč pro mládež
description: ELEVEN Evening Run is a 5 km night race held in the early evening at the VOLT brewery grounds in Jablonec nad Nisou. The course runs around three reservoirs and is suitable for men, women and young people aged 16 and over, as well as children up to 15. The race offers a sporting atmosphere, chip timing and valuable gifts for the first registered participants. The start and finish are at the brewery grounds, where race numbers can also be collected.
course_highlights: The course runs around three reservoirs
A 5 km night race
Start and finish at the VOLT brewery grounds
additional: The first 50 people to register will receive a sports headband in a special race design. The first 200 registered participants will receive a valuable gift from Dr. Oetker. Race numbers can be collected at the start venue from 18:00 to 19:30. Chip timing is provided by Datacontrol.cz. The race takes place around three lakes. Registration is available online and on site, and prizes are prepared for the best finishers and those who register early.

name: Běh Březinou v Polné
location: Fotbalový stadion v Polná, Polná, Jihlava, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: muži, veteráni, junioři, ženy, veteránky, juniorky

description: Běh Březinou in Polná is a traditional running race organized by Běžecký tým Polná and Běžec Vysočiny z.s., held at the football stadium in Polná. The race offers courses for various age categories, from the youngest children to veterans, with the main race covering 9.5 km along field and forest paths through the valley of the Šlapanka River. The race starts at 17:00, and participants can expect a pleasant atmosphere and commemorative prizes for the top finishers in each category. The race has a long tradition, with more than 39 editions since 1992.
course_highlights: The 9.5 km main course follows field and forest paths through the valley of the Šlapanka River
The asphalt section makes up approximately 30% of the course
The loop passes through the village of Věžnice and returns along forest and field paths
additional: Online registration is open until 12:00 on race day. A CZK 1,000 entry-fee season pass can be used. Runners aged 3 and over may take part. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, subject to the organizer’s means. Refreshments are available at the clubhouse buffet at the stadium. The race takes place on September 25, 2026. The start and event facilities are in Polná near Jihlava. The routes include various distances and terrain, including the 10.75 km main race and shorter categories.

name: Mělnický vinařský běh
location: Mělník, Mělník District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Mělník Wine Run is a traditional running race in Mělník, offering 10 km and 21 km courses. The race takes place on a single loop with beautiful views of the castle and vineyards, and the route passes historical and natural landmarks around the town. After the race, participants can enjoy a tasting of local wines, a commemorative glass, a free lunch, and a prize raffle. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own races free of charge. It is organized by the Run the World association, which promotes running as a friendly community activity.
course_highlights: The route passes Mělník Castle and vineyards, with views of the Vltava River
The loop includes crossing the lock and running through Hořín Park
On-course refreshment stations, including a turnaround point near Vrbno
additional: Registration and changes are not possible on race day. Race bibs can only be collected until 9:30. After the race, every participant receives a commemorative glass and can take part in a tasting of local wines. Lunch is free for all runners, including a vegetarian option. A prize raffle will take place after the winners are announced. The race capacity is 500 runners for the 10 km and 21 km courses. Children’s races are free of charge. Entry fees vary depending on the registration date. The event supports charitable causes helping people with cystic fibrosis, and the race is limited to 500 runners.

name: Grymovská pětka
location: Grymov, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Grymovská pětka is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering athletes the chance to test their abilities in the pleasant surroundings of the town of Grymov. Liga stovkařů Olomouc is a club specializing in recreational and competitive running that organizes a number of endurance races in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of its running calendar and attracts runners of different ages and ability levels. The club also supports runners with training and race preparation, helping to ensure a high-quality sporting experience.
course_highlights: Road course in a beautiful sports complex by the Bečva River
An opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners
Part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region
additional: The race takes place on 26 September 2026. The course is adapted to different ability levels; exact registration information is not provided.

name: Běh Bohutínem
location: Fotbalové hřiště Litavan, Bohutín, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 CZK pro dospělé, 20 CZK pro děti
description: Běh Bohutínem is a traditional running race organized by SK Sporting Bohutín, held at the Litavan football pitch. The race offers an 8 km course for men and a 4 km course for women, with a surface combining asphalt and forest trails. The event also includes children’s races, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. The main race starts at 13:00, and the atmosphere is friendly and sporty.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt and forest trails
Men run 8 km; women run 4 km
Start and finish at the Litavan football pitch
additional: Children’s races are part of the event. The course is GPS-measured at 4.88 km; according to the race details, men run 8 km and women 4 km. Results are regularly published in the system and as a PDF. The organizer offers neoprene chip straps for purchase for 100 Kč. The race starts at the Litavan football pitch at 13:00. The event also includes children’s races and running in a natural setting, with asphalt and forest sections.

name: Běh Zlínského kraje
location: Baťovský areál, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zlín Region Run is part of the celebrations for Zlín Region Day, taking place on 26 September 2026 in Zlín. The event offers not only a sporting experience in the form of a 6 km run, but also a cultural program, regional cuisine, and family activities. The run is open to the general public and is part of a full day of entertainment, crafts, and regional products. The organizer is the Zlín Region, which supports sport and local traditions through the event.
course_highlights: The course follows a closed asphalt loop in the Baťa industrial complex
The day also includes a children’s run and other sporting activities
The program features regional cuisine, crafts, and cultural performances
additional: Regional cuisine, running, sports and cultural program, family activities, regional products

name: Běh Velké skály
location: Děčín, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh Velké skály is a traditional running race held in Děčín, offering 11 km and 6.5 km courses through forest and urban terrain. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup and is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children, who have special races prepared for them. The start is at the ASK Děčín athletics stadium, and the race atmosphere is enhanced by the beautiful natural surroundings and rock formations. The event is now in its 56th edition and is known for its exceptional atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: Forest and urban terrain
11 km and 6.5 km courses
Start and finish at the ASK Děčín athletics stadium
additional: Registration is available online at www.nazavody.cz until midnight on 23. 9. 2026. The entry fee must be paid in advance to receive the lower price; on-site payment is available at a higher price. The race office accepts late registrations up to 30 minutes before the start of each category. The course covers forest and urban terrain. Registration is via www.nazavody.cz. Children’s races and relay races are held, and the main race is part of the Děčín Running Cup.

name: Plzeňský kardioběh
location: Plzeň-Roudná, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Plzeň Cardiovascular Run is the largest cross-country race in Plzeň, with 5.8 km and 10 km courses. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Youth Running Cup and also serves as the Czech Republic Cross-Country Championship for healthcare professionals. It is organized by Pro Sport Activities, an agency with a long-standing tradition of organizing sporting events in Plzeň and the surrounding area. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a quality sporting experience in the natural surroundings of Plzeň-Roudná.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in Plzeň-Roudná
Two courses: 5.8 km and 10 km
Czech Republic Cross-Country Championship for healthcare professionals
additional: The races include cross-country and asphalt routes. There are children’s races and an accompanying program with activities. Registration is through Apachi, and parking is available at Rychtářka.

name: KEEN Prague Park Race – Konopiště
location: Konopiště, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: KEEN Prague Park Race - Konopiště is a running race held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Konopiště, offering a unique running experience in the picturesque Central Bohemian Region. The course runs along both paved and unpaved paths and combines natural scenery with historic sites. The race is part of the Prague Park Race series, known for its relaxed atmosphere and high-quality organization. Runners of all levels are welcome to take on a sporting challenge close to nature.
course_highlights: The course runs along paved and unpaved paths in the natural surroundings of Konopiště
A combination of natural scenery and historic sites
A friendly atmosphere and well-organized race
additional: Choose between an 8 km or 14 km course, with the option to change your distance before race day. The longer course has a refreshment station at approximately 8 km, and refreshments are also available at the finish. The race is part of the Prague Park Race series, which includes pre-race group runs. Registration is through irontime.cz; payment must be made within three days of registering. The event includes a children’s race, on-site registration, parking nearby, and a detailed schedule on the website. The event also features test runs and presentations of KEEN running shoes.

name: 7 pohoří Beskydy
location: Ski Areál Severák, Trojanovice, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountain Ranges is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The Beskydy race takes place in the amphitheatre at Horečky in Trojanovice and offers technical trails, epic views and an atmosphere you won’t experience anywhere else. The routes follow forest roads and paths, with climbs up interesting hills and long descents. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and can look forward to refreshments and professional facilities.
course_highlights: Technical trails with 1,230 m of elevation gain on the main 23 km course
Routes follow forest roads and paths, with climbs up interesting hills
Beautiful views and an atmosphere in the amphitheatre at Horečky in Trojanovice
additional: The race time limit is 4 hours; after that, a runner is marked as DNF. Participants can leave small items at the registration booth. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The entry fee includes chip timing, refreshments on the course and at the finish, and a commemorative medal. The races take place at Ski Areál Severák in Trojanovice. Registration includes a race bib, chip timing, a medal, refreshments and facilities. The time limit is 4 hours.

name: ŠumpeRUN
location: Šumperk, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: ŠumpeRUN is a popular urban running race held through the historic centre of Šumperk. The eighth edition will offer races for the general public, including the 10 km main race, a 3.33 km race, relay races for teams of three, and children’s races over various distances. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and community spirit while celebrating the city’s cultural heritage. For 2026, a varied programme of activities is planned, including group warm-ups and music along the course.
course_highlights: The course runs through Šumperk’s historic centre, its urban conservation area, pedestrian zones and parks
The 10 km main race consists of three 3.33 km laps, with approximately 60 m of total elevation gain
Children’s races take place in Sady 1. máje Park, with distances from 100 m to 2 km depending on age
additional: Registration opens on 1 June 2026. Entry to the children’s races is free. Group warm-ups led by professional instructors will take place before the children’s races (10:30) and the adult races (14:00). There will be music along the course from a DJ or live band. The start and finish are at Svobody Square, near Hotel PERK and the Business Academy. Capacity is 350 runners for the main race, 100 runners for the 3 km race, 50 relay teams and 100 children in each age category. The event is aimed at the general public, offers a range of categories and makes results available online. It is part of the local sports calendar and promotes an active lifestyle.

name: K3-run
location: Krčmani, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: K3 – Krčmaň Run Over Three Peaks is an 11.3 km race with approximately 350 metres of elevation gain. The route passes through beautiful countryside over three peaks, mainly on paved paths and partly on grass, with predominantly firm surfaces. This run offers athletes an enjoyable experience in nature and a challenge in the form of climbs and trail running.
course_highlights: Route length: 11.3 km
Elevation gain: approx. 350 m
The route passes over three peaks, mainly on paved paths
additional: The race runs mainly on paved paths and grass, is suitable for runners of all levels, and offers beautiful views of the surrounding countryside.

name: Běchovice - Praha, MČR v silničním běhu mužů, žen, juniorů a juniorek
location: Běchovice, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Běchovice–Prague is a legendary 10 km road race with the longest uninterrupted tradition in Europe, now being held for the 130th time. The race is the official Czech Republic Road Running Championship and features a challenging 10,031-metre course that tests every runner. The atmosphere is exceptional and complemented by modern facilities, including an accompanying programme and commemorative medals. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from juniors to veterans, and also offers a relay race.
course_highlights: The course is 10,031 metres long, 31 metres more than the traditional 10 km
Start in Běchovice, finish at Pražačka in Prague
Official Czech Republic 10 km Road Running Championship with 26 categories
additional: Race numbers are distributed at the hall at Masaryk Railway Station in Prague in the days before the race, and in Běchovice on race day. The race includes a Joma technical T-shirt and a commemorative medal in the entry fee. The relay race starts at the same time as the third wave of the race, at 11:50. Each relay team consists of 4 members, with predetermined legs. The race has a capacity of 3,333 runners. Race photos and a personalised race video are free. The race is part of Prague’s running traditions and celebrations, offers online registration, and starts on Českobrodská Street in Běchovice.

name: Běh metropole Praha 1
location: Praha 1, Centrum Prahy, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: Běh Metropole is a series of public running races held in different districts of Prague. It aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and a sense of belonging to one’s district. The race is open to all age groups, from children to seniors, as well as participants with disabilities, who represent their district. Each start earns points in the competition to find Prague’s most sports-oriented district. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with original medals and gifts for participants.
course_highlights: Races take place in different districts of Prague, including the city centre
Promotes a healthy lifestyle and community spirit among Prague residents
Categories for all age groups, including participants with disabilities
additional: Each participant represents the district where they have permanent residence and contributes to the districts’ points tally. The project emphasises competition between Prague’s districts to be named the most sports-oriented. Original medals and running magnets for bib numbers are prepared for participants as keepsakes. The races offer different course distances and are part of a series, with medals and updates about the event location; registration is available online and on site.

name: Ivančická hodinovka
location: Městský stadion Ivančice, Ivančice, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Ivančice Hour Run is a traditional athletics race organized by Atletický klub Ivančice and held at Městský stadion Ivančice. The race takes place at the stadium by Malovaný mlýn, offering a sporting experience in the pleasant surroundings of a town rich in history. The start is scheduled for the morning, allowing participants to enjoy the race as well as other activities in Ivančice. The event is suitable for the general public and sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Race at Městský stadion Ivančice
Pleasant sporting surroundings in a historic town
Start at 10:30 a.m.
additional: The race is organized by Atletický klub Ivančice at the FC Ivančice sports ground in Malovansko. The venue is Městský stadion Ivančice, U Malovaného mlýna č.e. 1515, 664 91 Ivančice. The race offers chip timing, registration online and on-site, and is part of the local sporting tradition.

name: Svatováclavský běh Blažovicemi
location: Blažovice, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Spolek přátel Svatováclavského běhu - sdružení Vévoda
description: The St. Wenceslas Run through Blažovice is a traditional cross-country and trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Blažovice in the South Moravian Region. It offers two main routes, 10 km and 5 km long, which run mostly along natural paths and through woodland. The event also includes fun runs and children’s races ranging from 50 to 1,100 metres, making it appealing to the general public and families with children. It is organised by the Friends of the St. Wenceslas Run Association, which ensures a friendly atmosphere and high-quality organisation.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail-style routes
Two main routes: 10 km and 5 km
Fun runs and children’s races from 50 to 1,100 m
additional: The race starts at the football field in Blažovice. The main categories start at 12:45. The organiser is the Friends of the St. Wenceslas Run Association – Vévoda Association; contact person: František Kubínek, tel. 739 150 283. The race is part of the Czech Runners Club and the Czech Athletics Federation. It is part of the local running tradition and offers races of various distances, including children’s categories, making the event suitable for the whole family.

name: Běh Neumannovou stezkou
location: Unhošť, Central Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Neumann Trail Run is a traditional running race organized by the T. J. Sokol Unhošť running club in the picturesque wooded surroundings of Unhošť. The race offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in nature and also features children’s races. Runners who register in advance receive a discounted entry fee. The event has a long-standing tradition and is held regularly in autumn.
course_highlights: Picturesque wooded surroundings of Unhošť
Traditional running race with children’s races
Natural terrain suitable for running
additional: The race also includes children’s races. Those who register in advance pay a lower entry fee. Results and statistics are regularly published on the website. Course maps are available in the photo album. The start is scheduled for September 28, 2026, at 10:00. Exact registration information is not provided. The event is suitable for a wide range of runners.

name: MilešovKa(p)
location: Teplice, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: MilešovKa(p) is a traditional running race from Teplice to Milešovka, covering 17.5 km with 846 m of elevation gain. The course runs along paved roads, hiking trails, and dirt and forest roads, and is marked with the red and blue signs of the Czech Tourists Club. The race is open to the general public and offers awards for the top finishers in each category, hill climbers, and age-group record holders. It is organized by SPONA Teplice, an association that supports amateur sport in the region. The awards ceremony takes place in November alongside other running events.
course_highlights: 17.5 km course with 846 m of elevation gain
Surface: paved roads, hiking trails, dirt roads, and forest roads
Course marked with the red and blue signs of the Czech Tourists Club
additional: Awards for the top five in each category, medals and certificates, trophies for winners and teams, bonuses for hill climbers and the fastest Václav, and plaques for five and ten consecutive participations. The course is marked by the Czech Tourists Club. The awards ceremony takes place in November alongside BĚKODO. Registration is open until August 31, 2025. Participants receive a T-shirt and a race medal. The race is part of a series of local runs in Teplice.

name: Běh kolem Panské skály
location: Kamenicko Šenov-Prácheň, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh kolem Panské skály is a popular trail race taking place on September 28, 2026, in Kamenický Šenov-Prácheň in the Liberec Region. The race offers 3 km and 6 km routes through hilly terrain around Panská skála and is part of the Českolipsko District Running League. The event is open to recreational runners and experienced competitors alike, offering a unique experience of running in nature with beautiful views.
course_highlights: Trail courses over hilly terrain with views of Panská skála
Two distances: 3 km and 6 km, suitable for runners of different levels
Part of the Českolipsko District Running League
additional: The race is supported by local organizations. Results and race information are published regularly. The event has a long tradition and attracts runners from the surrounding area and across the country.

name: Podzimní běh projektantů "Od hospody k hospodě"
location: Krčský les, Praha 4-Krč, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Designers’ Autumn Run “From Pub to Pub” is a traditional running event held in the picturesque surroundings of Krč Forest in Prague 4-Krč. The race has been popular with runners for many years and welcomes everyone who enjoys running and nature. Organizers Pepa Krejčí and Honza Vočko warmly invite you to take part on this popular course, which offers an enjoyable experience in nature. Registration is open on race day, approximately one hour before the start.
course_highlights: The course runs through picturesque Krč Forest
A traditional running course popular with local runners
Pleasant natural surroundings in Prague 4-Krč
additional: Registration for the race is open on race day, approximately one hour before the start. A running course in Krč Forest; an event for designers and running enthusiasts.

name: Běh Karla Havlíčka Borovského
location: Havlíčkův Brod, Vysočina, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč online, 150 Kč na místě, zdarma pro mladší 17 let
