description: The Karel Havlíček Borovský Run is a traditional circuit race in Havlíčkův Brod, offering courses for different age groups, from the youngest children to adults. The route passes through Budoucnost Park and by landmarks such as the memorial to the victims of the world wars and the statue of Karel Havlíček Borovský. The race is suitable for all age groups and combines paved and unpaved paths with gentle elevation changes. The start and finish are at the primary school at V Sadech 560, where showers and toilets are also available.
course_highlights: Circuit route with a section through Budoucnost Park
Passes the memorial to the victims of the First and Second World Wars and the statue of Karel Havlíček Borovský
The highest point of the route is at Kalvárie, with its three crosses
additional: The start and finish are at the primary school at V Sadech 560. Showers and toilets are available in the school building. Parking is available at several locations nearby, some paid and some free. Runners aged 3 and over may take part. Participants aged 17 and under can enter for free. The event includes various age groups, with registration available online and on site. Parking is available nearby. Races take place at the Havlíčkův Brod Primary School and around the park.

name: PUMA Třeboňský půl/maraton 10 a 5 km
location: Třeboň, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Puma Třeboň Marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races take runners through the unique natural landscape of the Třeboňsko Protected Landscape Area. The routes are flat with minimal elevation gain and run mostly along paved cycling paths and forest trails, helping runners achieve personal bests in beautiful, peaceful surroundings. The race starts in Třeboň’s Renaissance square and passes through a historic gate into a nature reserve that is a candidate for UNESCO listing. The ideal October timing offers pleasant running weather and a motivating atmosphere, with professional pacers on the course.
course_highlights: Flat routes with minimal elevation gain in the protected natural area of Třeboňsko
Most of the course follows paved cycling paths and quality forest trails
Start in the Renaissance square and pass through a historic gate into a nature reserve that is a candidate for UNESCO listing
additional: Registration allows a refund of the entry fee until 8 September 2026, subject to a 150 Kč administrative fee, or transfer of the entry fee to the following year until 30 September 2026. After the race, participants can also receive a voucher worth 777 Kč toward the purchase of running shoes. The race has a participant limit, and transferring registration to another runner is not possible. The entry fee includes a free 12-month subscription to the Svět běhu magazine. Routes are available to download in .GPX format. The race includes a half marathon, 10 km and 5 km, is supported by regional authorities, and offers gift vouchers for purchase. The event takes place in October 2026.

name: Run Berounka Run
location: Újezd u Svatého Kříže, Plzeň-sever, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 3,300 Kč za tým; 800 Kč pro jednotlivce v kategorii Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné pro ročník 2026 je 3 300 Kč za tým.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pro jednotlivce v kategorii Ultra je startovné 800 Kč.

description: Run Berounka Run is a relay race for teams and individuals, following the Berounka River from Újezd u Svatého Kříže to Prague-Radotín. The 130 km route is divided into 6 legs, with over 3,100 metres of elevation gain, and runs mostly along forest and field paths. The race starts on 3 October 2026 from 5:00 in several waves; the Ultra category starts on the evening of 2 October. The race is open to teams of 2 to 6 runners and individuals in the Ultra category. Winners are announced in several categories, and refreshments are available at the finish.
course_highlights: 130 km route along the Berounka River, divided into 6 legs
Total elevation gain of 3,182 m, mostly on forest and field paths
Starts in Újezd u Svatého Kříže and finishes in Prague-Radotín, by the Říční Lázně kiosk
additional: Starts take place in waves from 5:00. The Ultra category starts on 2 October at 20:00 and at midnight. Teams have a 4-hour limit to complete each leg. Each team receives a race pack with bib numbers, a GPS chip and gifts from sponsors. Portable toilets are available at the relay points. Refreshments are available at the Říční Lázně kiosk at the finish. The maximum number of teams is 80; teams may have up to 6 runners, and the Ultra category is limited to 55 individuals. The race starts in Újezd u Svatého Kříže and finishes in Prague-Radotín. Registration is open from 1 November 2025 to 20 September 2026. The Ultra category starts on Friday evening. The route runs mostly along forest and field paths, with a total elevation gain of 3,182 m.

name: 24DS (24 Dlouhé Stráně)
location: Kouty nad Desnou, Jeseníky, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je stanoveno na 900,- Kč / účastník

description: 24DS is a 24-hour endurance challenge in the unique setting of the Hrubý Jeseník mountains, running from Kouty nad Desnou to the upper reservoir of the Dlouhé Stráně pumped-storage power plant. The race offers stunning views of the Jeseníky Mountains and combines daytime and night running with sunrise and sunset. The demanding route has 820 metres of elevation gain and is 90% trail, and is suitable for solo runners and pairs. The Kouty nad Desnou resort offers comfortable facilities, including restaurants, accommodation and parking.
course_highlights: 14.7 km loop with 820 m of elevation gain
90% trail surface
Views from the upper Dlouhé Stráně reservoir at an altitude of 1,354 m above sea level
additional: Registration runs from 1 May 2026 to 30 August 2026, or until capacity is reached. Every participant must have a GPS tracker, which is activated on race day during check-in. The race package includes a cable car voucher for viewing the course. Teammates in pairs may take turns as often as they like. Participants must follow the rules on the course and carry a working mobile phone. The organizer provides maps and marks the route with white spray paint and yellow course markers. At the finish, participants must return their chip and GPS tracker. The race takes place on 3 October 2026, offers accommodation options nearby, and is associated with support for MORAVA FLOW projects.

name: Běh kolem Hejtmanu
location: Chlum u Třeboně, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh kolem Hejtmanu is a traditional sporting event held in Chlum u Třeboně in the Třeboň region, always on the second Saturday in October. The main event is a 10 km race with a time limit of 1 hour and 20 minutes, running along local roads and pond dams through a picturesque setting. The race is open to the public and takes place amid normal road traffic, with an emphasis on safety and compliance with the rules. Shorter races are arranged for children and young people up to 15 years old, with on-site registration on race day. The event is organized by TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně, z.s.
course_highlights: The main race route crosses the dam of Hejtman Pond and the dam of Staňkovský Pond
The race follows local roads with picturesque views of the Třeboň region
The start and finish are at the TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně stadium
additional: Race-day registration takes place from 8:30 to 10:15 at the TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně stadium, where race numbers and timing chips are issued for the main 10 km race. Competitors participate at their own risk and must comply with road traffic regulations. Competitors under 18 must be accompanied by a legal guardian or provide a declaration from one. The race follows local roads and a cinder track; registration is available on-site or online. The start is at the stadium grounds, and races of varying distances are open to all age groups.

name: ČEZ RunTour Praha
location: Park Ladronka, Praha, Czech Republic
distance_verbose: Maraton, Půlmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: ČEZ RunTour Prague is a family-friendly running race offering courses for recreational runners and elite athletes over 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km, as well as children’s runs of 500 and 1,000 metres. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Ladronka Park and is part of a nationwide series spanning eight unique locations. The organizers focus on excellent service, safety and fun for the whole family, with an accompanying programme and a charitable dimension. Every participant receives a race pack and can support charity by taking part.
course_highlights: 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km courses in Ladronka Park
Children’s runs of 500 and 1,000 metres
Excellent service, including pacers and a medical team
additional: Pacers, a medical team and refreshment stations are available on the course (1 station for the 5 and 10 km races, at least 2 for the half marathon). Every runner receives a gymsack with gifts; children receive a race pack from Lidl. A children’s zone, warm-ups for children and an accompanying programme for families are available. A special emergency medical service phone line is set up for the race. More courses, family activities, charity support, medals, photos, refreshments and facilities for participants.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - říjen
location: Příluky, Zlín, Zlínský, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of less than two laps of a precisely measured asphalt loop. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and a 9:00 start. Every participant will be rewarded at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake for their effort.
course_highlights: Precisely measured 3.2 km (2-mile) asphalt loop
The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone
The children’s course is 800 m long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and over, and children aged 12 and under. Each runner is timed, and the top three finishers in the men’s, women’s, and children’s categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get to the start are by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates, or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). A regular monthly race, 3.2 km course, road surface, a run for all age groups, 800 m children’s course, access by bike, car, or trolleybus No. 11.

name: Běh na Čerťák
location: Flemmichova zahrada, Rýmařov, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: zdarma pro děti do 14 let, 150 Kč pro ostatní při online přihlášení, 200 Kč při prezenci na místě

price_tiers.distance: všechny kategorie mimo děti do 14 let

description: Běh na Čerťák is a traditional race organized by AK Běžci z Rýmařova, held in the grounds of Flemmich Garden in Rýmařov. The race offers courses for various age categories, from preschoolers to seniors, with the main route running along forest paths and over the summit of Kamenná hora. The race starts in the SKI Flemmich Garden grounds, and the course includes field tracks, meadows and forest trails with beautiful views. Refreshments are provided after the race, followed by the awards ceremony at the SKI grounds. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners, and category winners receive prizes.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the SKI Flemmich Garden grounds
Route over the summit of Kamenná hora (799 m above sea level), passing the Čerťák balancing rock
Forest and field paths with beautiful views
additional: Registration takes place at the facilities in the SKI grounds at Flemmich Garden from 9:30 to 10:30. Men’s categories D and E and all women run the shortened course. After the race, refreshments are provided: beer, soft drinks, coffee and tea. The awards ceremony takes place at the SKI grounds after all runners have finished. The course includes forest paths and meadows. Online registration is open until 3.10.2025. The start is in the SKI grounds at Flemmich Garden. The race takes place on 3 October 2026.

name: Benešovská osmička
location: Benešov u Semil, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Benešovská osmička is a traditional cross-country race in Benešov u Semil, held for more than half a century. The race offers courses for the whole family, from preschool children to veterans, with the main 8,000-meter race running through the picturesque countryside around the village and along the slopes of Benešov Hill. The start and race facilities are at the sports complex in Horní Benešov. Prizes are awarded, and light refreshments are available for all participants and spectators.
course_highlights: The main 8,000 m course runs mostly over meadows and farm and forest tracks of varying quality
Children’s courses follow paved paths within the sports complex
The area around the village and the slopes of Benešov Hill (567 m above sea level)
additional: Registration and check-in take place at the start venue from 12:30, no later than 15 minutes before the start of each category. The race is divided into categories: preschool children (50 and 100 m), youth (400–1,200 m), juniors, women, men, and veterans (2,250 m and 8,000 m courses). The first three finishers in each category receive prizes. Light refreshments are available for participants and spectators. Courses from 50 m to 8 km, a family event, refreshments, prizes.

name: Běh města Příbrami
location: Nový rybník, Příbram, Czech Republic
price_range: dospělí - předem 200 Kč, na místě 300 Kč; štafety - předem 400 Kč, na místě 600 Kč; děti a studenti zdarma; rodinné startovné 200 Kč
description: The Příbram City Run is a traditional running race, held for the 32nd year in the picturesque surroundings of Nový rybník in Příbram. The race offers various categories, including the 10 km main race, relays, and children’s races, welcoming a wide range of runners. The event is suitable for families, students, and individuals looking to enjoy a sporting day in a friendly atmosphere. Start times and check-in are tailored to the different categories to ensure everything runs smoothly and in an orderly manner.
course_highlights: 10 km main race in the natural surroundings of Nový rybník
Categories for children and adults, as well as family and student relays
Traditional race with a history of more than thirty years
additional: Check-in is from 8:00 to 10:30 for children and from 10:30 to 11:00 for adults. The schoolchildren’s category starts at 9:00; the 10 km main race and relays start at 11:30. Family relay teams must be made up of relatives. Student relay teams must consist of students from primary, secondary, or higher education institutions; student status may be checked at check-in. Starts from 8:00; the 10 km main race starts at 11:30; registration is from 8:00 to 10:30. Various categories, including relays and children’s races.

name: Mattoni Liberec Trail Run
location: Liberec, Jizerské hory, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Liberec Trail Run is a race in nature, offering runners the chance to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and enjoy running along forest trails in the Jizera Mountains. It is the final race of the season and leads through the forest, around a reservoir, through a granite quarry, and back. Runners can choose between a shorter 12 km route and a longer 22 km route, allowing them to test their strength amid beautiful natural scenery.
course_highlights: Forest trails in the Jizera Mountains
Running around the reservoir
Passing through a granite quarry
additional: The race takes place on 3 October 2026, with staggered starts from 10:00 to 12:15. Two routes are available: 12 km and 22 km. The event includes an accompanying program and a virtual package. The race is part of the RunCzech running league and is in its ninth year, with approximately 2,000 participants. The terrain includes forest trails. The race offers various categories, registration is possible using a code, and the race map is available in JPG/PNG and GPX formats. The event also includes family races.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - říjen
location: Stromovka Park, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open race for all ages and running levels. It’s for people who run for fun and want to improve their personal best or simply enjoy a pleasant run in a beautiful park. The course follows Stromovka’s paved paths. Adults run two laps (3.2 km), while children up to 12 years old run one lap (1.6 km). After the race, everyone gets a warm cinnamon pancake as a reward. The race is part of the year-round Lívancový pohár, which encourages regular participation and reflection on performance.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km); children run 1 lap (1.6 km)
A warm cinnamon pancake for all participants after the race
additional: Registration takes place at the Bruselská brána area from 8:15 to 8:45. Online pre-registration is available for faster check-in. Recommended ways to get there are by bike, on foot, by rollerblades, or by tram (Výstaviště stop). Parking is available by the bridge to Císařský ostrov on Za elektrárnou Street. Changing and bag-drop tents, a mobile valuables storage service, and toilet cabins are available. Categories are divided by age and gender, every participant is timed, and results are published online. Times adjusted using an age coefficient count toward the Lívancový pohár. The course is 3.2 km long and starts in Stromovka Park. Registration is available in advance or on site. The race is suitable for all age groups and running levels.

name: SILESIA kros 1/2marathon ZRUŠENO
location: Opava-Kylešovice, Opava, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: úhrada z Vašeho účtu k datu do 30. 9. 2025

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: úhrada z Vašeho účtu k datu do 30. 9. 2025

description: SILESIA Cross 1/2 Marathon is a traditional cross-country running race held in Opava-Kylešovice, with its hub at the U Chovatelů grounds. The race offers 21 km and 13 km courses that pass through scenic locations such as Raduň, Vršovice, Chvalíkovice, Hradec nad Moravicí, Branka and Opava. The course is challenging and partly follows roads open to traffic. Participants must follow fair-play rules and respect nature. Times are recorded electronically without chips, and the awards ceremony takes place at the finish area. The 2026 race has been cancelled, but information about previous editions and courses is available.
course_highlights: The route passes through Raduň, Vršovice, Chvalíkovice, Hradec nad Moravicí, Branka and Opava
The race takes place on roads open to traffic, with electronic timekeeping and no chips
Course changes have been made because of fenced private property; the 21 km course does not go to Raduň Chateau
additional: Race-day registration takes place at the race centre on Friday from 17:00 to 19:00 and on Saturday from 7:30 to 9:00. The start is at the sports field behind the primary school in Raduň, and the finish is at the U Chovatelů grounds in Opava-Kylešovice. The race takes place on roads open to traffic, and participants run at their own risk. Times are recorded electronically without chips. Because there are few entrants in the shorter races, the 750 m, 1,500 m, 3 km and 5 km races start directly at the finish area. The course is marked year-round, with additional temporary markings and course marshals provided for race day. From 1 October 2025, entry fees increase to 350 CZK for 21 km, 250 CZK for 13 km and 150 CZK for the shorter distances. If the entry fee is paid by 26 September, participants can have their name printed on their race number. Registration usually takes place in October. The event offers various distances and is known for its distinctive cross-country terrain. In the past, course changes have been made because of private property.

name: Běh zámeckým parkem
location: Zámecký park ve Vlašimi, Vlašim, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run Through the Chateau Park is a race through the picturesque grounds of Vlašim Chateau Park. The 8.4 km course combines off-road and paved sections, offering runners a varied experience. The race is organized by Atletika Vlašim, z.s., and is included in the official Czech Running calendar. It is suitable for runners looking to enjoy a run in a beautiful park with a historic atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs through Vlašim Chateau Park
A combination of off-road and paved sections
Course length: 8.4 km
additional: The race is part of a running series and offers various course lengths, including off-road and paved sections.

name: Z(a)tracené vrchy
location: Bordovice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Z(a)tracené vrchy is an adrenaline-fueled orienteering, beer-drinking running, walking and crawling race for teams, held in the scenic terrain of Bordovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. Competitors must complete the course carrying a 10-litre keg of beer on their backs, take part in mini-games at checkpoints and drink beer at the checkpoints. The race combines a physical challenge with teamwork and fun, with a route through varied terrain featuring climbs and descents. The winning team receives a travelling trophy and gift packages. The event is for adults over 18 and emphasises participant safety and responsibility.
course_highlights: The course runs through varied terrain with climbs and descents
Complete the course carrying a 10-litre keg of beer on your back
Five checkpoints with mini-games and beer drinking
additional: Mandatory gear includes a charged phone, a tap (bayonet fitting), a pump, a keg harness, a rubbish bag and a headlamp. Recommended gear includes a basic first-aid kit, water and nutritious food. Beer may be consumed only at checkpoints, where it is served from a single competition vessel in portions of max. 0.5 l. Keg collection takes place from 7:30 to 7:35 at the start location. The race is for competitors over 18 who sign a declaration accepting personal responsibility. The use of transport is prohibited, except for trekking poles. The event is part of an ultratrail series, with results from 2024 available, and is aimed at experienced runners seeking a challenge in demanding terrain.

name: Běh Pístovickou riviérou
location: Pístovice, Vyškov, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Pístovická Riviera Run is a traditional cross-country race along forest roads above the Pístovická Riviera recreational area in Pístovice near Vyškov. The race is open to everyone who enjoys healthy exercise, from children to adults, and takes place in all weather conditions. The course is uneven, with possible puddles and mud, and includes running and walking uphill and downhill. The organizers from the Vyškov Ski Club warmly invite runners and spectators to take part and support sport in the region.
course_highlights: Forest roads above the Pístovická Riviera recreational area
Uneven terrain with possible puddles and mud
Cross-country course with uphill and downhill sections
additional: The course is not closed, and participants must follow the organizers’ instructions. The race takes place regardless of the weather; only extreme conditions may result in postponement or cancellation. Runners under 15 must be accompanied by someone over 18. Participants under 18 must have written consent from a legal guardian. The race number must be worn visibly on the chest. Skates, bicycles, trekking poles, and taking shortcuts are prohibited. The race is open to all age groups and offers a varied program, refreshments, and activities for children. The event is supported by the City of Vyškov and Lesy České republiky, s.p.

name: Cibulka - Košířský okruh
location: Praha 5-Košíře, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Cibulka - Košířský okruh is a popular running race held in Prague’s Košíře district, offering a course approximately 4.5 km long. The race is part of a series of local running events and is intended both for recreational runners and for those looking to improve their performance in a natural setting. The course follows forest roads and trails around the Cibulka lookout tower, providing a pleasant and varied setting for running. The event is suitable for all ages and running levels, with an emphasis on the joy of exercising outdoors.
course_highlights: An approximately 4.5 km course featuring forest roads and trails
Natural surroundings near the Cibulka lookout tower in Prague 5
Open to both recreational and competitive runners
additional: The race takes place in Prague 5-Košíře, with the start near the 'U lesíka' stop.

name: Běh za bořetickým burčákem
location: Bořetice, South Moravia, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč / 6 EUR pro hlavní závod, zdarma pro mládežnické kategorie
description: The Run for Bořetice Burčák is a traditional sporting event held in the picturesque wine-growing village of Bořetice, in the heart of the Blue Mountains. The run gives participants the chance to experience the beautiful landscape of vineyards and wine cellars characteristic of this part of South Moravia. The event is organized by the Bořetice Municipal Cultural Commission, SDH Bořetice, and the Republic of Kraví hora, and is part of the village’s rich cultural calendar. The run is scheduled to start in the afternoon on October 3, 2026, at Sólo by the cultural centre.
course_highlights: The route passes through the picturesque wine-growing countryside of Bořetice and Kraví hora
Surroundings of wine cellars and fertile vineyards
Start and finish by the cultural centre in Bořetice
additional: The event is organized by the Bořetice Municipal Cultural Commission, SDH Bořetice, and the Republic of Kraví hora. The start is at Sólo by the cultural centre. Bořetice has a rich cultural and sporting programme, complemented by other events throughout the year. The race takes place on asphalt; registration opens at 13:20. There is a bouncy castle for children, and after the race participants can taste burčák and local specialities.

name: OLFINCAR HRADECKÝ PŮL/MARATON
location: Malšovický stadion, Hradec Králové, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: OLFINCAR Hradec Half Marathon is the largest sporting event in Eastern Bohemia and has been held since 2013. The event offers certified courses for the marathon, half marathon, relay, 10 km race and children’s races. The course is among the fastest in the Czech Republic and is considered one of the most beautiful urban courses. In 2026, the event will also host the Czech Veterans’ Half Marathon Championships and the Czech Championships for Emergency and Security Services in the half marathon. The facilities at the new football arena in the city centre provide runners with comfortable services.
course_highlights: Certified courses with a fast profile
The course is among the fastest in the Czech Republic
Facilities at the new football arena in the centre of Hradec Králové
additional: Start times: 11:15 (marathon), 12:30 (half marathon and 10 km), 12:40 (charity run). Facilities include changing rooms, luggage storage, toilets, catering, parking and clothing sales. The race package includes an original medal, a gift, a race number and an electronic timing chip. Refreshments are provided during the race and at the finish. Photos and a downloadable certificate are available (a photo is not guaranteed for every participant). There is an accompanying programme and prizes for 1st–3rd place in the categories. Races include the half marathon, marathon, 10 km and children’s races, with a limit of 3,500 runners, chip timing and certified courses.

name: Horský běh Alfrédka - Memoriál Miroslava Čermáka
location: Stará Ves u Rýmařova, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Alfrédka Mountain Run – Miroslav Čermák Memorial is a race run mainly on forest roads, covering 13.6 km with 430 m of elevation gain. It is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Endurance Runners and the Czech Cup in Mountain Running. The challenging course winds through the beautiful countryside of the Moravian-Silesian Region, appealing to fans of mountain running and endurance events. The race takes place in Stará Ves near Rýmařov and is suitable for experienced runners looking for an off-road challenge.
course_highlights: 13.6 km course, mainly on forest roads
430 m of elevation gain
Part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Endurance Runners and the Czech Cup in Mountain Running
additional: The race is part of running series and cups. It takes place on October 4, 2026.

name: Běh okolo Panoramy
location: Jáchymov, Krušné hory, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Panorama is a traditional cross-country race on challenging mountain terrain around the Jáchymov football stadium. The race is open to all age groups and is being held for the 33rd year. The event is organised by the Jáchymov Physical Education Union and offers sporting activities in the beautiful setting of the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain terrain around the TJ Jáchymov football stadium
Traditional cross-country race with a long history (33rd edition)
Suitable for all age groups
additional: The race starts at the TJ Jáchymov football pitch. The event is open to the general public and all age groups. The race takes place on challenging mountain terrain in the Ore Mountains around Jáchymov. It is suitable for all age groups; registration is not explicitly mentioned, and the course runs through the mountain terrain around Jáchymov.

name: Běh údolím Orlice
location: Klášterec nad Orlicí, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Tělovýchovná jednota Sokol Klášterec nad Orlicí

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: nejmladší, mladší, starší žactvo a dorost 50 Kč

description: The Run through the Orlice Valley is a traditional cross-country race held in Klášterec nad Orlicí. Its courses follow meadows and local roads over hilly terrain. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and adults. Winners can look forward to medals, prizes in kind and cash prizes. The start and finish are at the football pitch by the school, and the main race starts in the morning.
course_highlights: Cross-country courses on meadows and local roads
3 km loop with 60 m of elevation gain
A mix of flat and hilly sections on grass and dirt tracks
additional: On-site registration from 8:30. The main race starts at 11:15. Prizes for winners include diplomas, medals, prizes in kind and cash prizes for the best runners in the 6 km and 9 km races. The 9 km course consists of three 3 km loops, and the 6 km course consists of two loops. The 3 km loop has 60 m of elevation gain. Hilly terrain, trail/cross-country, various course distances, on-site registration, refreshments and a draw of race numbers

name: Slatinský kros
location: Park Terénky, Dědická, Brno-Slatina, Brno, Czech Republic
description: Slatinský kros is a traditional cross-country running race held in Brno-Slatina, now in its 19th year. The race takes place in Terénky Park on Dědická Street and features a grassy course with a rolling profile that challenges runners in pleasant natural surroundings. It is held under the patronage of the Brno-Slatina Municipal District and is suitable for the general public. Participants can look forward to trophies, medals, and valuable prizes.
course_highlights: Grassy course with a rolling profile
Terénky Park in Brno-Slatina
Cross-country running in natural surroundings
additional: Prizes include trophies, medals, and valuable prizes. Online registration will open in summer 2026. The race is held under the patronage of the Brno-Slatina Municipal District. The race offers trophies, medals, and prizes; registration is available online, and the course runs through Terénky Park in Brno-Slatina.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - říjen
location: Smetanovy sady, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Olomouc 2 Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The event focuses on the joy of running and competing primarily against yourself. It takes place in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc by the fountain, except for some races in June and August, which are held by the river. The race is part of a cup competition, where results are adjusted using an age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year.
course_highlights: 2-mile (3.2 km) course, with a 600 m children’s category
Race venue: Smetana Gardens in Olomouc by the fountain
Races by the river on U Dětského domova Street in June and August
additional: Registration takes place from 9:30 to 10:00 on race day. The top three places are announced in each category. Results are adjusted using an age coefficient, and points are accumulated as part of the cup competition for the period September 2025 to August 2026. The course follows paved paths in Smetana Gardens; registration is voluntary, and the race takes place on 4 October 2026. A 600 m children’s race is also included.

name: Roštejnské stráně
location: Ranč u Lipek, Telč, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Roštejnské stráně is a traditional cross-country race organized by Orel Telč and part of the Orel Running League. This 14th edition takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Ranč u Lipek in Telč and offers various race categories, including family relays and a recreational run for beginners. The race is open to all age groups and emphasizes fair play and sportsmanship. Medals, diplomas, and prizes are prepared for the winners, along with special awards for the youngest and oldest runners.
course_highlights: Start at Ranč u Lipek in Telč
Cross-country race on natural terrain
Part of the Orel Running League
additional: Categories include children’s races, family relays (teams of 3, including one child aged 12 or under), and a recreational run for beginners over 18. Start times are approximate and fall between 12:30 and 13:20; participants are advised to arrive at least half an hour before their start. Each runner participates at their own risk and is responsible for their health. The race is part of the Orel Running League; start times are between 12:30 and 13:20, and the event emphasizes fair play and sportsmanship.

name: Běh kolem Lužnice
location: TJ Lokomotiva stadion, Veselí nad Lužnicí, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around the Lužnice is a traditional running race organized by the Atletika Veselí athletics club in Veselí nad Lužnicí. The race offers runners of all ages a unique opportunity to enjoy the beautiful countryside and sporting atmosphere at the TJ Lokomotiva stadium. The club has a long-standing commitment to athletics and running races, with an emphasis on high-quality organization and a friendly atmosphere. The race is suitable for experienced runners, beginners, and children alike.
course_highlights: The route runs around the Lužnice amid beautiful natural scenery
Start and finish at the TJ Lokomotiva stadium in Veselí nad Lužnicí
Friendly atmosphere and support from the Atletika Veselí athletics club
additional: Athletics training takes place outdoors at the stadium according to the spring schedule. Parking is available in the TJ Lokomotiva sports complex. The club also offers club caps and headbands for sale. Payments and registration are handled electronically through club membership. The race is open to all age groups, with registration available via the website. The start is at the TJ Lokomotiva stadium, and runners can choose between the 8.09 km and 5.67 km courses.

name: Huť - Bratříkov - Huť
location: Huti, Jablonec nad Nisou, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: Huť-Bratříkov-Huť is a traditional cross-country race held every year on the first Sunday in October in Huť, near Jablonec nad Nisou. The race, which dates back to 1972, features a 10 km main race and shorter distances for various age groups. The course runs through picturesque countryside, with a grass field serving as the start and finish venue. The event is suitable for runners of all ages, from children to adults, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: 10 km main race through picturesque countryside
Traditionally held on the first Sunday in October
Start and finish on the grass field by the fire station in Huť
additional: Entries and race bibs are handled at the start venue. Children’s races register from 08:10 to 09:00; other categories register from 08:10 until 15 minutes before their start. The program begins with a group assembly at 09:10. Categories include preschool children, youth, unregistered men and women, and the 10 km main race. The event takes place on the first Sunday in October on the grass field by the fire station in Huť, with online registration available. The course is highly undulating and follows mainly forest and meadow paths, making it suitable for trail runners.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Tetín
location: Hospůdka u Plotice, Tetín, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 240 Kč (voucher na 12 závodů), 316 Kč (voucher na 6 závodů)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 240 Kč (v rámci voucheru na celou sérii 12 závodů)

description: The Berounka - Tetín running series is a community trail race held on October 5, 2026, in the picturesque surroundings of Tetín. The route runs over hills and offers stunning views of the Bohemian Karst and the surrounding countryside, including a climb to the viewpoint overlooking Beroun. The race is part of a series of 12 runs that encourage runners of all levels to get active outdoors in a friendly atmosphere, with facilities at local pubs. Refreshments, baggage storage, and prizes for the top finishers in each category are available on site.
course_highlights: The route crosses Damil Hill, with views of Tetín and the Bohemian Karst
The highest point is near the village of Na Koledníku, followed by a mostly downhill route
A picturesque viewpoint overlooking Beroun and the surrounding countryside comes before the final descent to the finish
additional: The route is marked with red-and-white and yellow reflective markings, as well as red arrows on the ground. Refreshments and baggage storage are available on site. Bringing a headlamp is recommended. The first three finishers in each category receive a certificate and medals. This trail race has a marked route and starts at Hospůdka u Plotice. It features hilly terrain and beautiful views. Registration is via voucher. Refreshments and baggage storage are available on site; bringing a headlamp is recommended.

name: Mrdická mašina
location: Heřmanův Městec, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Mrdická Mašina is a fast 2.0 km run across the Mrdice meadows in Heřmanův Městec. The race is part of the Heřmanův Městec Sports League, which includes ten athletics and cycling races around the Mrdice fortress site. The race is open to the general public and offers a fun sporting challenge for all runners. It is organized by Běžecký klub Heřmanův Městec, which promotes running and sports activities in the region.
course_highlights: 2.0 km run across the Mrdice meadows
Part of the Heřmanův Městec Sports League, with 10 races
Around the historic Mrdice fortress site
additional: The race is for all running enthusiasts. Registration is available in the race information, and the course runs across meadows and forest paths around Heřmanův Městec.

name: Roštejnskou oborou
location: Růžená, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: The Run through Roštejn Game Preserve is a friendly race for the general public, held in the scenic forests near Růžená in the Vysočina Region. The course follows forest paths and is suitable for all ages from 4 upwards, with distances ranging from 300 metres to 8,900 metres. The event is part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup and offers a unique opportunity to run in nature and observe local wildlife. It is organised by TJ Růžená, z.s., and is ideal for families and sports enthusiasts who want to combine sport with nature.
course_highlights: Forest terrain with opportunities to observe local wildlife
Distances from 300 m to 8,900 m, suitable for all age groups
Part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup, ideal for families and sports enthusiasts
additional: The race takes place on 9 October 2026 near Růžená. The main race is 7.3 km long, follows forest paths and is suitable for all age groups from 4 upwards.

name: Pražský Kelt
location: Praha 4-Kunratice, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Pražský Kelt is a unique 100 km ultra trail in the heart of Prague, offering runners the chance to discover beautiful natural surroundings and Celtic hillforts, with a total elevation gain of 2,500 metres. The route passes through Prague’s wooded, hilly landscape and includes historic sites such as the Šance, Butovice, Závist and Vyšehrad hillforts, as well as others. It offers beautiful views of the city and surrounding nature. The race starts and finishes at the grounds of Kunratice Elementary School and is for runners who want to experience the atmosphere of an ultramarathon in an unconventional urban setting. The race is limited to 120 participants, ensuring an intimate and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 100 km course with 2,500 m of elevation gain through Prague’s wooded hills
A route linking three Celtic hillforts and historic sites in Prague
Beautiful views of Prague from Vyšehrad, Branické skály and other places
additional: The start and finish are at the grounds of Kunratice Elementary School. The race is limited to 120 participants. Take bus 193 from Kačerov station to Kunratická škola (12 minutes). Parking is available around the school. Mandatory equipment is specified in the race rules (section 3.3). The route for the new edition is emailed to registered participants. Aid stations are provided as part of the race and are highly appreciated by participants. The course is 100 km with 2,500 m of elevation gain; aid stations; the option of a distance race; a diploma and medal; registration until 30.9.2026; capacity of 120 participants.

name: Cena Metuje
location: Nové Město nad Metují, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
organizer: Sportovní klub Nové Město nad Metují z.s.
price_range: 300-500 Kč pro dospělé, zdarma pro členy SK Nové Město nad Metují

tiers.description: 75,- Kč při přihlášení on-line do středy 8.10. 2025, 23:59 hod.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 100,- Kč při přihlášení on-line do soboty 11.10. do 8:00 hod.

description: Cena Metuje is a traditional 10 km road race held in Nové Město nad Metují as part of the PRIMÁTOR CUP running series. This 65th edition also features races for children in various age categories. The route follows an asphalt road through the Metuje River valley to Peklo and back, offering a pleasant yet challenging running experience. The event is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children, parents and grandparents, who can earn points in the series. Winners are recognized in both the children’s categories and the main race, with cash and non-cash prizes.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course through the Metuje River valley
The route follows an asphalt road to Peklo and back
Supporting children’s races over various distances from 100 m to 1,700 m
additional: Registration is online only at sportchallenge.cz, including on race day until 8:00. The race office opens at 8:00 on race day at the sokolovna in Nové Město nad Metují. Members of SK Nové Město nad Metují can enter for free. Children can earn points in the PRIMÁTOR CUP series and receive participation rewards. Children’s races are scheduled by category from 9:00 to 10:30; the main race starts at 10:45. Winners are announced at 10:45 (children’s categories) and 12:00 (main race). The event is part of the Primátor Cup 2025 series and the Velká cena východních Čech, includes various age categories, and offers prizes and certificates.

name: VOKOLO priglu
location: Brněnská přehrada, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Brněnský klub běžeckých a sportovních aktivit z.s.
price_range: early bird ceny do konce roku 2025, přesné ceny nejsou specifikovány
description: Vokolo priglu is a traditional running race around the Brno Reservoir, taking place on 10 October 2026. The race offers a unique sporting experience on a 14.1 km course, approximately one third of a marathon. The course is gently undulating, mostly on asphalt with a section of rocky surface, and offers beautiful views of the Brno Sea, Veveří Castle and autumn forests. The race is open to individuals, pairs in the steamboat relay, teams of four, companies and universities, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: A 14.1 km course around the Brno Reservoir
A gently undulating course with 85% asphalt and 15% rocky surface
Views of the Brno Sea, Veveří Castle and the autumn Podkomorské Forests
additional: The main race starts in waves, timing is chip-based using a chip attached to the race bib, and the time limit is 2.5 hours. Facilities include a sports EXPO, an accompanying program for adults and children, changing rooms, portable toilets, a baggage drop, refreshments, and medical services on the course and in the start and finish area. Gift vouchers are sent electronically as PDF files. The race offers various categories, the option to buy official race merchandise, and an environmentally friendly approach with electronic vouchers.

name: Běh Borským parkem
location: Borský park, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Běh Borským parkem is a traditional autumn sporting event in Plzeň, with a history dating back to 1970. The race is open to both beginner recreational runners and experienced athletes of all ages. It offers excitement at the starting line, the thrill of the race atmosphere, and the joy of crossing the finish line. The organizers provide a welcoming race environment and homemade refreshments for all participants.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Borský Park in Plzeň
A traditional autumn running event with a history dating back to 1970
A friendly atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners of all ages
additional: Registration is available in advance until 10. 10. 2024 at a discounted entry fee on nazavody.cz. On-site registration is available on race day, 12. 10. 2024, from 8:30 to 9:45. The organizers provide homemade refreshments for runners. Race in Borský Park; registration: https://www.nazavody.cz/zavod/565-beh-borskym-parkem; start from 8:30 to 9:45

name: Běhej lesy Lednice
location: Lednice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Běhej lesy Lednice is part of a popular running series offering races in the Czech Republic’s most beautiful natural locations. The Lednice race takes place in the picturesque Lednice-Valtice Cultural Landscape, where runners pass through the château park, around ponds, and by iconic landmarks such as the Temple of the Three Graces and Apollo’s Temple. The courses suit runners of different abilities and include the shorter Nova 14 km and the longer ČSOB 21 km, both with an international UTMB Index. The race also features speed-section competitions and an attractive finish straight, providing extra motivation for participants.
course_highlights: Courses pass through the Lednice-Valtice Cultural Landscape, by landmarks such as the Temple of the Three Graces and Apollo’s Temple
The 150-metre Conti Speed Section, marked with Continental flags
The 500-metre Generali Investments Finish straight, with a timed section
additional: The race features the Conti Speed Section—a 150 m speed section with Continental flags—and the Generali Investments Finish—a 500 m finish straight with a timed section. The fastest man and woman will receive a technical running shirt from Craft. Participants are advised to collect their race numbers at least 90 minutes before the start. The event offers various course distances from 3 to 50 km, is suitable for families and children, and includes a charity run and partnerships with major companies such as Continental and ČSOB.

name: Hradčanské vlnky
location: Hradčany u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Hradčanské vlnky is a traditional cross-country trail race in Hradčany near Olomouc, offering three main distances: 5.6 km, 10.4 km, and a 21.1 km half marathon. The race focuses on off-road running, predominantly on forest and field paths, making it both appealing and challenging. Children’s categories with various distances are also included. Runners are provided with refreshments, chip timing, and extensive facilities, including showers. The atmosphere is friendly, and the race is suitable for a wide range of runners, from children to experienced trail runners.
course_highlights: Main 10.4 km course with approximately 260 m of elevation gain; 5% asphalt, 25% field paths, and 70% forest roads and trails
21.1 km half marathon with approximately 505 m of elevation gain; a combination of asphalt, field paths, and rocky trails, with the second half off-road
Short 5.6 km course with approximately 155 m of elevation gain; a fast, technical blue route
additional: Registration for children’s races opens at 8:30; the main races start at 9:45. The half marathon starts at 11:00 from the recreation area; the main 10.4 km course and the short 5.6 km course start from the town square. The entry fee includes race organization, facilities, showers, food, beer/soft drinks, chip timing, a race bib, on-course refreshments, and refreshments after finishing. Parking is organized by volunteers, with an emphasis on following traffic regulations and being considerate of Hradčany residents. The race offers various categories, including children’s categories, and features an extensive accompanying program and a raffle.

name: Podzimní běh Olympu
location: Stromovka, Praha 7, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Olymp Autumn Run is a traditional running race organized by the Olymp Prague Police Sports Club. It takes place in the scenic surroundings of Stromovka Park in Prague 7. The race offers runners of all levels the chance to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and a sporting challenge in a pleasant city park. The event is open to the general public and promotes team spirit and an active lifestyle. The organizers welcome all participants and provide support during registration and the race.
course_highlights: Run in Stromovka Park, Prague 7
Scenic urban setting with natural views
Traditional autumn running event with a friendly atmosphere
additional: The run takes place in the Stromovka grounds. Online registration is available at results.bezeckenadeje.cz

name: Benešovský půlmaratón a desítka Pojizeřím
location: Podmošně, Benešov u Semil, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Benešov Half Marathon and 10K through the Pojizeří is a traditional running race set in the picturesque village of Benešov u Semil in the Liberec Region. The race offers half-marathon and 10-kilometer courses through the beautiful countryside of the Pojizeří, with varied terrain. It is organized by TJ Benešov u Semil, which provides a friendly atmosphere and light refreshments for runners and spectators. The race is suitable for runners of all abilities and is part of the village’s sporting activities.
course_highlights: The courses wind through the scenic countryside of the Pojizeří, along forest and field paths
The half-marathon course features elevation changes and views of the hills around Benešov
The 10K offers a faster run on a mix of asphalt and forest paths
additional: The race venue is at the sports complex in upper Benešov. Registration and check-in take place at the start venue from 12:30, no later than 15 minutes before the start of each category. Light refreshments are available for runners and spectators. The race is organized by TJ Benešov u Semil z.s., with support from the village of Benešov u Semil. Events include a half marathon, a 10K, and a non-competitive 10 km route. They take place in October 2026, with the start in Podmošno.

name: Běh Bukovem
location: Plískov, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh Bukovem is an annual running festival held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Bukov and Plískov as part of the Brdy Running Cup. The race takes place entirely on meadows, forest roads and trails, offering runners an enjoyable experience in nature. The event is suitable for a wide range of age groups, from the youngest children to veterans. It is organised by the municipality of Plískov in cooperation with Farma Ekl and is known for its friendly atmosphere and tradition.
course_highlights: The course runs through the meadows, forest roads and trails around Bukov and Plískov
A range of distances for children and adults, from 100 m to 8,250 m
Start and finish at the playground by the swimming pool in Plískov
additional: Participant registration takes place on the terrace of the pub in Plískov from 9:00 to 10:50. Starts are staggered by category, from 10:05 (youngest children) to 11:21 (women, juniors and veterans). Winners in the children’s categories are announced throughout the event, while winners in the other categories are announced after the race. Participants are asked to follow Covid precautions; disinfectant is available at the start. Runners with no health restrictions take part at their own risk. The race takes place in October. The course is mainly through forest and meadows, with online registration available and different race distances offered during the year.

name: Kašavský kros
location: Kašava, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 400 CZK dospělí, 200 CZK junioři, 50 CZK děti
description: Kašavský kros is a traditional off-road running race in the area around Kašava, offering two main routes for runners aged 16 and over, as well as children’s races. The race takes place on Saturday, October 10, 2026, and is known for its established route with hills and a friendly atmosphere. It is organized by the VALACHBAJK TEAM KAŠAVA association in cooperation with the local municipality and school. The children’s races take place after the main races finish and are divided into several age categories, with different course distances.
course_highlights: Main course: 16.6 km with 679 m of elevation gain
Short course: 8 km with 254 m of elevation gain
Children’s races with courses from 100 to 1,300 m
additional: Children can register only in person on race day. Registration opens at 10:30; registration for the long course closes at 11:30; the long course starts at 12:00 and the short course at 12:30. The children’s races start from 14:30. The organizer limits the number of adult participants to 200. After the race, winners are presented with awards and a raffle is held. Terrain: trail. Registration: online and in person. The event includes children’s races and the main adult courses.

name: MUTRAverz - Mikulovský Ultra Trail Run (2)
location: Mikulov, Krušné hory, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Mikulovský Ultra Trail Run, z. s.
description: MUTRAverz is an extreme ultratrail race held in the Ore Mountains, specifically in Mikulov and its surroundings. The race is intended for experienced runners looking for a challenging course in beautiful countryside on waymarked hiking trails. The organizers emphasize safety, fair play, and high-quality event support. The race is suitable for runners over 18 who are physically and mentally prepared for extreme conditions. We look forward to seeing you at the next edition on October 10, 2026.
course_highlights: Extreme ultratrail in the Ore Mountains
Waymarked hiking trails in the Mikulov countryside
Challenging terrain suitable for experienced runners
additional: The race is open only to people over 18. Participants must be physically and mentally fit and are required to follow the race rules and safety measures. The organizer is not responsible for trail conditions or any health complications. Runners consent to audiovisual recording of their performance for the purpose of promoting the race. A trail race with courses of over 50 km and 16 km, suitable for both experienced and recreational runners; the event supports athletic performance in nature.

name: Rybský trhák
location: Rybí, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Rybský trhák is a road race organised by Atletický klub Emila Zátopka Kopřivnice in cooperation with the municipality of Rybí and TJ Sokol Rybí. The race is 7 km long with 135 metres of elevation gain and is open to various age categories for both men and women. The start is at the TJ Sokol Rybí football pitch, where changing rooms and showers are available. Refreshments are provided at the finish, along with prizes for the top runners in each category, including an award for the oldest participant and the best runner from the municipality of Rybí.
course_highlights: 7 km course
135 m elevation gain
Start and finish at the TJ Sokol Rybí football pitch
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available. Refreshments and a tasty treat are provided at the finish. Prizes are awarded to the first three runners in each category, as well as to the oldest participant and the best runner from the municipality of Rybí. The race takes place on 10 October 2026, with the start at 11:00. Registration is at the football pitch in Rybí. Runners can expect refreshments and prizes for category winners.

name: Běh pro Kleofáše
location: Lázeňský park Aurora, Třeboň, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh pro Kleofáše is a traditional charity run held in the spa park in Třeboň, supporting the local hospice. Participants can choose from several categories, from short children’s races to a 12-kilometre run around Svět Pond. Less experienced runners can enjoy a pleasant four-kilometre route, and there is also a relay for two or four runners. The event offers a varied programme of activities for children and is part of Hospice Week.
course_highlights: A beautiful natural route around Svět Pond
A pleasant four-kilometre route for other runners
A 4 km relay for two or four runners
additional: Registration opens at 9:00, and participants can also sign up on the day of the event. Children’s races are divided by age, with distances of 200 m, 450 m and 1 km. Results are announced in stages after the children’s races and the 4 km and 12 km races. The event is part of Hospice Week. Routes range in length from 200 m to 12 km, with forest paths, asphalt and trails and gentle or flat elevation. Registration is available via an online form or on site. The start is at Lázeňský park Aurora.

name: Malá cena Špindlerova Mlýna
location: Městský úřad ve Špindlerově Mlýně, Špindlerův Mlýn, Krkonoše, Czech Republic
description: The Malá cena Špindlerova Mlýna is a traditional 34th edition of a hill race held as part of the Czech Cup. The race starts at the Municipal Office in Špindlerův Mlýn and offers a challenging 14 km course with 901 metres of elevation gain. It is ideal for hill-running enthusiasts who want to test themselves in the beautiful mountain setting of the Krkonoše.
course_highlights: Course distance: 14 km
Elevation gain: 901 m
Start at the Municipal Office in Špindlerův Mlýn
additional: The race is part of the Czech Cup running series. The organisers call for the protection of the Krkonoše nature. The race offers various categories for men and women. Registration is available at www.jktiming.cz. It is known for its challenging course and the beauty of the surrounding Krkonoše nature.

name: Červený okruh
location: Termit, Doksy, Liberec District, Czech Republic
description: The Červený okruh in Doksy is a traditional race in the Českolipsko District Running League, taking place on October 10, 2026. The race gives runners the chance to test themselves on an interesting course in the natural surroundings of Termit in Doksy. The event is part of a series of regional running races and attracts both the general public and experienced athletes. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and quality facilities for all participants.
course_highlights: Natural terrain at Termit, Doksy
Part of the Českolipsko District Running League
Traditional autumn running race with a history
additional: The race takes place at the Termit complex in Doksy. The course runs through woodland. Registration is available on site or by email. The race is suitable for various age groups.

name: Bašťanská šestka
location: Baška, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Bašťanská šestka is a traditional running race held in the picturesque setting of the Baška Reservoir in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The race is organized by Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, z.s., which has long been dedicated to athletics and supporting sporting activities in the region. The event is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in beautiful natural surroundings. Both experienced runners and recreational athletes are welcome to register and take part.
course_highlights: The race takes place on a route around the Baška Reservoir
Picturesque natural surroundings in the Moravian-Silesian Region
A traditional running event organized by the Slezan Frýdek-Místek athletics club
additional: The race is held on a road circuit around the Baška Reservoir, with the start scheduled for 11:00. The event is suitable for all age groups and also offers races for children.

name: Svatováclavský běh - Tyreto RUN
location: Děčín, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: libovolná cena (dobrovolný příspěvek od 250 Kč do 1000 Kč pro první desítku registrujících)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.price: libovolná částka od 250 Kč do 1000 Kč
tiers.description: Startovné je libovolné v rozmezí 250 až 1000 Kč, výtěžek jde na charitu

description: The Svatováclavský běh Tyreto RUN 2026 is a charity running race taking place on October 10 in Děčín. The race offers courses for men, women, and children, including a family run, and supports people with multiple sclerosis through proceeds from entry fees. Participants can enjoy a sporting experience while supporting a good cause. The first ten people to register will receive a discount on Tyreto tire purchases.
course_highlights: A traditional running race in Děčín
Courses for all age groups: 2.5 km, 5 km, 12 km, and 21 km
A charitable purpose supporting Domov svatého Josefa
additional: The first ten registered participants who pay an entry fee of 250 to 1,000 Kč will receive a voucher for a discount on Tyreto tire purchases equal to the amount of their entry fee. 5 km, 12 km, and 21 km routes; races in Děčín; charity support; music and accompanying program

name: Borský kros
location: Doleček, Machov, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Borský Cross-Country Race is a traditional running race organized by the Borský Club of Skiers Machov in the scenic Doleček cross-country skiing area in the Hradec Králové Region. The course offers a range of difficulty levels, from gentle, sustained climbs suitable for families with children to challenging, hilly and steep profiles for experienced runners. The race is part of the club’s varied sporting activities and takes place in beautiful natural surroundings with quality facilities. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and a quality sporting experience for all participants.
course_highlights: The Doleček cross-country skiing area offers different types of courses, from gentle to very hilly and steep profiles
Scenic natural surroundings near Machov in the Hradec Králové Region
Quality facilities and a long tradition of the organizer, the Borský Club of Skiers Machov
additional: The Doleček cross-country skiing area offers courses suitable for families with children as well as challenging runners. The Machov area also has the Hůrka ski-jumping complex, with certified hills for summer use. The club has new facilities following the renovation of the unit beneath the ski-jumping hills, funded by a grant from the SZIF program. The race takes place in Doleček, near the ski area, with results available online. Registration details are not specified.

name: Podzimní přespolní běh - Memoriál Jiřího Bláhy
location: Koupaliště Nové Město na Moravě, Nové Město na Moravě, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: The Autumn Cross-Country Run – Jiří Bláha Memorial is a traditional race that has been held since 1986, and this year marks its 39th edition. The race takes place at the swimming pool complex in Nové Město na Moravě, where registration opens at 8:30. The longest course is approximately 6 km for men; women run 2 km, while youth courses range from 300 m to 1,500 m. The race is run on grass, and spikes are suitable. Categories start in sequence so everyone can make it to Sunday lunch, and the results are announced shortly after the last men’s category finishes.
course_highlights: A run on grass at the swimming pool complex
Longest course approximately 6 km for men; 2 km for women
Categories start in sequence with minimal gaps
additional: Registration opens at 8:30 by the swimming pool. Categories start in sequence with the shortest possible gaps so everyone can make it to Sunday lunch. Spikes suitable for grass are used. The races are open to the general public, with the start at 9:30 and registration from 8:30 at the swimming pool. Courses are suitable for all age groups.

name: Lesní běh Říčany XCR
location: Říčany, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Lesní běh Říčany XCR is a popular forest race held in Říčany, with courses suitable for all age groups, from children to veterans. The race takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region and offers courses of various lengths, including 11 km and 5.7 km for adults, on challenging forest trails with steep climbs. The event is intended not only for sports enthusiasts but also for families with children, who can enjoy shorter routes adapted to the participants’ ages. The organizer, Bežecký klub Říčany, invites everyone to enjoy an active day outdoors and take part in this traditional event.
course_highlights: Forest terrain with natural trails and steep climbs
Courses available for all age groups, from children to veterans
Adult course distances of 11 km and 5.7 km
additional: The race is part of the Pohár Ladova kraje, offers courses of various lengths, and is suitable for families with children. It is scheduled for October 11, 2026.

name: Běh na Strandu
location: Stránská skála, Brno-Slatině, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Běh na Strandu is a distinctive uphill running race held at Stránská skála in Brno-Slatina. Competitors start individually at one-minute intervals, allowing them to focus on the 450-metre course with 47 metres of elevation gain. The route follows a rocky and grassy path, and the race is divided into several age categories, from younger pupils to veterans. After finishing, runners must return their bib number. Results are announced after the last competitor finishes. Registration takes place on race day from 9:00 to 10:00, and the race starts at 10:01.
course_highlights: 450 m course with 47 m of elevation gain
Route along a rocky and grassy path
Individual starts at one-minute intervals
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 9:00 to 10:00. The bib number corresponds to the start time (for example, number 1 starts at 10:01). Runners must return their bib number after finishing. Results are announced after the last competitor finishes. The race takes place in October, starts between 9:00 and 10:00, and registration begins at 9:00. The entry fee is 50 Kč. The race is open to the general public, including children and adults.

name: Hrabenovský kros
location: Hrabenov u Šumperka, Šumperk, Czech Republic
description: Hrabenov Cross is a 7.47 km forest cross-country race with 200 metres of elevation gain, held in the picturesque surroundings of Hrabenov near Šumperk. The race is part of the Chlapácký běh series, which offers challenging cross-country courses in the area around Šumperk. It is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on natural terrain with significant elevation gain. The route runs through the forest and offers beautiful natural scenery and technically interesting terrain.
course_highlights: 7.47 km forest course
200 metres of elevation gain
Part of the Chlapácký běh series in and around Šumperk
additional: The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on natural terrain with a technically interesting profile. It takes place in October 2026.

name: Slavkovský lesík
location: Fotbalové hřiště TJ Sokol Slavkov, Slavkov u Opavy, Opava, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Slavkovský lesík Cross-Country Run is a traditional race organized by TJ Opava, held in the picturesque woodland near Slavkov u Opavy. The race offers runners the chance to enjoy nature, varied terrain, and a relaxed sporting atmosphere. The start and registration take place by the TJ Sokol Slavkov football field, with the start traditionally at 10:00. The organizers invite all runners to take part and promise an enjoyable sporting experience.
course_highlights: Woodland terrain with varied surfaces
Start and finish by the TJ Sokol Slavkov football field
Traditional autumn date in October
additional: Registration opens at 8:30 by the TJ Sokol Slavkov football field. The race is open to the general public, and the organizers invite everyone to run for fun and enjoy a friendly atmosphere. Registration is through the ORIS system. The course follows woodland paths and is suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike.

name: Rozběháme (i) Klenčí
location: Klenčí pod Čerchovem, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Rozběháme Klenčí is a traditional running race set in the picturesque surroundings of Klenčí pod Čerchovem in the Plzeň Region. The race offers runners of all ages and abilities the chance to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and the region’s beautiful countryside. Results and rankings are carefully tracked, and the race is part of the wider Běžec Chodska series. The organizers welcome all runners and provide high-quality event facilities.
course_highlights: Various course distances, including 5 km and 10 km
Running in the picturesque surroundings of Klenčí pod Čerchovem
Races for different age groups and ability levels
additional: The event is part of the Běžec Chodska 2024 series, includes various distances and terrain, and has a strong community atmosphere.

name: Z Dobřichovic na Šraňk
location: Dobřichovice, Prague-West District, Czech Republic
description: From Dobřichovice to Šraňk is a 3.7 km uphill race with 280 metres of elevation gain, part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series. This run offers a challenging course with a significant climb, ideal for fans of mountain running and outdoor challenges. The race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Dobřichovice and is suitable for runners who want to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain. Come and enjoy the race atmosphere and push your limits at this traditional event.
course_highlights: Course distance: 3.7 km
Elevation gain: 280 m
Part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series
additional: The course follows the blue trail uphill to the ridge. The race is low-budget, with no changing rooms and luggage storage only. The entry fee is 20 CZK. The race offers the opportunity to be admired by slower runners and to have your photo taken for the website.
